english: ~z~You're the boss, it ain't like I'm working for free.
zh: ~z~你是老板，我好像也不是白干。

english: ~z~You ain't gonna be happy about everything you get told to do, are ya?
zh: ~z~别人吩咐你做的事哪有能让你满意的。

english: ~z~There's something wrong about you. Get out of the truck real slow.
zh: ~z~你们不太对劲。慢慢从车上下——来。

english: ~z~That wasn't a successful operation by any way you look at it.
zh: ~z~怎么看都不是一次成功的行动。

english: ~z~Fuck you, I ain't. I just keep thinking these choppers is following me, that's all.
zh: ~z~去你妈的，不是。只是我经常觉得有直升机跟着，就这样。

english: ~z~I don't understand. Whatever you say.
zh: ~z~我听不懂。随你说吧。

english: ~z~You scan this thing for bugs?
zh: ~z~确认过车上没窃听器吗？

english: ~z~I don't let anyone in here until I get the word.
zh: ~z~接到指示之前，谁也别想过去。

english: ~z~You mean that someone in the family would see someone else going inside as an opportunity to get ahead?
zh: ~z~就是说有些家族成员会把别人被抓视为上升机会？

english: ~z~Damn, looks like these guys really want to hold onto the coke!
zh: ~z~我靠，看来他们真的不肯对这些可卡因放手！

english: ~z~I don't think I'd trust him to send me on another job after the shit he had me doing.
zh: ~z~就凭他让我做的那些事，我都不敢让他再给我一份活干。

english: ~z~You and me know it ain't gonna work.
zh: ~z~你我都知道行不通。

english: ~z~After all of that, you guys didn't even get the diamonds.
zh: ~z~事干了不少，结果钻石都没拿到。

english: ~z~That's the attitude.
zh: ~z~这态度没错。

english: ~z~I didn't pick you for a helicopter enthusiast.
zh: ~z~没想到你还是直升机爱好者啊。

english: ~z~I can't follow every order I'm given.
zh: ~z~我不可能服从一切命令。

english: ~z~Even Russian coke runners ain't that stupid.
zh: ~z~就算是俄国毒贩子也没那么蠢。

english: ~z~I don't speak English. Fuck off.
zh: ~z~我不说英语。滚蛋。

english: ~z~This is a down period, man. I haven't got anything for you.
zh: ~z~现在形势不好啊，伙计。我这儿没活给你。

english: ~z~Just like everyone else in this city. What's your deal?
zh: ~z~这里人不都一样吗。你这儿什么业务？

english: ~z~Fill your day with something other than killing.
zh: ~z~找点别的事做吧，别光顾着杀人。

english: ~z~Contact me on the outside line for more jobs.
zh: ~z~需要别的差事就用公共电话联系我。

english: ~z~A man loses taste for this kind of work after a time. I can't run that risk with a partner.
zh: ~z~这种活做太久就没意思了。我不能拿合伙人冒险。

english: ~z~The turkey flew the nest before we could have our thanksgiving dinner, brother. I hate to disappoint.
zh: ~z~感恩节晚餐都没吃，火鸡就飞回家了，兄弟。我也不想让人失望。

english: ~z~but you can't disappoint the client like you did last time.
zh: ~z~但你别像上次那样让委托人失望。

english: ~z~I'll give you the job. You need to be confident that it'll go smooth this time though.
zh: ~z~我会给你活的。不过你务必要保证这次能顺利完成。

english: ~z~Be cool, brother. Keep your senses alert and you might make retirement.
zh: ~z~保重，兄弟。保持警惕，说不定还能安稳退休。

english: ~z~People come to me when they need something handled.
zh: ~z~需要解决事务的时候，别人就来找我。

english: ~z~Tell the client that they don't need to worry.
zh: ~z~告诉委托人，他们不用再担心了。

english: ~z~Make sure they don't come back.
zh: ~z~确保他们有去无回。

english: ~z~You cannot leave them open like you did last time.
zh: ~z~可不能像上次那样放着不管。

english: ~z~Not many in this game cross that line. So long.
zh: ~z~至今为止，这行很少有人能越过那条线。

english: ~z~I am afraid those eggs got broken before we could make an omelet.
zh: ~z~恐怕鸭子还没煮熟，就已经飞走了。

english: ~z~I haven't got any jobs for you right now.
zh: ~z~现在我这儿没活给你。

english: ~z~Make this quiet.
zh: ~z~要悄无声息。

english: ~z~Understood... I'm a little on edge here. We got a real problem. Jimmy wants you to handle this.
zh: ~z~懂吗...我没有地位。我们有一个难题。吉米希望你去处理。

english: ~z~Great, I gotta go get noticed so I ain't a suspect.
zh: ~z~好，我去别的地方露露脸，省得被人怀疑。

english: ~z~I mean, I ain't raising them, and I ain't seeing them,
zh: ~z~我说，我可不会养着他们，更不会去看他们，

english: ~z~Can't be a close friend, know what I mean.
zh: ~z~别做亲密的朋友，想想我说的话。

english: ~z~Cause I been hearing things, things I don't like...
zh: ~z~因为我听到了一些事情，一些我不喜欢的事情...

english: ~z~You don't need to worry about the fat man singing. He's lost his voice.
zh: ~z~你不用担心那个胖子去告密了，他说不了话了。

english: ~z~I'm coming back to clip you, asshole. Don't worry about that.
zh: ~z~我会回来干掉你的，混蛋。不必担心。

english: ~z~I don't think so. You're pretty paranoid.
zh: ~z~我不这么想。你太多疑了。

english: ~z~You immigrant scumbag. In my prime I coulda turned you inside out.
zh: ~z~你是个卑鄙的偷渡客。我要是还年轻非把你干掉不可。

english: ~z~to tell the Commission that we're knocking off the Ancelottis' action.
zh: ~z~别让委员会知道我们在搅合安切洛蒂家族的生意。

english: ~z~but I'd like to think that when my ex-wife stops wanting to have me killed herself, maybe I'll be part of their lives.
zh: ~z~但我想，如果我前妻不再想要我自杀了，可能我会成为他们生活的一部分。

english: ~z~Cause I been hearing things, things I don't like, things will get someone hurt.
zh: ~z~因为我听到了一些事情，一些我不喜欢的事情，一些会给我们带来伤害的事情。

english: ~z~One lesson I've learnt, Niko. Assume everyone knows everything.
zh: ~z~我得到了一个教训，尼克。若要人不知，除非己莫为。

english: ~z~Chubby Charlie Matteo ain't someone you wanna piss off.
zh: ~z~肥佬查理･马泰奥不是你该惹的人。

english: ~z~You remember that sugar we borrowed... well the Russians ain't too pleased. They're convinced it was down to Jimmy.
zh: ~z~你还记得我们借来的毒品吗...俄国佬可不是很乐意。他们确信是吉米搞的鬼。

english: ~z~Otherwise you slip around the back, go in through the basement and fuck them up their asses.
zh: ~z~要不然，绕到他们后面，走地下室进去，爆了他们的菊花。

english: ~z~Every time. I don't want that. I got kids.
zh: ~z~每次都是。我不想这样。我有孩子。

english: ~z~Shit, Phil. The fat man is on his way to Algonquin. I couldn't get him.
zh: ~z~妈的，菲尔。胖子已经在去阿尔冈琴的路上了，我无能为力了。

english: ~z~Did you see a fuckin' helicopter on your way here?
zh: ~z~来的路上有没有看见直升机？

english: ~z~You ain't fit to lick my spats.
zh: ~z~你连给我擦鞋都不配。

english: ~z~Of course but they don't know that and we don't want them convincing the Ancelottis either.
zh: ~z~他们当然不知道，我们也不想他们说服那些安切洛蒂家的佬。

english: ~z~Maybe the ones who don't worry, act all crazy, maybe they get to the top for a bit, frighten a few people.
zh: ~z~可能那些人并不担心，行动却是很疯狂，也许他们达到了顶峰，吓到了一些人。

english: ~z~If you don't then it'll be the Pegorinos going to the mattresses with every one of the Liberty City families.
zh: ~z~如果干不掉他，就等于佩戈里诺家族和所有自由城的家族开战了。

english: ~z~It don't matter.
zh: ~z~无所谓。

english: ~z~This ain't good. I gotta tell Jimmy P.
zh: ~z~这可不好。我得告诉吉米 P。

english: ~z~Why do you think I put my neck on the line for you?
zh: ~z~你以为我为什么肯为你把头别在裤腰带上？

english: ~z~Then maybe you wouldn't have such problems with people turning state's.
zh: ~z~说不定你们就不用担心有人告密了。

english: ~z~Dammit, Niko. We can't do this with just two of us. I'm calling it off. Ciao.
zh: ~z~该死，尼克。光我们两个人不行，只能先取消了。再见。

english: ~z~A Fed don't care if he's taking someone down on a legitimate beef or if it's total bullshit.
zh: ~z~FIB不在乎抓人靠的是证据确凿还是一堆屁话。

english: ~z~Don't think about it. He fucked up today and he paid the price.
zh: ~z~别再想了。这次他搞砸了，就付出了代价。

english: ~z~You can if you do everything yourself. If you don't rely on anybody else.
zh: ~z~如果你自己做每件事你就能做到。如果你不依赖别人。

english: ~z~Yeah, call it a cooling off period. We took it, but we don't know who was watching it beforehand.
zh: ~z~是啊，算是种冷静期吧。货到手了，但不知道有没有被人盯上。

english: ~z~We can't let those Feds run the boss off the road, get them.
zh: ~z~不能让那些条子把老板的车掀翻，干掉他们。

english: ~z~It's just been sitting there?
zh: ~z~放那儿后就没动过？

english: ~z~Hey, let's see if we get back before you start talking like this, shall we?
zh: ~z~喂，这些有的没的等我们平安抵达了再说，好吗？

english: ~z~You and me are only here today because we didn't make the fuckup that Frankie did.
zh: ~z~你我现在还活着，是因为我们没像弗兰基那样把事搞砸。

english: ~z~Shit. Uncle Phil's gone forever. Don't tell the other guys you saw me crying, okay?
zh: ~z~妈的。菲尔叔叔永远走了。别告诉其他人你看到我哭了，好吗？

english: ~z~Shit, I don't know how much more of this I can take.
zh: ~z~妈的，我快要撑不住了。

english: ~z~Shit, I ain't made for this sort of stress. Can we lose the heat already?
zh: ~z~妈的，我要顶不住了。能不能快点甩掉条子？

english: ~z~But, Phil - and...
zh: ~z~不过，菲尔，其实...

english: ~z~You know, since you don't look like you're full of crap,
zh: ~z~你知道吗，你也不像是满嘴假话的人，

english: ~z~Damn, this is a wild ride. I didn't think I was gonna come outta that one.
zh: ~z~妈的，这次太惊险了。我还以为自己要没命了。

english: ~z~The Feds aren't learning their lesson, there's more of them.
zh: ~z~条子还没学乖，又来了一群。

english: ~z~You don't need to blame yourself.
zh: ~z~你不必自责。

english: ~z~You don't notice the fifty feds watching these cars?
zh: ~z~50个FIB盯着这些车都不知道？

english: ~z~how could I say no?
zh: ~z~我怎么能拒绝呢？

english: ~z~We don't got all day, come on.
zh: ~z~我们没时间了，快点。

english: ~z~You're fucking lucky that you did. Lucky any of us did.
zh: ~z~没死真的算你走运，活着的都走运。

english: ~z~I ain't seen a soul, boss. It's a ghost house.
zh: ~z~人影都没见着一个，老板。就一鬼屋。

english: ~z~We will fire if you fail to surrender what you are carrying.
zh: ~z~再不交出身上的东西就范，我们就要开枪了。

english: ~z~You got a wife, you got a ma, don't play around with your life.
zh: ~z~你娶了媳妇，上又有老母，别拿自己的命开玩笑。

english: ~z~As long as we don't see any helicopters, vans, suspicious gardeners talking into earpieces.
zh: ~z~只要我们没见着什么直升机啊、厢型车啊、可疑的园丁对着耳机讲电话啊，

english: ~z~Get a move on, we ain't sight seeing over here.
zh: ~z~快点走，我们不是来旅游的。

english: ~z~Enough of this chit-chat.
zh: ~z~别讲这些了。

english: ~z~Shit, we can't stash the stuff with the cops on our backs, lose 'em.
zh: ~z~妈的，我们不能背着警察把东西藏起来，扔了。

english: ~z~Don't play around with other people's lives either.
zh: ~z~也别拿别人的命开玩笑。

english: ~z~I've been telling Niko I got a lot on my mind.
zh: ~z~我跟尼克也说了，我顾不过来。

english: ~z~Gimme a break, man. I got a lot on my mind, you know?
zh: ~z~饶了我吧，伙计。我顾不过来，懂吗？

english: ~z~I don't want to take a bullet or a stint in the pen for anyone else's fuck up.
zh: ~z~我不想为别人的失误去蹲监狱或者挨枪子儿。

english: ~z~Next time, mind on the job. This ain't a fucking joke.
zh: ~z~下一次，多顾着点工作。别拿这事儿当儿戏。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. My half ain't in too good shape neither but I don't wanna tell the skip we lost it all. Ciao.
zh: ~z~妈的，尼克。我这份看起来也不太好，但我不想告诉老大我们全弄丢了。再见。

english: ~z~I don't feel comfortable with all these cops on us.
zh: ~z~警察一直在追，让我很不舒服。

english: ~z~Yeah, we put it in an isolated place, hopefully any attention it was getting would be noticed.
zh: ~z~对，我们故意找了个偏僻的地方，很容易知道货有没有被人盯上。

english: ~z~Maybe I can give you a call?
zh: ~z~有事我能不能电话找你？

english: ~z~I dunno, this don't feel right.
zh: ~z~不太对，感觉不太对。

english: ~z~I thought it was a wedding present for your nephew?
zh: ~z~不是送你侄子当新婚礼物了吗？

english: ~z~Maybe then you can spend time with your wife instead of some jailhouse bitch.
zh: ~z~否则你就到监狱里找婊子吧，有老婆也没用。

english: ~z~Phil, that stuff ain't around anymore. We lost it.
zh: ~z~菲尔，货没了，我们弄丢了。

english: ~z~I don't mean to take advantage, but...
zh: ~z~我不是想利用你，不过...

english: ~z~he can ask the bitch to take it out of the divorce settlement. Fucking cunt.
zh: ~z~不想要就让那个贱人从离婚协议里去掉啊。混蛋婊子。

english: ~z~He's my nephew through my ex-wife, I might give him work sometimes but I ain't gonna give him this load of horse.
zh: ~z~他是我前妻那边的侄子，我偶尔会找他干活，但绝不可能把这批海马送他。

english: ~z~I don't want to see a fucking picture. I'm trying to get us out of this situation.
zh: ~z~我他妈的不看。老子忙着摆脱条子追捕。

english: ~z~I didn't have much time to scope this out. My ma's kinda sick. I been looking after her.
zh: ~z~我没空盯着这边。我妈身体不好，一直是我照顾。

english: ~z~This ain't over until we got the H in a safe place.
zh: ~z~没把白粉送到安全的地方就还没结束。

english: ~z~God they ain't making it easy, are they?
zh: ~z~天哪，他们就是不肯放水是吧？

english: ~z~Can't these fucking Feds let up for a minute.
zh: ~z~这些屌毛条子就不能消停一会儿吗。

english: An enemy is nearby, turf cannot be taken over.
zh: 附近有敌人，无法占领地盘。

english: ~z~you and I don't know each other.
zh: ~z~你我之间互不相识。

english: ~z~You don't understand the way I suffer. I need to go in that park.
zh: ~z~你不明白咱受的什么苦，咱必须去公园。

english: ~z~I can't go on. Do it alone Niko.
zh: ~z~咱撑不住了，你自己上吧，尼克。

english: ~z~Niko, you're still in great shape. You work out?
zh: ~z~尼克，你身材保持得很不错啊，平常健身吗？

english: ~z~I thought we didn't know each other.
zh: ~z~不是说咱俩互不相识吗。

english: ~z~Forget about your hair, Florian.
zh: ~z~别说头发的事了，弗洛里安。

english: ~z~I knew you were the right person to call.
zh: ~z~咱就知道拜托你没错。

english: ~z~I'm going to kick the shit out of you.
zh: ~z~我会把你打到亲妈都不认识。

english: ~z~Sorry, love. You were born in the wrong century.
zh: ~z~抱歉了，亲爱的，你生不逢时啊。

english: ~z~I have to jog. How am I going to keep fit? One ounce of cellulite and Bryce will leave me.
zh: ~z~咱必须跑步，不然怎么保持身材？多一块赘肉布莱斯都会立马甩掉咱的。

english: ~z~I'm sorry, I just see him running and I need to grab him and just...
zh: ~z~对不起，我看着他跑步就想抓住他...

english: ~z~Flor... Bernie. Don't go jogging for a while. He's still out there.
zh: ~z~弗洛尔...伯尼。暂时先别去跑步了，他还在外面。

english: ~z~How can you say that? I thought you were different!
zh: ~z~你怎么能这么说？咱还以为你跟那些俗人不同！

english: ~z~We're going for a jog, Niko. Try to keep up. And stay back too, we don't want to be rumbled.
zh: ~z~咱们要准备跑步了，尼克。尽量跟上，但别跟太近，咱可不想被看出来。

english: ~z~~c~Don't be a fag.~s~
zh: ~z~~c~别跟个基佬一样。~s~

english: ~z~He's not going to come out if you're that close.
zh: ~z~你跟这么近他怎么会出来呢。

english: ~z~Niko, he got me. Where were you? I thought you were watching me?
zh: ~z~尼克，他打到我了。你在哪？你没有替我盯着吗？

english: ~z~I can't believe that Bryce hasn't ended things already. I'm disgusting.
zh: ~z~真不敢相信布莱斯还没把事情摆平，咱吐了。

english: ~z~I can't stand it. I gotta go.
zh: ~z~我受不了了，我得走了。

english: ~z~I can't get beaten up by boyfriends.
zh: ~z~我可不会被基佬们追上。

english: ~z~Oh shit. This wasn't meant to happen.
zh: ~z~哦靠，我不是有意的。

english: ~z~Nuh uh, honey. I'm going home.
zh: ~z~这不行，亲爱的。咱回家了。

english: ~z~Thanks a bunch Niko.
zh: ~z~非常感谢，尼克。

english: ~z~The haters are trying to kill me... I can't stand it.
zh: ~z~有仇同者想杀咱...咱受不了了。

english: ~z~I wish people would just accept me for who I am, you know, the good and the bad?
zh: ~z~咱只希望别人能接受咱的为人，你懂吗？优点和缺点都是。

english: ~z~We can't let him lose us, sweetie.
zh: ~z~咱们不能让他跑了，亲爱的。

english: ~z~I keep thinking I'm being followed, and I don't know why.
zh: ~z~咱一直都觉得有人跟踪我，也不知道为什么。

english: ~z~Pick on someone else, bully.
zh: ~z~欺负别的人去，恶霸。

english: ~z~Go hold hands or something, leave me alone.
zh: ~z~你们自己去牵手吧，别来找我。

english: ~z~Don't drop your diet muffins, people.
zh: ~z~别把松饼弄掉了，伙计。

english: ~z~He's got away. We ain't gonna catch him.
zh: ~z~他跑掉了。我们现在抓不了他了。

english: ~z~You thought this was going to be easy, didn't you?
zh: ~z~你以为我好欺负，不是吗？

english: ~z~Sometimes I think it's a godsend that Bryce has to go back to his wife for the night instead of sleeping with me.
zh: ~z~有时咱都觉得布莱斯晚上回去不跟咱睡跟老婆睡已经是万幸了。

english: ~z~I don't know.
zh: ~z~不知道。

english: ~z~I don't take it lying down, hater.
zh: ~z~咱可不会轻易倒下，死仇同。

english: ~z~That's cool. But listen...
zh: ~z~不用谢，但是听着...

english: ~z~It takes hours of plucking and buffing before I can even bear to look at myself.
zh: ~z~咱得花好几小时化妆、抛光，不然咱自己都不敢看咱的脸。

english: ~z~Hold back the tears, Florian. Wait until we get this guy.
zh: ~z~别急着哭，弗洛里安。等我们抓住他再哭。

english: ~z~Niko, this isn't working sweetie. Either the hater has seen us and he'll stay away.
zh: ~z~尼克，这样不管用啊，甜心。要么他发现咱俩然后走掉。

english: ~z~I need an ice pack Niko, but get that guy first!
zh: ~z~咱需要个冰袋，尼克。不过先抓住那家伙！

english: ~z~This soldier's out of action. Finish the mission without him.

zh: ~z~本来我以为花花公子会关照一下我，但他都不接我电话。那混蛋不想管我的事。

english: ~z~I didn't mean it. Girl get lonely when her man's inside for a long time.
zh: ~z~我不是故意的。男人在里面待太久的话，他的女人会寂寞的。

english: ~z~Yeah. Especially when the present has turned into an asshole.
zh: ~z~确实。在这种人心不古的时代就更难了。

english: ~z~Ain't shit to say.
zh: ~z~没什么好说的。

english: ~z~Don't kill me. I know I fucked Dwayne over real bad but he wouldn't want me dead.
zh: ~z~别杀我。我知道我把德维恩骗得很惨，但他不会想要我死的。

english: ~z~He too much of a gentleman for that. He ain't like that Playboy X punk, he's only chasing paper.
zh: ~z~他很仁慈，不会下手的。他只想要钱，不像花花公子X那个混蛋。

english: ~z~But I ain't there yet.
zh: ~z~但我还不能死。

english: ~z~Dwayne, I couldn't get the money. Jayvon gave me the slip.
zh: ~z~德维恩，我没能拿到钱。杰丰跑掉了。

english: ~z~You slept Cherise? She were a bitch, weren't she?
zh: ~z~你杀了谢丽丝？她就是个婊子，不是吗？

english: ~z~Uh, look, man, don't bother.
zh: ~z~呃，听着，兄弟，不麻烦你了。

english: ~z~I had to explain things to them. They didn't listen so good.
zh: ~z~我必须给他们解释清楚，但他们没怎么听。

english: ~z~He swears he wasn't involved in me going down, but I knew.
zh: ~z~他发誓他和我被逮捕无关，但我知道。

english: ~z~Not much. How are you doing?
zh: ~z~就那样了。你怎么样？

english: ~z~Dwayne, one of the guys who runs that gentlemen's club got away. I couldn't get control of it for you.
zh: ~z~德维恩， 其中一个绅士俱乐部的经理跑掉了。我没能替你把店夺回来。

english: ~z~Big time, but we'll talk about that later.
zh: ~z~欠了很多，不过以后再说。

english: ~z~Nah, fuck that.
zh: ~z~不，算了吧。

english: ~z~Now, I ain't shit.
zh: ~z~现在，我屁都不是。

english: ~z~He's in the back but he don't wanna be troubled.
zh: ~z~就那后面，但现在他不想被人烦。

english: ~z~Playboy ain't gonna be happy.
zh: ~z~花花公子不会高兴的。

english: ~z~Come on man, stop being so miserable. What did you lose?
zh: ~z~拜托，兄弟，别这么消沉了。你失去了什么？

english: ~z~I got a piece back here. It ain't worth it.
zh: ~z~我这儿可有真家伙。别抠门了。

english: ~z~I won't have no bitches calling me bitch, bitch.
zh: ~z~你一婊子还敢叫我婊子，臭婊子。

english: ~z~Alright, you've been a help, but I don't need you no more.
zh: ~z~好了，你们帮了我很多，但现在可以退下了。

english: ~z~Alright, stick to me and we should be okay. Come on.
zh: ~z~好了，跟紧我，我们会没事的。来吧。

english: ~z~Thanks for your help but you aren't needed no more.
zh: ~z~多谢你们配合，但现在可以退下了。

english: ~z~Alright, we had some fun, yeah? Now go get back to your wife and kids.
zh: ~z~好了，我们很爽不是？现在回家陪老婆孩子去吧。

english: ~z~It stops you caring, which is even better.
zh: ~z~比那还要好，能让你漠不关心。

english: ~z~Fucking coward would rather everyone go down than him take a fall alone.
zh: ~z~傻逼儿子，宁可大家一起完蛋，也不肯自己一个人坐牢。

english: ~z~I ain't a man of principle...
zh: ~z~我也不是有原则的人...

english: ~z~Good, yeah... alive or dead, it's all the same though, isn't it?
zh: ~z~好啊，确实...是死是活，其实都差不多，不是吗？

english: ~z~Sure. I mean... I ain't a saint...
zh: ~z~当然。我是说...我不是圣人...

english: ~z~Looks like you'll need more than that.
zh: ~z~不过看来你不止需要被拉一把。

english: ~z~Bucky didn't make it to the rest of his guys. There was an accident.
zh: ~z~巴基没能回到余下同伙那儿。出了点事故。

english: ~z~Okay, don't get sanctimonious on me.
zh: ~z~好了，别跟我这装高尚了。

english: ~z~Go check it out, but make sure his boys are there, I want them all to pay.
zh: ~z~过去看看，不过务必确保他的手下也在，~n~我要让他们全部付出代价。

english: ~z~Living, dead, good, bad, right, wrong, chalk, cheese...
zh: ~z~是死，是活，是好，是坏，是对，是错，是是，是非...

english: ~z~Take charge of her, won't ya Niko.
zh: ~z~差不多该上舰了，尼克。

english: ~z~That ain't good news. Take me back to land.
zh: ~z~这可不是好消息。送我回岸上。

english: ~z~It's like fucking Cain and Abel the two of us. No wonder I turned into the wreck you see before ya.
zh: ~z~我们俩就像该隐跟亚伯。也难怪我会变成你见过的那副熊样。

english: ~z~Shit, can't they let us go about our activities in peace.
zh: ~z~妈的，他们就不能让我们安安稳稳做点生意。

english: ~z~Shit, I think he ain't gonna last much longer.
zh: ~z~妈的，我看他撑不了多久了。

english: ~z~I don't give a shit as long as it keeps me in brown, you know.
zh: ~z~我也不管这么多，能让我打海洛因就行，懂吧。

english: ~z~Don't tell me you dropped something overboard.
zh: ~z~别跟我说你在船上落东西了。

english: ~z~I wouldn't know.
zh: ~z~我不会知道的。

english: ~z~Fuck, that boat ain't looking too fresh.
zh: ~z~妈的，那艘船看着可不怎么新。

english: ~z~Yeah. So Aiden got caught with something when he was somewhere he wasn't meant to be.
zh: ~z~对。然后艾登在不该在的地方带着东西被抓了。

english: ~z~I don't reckon he's gonna hold up much longer.
zh: ~z~我看他撑持不了多久了。

english: ~z~If the shoe fits, Niko. If the bloody shoe fits.
zh: ~z~只能这么解释了，尼克。就没别的解释。

english: ~z~I don't reckon this vessel will hold up much longer.
zh: ~z~我看这船撑持不了多久了。

english: ~z~Good thing the DTs ain't come in yet.
zh: ~z~还好戒断反应还没上来。

english: ~z~Needless to say, he'll be inside for a time. Him and Bucky think I talked.
zh: ~z~想都不用想，他肯定得进去一段时间。他和巴基觉得是我告发的。

english: ~z~Me brothers were right to trust ya, Niko.
zh: ~z~我的兄弟没看错人，尼克。

english: ~z~McRearys don't fuck about.
zh: ~z~我们麦克雷里家的人不闹着玩。

english: ~z~Maybe Frankie has been tapping Ma's fucking phone and he called this in to mess with me.
zh: ~z~说不定弗兰基这厮一直在偷听妈的电话，这群人就是他派来搞我的。

english: ~z~Shit. They're on the coastline. Can't even dock here.
zh: ~z~妈的。他们上了海岸线。这里都没法靠岸。

english: ~z~Jesus, helicopters ain't my idea of fun.
zh: ~z~老天，直升机这种玩意我可不喜欢。

english: ~z~It ain't personal.
zh: ~z~这不是私人恩怨。

english: ~z~I wasn't prepared for this type of attack.
zh: ~z~这种打法我可没料到。

english: ~z~Could be a coincidence anyway.
zh: ~z~只是凑巧也说不定。

english: ~z~That's all you can hope for in this God forsaken world. See you round, Niko.
zh: ~z~在这个被神抛弃的世界也没别的指望了。回头见，尼克。

english: ~z~I didn't think he even knew I was back. Can't the man just let his brother be?
zh: ~z~我都没想到他居然知道我回来了。这家伙就不能放他兄弟一马吗？

english: ~z~I'd rather swim home tonight than come back tomorrow to dive for those notes.
zh: ~z~我宁可今晚游泳回家，也不要明天再来捞钱。

english: ~z~I don't give a shit if this thing sinks, we got to protect him.
zh: ~z~我他妈才不管这条船的死活，能保住金就行。

english: ~z~Don't worry Kim, we're looking after you.
zh: ~z~别担心，金，有我们保护你。

english: ~z~I don't know. I told my dealer I was good for the money I owed him.
zh: ~z~不知道。我跟卖我毒品的人说过我很快就能把欠他的钱还上了。

english: ~z~Don't put all the pay off up your arm, Derrick.
zh: ~z~别把这些钱全部花在给自己扎针上，德里克。

english: ~z~Doesn't look like the arrival of these notes was such a secret. Can you think of why that is?
zh: ~z~走私钞票的消息好像保密不够到位嘛？你知道咋回事吗？

english: ~z~Don't leave him alone out there, Niko.
zh: ~z~别把他一个人扔在那儿，尼克。

english: ~z~Nice scam if you don't hit the same place too often. His boys are pulling the same gig over here.
zh: ~z~不盯着一个地方洗就不会被发现。他的人要在这里来这套。

english: ~z~I thought you was taking me to the coast? See ya, man.
zh: ~z~你不是说要送我去海边吗？回见，老兄。

english: ~z~Is that because he's coming into the country to rob the good people of America of their hard earned money?
zh: ~z~是不是因为他入境也是来掠夺美国好人的血汗钱的？

english: ~z~They ain't gonna try that again.
zh: ~z~他们不会想再来一次的。

english: ~z~From what I hear, Aiden still rants about me to anyone who'll listen.
zh: ~z~我听说，艾登现在还在跟别人抹黑我。

english: ~z~I haven't felt safe since Aiden O'Malley went inside.
zh: ~z~自从艾登･奥马利进局子以后，我就没觉得安全过。

english: ~z~I wouldn't fuck with you, Niko.
zh: ~z~我以后不会惹你的，尼克。

english: ~z~Don't shoot Kim. The fucking notes might catch fire.
zh: ~z~别朝金打，钞票会着火的。

english: ~z~I ain't burnt out yet.
zh: ~z~我这把老骨头还没垮呢。

english: ~z~Yeah, got a bit hairy out there. Good thing you have your sea legs.
zh: ~z~确实，出了点小意外。还好你不会晕船。

english: ~z~What's happening out there? I didn't think you had many friends left.
zh: ~z~出海干什么？我还以为你没剩下几个朋友了。

english: ~z~Sure, I been telling a few people about this, but, hell, I smell a rat.
zh: ~z~的确，我有跟别人说过这事。不过，妈的，肯定是有人泄密。

english: ~z~He's earning that money alright.
zh: ~z~他这钱挣得可真不容易。

english: ~z~They shouldn't a messed with you.
zh: ~z~他们就不该招惹你。

english: ~z~Jesus, Niko. Don't let him hang like this.
zh: ~z~老天，尼克。别让他就这么晾在那儿。

english: ~z~Counterfeits. They look so good you wouldn't spot 'em in a month of Sundays.
zh: ~z~就是假钞。成色很好，仔细看都看不出来。

english: ~z~You're illegal, right? You think us McRearys was legal when we came here?
zh: ~z~你是非法移民，对吧？你以为我们麦克雷里家族刚来这儿的时候就是合法公民吗？

english: ~z~Kim ain't looking too good.
zh: ~z~金的状况看着不太妙。

english: ~z~I ain't going for a swim with ya, Niko. Later on.
zh: ~z~我才不陪你游泳呢，尼克。回头见。

english: ~z~It's about bloody time. I been in there doing a stretch I didn't deserve for too long.
zh: ~z~也该到时候了。我在里面蹲了太久本不该蹲的牢。

english: ~z~I got a bad feeling about this.
zh: ~z~我对此有不好的感觉。

english: ~z~But it ain't like I'm going to put a weapon in his hand just so I can pop him, is it? You do what you got to do.
zh: ~z~可我也不能为了崩了他，先塞把枪到他手上，对吧？该怎么做你就怎么做。

english: ~z~Don't think about it, man, he was a rat. I don't believe a word he said about Derrick. He's fish food.
zh: ~z~别想了，老兄，他就是个叛徒。他说德里克的话我一个字都不信。他已经喂鱼了。

english: ~z~She stopped writing and coming on visiting days but I could tell she was still thinking of me. I knew it.
zh: ~z~她确实不给我写信也不来探监了，不过她一定还想着我。我就知道。

english: ~z~Or doing a kind turn for someone who's helped you out in the past. That's what this is about, isn't it?
zh: ~z~又或是帮一个从前帮过你的人一把。这趟就是这个意思，不是吗？

english: ~z~I ain't gonna be around much longer at this rate. Fucking help me!
zh: ~z~再这样下去我可撑不住。快他妈支援我。

english: ~z~Let alone eaten another prison meal or taken another fucking shower.
zh: ~z~更别说再吃一顿牢饭、再洗一次他妈的澡了。

english: ~z~They ain't gonna break this perp out on our watch.
zh: ~z~有我们在，他们别想救走这个囚犯。

english: ~z~Don't let them get this perp outta here.
zh: ~z~别让他们把犯人劫走。

english: ~z~Good, because I couldn't catch the prison van.
zh: ~z~那就好，因为我可赶不上囚车。

english: ~z~Derrick? But he ratted me out.
zh: ~z~德里克？不就是他把我卖了的吗？

english: ~z~put all this crap to bed...
zh: ~z~能和过去告别...

english: ~z~I don't want to die, I've been rotting in prison for years. I don't want to die.
zh: ~z~我不想死，我都在监狱里烂了这么多年了。我不想死。

english: ~z~He's the reason I ended up in that place to start with, the spineless...
zh: ~z~一开始我会进去就是因为他，这没骨气的...

english: ~z~Christ, we can't make him disappear now.
zh: ~z~上帝啊，现在我们没法让他消失了。

english: ~z~Get rid of this attention, Niko. We don't want anyone after us while we're doing what we gotta do.
zh: ~z~摆脱通缉，尼克。我们可不想在做正事的时候被人追着。

english: ~z~That wasn't about getting out, that was pay back.
zh: ~z~那不只是为了出来，那是报仇。

english: ~z~Why don't we just kill the fucker there and then?
zh: ~z~干嘛不直接当场宰了那逼？

english: ~z~Fuck, boys. I ain't doing too good over here.
zh: ~z~我操。这边情况不太妙。

english: ~z~Lose 'em before I lose my fucking mind, okay?
zh: ~z~趁我还没疯之前甩掉他们，好吗？

english: ~z~We ain't letting this one get away.
zh: ~z~我们不会让他跑掉的。

english: ~z~I knew I wasn't forgotten about.
zh: ~z~我就知道我还没被抛弃。

english: ~z~Who knows where I'm heading but it ain't Alderney. Maybe I'll go west. Follow the setting sun.
zh: ~z~谁知道我要去哪儿，反正不是奥尔德尼。也许往西走，追着落日走。

english: ~z~He's the reason I ended up in that place to start with, the spineless...
zh: ~z~一开始我会进去就是因为他，这没骨气的...

english: ~z~This ain't my idea of fun, boys. Would ya give me a hand?
zh: ~z~这跟我那种乐子不太一样，小子。麻烦您老帮个忙好吗？

english: ~z~The cops is gonna know it wasn't a prison break when they find Aiden. Shit. I'll call Derrick.
zh: ~z~条子找到艾登就会发现这不是一次劫狱了。操。我给德里克打个电话。

english: ~z~Derrick? But he ratted me out.
zh: ~z~德里克？不就是他把我卖了的吗？

english: ~z~I don't think I coulda spent another night in the joint.
zh: ~z~我觉得我可能熬不过牢里的下一个晚上了。

english: ~z~I don't know that I got off so lightly.
zh: ~z~我倒不觉得自己有多轻松。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. Will you handle these boys?
zh: ~z~我操，尼克。你能不能解决这些人啊？

english: ~z~Shit, I don't even know who sent you guys. Who do I got to thank for springing me from the joint?
zh: ~z~靠，都不知道你们是谁派的。我要感谢哪位大哥出手相助？

english: ~z~Alright, man. We're coming to ya. Take out the escort but keep Derrick's pal alive.
zh: ~z~好的，兄弟。我这边快到了。干掉护卫，但别伤着德里克的旧友。

english: ~z~I nearly gave up hoping. I nearly lost faith.
zh: ~z~我差点就不抱希望了。差点失去信念。

english: ~z~For the grace of God, all but for the grace of God I coulda died in there.
zh: ~z~托上帝的福，要不是上帝保佑，我就死在里面了。

english: ~z~You don't trust these guys you're doing the deal with, how come you trust me?
zh: ~z~你都不相信那些跟你交易的人，怎么还信得过我？

english: ~z~For one, I won't have to listen to him talk.
zh: ~z~至少我不用听他扯淡了。

english: ~z~Mallorie was right about you. You are good. I have some more work for you.
zh: ~z~玛洛丽说的没错，你很棒。我还有更多工作给你。

english: ~z~and I can't, in good consciousness, help him...
zh: ~z~而且说实话，我也没法帮他...

english: ~z~Maybe I was too busy saving your ass to clean up your mess? Sue me.
zh: ~z~可能是我忙着救你的命，没空收拾残局？你打我啊。

english: ~z~You didn't give them the chance to do the deal.
zh: ~z~你都没有给他们交易的机会。

english: ~z~Nah? You sound like you coming outta Russia with that accent. That all good, money.
zh: ~z~不是吗？听口音你像是俄罗斯出来的。也没事，老弟。

english: ~z~There ain't a deal in this town I don't know about. I own this city, for real.
zh: ~z~这座城市里就没有我不知道的交易。城市是我的，真的。

english: ~z~You take a bid on a heroin beef you ain't seeing light for a long time.
zh: ~z~一旦被卷入海洛因的交易，你就得过上好久暗无天日的生活了。

english: ~z~Shit, I don't know, all type of shit.
zh: ~z~靠，我也不知道，各种玩意吧。

english: ~z~I don't go near the stuff... professionally... but I found him a buyer.
zh: ~z~我不卖那玩意...说真的...但我帮他找了个买家。

english: ~z~Elizabeta don't get me to do shit. I just like to keep an eye on things.
zh: ~z~不是伊丽莎贝塔叫我去做事。我只是想盯着情况。

english: ~z~I like to make money, but there should be other considerations when you go into business with a person.
zh: ~z~我喜欢赚钱，但你和别人做生意应该还有其他考量吧。

english: ~z~Playboy X don't like coming that close to being taken down.
zh: ~z~花花公子X可不喜欢命悬一线的感觉。

english: ~z~It's like extra large as well. All type of bitches be calling me that, yeah.
zh: ~z~也代表XL的尺码。所有母狗都那么说我，没错。

english: ~z~This making me uncomfortable. Where're you?
zh: ~z~这让我很不舒服。你在哪呢？

english: ~z~This is a cash deal. I got other shit going down as well.
zh: ~z~都是钱的事儿。别的生意我也有做。

english: ~z~Playboy was a fool, but he earned. This ain't good. Come back to see me.
zh: ~z~花花公子是个傻子，但是他能挣钱。这可不好。快回来找我。

english: ~z~Don't want to even look at him the wrong way, crazy motherfucker.
zh: ~z~没事都不敢看他一眼，狗逼疯子。

english: ~z~You ain't right, friend, come on... let's get out of here.
zh: ~z~你不对劲，朋友，好了...咱们快走吧。

english: ~z~I ain't doing a bid for this shit. Stick to me, player.
zh: ~z~我可没为这鸟事投保，跟紧我，玩家。

english: ~z~Only this commodity is illegal.
zh: ~z~只是这种商品是非法的。

english: ~z~Gimme them digits, we see if we can make shit happen.
zh: ~z~给我你的号码，说不定以后我们能干成些大事。

english: ~z~But you are a drug pusher?
zh: ~z~不过你确实是个毒贩吧？

english: ~z~Not much. Let's do this.
zh: ~z~一般。我们开始吧。

english: ~z~He showed me some shit back in the day but shit...
zh: ~z~当年他确实教了我不少玩意，不过...

english: ~z~Hey, you ready?
zh: ~z~嘿，准备好没？

english: ~z~The deal didn't happen, Elizabeta.
zh: ~z~交易没能成功，伊丽莎贝塔。

english: ~z~You obviously ain't been big time. I started small like you, player.
zh: ~z~你之前肯定还不够格。刚开始我也是小喽啰，玩家。

english: ~z~LCPD. Freeze motherfucker. I said freeze.
zh: ~z~LCPD。不许动混蛋，都不许动。

english: ~z~The deal didn't go so good. Charlie was an undercover cop.
zh: ~z~交易不太顺利。查理是个卧底警察。

zh: 素未谋面的朋友

english: ~z~Don't be ridiculous. You're being paranoid.
zh: ~z~别胡扯了，是你想多了吧。

english: ~z~There has to be more than one truck around here.
zh: ~z~这附近肯定不止一辆卡车。

english: ~z~Hey, you got bad information, brother.
zh: ~z~嘿，你的情报不行啊，兄弟。

english: ~z~Don't kill me, man. I'll show you.
zh: ~z~别杀我，伙计，我这就给你看。

english: ~z~Are you carrying a shipment of TVs?
zh: ~z~你运的是不是一批电视？

english: ~z~I pulled over a van, it didn't have any TVs in it.
zh: ~z~我拦住了一辆面包车，但车里并没有电视。

english: ~z~Can't you be a bit more specific than South Broker?
zh: ~z~你就不能比南布洛克更具体一点吗？

english: ~z~I don't want to, man. I'm shitting myself.
zh: ~z~我不想出来，老弟。我都要吓出屎了。

english: ~z~but you've got to get them for us so we can make the sale.
zh: ~z~不过你必须帮我们把货搞到手，然后我们才能去交易。

english: ~z~Show me the back. You carrying TVs?
zh: ~z~让我看下后面，是不是装了电视？

english: ~z~Show me you don't got any flatscreens in the back.
zh: ~z~让我看看后面有没有电视。

english: ~z~Man, I ain't picked up shipment yet.
zh: ~z~伙计，我都还没装上货呢。

english: ~z~You have the shipment already? You are good.
zh: ~z~你货已经到手了吗？挺不错啊。

english: ~z~Listen, I don't got insurance.
zh: ~z~听着，我没有保险。

english: ~z~Don't be an idiot.
zh: ~z~别犯傻。

english: ~z~I'd do it quick, Roman don't look too good.
zh: ~z~我得速战速决，罗曼看起来不太好。

english: ~z~They don't care about him. All they care about is making money.
zh: ~z~他们不在乎他的死活，只会关心如何赚钱。

english: ~z~He's ok. A little scarred, but ok. You did good. Mikhail needs someone like you.
zh: ~z~他很好，有点伤痕，但没啥大碍。你做得不错。米哈伊尔需要像你这样的人。

english: ~z~Be more specific. How many vans you think there are in South Broker?
zh: ~z~再具体点。你不想想南布洛克有多少面包车？

english: ~z~Stop shooting people, you maniac!
zh: ~z~别乱射了，你个疯子！

english: ~z~You shouldn't have brought them here, Andrei.
zh: ~z~ 你不该带他们来这里，安德烈。

english: ~z~Your cousin will only be alright when Mr. Faustin has that van. Go and get it for him.
zh: ~z~只有福斯汀先生得到那辆货车你的堂兄才会没事。快去给他弄来。

english: ~z~My wife don't like when people shout!
zh: ~z~我老婆不喜欢别人大吼大叫！

english: ~z~I'm dead if I lose this shipment.
zh: ~z~要是丢了这批货，我的人头就不保了。

english: ~z~-Shut the fuck up!~n~-He's just screaming that's it!
zh: ~z~－让丫闭嘴！~n~－他就是要叫，没办法！

english: ~z~You ain't taking these.
zh: ~z~你别想拿走这些货。

english: ~z~I ain't losing this.
zh: ~z~这货我不能丢。

english: ~z~-Roman, shut up!~n~-I can't make him shut up!
zh: ~z~－罗曼，别叫了！~n~－我没法让他闭嘴！

english: ~z~Dimitri, I couldn't get you that shipment.
zh: ~z~迪米特里，那批货我弄不到了。

english: ~z~I wouldn't do this, Kenny Petrovic is looking after this truck.
zh: ~z~我不会这么做的，肯尼･彼得罗维奇还罩着这车呢。

english: ~z~We had to gag him, to stop the screaming.
zh: ~z~我们只能堵住他的嘴，好不让他叫。

english: ~r~The fare was lost.
zh: ~r~这单没了。

english: ~z~Yes, but you've angered the wrong people.
zh: ~z~不错，但是你惹怒了不该惹的人。

english: ~z~Don't think I cannot see through you.
zh: ~z~别以为老子看不透你。

english: ~z~This ain't right.
zh: ~z~这样可不对。

english: ~z~You got some money for Mr. Faustin?
zh: ~z~钱有没有给福斯汀先生准备好？

english: ~z~that I am a man who appreciates a good business venture when one comes along.
zh: ~z~我是个不会放过任何摆在眼前的上好商机的人。

english: ~z~It wasn't always like this. Mikhail was a great man. He had a temper, but he was fair.
zh: ~z~以前不是这样的，米哈伊尔是个好人。他脾气不好，但他很公正。

english: ~z~~c~Mikhail... I know you didn't mean it. That's alright.
zh: ~z~~c~米哈伊尔...我知道你不是那个意思，也行。

english: ~z~Fine, here you go. We ain't gonna have the...
zh: ~z~好，给你，我们也不想...

english: ~z~At least he's alive, eh? Mikhail don't always go for the gut shots.
zh: ~z~至少他还活着，嗯？米哈伊尔不是每次都朝肚子打的。

english: ~z~Alright, you don't look like a cop. Buy what you want.
zh: ~z~好吧，你不像是条子，想买就买吧。

english: ~z~You can't even hit him in the leg. He has learned at least. Let's go.
zh: ~z~你一点也不能打他的腿，你看他至少知道了轻重，我们走吧

english: ~z~I didn't kill Joseph, we will make more money with him alive.
zh: ~z~我没杀掉约瑟夫，他活着我们还能大捞特捞。

english: ~z~This guy been making porno in his basement and he didn't cut Mikhail in.
zh: ~z~这家伙在他的地下室拍毛片，还不给米哈伊尔分账。

english: ~z~You need to control yourself, you could become like Mikhail.
zh: ~z~你要控制住自己，不然就会变得跟米哈伊尔一样了。

english: ~z~You guys are getting protection money off of websites now? What, you stop them from getting viruses?
zh: ~z~你们现在还要收网站的保护费了吗？怎么，交了钱就不会中病毒？

english: ~z~Don't fuck around in here.
zh: ~z~别他妈在这儿乱搞。

english: ~z~I'm just in this for the bitches, I don't wanna get hurt! Please. Please. Come on.
zh: ~z~我只是为了那些婊子，我并不想伤到谁！拜托拜托，走啊。

english: ~z~Wasn't always like this though. Things got to him.
zh: ~z~以前他不是这样的。只是遇上了各种各样的事。

english: ~z~I got some bad news, Mr. Faustin. Dimitri's gone.
zh: ~z~我有一个坏消息，福斯汀先生。迪米特里没了。

english: ~z~Please, go get us some wheels. I haven't the energy.
zh: ~z~拜托，去给我们弄辆车来，我没那力气。

english: ~z~Shit, he'll be outta action for a couple a weeks.
zh: ~z~操，他得有几个星期没法下床了。

english: ~z~I'm special. I'm different.
zh: ~z~我很特别。我不一样。

english: ~z~I take it you won't be joining us?
zh: ~z~我就当你不一起来了？

english: ~z~Fuck! You're lucky Roman don't try to make you kill someone every two seconds.
zh: ~z~操！罗曼没有隔两秒就让你去杀个人真是你的福气。

english: ~z~Hey man, please? Go easy on me. Come on, big guy?
zh: ~z~嘿，伙计，拜托？别那么生气。好啦，大块头？

english: ~z~It doesn't matter that it's online.
zh: ~z~是不是网上的并不重要。

english: ~z~Dimitri... dead? How? This is impossible.
zh: ~z~迪米特里...死了？怎么死的？不可能吧。

english: ~z~Do you think that I am not to be obeyed? Come back to see me.
zh: ~z~你以为我是能被忤逆的人吗？再回来找我。

english: ~z~You don't know what I can do.
zh: ~z~你不会知道我能力多大。

english: ~z~Lay off that stuff.
zh: ~z~别吸那玩意了。

english: ~z~Guns don't seem that controlled. I seen plenty and I just got here.
zh: ~z~感觉枪也没管那么严啊，我刚到这里就见着一堆了。

english: ~z~You fuckin' Ruskies are milking me dry. I ain't a cow.
zh: ~z~你们这些狗逼俄国佬要把我榨干了，我又不是奶牛。

english: ~z~I ain't Russian.
zh: ~z~我也不是俄国人。

english: ~z~Fuck, why couldn't you make this easy? We're out of here, Niko.
zh: ~z~妈的，你们就不能少整点花活？我们走，尼克。

english: ~z~Don't kill me. I got a load of desperate fans on the internet.
zh: ~z~别杀我，我在网上有很多死忠粉。

english: ~z~If it wasn't for that, I'd say this weren't worth transferring to DVD.
zh: ~z~没有这个镜头，这片就没必要烧成碟了。

english: ~z~When I have to push people, it's "me".
zh: ~z~我必须得威逼别人的时候，就成「我」了。

english: ~z~Do you think that I am not to be obeyed? Come back to see me.
zh: ~z~你以为我是能被忤逆的人吗？再回来找我。

english: ~z~Shit, well now it looks like you got me to settle your business.
zh: ~z~操，不过看来现在你还有我能帮你处理事务。

english: ~z~I hope it don't get to me.
zh: ~z~希望不会让我遇上。

english: ~z~Funny. That ain't it. These guys are making the shit loads of cash,
zh: ~z~有趣。不是这样的，这些家伙赚了大把钞票，

english: ~z~I'm special, I'm gonna be a star. Don't hurt me. A big, big star!
zh: ~z~我很特别，我会成为明星的，别伤害我，我是一颗闪亮的明星！

english: ~z~ -Woah, woah... ~n~-and we won't know about it, huh?
zh: ~z~－喔，喔...~n~－还能不被我们知道，是吧？

english: ~z~and we ain't seein' any of it.
zh: ~z~结果我们一分都没见着。

english: ~z~I got something special in these pants, I need to show it to the world.
zh: ~z~我裤子里有个特别的东西，我还要向全世界展示它呢。

english: ~z~Listen, big guy. You got a great look going on, real strong. We could put you in one of our films.
zh: ~z~听着，大块头，你看起来很棒，力大无比，你可以来参演我们的片子。

english: ~z~We ain't making that much cash.
zh: ~z~我们也没赚多少钱。

english: ~z~I've angered people?
zh: ~z~我惹怒了别人？

english: ~z~Get out of the way.
zh: ~z~别挡路。

english: ~z~I told you to shoot him in the leg. It matters little. Let's get out of here.
zh: ~z~我都跟你说了你开枪打他的腿，不过都没关系了，我们赶紧走吧。

english: ~z~I guess Roman's real lucky then. I wonder what big favor Faustin's gonna do for him next?
zh: ~z~那我猜罗曼真的很走运了。不过你说福斯汀接下来会对他做什么？

english: ~z~if we don't start playing by the rules.
zh: ~z~不能再这样不按规矩胡闹了。

english: ~z~I can't die today. I'm special. I'm really special. I can show you...
zh: ~z~我现在不能死，我很特别、我真的很特别，我可以给你们看看...

english: ~z~Please don't hurt me, I'm an actor.
zh: ~z~求你别伤害我，我只是个演员。

english: ~z~Pleased to be of use.
zh: ~z~不胜荣幸。

english: ~z~Is that a fact? Maybe we can't pop you, Joseph. But we can fuck up one of your boys.
zh: ~z~这是事实吗？也许我们不能立刻崩了你，约瑟夫，但我们可以干死你的一个手下。

english: ~z~-but he didn't buy the pot.~n~-That's Lenny.
zh: ~z~－但他并没有买大麻。~n~－那是莱尼。

english: ~z~Faustin ain't nobody. Fuck off.
zh: ~z~福斯汀算个屁，去他妈的。

english: ~z~I cannot talk just now. Do what you have to do.
zh: ~z~我现在不方便说话，让你做你就做。

english: ~z~Keep it warm. I won't be too long.
zh: ~z~保持热情，我不会耽搁太久。

english: ~z~He's enough of a somebody to get you killed.
zh: ~z~至少他足以让你没命。

english: ~z~It could be you.
zh: ~z~是你也说不定。

english: ~z~-Mikhail, please, don't do this.~n~-Shut up.
zh: ~z~－米哈伊尔，拜托，别这么做。~n~－闭嘴。

english: ~z~-Why don't you listen?~n~-You want to play games?
zh: ~z~－你为什么不听？~n~－你想玩游戏吗？

english: ~z~Think? Look where your thinking has got us.
zh: ~z~想想？也不看看你的想想都让我们落到什么地步了。

english: ~z~Haven't you heard of my father, Kenny Petrovic?
zh: ~z~你没听说过我父亲肯尼･彼得罗维奇吗？

english: ~z~This isn't meant to be happening.
zh: ~z~不该有这种事的啊。

english: ~z~Making too much noise. This was inevitable.
zh: ~z~动静太大，避免不了的。

english: ~z~Don't question my loyalty.
zh: ~z~不要质疑我的忠诚。

english: ~z~Girls, can you give us a minute, huh?
zh: ~z~姑娘们，能不能给我们一点时间，哈？

english: ~z~-don't do this. ~n~-Go.
zh: ~z~－别这么做。~n~－去。

english: ~z~I don't trust him.
zh: ~z~我信不过他。

english: ~z~Then don't question my orders.
zh: ~z~那就别质疑我的命令。

english: ~z~Shut up Dimitri, I don't care who he is. It is too late anyway. Niko has killed him. Stop your whining.
zh: ~z~迪米特里，能消停会吗，我不在乎他是谁，反正已经太晚了，尼克都杀了他了。别抱怨了。

english: ~z~You would still be in a fucking Gulag if it wasn't for me. You'd be drilling for oil in the tundra.
zh: ~z~要不是有我，你还会被困在狗屁古拉格，你还会在冻土带钻探石油。

english: ~z~Raise her well.
zh: ~z~待她不薄。

english: ~z~But I don't accept my daughter turning into a whore.
zh: ~z~但我不能接受我的女儿去做鸡。

english: ~z~Stay outta this, man.
zh: ~z~别管这事，伙计。

english: ~z~You won't need to wait much longer.
zh: ~z~你不会等太久的

english: ~z~-I don't see why it's such a problem.~n~-I tell you. I want you to keep an eye on her.
zh: ~z~－我是不明白这怎么就成问题了。~n~－我跟你说，我要你看好她。

english: ~z~I don't care about her happiness. I care about discipline and loyalty. Thank you, Niko.
zh: ~z~我不在乎她高不高兴，我只关心纪律和忠诚。谢谢你，尼克。

english: ~z~~c~Your God doesn't give a damn about you! Just like everyone else.~s~
zh: ~z~~c~你的上帝根本就不在乎你！没人在乎你。~s~

english: ~z~These people will wish they did not take you, Roman.
zh: ~z~这些人会后悔绑架你的，罗曼。

english: ~z~Fuck you, this ain't Russia and we ain't communists.
zh: ~z~操你妈的，这里不是俄国，我们也不是共产主义者。

english: ~z~I've killed the biker. I don't know how happy your daughter will be.
zh: ~z~我做掉了那个飞车党，我不知道你女儿会有多高兴。

english: ~z~I bring her here. I spoil her rotten.
zh: ~z~我带她来的，我非常宠她。

english: ~z~My father is Mikhail Faustin! You can't hurt your boss's daughter.
zh: ~z~我父亲是米哈伊尔･福斯汀！你不能伤害你老板的女儿。

english: ~z~Jason's a nice boy. Stay away from him. Stay away from him.
zh: ~z~杰森是个好男孩。别动他，别动他。

english: ~z~You wouldn't dare. I'm Anna Faustin.
zh: ~z~你不敢的，我是安娜･福斯汀。

english: ~z~Don't you hurt Jason. Don't hurt him. You stupid thug, you stupid gangster.
zh: ~z~你别伤害杰森，不要伤害他。你个蠢蛋流氓，你个白痴黑道。

english: ~z~You ain't gonna know what the fuck hit you, pal.
zh: ~z~你丫等会儿死都不知道咋死的，伙计。

english: ~z~-You alright?~n~-What?
zh: ~z~－你没事吧？~n~－啥？

english: ~z~Yes. Good name. Good name...
zh: ~z~不错，好名字，好名字...

english: ~z~So many years I wondered what it was. Or what was wrong with me,
zh: ~z~这么多年来我一直在想是哪儿不对。也在想我又有哪儿不对，

english: ~z~God is very complicated. You mustn't give up hope...
zh: ~z~上帝是难以捉摸的。你一定不能放弃希望...

english: ~z~you realize that the creature that could do this doesn't have a soul.
zh: ~z~你就会意识到能做出这种事的禽兽根本没有心。

english: ~z~Pussy. Hasn't anyone got any balls?
zh: ~z~弱鸡。一个有胆子的都没有吗？

english: ~z~I've blown the place up, but don't pull that shit on me again.
zh: ~z~那地方炸了，但以后别找我办这种事了。

english: ~z~But um... then something changed... years ago.
zh: ~z~但是...然后就不太对了...几年之前。

english: ~z~Mikhail doesn't let me use this anymore, says it makes us look like barbarians.
zh: ~z~米哈伊尔不让我用这个壶，说用它显得我们像野蛮人。

english: ~z~Maybe you be careful on the drive over. Is pretty volatile stuff.
zh: ~z~开过去的时候小心点。东西不是很稳定。

english: ~z~Anyway, I'm sorry but if I get drunk with you and then drive this thing I'll definitely blow myself up.
zh: ~z~总之，我很抱歉，要是跟你去喝个烂醉，开这车的时候肯定会把自己炸没命。

english: ~z~~c~It's burning. Everything is gone.
zh: ~z~~c~它着火了，什么都没了。

english: ~z~You're welcome.
zh: ~z~不客气。

english: ~z~When the war came, I did bad things. And after the war, I thought nothing of doing bad things.
zh: ~z~战争期间，我坏事做尽。等到战后，我做坏事都成了家常便饭。

english: ~z~We're already in a lot of trouble. I don't know if I can smooth things over with Petrovic.
zh: ~z~我们的麻烦已经够多了。我都不知道能不能把彼得罗维奇那边摆平。

english: ~z~I want you to teach people to listen to me.
zh: ~z~我要你教别人听我的话。

english: ~z~Well, I don't know about that.
zh: ~z~这我倒不知道。

english: ~z~And you don't worry about your soul?
zh: ~z~那你的良心就不会痛吗？

english: ~z~Maybe I don't want to drive around while sitting on an atom bomb?
zh: ~z~万一我不想坐在原子弹上面开车乱转呢？

english: ~z~You didn't give him a choice.
zh: ~z~是你让他没得选的。

english: ~z~You killed Petrovic's son. I need not remind you of that.
zh: ~z~你要杀的是彼得罗维奇的儿子，这点我要提醒你

english: ~z~You're mine, Faustin.
zh: ~z~你逃不掉的，福斯汀。

english: ~z~You don't have any family. You could run.
zh: ~z~你没有亲人，可以远走高飞。

english: ~z~Wherever you go, people will find you, if they want to badly enough.
zh: ~z~只要他们愿意，不管你逃到哪儿，都会被找着的。

english: ~z~You fight like a worm, like spineless worm, Bellic.
zh: ~z~你的攻势像条虫，没骨气的虫，贝利克。

english: ~z~You would be dead if it wasn't for me.
zh: ~z~要不是有我，你早就死了。

english: ~z~but we cannot change the rules.
zh: ~z~却不能改变规则。

english: ~z~You and Dimitri are taking over, no?
zh: ~z~你和迪米特里要取而代之了是吧？

english: ~z~I got where I am for a reason. I won't have some Balkan shit take this away from me.
zh: ~z~我能有现在的地位是有原因的，不会让一个巴尔干傻逼夺走的。

english: ~z~You have me cornered. There is nowhere for me to go.
zh: ~z~你把我逼入了绝境，现在我也无处可退了。

english: ~z~I don't know what happened. I nearly drowned.

zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟，我现在没空看表演。还有重要的事要忙。

english: ~z~Now, let me sit in peace, Niko. You know me get funny when me drink and you make de world spin funny, man.
zh: ~z~让我好好坐会儿，尼克。你知道我酒品不好，你整的世界天旋地转，兄弟。

zh: ~z~抱歉，尼克，其实我...酒量不太好。

zh: ~z~我没法去脱衣舞俱乐部了，雅各布。我遇上了点麻烦。

english: ~z~Jacob, listen, I'm sorry, but I ain't going to be able to go out drinking.
zh: ~z~雅各布，听着，我很抱歉，但我没法来喝酒了。

english: ~z~Some other time - did we nuh just go a' the show?
zh: ~z~改天吧，我们不是刚看过表演吗？

zh: ~z~有没有兴趣来投局飞镖？

zh: ~z~不是刚玩过飞镖吗？

english: ~z~Alright, thanks for that, yeah? Me apprieciate that, yeah, yeah, uhuh, yeah alright, cool.
zh: ~z~好啊，谢谢你啊。我很感激，对对，嗯，对的没错。

zh: ~z~又玩飞镖啊？这不是刚玩过吗？

zh: ~z~抱歉，雅各布。我没仔细看时间。

zh: ~z~哟，我也不能一直喝酒啊，尼克。要么下次吧？

english: ~z~It's alright, man. Maybe a next time, it's alright.
zh: ~z~没事，兄弟。那就下次吧，没事的。

english: ~z~Nah, me nuh going to the strip club now, ram goat - maybe later.
zh: ~z~算了，我现在不去脱衣舞俱乐部，兄弟。改天吧。

english: ~z~Nah, man. Me full, star - but... maybe a lickle later.
zh: ~z~不了，兄弟。我饱了，兄弟。过会儿再说吧。

zh: ~z~以后再说吧，我们不是刚出去吃过吗，兄弟？

english: ~z~I'm afraid I won't be making the pool - sorry man.
zh: ~z~恐怕我没法来打台球了，抱歉，兄弟。

english: ~z~Not again, star - another time, seen?
zh: ~z~才刚去过，兄弟。改天再说，好吧？

english: ~z~Jacob I can't make the darts, sorry man.
zh: ~z~雅各布，飞镖我来不了了，抱歉兄弟。

english: ~z~No, Star. Me full, man - maybe later.
zh: ~z~算了，兄弟。我饱了，改天吧。

zh: ~z~你有兴趣去看表演吗？我有点无聊。

zh: ~z~别惹什么麻烦，兄弟。我们之后见。

zh: ~z~哟，我现在没法帮你，兄弟。给我点时间进货，好吧？

english: ~z~Hey, listen, Jacob - it's all cool. I don't need that hardware anymore.
zh: ~z~嘿，听着，雅各布，都没事了。我不需要你那些家伙了。

english: ~z~Yo, sorry rasta, yo. I don't have nuthin for ya right now, man. Try again later.
zh: ~z~哟，抱歉好兄弟，哟。我现在没东西能给你，兄弟。改天吧。

english: ~z~Ye dun know, ye dun know man, Middle Park.
zh: ~z~你不懂，你不懂，兄弟。中央公园。

english: ~z~Fuck, that place ain't bad. It ain't bad at all.
zh: ~z~操，那地方还不错，还算不错。

english: ~z~Fuck Niko. I don't wanna do this.
zh: ~z~操，尼克。我不想做这个。

zh: ~z~到了，尼克。看看我们明早还记不记得自己来过这里吧。

zh: ~z~没关系，尼克。不过是场游戏而已。你还是更擅长打人，不知道算不算是安慰。

english: ~z~Okay, Niko. This place ain't too shabby. It ain't too shabby at all.

zh: ~z~尼克，我他妈无聊死了。送我回家。

zh: ~z~还不错。要是我事前能多吸点粉就更好了。

zh: ~z~运气不行啊，尼克。要是给你打到了，真有可能会赢。

english: ~z~Man, I just don't like stopping once I've started. I could drink all fucking night.
zh: ~z~兄弟，一开始喝酒就停不下来了，我他妈能喝一整晚。

zh: ~z~还算不错吧，尼克。这人挺会讲笑话的。

english: ~z~After all that there ain't a chance in hell of me being able to get hard. It's a fucking Catch-22.
zh: ~z~到头来，我他妈根本就硬不起来。这他妈是个死循环。

english: ~z~I don't know.
zh: ~z~我不知道。

english: ~z~but at least you ain't a fucking hypocrite?
zh: ~z~至少不可能当伪君子吧？

english: ~z~They both just stopped when they saw her. Kate stopped being a kid after that. You know what I mean?
zh: ~z~看见她就停下来了。自那以后凯特就不再是一个小孩子了。懂我意思吗？

english: ~z~Wasn't hard for me, but I always knew what life was like.
zh: ~z~对我倒不艰难，但我向来知道生活是怎样的。

english: ~z~There ain't winner in a fight like this. I thought the only thing that was gonna end it was one of them dying.
zh: ~z~这种干架没有赢家。我觉得只有打到一个人半死不活才会结束。

english: ~z~That's because you ain't Irish.
zh: ~z~谁让你不是爱尔兰人呢。

english: ~z~I dunno, she's me ma but I ain't gonna ever understand that.
zh: ~z~我也不知道，虽然是我妈，但我一辈子都搞不懂她。

english: ~z~If an Irishman ain't beating himself up he's beating up his family.
zh: ~z~要是一个爱尔兰人不打他自己，他就会打自己的家人。

english: ~z~There was just this feeling in the air. This feeling that told me - this one ain't like all the other fights. They didn't stop.
zh: ~z~空气里就有一种氛围。这个氛围告诉我，这一次不同于往常的打架。

zh: ~z~我不觉得你在窃听。可能是我英语不太好。

english: ~z~Keeps your head up your own fucking ass, that's about as grounded as you can get.

english: ~z~I think that was when she realized just what we were like - she was young then. She was never quite the same after that.
zh: ~z~我想她就是在那时候意识到我们的生活的，当时她还小。在那以后她就性情大变了。

english: ~z~As long as I don't think about things, fantastic!
zh: ~z~只要不用我动脑子，就超爽！

english: ~z~I don't know. He loved the stories about the Old Country. The poetry, the songs, the books.
zh: ~z~不知道。他就喜欢老家的那些故事。诗歌、歌曲、图书。

english: ~z~Although my dad was both - drunk and miserable. Right fucking idiot.
zh: ~z~不过我爸两种都占了，既醉又苦。真他妈白痴。

zh: ~z~妈看了动都没动，就坐在那儿。后一周，格里在桌上的位置就没东西了。

zh: ~z~他们没有收手。眼里都有一种目光，是他妈野兽的目光。

english: ~z~Maybe sometimes, I mainly try to focus my need to destroy things onto other people.
zh: ~z~也许有吧，我一般会把破坏欲发泄在别人身上。

english: ~z~Francis tried to get me on his side, team up against the other two he said, but I wasn't having any of it.

zh: ~z~嘿，尼克。别跟丢了这些混蛋。

english: ~z~Don't think I don't know how to fight.
zh: ~z~别以为我不懂得战斗。

english: ~z~I don't know, ya know rasta. Can't be far though.
zh: ~z~我不知道，兄弟。应该不太远了。

english: ~z~Word pon de street is dat Peg ain't got much, him held up somewhere a waiting fe get outta town.
zh: ~z~据说佩戈里诺的势力所剩无几，现在正躲在哪里准备跑路。

english: ~z~He cannot go much further, we must reach Pegorino soon.
zh: ~z~他跑不了多远了，肯定很接近佩戈里诺了。

english: ~z~At least we're seeing some of Alderney. I don't normally come this side of the West River.
zh: ~z~至少我们见识了下奥尔德尼。平常我不会来西河西边的。

english: ~z~Motherfucker, why don't we just stop his car and start cutting off his fingers until he tells us where the fuck Pegorino is?
zh: ~z~妈个逼的，我们直接把他逼停，断指逼供让他说出佩戈里诺在哪儿不就行了？

english: ~z~I showed a man that you cannot always get what you want at the cost of the lives of others.
zh: ~z~我之前已经让一个人知道，你不能总是以别人的生命为代价去得到你想得到的东西。

english: ~z~You couldn't take the ras clot down inna dat place back there? Him get away from you?
zh: ~z~你不能在那里杀了那个混蛋？他逃走了？

english: ~z~Okay, we're making some progress then.
zh: ~z~好，我们没有白跑。

english: ~z~It's a different city from de rest of Liberty, true?
zh: ~z~这边跟自由城不是同一个城市，对吧？

english: ~z~We will keep on this guy and hopefully he won't fucking kill us or crash before he leads us to Pegorino.
zh: ~z~继续跟着他，希望他不会杀了我们或者撞死自己，能带我们找到佩戈里诺。

english: ~z~Big talk. You wanna know something funny?
zh: ~z~你就吹吧。想不想听个趣事？

english: ~z~We will kill Pegorino, cousin. Whether this constitutes a victory; that is another matter.
zh: ~z~我们会杀了佩戈里诺的，堂兄。不管这是不是一场胜利，那都是另一回事了。

english: ~z~Seen, Roman. I don't come pon dis ground neither and ting.
zh: ~z~确实，罗曼。我也没来过这边。

english: ~z~Where'd you get this chopper, anyway? This is a serious piece of equipment.
zh: ~z~你在哪整的这架飞机，不管怎么样。这真是个大家伙。

english: ~z~Seen, Niko. We going fe get him now. Dere ain't nowhere him can go.
zh: ~z~尼克，我们快追上他了。他已经无处可逃了。

english: ~z~He's going fe stop soon ya know, Niko.
zh: ~z~他差不多该停下来了，尼克。

english: ~z~Are you sure that he's going back to Pegorino? He's not going to go on the lamb?
zh: ~z~你确定他会去找佩戈里诺吗？万一是他自己的藏身处呢？

english: ~z~I told you to leave me alone.
zh: ~z~我早说了，别来找我麻烦。

english: ~z~But that don't work inna real life.
zh: ~z~现实生活中根本不管用的。

english: ~z~I don't know. What did I do?
zh: ~z~我不知道，我做了什么？

english: ~z~You think that it'll just be this guy and Pegorino? We teach them a lesson and we go.
zh: ~z~会不会只有这个人跟佩戈里诺？教训完他们就能走了。

english: ~z~I want to get this guy.I just don't think we want to take any unnecessary risks while we're doing that.
zh: ~z~我也想找到他。只是我不想让我们陷入没必要的危险。

english: ~z~This is something that I have to do. Kate had a messed up family, but she remained good.
zh: ~z~这是我必须要做的事。凯特的家庭环境不好，但是她出淤泥而不染。

english: ~z~Pegorino ain't as strong as when he used to run the Aldreney family, is he Niko?
zh: ~z~佩戈里诺没之前掌控奥尔德尼家族时那么强大了，对吧，尼克？

english: ~z~Roman, the last thing I want is to lose you as well as Kate. I can't imagine how I'd feel if I lost you today.
zh: ~z~罗曼，我最不希望的就是同时失去你和凯特。~n~我都不知道再失去你的话我会怎么样。

english: ~z~He been running round town like a headless chicken,ya know rasta. Picking up shit, him desperate.
zh: ~z~他像无头苍蝇一样在城里乱转，兄弟。到处采购，他怕了。

english: ~z~I did... I do want to but, you know. I don't want to die, I have a wife to think about now.
zh: ~z~是说过...我确实想，但是，说真的，我不想死啊，我还有老婆要照顾。

english: ~z~There's nowhere left for these guys to go. The whole city wants them dead now.
zh: ~z~他们已经无处可逃了。全城没人想放过他们。

english: ~z~I'm about ready to see that particular moron.
zh: ~z~我差不多做好去见那个混蛋的准备了。

english: ~z~~c~Why is this man still breathing?
zh: ~z~~c~这人怎么还没断气？

english: ~z~Your hitman didn't kill me, Dimitri!
zh: ~z~你的杀手没杀掉我，迪米特里！

english: ~z~You snake, Dimitri...
zh: ~z~卑鄙无耻，迪米特里...

english: ~z~I don't care how many of your men I have to kill, I'm finding you, Dimitri.
zh: ~z~我不在乎要杀多少你的人，我来找你了，迪米特里。

english: ~z~If you guys give up Dimitri, you might survive. Otherwise you're dead men.
zh: ~z~交出迪米特里，饶你们不死。否则你们死定了。

english: ~z~You'll stop running one day, Dimitri.
zh: ~z~你躲得过初一躲不过十五，迪米特里。

english: ~z~I didn't work this hard to share the spoils of a victory. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~我付出那么多可不是为了和谁分享胜利果实的。再见。

english: ~z~Roman was my cousin and I cannot put anyone else at risk.
zh: ~z~罗曼是我堂兄，我不能再让任何人陷入危险了。

english: ~z~Why do I have to keep killing?
zh: ~z~为什么我还是得不断杀戮？

english: ~z~Alright, so this guy is taking us to his bosses. We cannot kill him yet then.
zh: ~z~好了，既然这家伙会带我们找到他的老板，暂时就不能杀他。

english: ~z~Yo Niko, Dimitri and Pegorino gwan have mad firepower pon di ground, ya know. Dis ain't gwan be easy.
zh: ~z~哟，尼克，迪米特里和佩戈里诺肯定会在周边布置大量的火力懂吧。不会那么容易的。

english: ~z~Don't worry, rasta. I gwan shoot him out de blood clot sky. He ain't going to be able to talk his way outta dis.
zh: ~z~别担心，兄弟。我这就让他在天上血妈爆炸。他没法再用花言巧语骗出生路了。

english: ~z~That's just the way Roman was. Don't ever forget him, seen?
zh: ~z~罗曼他就是这样的。永远不要忘记他，好吧？

english: ~z~True me breda, true. I ain't gwan fe let it go neither.
zh: ~z~确实，兄弟，确实。我也不会就这样放着不管。

english: ~z~Dimitri and Pegorino, they be pon top after that deal, ya know. They got de coil and de brown, didn't dey?
zh: ~z~迪米特里和佩戈里诺，他俩在那次交易后就上位了。他们既有钱又有货，不是吗？

english: ~z~I think he probably did. We'd have to go to Russia to find out though.
zh: ~z~我想也是。不过我们得去俄罗斯才能查证。

english: ~z~Anyting could happen if you kill Dimitri pon dat day.
zh: ~z~就算你当时把迪米特里杀了，也不能保证之后会发生什么。

english: ~z~Also, dey ain't going to know their boy at the wedding didn't do his job properly. They tink ya dead, ya know.
zh: ~z~还有，他们都不知道派去婚礼的杀手没办成事。当你已经死了，懂吗？

english: ~z~Who dat inna de helicopter? Did Dimtri and Pegorino both leave when you get inna de ground?
zh: ~z~那架直升机里是谁？你进去的时候迪米特里和佩戈里诺是不是都跑了？

english: ~z~If he did, ya know, say him boss don' have long fe live 'pon this earth.
zh: ~z~要是他懂，就会说他的老板活不了多久了。

english: ~z~Roman brought me to this city and I was nothing but a curse to him.
zh: ~z~罗曼让我来到这个城市，而我于他完全就是灾厄。

english: ~z~All we can be tinking about is taking dat ras clot down, and stopping him from hurting anyone else. Seen?
zh: ~z~我们现在能考虑的就是干掉那个狗杂种，让他不能再伤害任何人。懂？

english: ~z~I don't tink you have a choice about dat, ya know, Niko. Roman loved you.
zh: ~z~我想这你也没得选，尼克。罗曼一直爱你。

english: ~z~Ya mind be clouded and ya don't be able fe tink clearly, ya know. Ya want some weed?
zh: ~z~头脑不清就没法好好思考，懂吧。要来点草吗？

english: ~z~Me understand ya know, rasta. It's a good ting dat blood clot don't know you as good as I and I know ya, ya know?
zh: ~z~我明白，兄弟。幸好那个狗逼没我那么了解你，懂吗？

english: ~z~If there was any way I could change my actions so that he would not die, I would do it.
zh: ~z~要是有什么办法能改变我的选择，保住他的性命，我一定会去做的。

english: ~z~If you didn't wanna come up here, he was gonna go to Europe and drag you pon a boat.
zh: ~z~就算你不想来这儿，他也会去欧洲拉着你上船过来。

english: ~z~Jah know not many man could a got through dem boys, ya know, star. Ya a real badman for real, real badman!
zh: ~z~主也知道很少有人能杀出这样的血路懂吧，老兄。你真是个大恶人，真真正正的恶人！

english: ~z~Dat be a whole heap of teeth, ya know, Niko. I don't tink we have enough ammo fe shoot him dat many times, ya know.
zh: ~z~那可得打上不少子弹，尼克。我觉得我们的子弹还不够打那么多次。

english: ~z~never hurt... anyone.
zh: ~z~从未伤害...任何人。

english: ~z~I can't believe I did that deal with Dimitri. How could I trust him? I'm a fool.
zh: ~z~我都不敢相信我居然会帮迪米特里去交易。我怎么会相信他的？我就是个白痴。

english: ~z~Cha! A burial be too good for that bumba clot, ya know. He ain't worth putting inna di ground, ya know, star.
zh: ~z~擦！那狗逼根本不配下葬懂吧。他不值得被葬在地下，懂吧老兄。

english: ~z~Just be calm now, rasta. Just make sure ya don't lose dat blood clot.
zh: ~z~先保持冷静，兄弟。别跟丢那个狗逼就行。

english: ~z~He had many men there. Both Russians and Pegorino's men.
zh: ~z~他在那儿安排了不少人。俄国人和佩戈里诺的手下都有。

english: ~z~Why would they bother to send a hitman to the wedding?
zh: ~z~为什么还不惜在婚礼时派出杀手？

english: ~z~to surround myself with good people rather than bad ones.
zh: ~z~尝试和好人而不是坏人处在一起。

english: ~z~Forced to do things he did not want to do in order to survive.
zh: ~z~为了生存被迫做违心事。

english: ~z~Rational blood doesn't flow through these veins.
zh: ~z~血脉之中根本没有理性。

english: ~z~Tell me, have these good people been hurt by what you've had to do?
zh: ~z~告诉我，这些好人有没有因为你不得不做的事情受到伤害？

english: ~z~You don't need to say anything else.
zh: ~z~你也没必要再多说什么了。

english: ~z~Okay, maybe it is weird, but maybe it isn't.
zh: ~z~好吧，可能是有点怪，但也没那么怪。

english: ~z~How do I know that you're right for me? How do I know that I won't get hurt?
zh: ~z~我怎么知道你是不是那个他？我怎么知道自己不会受伤？

english: ~z~Aren't you dashing?
zh: ~z~你不跑快点吗？

english: ~z~Don't worry, man, me find Dimitri me call you. Leave!
zh: ~z~别担心，兄弟，一找到迪米特里我就给你打电话。快走！

english: ~z~You won't regret this, Kate. I'll look after you. I'll protect you.
zh: ~z~你不会后悔的，凯特。我会照顾你的，我会保护好你的。

english: ~z~I feel like it's time to move on, start living my life right.
zh: ~z~也差不多该向前进了，开始好好过日子。

english: ~z~Oh, I didn't realize it was going to be such a casual service. Shall we go to the church?
zh: ~z~哦，没想到你会穿得这么随意。我们是不是该去教堂了？

english: ~z~It would be easier to be happy if I was with the right person though.
zh: ~z~不过要是跟对的人在一起的话，我应该更容易得到幸福。

english: ~z~Will you fire a gun into the air as your cousin walks down the aisle?
zh: ~z~你会不会在你堂兄走下红毯时朝天开枪？

english: ~z~Because... no matter how stupid I think this is, I'm willing to take a chance on you.
zh: ~z~虽然我觉得这样做很蠢，但我愿意试一试。

english: ~z~Well maybe they are. I don't want to be involved with the men I have been involved with.
zh: ~z~的确是很久以前吧。我不想再和之前那些人扯上关系。

english: ~z~Yeah? Do you think that that is the answer for everyone then?
zh: ~z~是吗？你不觉得对所有人都可以这么回答吗？

english: ~z~I'm okay, he's still in my thoughts, you know.
zh: ~z~我没事，他还在我心里，你也知道。

english: ~z~Are you prepared to say goodbye to the fast cars, the drugs, the violence, the cheap women?
zh: ~z~那你有准备好向跑车、毒品、暴力和骚货们告别了吗？

english: ~z~Niko, you can't blame yourself.
zh: ~z~尼克，这不能怪你。

english: ~z~I'm really proud of you, Niko. It must have been really hard to turn down the money and stick to your principles.
zh: ~z~我真的很为你骄傲，尼克。拒绝那笔钱的诱惑坚持原则一定很不容易。

english: ~z~The problem is that it's difficult to tell which one the man you are with is.
zh: ~z~但难就难在区分不了身边的人是哪一种。

english: ~z~Well it was the right thing to do. Are you coming to Roman's wedding?
zh: ~z~不过这是正确的事。你来参加罗曼的婚礼吗？

english: ~z~He brought it on himself and he wasn't a good person.
zh: ~z~这都是他自找的，他也不是什么好人。

english: ~z~I was good once, I was a normal kid who got sucked into a war he didn't believe in
zh: ~z~我也曾是个好人，是一个被自己不认同的战争吞噬的普通孩子，

english: ~r~You can't chase Pegorino's men if they don't have a vehicle.
zh: ~r~没有载具你追不上佩戈里诺的人。

english: Don't get too close to the dealer or he'll get suspicious.
zh: 不要靠毒贩太近，不然他会起疑的。

english: The ~r~dealer~s~ is in the apartment block. Follow, but don't attack him.
zh: ~r~毒贩~s~在公寓楼中。跟着他，但不要攻击他。

english: ~z~Now obviously I can't go, cause then he gets a picture of me giving him money, and I'm admitting guilt.
zh: ~z~现在我显然不能去，去了就会被他拍下我给他钱的照片，相当于认罪了。

english: ~z~You know what? He thought that that wasn't such a bad idea.
zh: ~z~你猜怎么着？他觉得这么来其实也不错。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天。没错。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天。没错。

english: ~z~Not many people get a second chance like this. It's my redemption.
zh: ~z~很少有人能像这样获得第二次机会。这是我的救赎。

english: ~z~Wouldn't it be easier just to pay?
zh: ~z~直接付钱不会更简单点吗？

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天，对。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天，对。

english: ~z~That people ain't perfect... that life is a mess...
zh: ~z~人无完人...生活不易...

english: ~z~This isn't going to end with my death.
zh: ~z~杀了我也没有用。

english: ~z~I told McReary I wasn't giving up them photos unless he paid me.
zh: ~z~我告诉过麦克雷里了，他不给钱我就不交照片。

english: ~z~and I don't look out for you. Know what I mean?
zh: ~z~而我不会帮你忙。懂我意思吧？

english: ~z~I shouldn't a got involved.
zh: ~z~我不该多管闲事的。

english: ~z~What? Did he know I had something to do with it? Shit, I got to call him. Don't fuck up again.
zh: ~z~什么？他知不知道你和我有关系？操，我得给他打个电话，别再搞砸了。

english: ~z~There are other copies. Don't do this.
zh: ~z~其他地方还有副本，别杀我。

english: ~z~I really don't know what you're talking about.
zh: ~z~我是真不知道你在说什么。

english: ~z~To be honest, I don't really care one way or another.
zh: ~z~说实话，我根本不在乎你有没有罪。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天，对。

english: ~z~Tell me you got the stuff?
zh: ~z~东西拿到了没？

english: ~z~Yeah. I got it. We're gonna make this shit happen. I don't mess around, you know?
zh: ~z~对，在我这儿。这个狗屁交易最好能顺利点。我不是好惹的，懂吗？

english: ~z~That's a weight off my mind. You don't need to be worrying about me knocking on your door in the middle of the night.
zh: ~z~那我就放心了。你也不用担心我半夜三更来敲你门了。

english: ~z~Yeah, he better have my paper. I ain't fucking around.
zh: ~z~是吗，那他最好已经把钱备好了，我他妈不在这附近。

english: ~z~This isn't right.
zh: ~z~情况不妙。

english: ~z~Call me when this exchange is going down. I don't like all the talking. Yeah.
zh: ~z~等你确定要进行交易了再打给我。我不喜欢一直聊天，对。

english: ~z~I don't know. Thinks he's getting paid though.
zh: ~z~我不知道。不过他好像有两把刷子。

english: ~z~Yeah, he better have my paper. I ain't fucking around.
zh: ~z~是吗，那他最好已经把钱备好了，我他妈不在这附近。

english: ~z~Something's wrong here.
zh: ~z~有什么不太对。

english: ~z~Listen... I did what I did... I made a mistake. That don't make me the devil.
zh: ~z~听着...过去我是做了点事...犯了个错。但这并不足以让我成为恶人。

english: ~z~Yeah. I got it. We're gonna make this shit happen. I don't mess around, you know?
zh: ~z~对，在我这儿。这次交易最好能顺利点。我可不好惹，懂吗？

zh: ~z~我不知道你在说什么，长官。

english: ~z~Come on, Nikolai, don't kill me.
zh: ~z~拜托，尼克，别杀我。

english: ~z~Listen. Where to begin? I don't know.
zh: ~z~听着，从哪儿说起好呢？不知道。

english: ~z~I didn't even get in the room with him. Things kicked off a bit early.
zh: ~z~我连房间都没进去，见不着他。结束的有点早。

english: ~z~Yeah. So, it's him or me.
zh: ~z~对，所以总得没一个人。

english: ~z~He's just in here. Don't be nervous. He doesn't bite.
zh: ~z~他就在这里。别紧张，他不咬人。

english: ~z~My problem is that people don't notice the decay in society.
zh: ~z~我的困难在于人们不关注社会腐败。

zh: ~z~喂，我他妈不是来听取人生经验的，朋友。你想要怎样？

zh: ~z~他们不顾腐败，之后为时已晚，就必须将腐败这颗牙连根拔起。

zh: ~z~你就是个花瓶，对不对？
