zh: ~z~麦克雷里先生，他们没让我见他。

english: ~z~Whoa, is that thing real? You know, if that thing goes off we can sue the shit out of whoever sold it to you.
zh: ~z~喔，这玩意是真家伙吗？你也知道，要是它炸了，我们就能把卖你这玩意的人起诉到他亲妈都不认他。

english: ~z~I don't like people who cut corners, Nikolai.
zh: ~z~我不喜欢偷工减料的人，尼克。

english: ~z~I'm coming close to getting you thrown away for good, Niko. Don't mess up again.
zh: ~z~我都想把你永远抛开了，尼克。别再搞砸了。

english: ~z~People don't understand how life is. Life is like a bowl of fruit...
zh: ~z~人们不知道人生是怎样的。人生就像是一碗水果...

english: ~z~Fuck me, this guy's about to bring my whole life tumbling down and you can't even go into an interview room.
zh: ~z~我操，这人都要让我的这辈子完蛋了，你居然还连一间面试室都进不去。

english: ~z~Don't you want to pick that up? This is only a job interview at one of the most respected law firms in Liberty City.
zh: ~z~你不接吗？这不过是自由城最受敬重的律师行之一的一场求职面试而已。

english: ~z~Teach him for sticking his nose in other peoples' business and get the files.
zh: ~z~教会他不要多管闲事，然后拿走档案。

english: ~z~You silenced Goldberg too, right? I don't need to worry about him?
zh: ~z~你也让戈德堡闭嘴了，对吧？我不用再担心他了吧？

english: ~z~But, uh... get yourself a suit.
zh: ~z~不过，呃...你得穿正装去。

english: ~z~Perfect, the smug bastard ain't gonna know what's coming at him.
zh: ~z~完美，那个自大混蛋不会知道找上他的是什么的。

english: ~z~You can't go through there, sir.
zh: ~z~您不能通过这里，先生。

english: ~z~And remember to wear a suit.
zh: ~z~别忘了穿正装。

english: ~z~Hey Mitch... looking good.
zh: ~z~嘿，米奇...气色不错啊。

english: ~z~Nikolai, this city needs me. Don't kill me.
zh: ~z~尼克，这座城市需要我。别杀我。

english: ~z~You're undercover. As in deep.
zh: ~z~你是一名卧底，深藏不露。

english: ~z~Some morality cunt who takes photos of guys in the shower at the gym
zh: ~z~这个道德逼，整天在健身房的浴室里拍别人照片，

english: ~z~I'm an important person, don't hurt me, Nikolai.
zh: ~z~我是重要人物，不要伤害我，尼克。

english: ~z~You didn't see anything, okay?
zh: ~z~你什么都没看见，好吧？

english: ~z~-Get off me.~n~-Get in there. Stop with this okay?
zh: ~z~－放开我。~n~－进来，别折腾了好吧？

english: ~z~Nikolai, this isn't right. I'm helping people.
zh: ~z~尼克，这样是不对的。我是在帮助大众。

english: ~z~Have you got A.D.D., is that the problem? We can get you a mild amphetamine to level you out, if you need it.
zh: ~z~你是有注意力缺陷症吗？是这毛病吗？如果你有需要，我们可以给你配备低浓度安非他命。

english: ~z~Guns don't kill people, video games do.
zh: ~z~枪支不会杀人，电子游戏才会。

english: ~z~You don't have to do this, Nikolai.
zh: ~z~你没必要这么做的，尼克。

english: ~z~Strong move though, I gotta say, like that style. I'm all about the Second Amendment.
zh: ~z~但还是很有力的举措，不得不说，我还是喜欢这风格的。我很赞成第二修正案的。

english: ~z~We're lawyers, we don't need guns.
zh: ~z~我们是律师，我们用不到枪。

english: ~z~Whoa, I don't know what the policy is where you're from, Nikolai, but this is a non-smoking office.
zh: ~z~喔，我不知道你老家的政策，尼克，但这个办公室禁烟。

english: ~z~This really ain't the place for you, tough guy.
zh: ~z~这里不是你该来的地方，刺头。

english: ~z~Clarence told me to dead any fool who don't belong in here.
zh: ~z~克拉伦斯跟我说过，干死任何不是这儿人的傻逼。

english: ~z~Yo, it's that rat cop McReary. Ain't it?
zh: ~z~哟，就那个骗子警察麦克雷里，对不对？

english: ~z~This isn't my choice, the police want you dead.
zh: ~z~这不是我的选择，那个警察要你死。

english: ~z~Upstairs for residents only. I know your white ass don't live in this shit.
zh: ~z~只有住户能上楼，我知道你个白佬不住这儿。

english: ~z~Shit, I wouldn't recommend going up there. It ain't gonna end well for you.
zh: ~z~靠，我不建议你上楼，你下场会很惨的。

english: ~z~Anyway, these projects all got the same layout, a staircase leading up on either side.
zh: ~z~总之，这些公屋的设计都差不多，两边各一个楼梯。

english: ~z~This ain't looking good for you, bitch.
zh: ~z~你的情况不太妙啊，贱人。

english: ~z~This ain't the place for you, son. You dead.
zh: ~z~这不是你该来的地方，小子。你死了。

english: ~z~You mean five.
zh: ~z~五千还差不多。

english: ~z~He don't like a younger brother with ambition. Tell you what, I'll reform.
zh: ~z~他不喜欢有野心的小兄弟。这么说吧，我会洗心革面的。

english: ~z~Yo cracker, you a long ways from home.
zh: ~z~哟，白皮，这里不是你家。

english: ~z~Whatever you say. They don't look much cleaner from where I'm standing.
zh: ~z~随你怎么说吧，从我这儿看也没干净到哪去。

english: ~z~The cops ain't gonna help you in here, they scared as shit.
zh: ~z~条子可不会来这儿帮你，他们怕死了。

english: ~z~Even the cops be scared to come up here.
zh: ~z~就连条子都不敢上来的。

english: ~z~I surrender. You wouldn't kill an unarmed man, would you?
zh: ~z~我投降。你总不会杀手无寸铁的人吧？

english: ~z~Clarence, is that you again? Can't you deal out on another block?
zh: ~z~克拉伦斯，又是你？你就不能去别的街区交易吗？

english: ~z~You don't have to worry about Clarence anymore.
zh: ~z~你不用再担心克拉伦斯了。

english: ~z~Damn, son, you don't belong round here.
zh: ~z~干诶，小子，你不是这儿的人。

english: ~z~He tried to convince me to let him go. Said he'd get out of town. I finished him anyway.
zh: ~z~他想说服我放了他，说他会离开这里。不过我把他干死了。

english: ~z~That was the wrong move.
zh: ~z~这步可不行。

english: ~z~Get out of here. I see you again, you'll wish I had killed you now.
zh: ~z~滚得越远越好。再让我碰到你，你会后悔没有现在就死的。

english: ~z~This didn't have to go this way.
zh: ~z~本来没必要这样的。

english: ~z~But it'll take me a year to get the evidence. More maybe.
zh: ~z~但是，光是取证就会花上一年时间，可能还不止。

english: ~z~Good move. You shouldn't trust a word that comes out of that scum's mouth.
zh: ~z~明智的选择。那个小人嘴里的话一个字都不能信。

english: ~z~You the boss though, man. You the boss of me.
zh: ~z~不过你是大哥，老兄。你是我大哥。

english: ~z~Don't kill me, boss.
zh: ~z~别杀我，大哥。

english: ~z~Anyway, these projects all got the same layout, a staircase leading up on either side.
zh: ~z~总之，这些公屋的设计都差不多，两边各一个楼梯。

english: ~z~Isn't that police work?
zh: ~z~那不是警察的工作吗？

english: ~z~I didn't know she was yo' sister.
zh: ~z~那会儿我不知道她是你妹妹。

english: ~z~I don't have anything to lose, Mr. McReary.
zh: ~z~我没有什么好失去的，麦克雷里先生。

english: ~z~You ain't getting my ass.
zh: ~z~别想干掉我。

english: ~z~Shit, I don't know. Is there a number on the phone? Can you call it?
zh: ~z~靠，我不知道。电话上有显示号码吗？你能打过去吗？

english: ~z~Shaniqua, that you? It ain't your style to be doin' this silent shit.
zh: ~z~莎妮夸，是你吗？屁都不放一个可不是你的风格。

english: ~z~Your call. I don't care.
zh: ~z~干不干随你，我不在乎。

english: ~z~Maybe he will. Either way, you're screwed.
zh: ~z~说不定真会呢。不管怎么样，你都得完蛋。

english: ~z~What if he isn't standing by the window?
zh: ~z~万一他不在窗边呢？

english: ~z~I still can't get a shot.
zh: ~z~我还是打不着。

english: ~z~This ain't right. How'd you get these digits? Is this Francis? You killed Clarence, man.
zh: ~z~不太对，你从哪儿弄到这号码的？你是不是弗朗西斯？你把克拉伦斯给杀了，老兄。

english: ~z~Terrible. I don't know how I'll sleep at night.
zh: ~z~太糟了。我都不知道晚上还能不能睡着。

english: ~z~You don't see anything that will get him up?
zh: ~z~你就找不到什么能让他起来的东西吗？

english: ~z~I wonder what he'll say? Maybe he'll let you walk -
zh: ~z~你看他会怎么想？说不定就放你走人了——

english: ~z~Tell him I only sent you to kill one guy... so it ain't your fault.
zh: ~z~跟他说我只让你去杀一个人...所以不是你的错。

english: ~z~I didn't know she was yo' sister.
zh: ~z~那会儿我不知道她是你妹妹。

english: ~z~Shaniqua, that you? It ain't your style to be doin' this silent shit.
zh: ~z~莎妮夸，是你吗？屁都不放一个可不是你的风格。

english: ~z~Look around the place, see if there's something you can use to get his lazy ass up.
zh: ~z~仔细看一看，找找有没有能利用的东西，让丫这懒虫起来。

english: ~z~Frankie, what's this about? I've gotta say. I'm nervous about this little meeting.
zh: ~z~弗兰基，这是怎么了？不得不说，这次会面让我很慌。

english: ~z~Why didn't you tell me Derrick was back?
zh: ~z~你怎么不告诉我德里克回来了？

english: ~z~I really got the feeling it was him or me back there.
zh: ~z~我真的有感觉，死在那儿的不是他就是我。

english: ~z~Whatever he stood for, he betrayed.
zh: ~z~不管他站在哪边，最后都会背叛。

english: ~z~Making a fool of himself. Betraying people. Going into hiding.
zh: ~z~自己出尽洋相，背叛别人，跑路躲起来。

english: ~z~You don't think I know that. Christ, it happened right in front of me.
zh: ~z~你当我不知道吗。天哪，完全就是在我面前发生的。

english: ~z~Oh - don't push me.
zh: ~z~噢，别逼我。

english: ~z~That might help.
zh: ~z~说不定可以。

english: ~z~Maybe you'll get lucky and he'll die of an overdose.
zh: ~z~要是你走运的话说不定他就死于毒品过量了。

english: ~z~Do you know the place? Are you close? Can you get there in time?
zh: ~z~你知道那地方吗？在附近吗？你能不能快点过来？

english: ~z~Why didn't you tell me you was hanging around with my brother?
zh: ~z~你怎么不告诉我你在跟我哥哥混？

english: ~z~Sit down. Why didn't you call me? You coulda slept on my couch.
zh: ~z~坐吧，你怎么不给我打电话？你可以睡我沙发。

english: ~z~Do it, or I will put you away.
zh: ~z~下手，不然我灭了你。

english: ~z~You don't know the half.
zh: ~z~你没想到刚才情况有多险恶。

english: ~z~Don't you forget about that.
zh: ~z~你可别给忘了。

english: ~z~I'll hit who I'm aiming at, don't worry.
zh: ~z~我瞄谁打谁，不用担心。

english: ~z~And you're going to make shit go away. That cool?
zh: ~z~然后你帮我把事情都摆平了，没问题吧？

english: ~z~He's always off getting involved in someone else's fight.
zh: ~z~他每次都会被卷入别人的斗争。

english: ~z~What the fuck? I thought you could shoot.
zh: ~z~你搞毛？开枪都不会吗？

english: ~z~Don't miss, Niko. You might hit me.
zh: ~z~别打偏了，尼克。可能会打到我的。

english: ~z~This phone's running out a batteries, shit. Look after me, Niko.
zh: ~z~手机要没电了，操。帮我，尼克。

english: ~z~I'm doing real well for myself, real well. I'm sorry about how life turned out for you.
zh: ~z~我现在过得很好，真的很好。很遗憾你的生活不尽人意。

english: ~z~The amount of smack my brother's gonna have to do to calm himself down after that.
zh: ~z~回去以后我哥他得打上不少麻药。

english: ~z~Sounds like I don't have a choice.
zh: ~z~听上去我也没得选。

english: ~z~Don't forget that I still got dirt on you. I know this ain't nice, but neither of us has a choice.
zh: ~z~别忘了我还有你的黑料。我知道这样不太好，不过大家都没得选。

english: ~z~If it wasn't bad enough having a bunch of crooks for brothers,
zh: ~z~如果说光是有一群恶棍兄弟还不够糟的话，

english: ~z~Jesus. Frankie, I'm sorry. May God forgive us for what we've done.
zh: ~z~老天。弗兰基，对不起。愿上帝宽恕我们的所作所为。

english: ~z~Hey, what the problem? I thought you were going to make something happen for me?
zh: ~z~喂，怎么回事？你不是要替我办事的吗？

english: ~z~Okay Niko. Time to get out of here but I ain't leaving my poor dead brother to the mercy of them animals.
zh: ~z~好了尼克。该离开这儿了，但我不会把我死了的可怜哥哥扔在这儿任那些禽兽处置的。

english: ~z~Yeah, well, there ain't a lot more that coulda been done.
zh: ~z~对，确实，也没什么别的能做的了。

english: ~z~Things ain't pretty out here. Stay in the church.
zh: ~z~外面情况不太妙，待在教堂里面。

english: ~z~Only a petty hood, Packie? You're involved in more shit than that.
zh: ~z~你还小混混，派奇？你可不止那么点。

english: ~z~This is place of God. Jesus Christ! Can't these people shoot at us on another day?
zh: ~z~这里是上帝的地方。我的天哪！这些人就不能改天再来袭击我们吗？

english: ~z~I don't reckon they can throw much more at us.
zh: ~z~他们应该不会再还手了。

english: ~z~-Let's go inside, it's gonna be alright.~n~-Come on, come on!
zh: ~z~－都赶紧进去，不会有事的。~n~－进来，进来！

english: ~z~Fuck. Francis was an asshole but he didn't deserve to end up on the road like that.
zh: ~z~操。弗朗西斯确实是混蛋，但也不用让他横尸街头吧。

english: ~z~If Derrick was alive we wouldn't be in this situation.
zh: ~z~要是德里克还活着，我们也不会有这么大压力。

english: ~z~What in the hell is this, don't these people have any damn respect? It's my own brother's funeral!
zh: ~z~这他妈是什么玩意，这群人都他妈不懂尊重的吗？这是我亲哥哥的葬礼诶！

english: ~z~Finally, it's time to say goodbye to my brother. Amen.
zh: ~z~终于，是时候和我的哥哥道别了。阿门。

english: ~z~There's a whole lot a air where the back doors should be, Niko. Go easy on her or my brother'll fall out.
zh: ~z~后面该有门的地方门没了，尼克。好好开车，别让我哥掉出来。

english: ~z~I guess me brother ain't making it into the ground.
zh: ~z~看来我的哥哥没法入土了。

english: ~z~Alright Niko, it's time to go but we're taking my brother with us. Can you drive the Romero?
zh: ~z~好了尼克，该走了，不过我们得把我哥带上。开车就麻烦你了。

english: ~z~Don't let 'em get my family, Niko.
zh: ~z~别让他们伤害我的家人，尼克。

english: ~z~Shit, we lost the back doors. Don't lose my brother too. Go easy there, Niko.
zh: ~z~靠，我们后门没了。别把我哥也弄没了。好好开车，尼克。

english: ~z~Jesus, they're coming out of that van. Keep 'em away from the church.
zh: ~z~天哪，他们从车上下来了。别让他们靠近教堂。

english: ~z~If this ain't a fucking beating I don't know what is.
zh: ~z~要是这他妈不是干架的话，我就不知道是什么了。

english: ~z~You damn disrespectful bastards.
zh: ~z~你们这群毫无尊重的混蛋。

english: ~z~One brother in jail, another killed and the funeral attacked. You can't tell me this is just bad luck.
zh: ~z~一个哥哥进了监狱，另一个被杀了，他的葬礼还被人袭击。这已经不是能用运气差解释的了。

english: ~z~I am sorry that we weren't able to bury your brother, Packie.
zh: ~z~很抱歉，没能让你的哥哥下葬，派奇。

english: ~z~We all have our ways of coping, Packie. That was Derrick's. He had a hard life.
zh: ~z~我们都有自己的解决方式，派奇。德里克是那么做的。他活着的时候也没好过。

english: ~z~Tell yourself you did it out of the grace of your own heart rather than for another piece of your anatomy.
zh: ~z~告诉自己那么做是出于良知，并不是为了满足那根东西。

english: ~z~Can't we call for backup or something?
zh: ~z~我们就不能叫点支援吗？

english: ~z~We ain't looking pretty, man.
zh: ~z~情况不太妙啊，兄弟。

english: ~z~I don't know.
zh: ~z~我不知道。

english: ~z~No, you dumb European fuck, I meant my brother, Francis. It was a joke.
zh: ~z~屁，你个欧洲白痴，我说的是我哥，弗朗西斯。就是开个玩笑。

english: ~z~I don't know why your brother got killed but it looks like the funeral was shot up because of the shit Gerry was into.
zh: ~z~我不知道你的哥哥为什么被杀，但看来对葬礼的袭击和格里的所作所为有关。

english: ~z~This ain't good, Niko.
zh: ~z~情况不妙啊，尼克。

english: ~z~I don't wanna lose my brother, Niko. Come on.
zh: ~z~我可不想把哥哥丢了，尼克。给力点。

english: ~z~Swiftly running out, Niko. Ain't got that many left.
zh: ~z~很快就要没了，尼克。没剩几个了。

english: ~z~Which ain't gonna get used, I might add.
zh: ~z~其实还多半满足不了，要我说。

english: ~z~Hell of a fucking time to be making jokes about your dead brother.
zh: ~z~现在开你死去哥哥的玩笑也太他妈不是时候了。

english: ~z~That means the men is in for a bad time but Katie's gonna make it out the other side. She'll stay clean and come out good.
zh: ~z~就是说家族的男人会很糟，但凯特会不一样的。她会洁身自好有好结果的。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. Calm it or we'll lose my brother.
zh: ~z~靠，尼克。冷静点，不然我哥哥就要掉了。

english: ~z~I guess you've got enough brothers to hate one of them.
zh: ~z~我想你是哥哥太多，讨厌一个也无所谓。

english: ~z~Guys like you don't like cops. Being here, helping us out... I appreciate it.
zh: ~z~像你这样的人都不喜欢条子。你能来，还帮了我们...我很感激。

english: ~z~Christ, that didn't have to happen.
zh: ~z~天哪，不该这样的。

english: ~z~More people didn't have to die at a McReary funeral. I'll see you round.
zh: ~z~麦克雷里家的葬礼上不应该死这么多人的。再见了。

english: ~z~You're a sick man, Niko. I'd fucking slap you if I didn't love ya so much.
zh: ~z~真是恶心，尼克。要不是我太爱你，我都要糊你一巴掌了。

english: ~z~Niko, are you gonna help me stop these bastards from killing any more McRearys?
zh: ~z~尼克，我们家族不能再死人了，干掉他们好吗？

english: ~z~Oh my God get the hell out of the way!
zh: ~z~噢上帝，不要挡在里边！

english: ~z~There can't be a lot more where they came from, right?
zh: ~z~应该不会再来一波了吧，对吧？

english: ~z~Don't come out of the fucking church.
zh: ~z~别他妈从教堂里出来。

english: ~z~I don't know.
zh: ~z~我不知道。

english: ~z~Don't these scum let up for a second.
zh: ~z~这些人渣就不能消停会儿吗。

english: You're too far away from the ~y~viewpoint~s~. You won't be able to spot the blackmailer.
zh: 你离~y~观景台~s~太远了，会看不到勒索者的。

english: You're losing the ~r~blackmailer.~s~ Don't let him get away.
zh: 你要跟丢~r~勒索者~s~了，别让他跑了。

english: This isn't right.
zh: 这可不好。

english: The ~r~blackmailer~s~ has entered a car, don't let him get away.
zh: ~r~勒索者~s~上车了，别让他跑了。

english: ~r~The files were not taken from the office.
zh: ~r~未从办公室拿走档案。

english: ~r~You didn't conceal your weapon.
zh: ~r~你没有藏住你的武器。

english: ~r~Clarence~s~ is fleeing the projects. Don't let him get away.
zh: ~r~克拉伦斯~s~正在逃离社区，别让他跑了。

english: ~R~You failed to kill one of the brothers.
zh: ~R~你没能杀死兄弟中的任何一个。

english: ~s~Don't leave ~b~Packie~s~ behind.
zh: ~s~别把~b~派奇~s~落下。

english: ~z~If I get out of this, punks like Dimitri Rascalov are going to wish they never got off the boat here.
zh: ~z~要是我活下来了，迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫这种混蛋就要后悔自己乘船来这儿了。

english: ~z~This isn't City Hall.
zh: ~z~市政厅还没到。

english: ~z~Isn't that the famous American dream?
zh: ~z~那不就是著名的美国梦吗？

english: ~z~Don't go too far.
zh: ~z~别走太远。

english: ~z~They won't stop at anything, these people.
zh: ~z~他们这些人不会善罢甘休的。

english: ~z~They don't respect anything.
zh: ~z~他们目中无人，什么都不在乎。

english: ~z~telling me that you were too busy screwing around to get him to City Hall?
zh: ~z~说你忙着搞破坏，没空送他去市政厅？

english: ~z~Don't mention it.
zh: ~z~别提了。

english: ~z~I don't know who you are, but you got me here.
zh: ~z~我不知道你是谁，但你护送我到这儿了。

english: ~z~Switzerland or some shit.
zh: ~z~不论瑞士还是哪里。

english: ~z~I don't have time for this.
zh: ~z~我没空等在这里。

english: ~z~The speech is fine, Jon. Before Mayor Ochoa knows it,
zh: ~z~演讲挺不错的，乔恩。但仅限于奥乔亚市长知道之前。

english: ~z~Kid, you are something else. I haven't had someone bust my balls like that in years.
zh: ~z~小子，你跟别人不同。我好多年没被人这么耍了。

english: ~z~I can't believe they're trying this.
zh: ~z~简直不敢相信他们居然尝试这样做。

english: ~z~I hadn't been in a fire fight since my army days.
zh: ~z~从军队退伍以后我就没参与过枪战了。

english: ~z~Another road block, this definitely wasn't mentioned on the traffic report.
zh: ~z~这里也封了，之前的路况报告肯定没写这个。

english: ~z~but don't think about screwing up or screwing with me again, or we'll have a real problem.
zh: ~z~但是别再想着搞破坏或者搞我了，否则就要追悔莫及了。

english: ~z~All people. Even you, even me, an old man facing the end...
zh: ~z~所有人。不管是你还是我－一个垂死的老人...

english: ~z~I got a feeling some people ain't gonna want that speech to happen.
zh: ~z~我有预感，有些人不想让演讲顺利进行。

english: ~z~Yeah, sure. You are as clean as the driven snow.
zh: ~z~对，没错。您可就一清二白了。

english: ~z~Maybe the guy you love, this Dimitri Rascalov, has an interest in keeping this story out the press.
zh: ~z~或许你最爱的这个迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫就不太想让这件事见诸报端。

english: ~z~But if it wasn't me, it would just be someone else.
zh: ~z~就算没有我，也会有别的王朝。

english: ~z~I'll tell Jon you did well.
zh: ~z~干得不错，我会告诉乔恩的。

english: ~z~I expected better from a man with your reputation.
zh: ~z~我对你的大名可没有那么低的预期。

english: ~z~Control yourself.
zh: ~z~别乱开车。

english: ~z~Come on, cowboy. Get back in line.
zh: ~z~拜托，牛仔。别离开车队。

english: ~z~They don't understand that things are different here.
zh: ~z~他们不知道这里另有一套规矩。

english: ~z~You're working with me, aren't you Mr. Gravelli? See you later.
zh: ~z~你跟我联手了，不是吗，格拉韦利先生？回头见。

english: ~z~We were driving with those other cars for a reason.
zh: ~z~选择车队同行不是没有原因的。

english: ~z~I don't know what I would have done if you hadn't held your head back there. Thank you, son.
zh: ~z~如果没有你在背后支持我，我甚至不知道事情会成什么样。谢谢你，小伙子。

english: ~z~This country is falling apart. There's no law anymore. Jesus.
zh: ~z~这个国家正在分崩离析，哪有什么法律可言，天哪。

english: ~z~That was a mistake they didn't want to make.
zh: ~z~他们犯了不该犯的错误。

english: ~z~Don't worry about me. You should be putting all your energy into getting better.
zh: ~z~别担心我。你还是专心对抗病魔吧。

english: ~z~I ain't got much time left.
zh: ~z~也时日无多了。

english: ~z~He doesn't want to start getting reckless with the lives of Liberty City voters.
zh: ~z~他不会想草菅自由城选民的命的。

english: ~z~Get out of my office before more guys come in here and shoot the place up.
zh: ~z~滚出我的办公室，不然我叫人来把这里打成马蜂窝。

english: ~z~Tell me that Kim Young-Guk isn't devaluing our precious currency anymore?
zh: ~z~那个金永国是不是没法继续让我们宝贵的货币贬值了？

english: ~z~Shit man, I can't. I'm already on my way to a Korean place.
zh: ~z~操了，兄弟，没空。我已经在去朝鲜饭店的路上了。

english: ~z~His superiors aren't going to be happy.
zh: ~z~他的上司肯定会不高兴的。

english: ~z~I told you, don't hurt me.
zh: ~z~我都说了。别杀我。

english: ~z~Mr. Gravelli, I couldn't take out Kim.
zh: ~z~格拉韦利先生，我没能干掉金。

english: ~z~You don't need me to tell you that it's all fugazi.
zh: ~z~我不说你都知道是假币了。

english: ~z~Don't worry, I'll take care of it.
zh: ~z~别担心，我会解决的。

english: ~z~Yeah, yeah, I'm fine...
zh: ~z~嗯，嗯，我没事...

english: ~z~Mr. Gravelli, are you alright?
zh: ~z~格拉韦利先生，你没事吧？

english: ~z~Leave already, you ain't going to find Kim here.
zh: ~z~早走了，在这儿找不到金的。

english: ~z~It seems he wasn't in Switzerland at all, but in Bucharest.
zh: ~z~不过他似乎根本不在瑞士，而在布加勒斯特。

english: ~z~Weren't you the one who help me get into this country?
zh: ~z~你不就是帮我入境的那个吗？

english: ~z~You hang with that junkie, right?
zh: ~z~你不是那个瘾君子的同伙吗？

english: ~z~Please, don't.
zh: ~z~求你了，不要。

english: ~z~Don't let him destroy all the charlie, get the vans out. Now!
zh: ~z~别让他把货都毁了，开车走人，快！

english: ~z~Make sure we don't lose the product.
zh: ~z~别让他把货都毁了。

english: ~z~but I spared him, and this is how he repays me? Unbelievable!
zh: ~z~但我放了他，他现在就这么报答我？不可理喻！

english: ~z~Get him away from the stuff, people.
zh: ~z~别让他接近货，弟兄们。

english: ~z~That was worth a lot of monies.
zh: ~z~这没的全是钱啊。

english: ~z~We don't want to lose the cocaine.
zh: ~z~别让可卡因有闪失。

english: ~z~Whatever it takes.
zh: ~z~不惜一切代价。

english: ~z~No shoot until he out from behind the van.
zh: ~z~等他从货车后面出来再开枪！

english: ~z~Normally, I don't care about cocaine, keeps controllable people in power,
zh: ~z~通常我不会管可卡因，而是利用借此上位的人。

english: ~z~This is no good at all.
zh: ~z~实在太糟了。

english: ~z~You will hit van if you shoot. Hold back.
zh: ~z~开枪会打到货车的。别开枪。

english: ~z~All coke is lost. Get this fucker.
zh: ~z~所有可卡因都没了。抓住这个混蛋。

english: ~s~Don't let ~r~Kim ~s~escape.
zh: ~s~别让~r~金~s~跑了。

english: ~r~You acted unprofessionally.
zh: ~r~你的表现很不专业。

english: ~z~Okay, Niko. If that's the way it is, that's the way it is.
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克。既然情况如此，那我也没什么办法。

english: ~z~My psychiatrist says that I shouldn't be seeing anyone in this emotional state, maybe if you me call back later...
zh: ~z~心理医生说以我现在的情绪状态最好不要见任何人，改天再联系我吧...

english: ~z~Sorry, Alex but I don't memorize your sleeping hours. I'll call you later.
zh: ~z~抱歉，亚历克斯。我不知道你现在在睡觉，晚点再联系你。

english: ~z~That won't be a problem Niko. I can get you a fifty percent discount for the rest of the day.
zh: ~z~没问题，尼克。今天一天我都能给你五折的价。

english: ~z~You know, I don't feel like seeing you right now. Maybe in a while.
zh: ~z~那个，我现在不太想见你。过段时间吧。

english: ~z~Don't be late, Niko.
zh: ~z~别迟到了，尼克。

english: ~z~I didn't know you'd be in bed. I'm sorry.
zh: ~z~我不知道你还在睡觉，真对不起。

english: ~z~Niko, I just can't see you right now. I have to put in some serious Daddy time to make sure the card doesn't get cut off.
zh: ~z~尼克，我现在不能陪你。还得好好陪着我亲爹，否则就没人帮我付信用卡账单了。

english: ~z~Okay, I was getting ready, but fine.
zh: ~z~好吧，我刚准备的差不多，但也没事。

english: ~z~Niko, you picked up. Well it's been a while since I've heard from you.
zh: ~z~尼克，你终于接电话了。好久没接到你的联络了。

english: ~z~Well, I blew off a lot of people to see you but... sure.
zh: ~z~好吧，为了跟你约会我推了很多人，不过...好吧。

english: ~z~Sorry Alex, it's over between us. I can't say I'm going to miss you.
zh: ~z~抱歉，亚历克斯，咱俩结束了。我也不知道以后会不会想你。

english: ~z~Oh, you picked up. I was starting to think I'd have to get Daddy's private investigator to track you down, Niko.
zh: ~z~噢，可算接电话了。我都在想是不是应该让我爸的私家侦探调查你的行踪了，尼克。

english: ~z~I can't take you out just now, Alex. I'll call you later.
zh: ~z~我现在不能带你出去，亚历克斯。晚点我再打给你。

english: ~z~Alex, I'm sorry about this but I can't take you out anymore.
zh: ~z~亚历克斯，很对不起，但我不能带你出去了。

english: ~z~Hey Niko, I was just thinking I like guys I date to look good in case the paps snap us together or something.
zh: ~z~喂，尼克，其实我比较希望我的约会对象能好看点，这样被狗仔队拍到也不会太尴尬。

english: ~z~Well this really is a surprise. Guys don't normally wait this long to call me back.
zh: ~z~太令我惊讶了。一般人不会过这么久才打电话找我。

english: ~z~If you think you can just treat me like some slutty European whore then you are sadly mistaken.
zh: ~z~我可不是呼之即来挥之即去的欧洲妓女，别搞错了。

english: ~z~Niko, I cannot get tied down right now. We should leave a bit of a gap between each date.
zh: ~z~尼克，我现在不能被你束缚住。应该在两次约会间多留一些时间。

english: ~z~My therapist was right. He was totally right about you.
zh: ~z~心理医生没说错，他对你的评价完全正确。

english: ~z~Niko. I don't want this to get too serious. Maybe we shouldn't see each other this often. Maybe in a while.
zh: ~z~尼克，我不想让咱俩走得太近。还是不要这么频繁地见面了。改天再说吧。

english: ~z~I can't just go helping anybody out. I'd lose my reputation. Why don't you hang out with me more and then maybe we'll talk?
zh: ~z~我不能随便帮你，面子会挂不住的。你多陪我出去的话说不定还有得聊。

english: ~z~I wouldn't ask you to do this if it wasn't absolutely necessary.
zh: ~z~要不是情况紧急，我也不会来麻烦你。

english: ~z~Sorry Alex but something's come up. I can't get you from the hospital.
zh: ~z~抱歉，亚历克斯，但我突然有急事，不能来医院接你了。

english: ~z~My therapist was right. He was totally right about you.
zh: ~z~心理医生没说错，他对你的评价完全正确。

english: ~z~A woman has needs, Niko. If you aren't prepared to meet those needs then she might look elsewhere.
zh: ~z~女人也有需求，尼克。如果你满足不了需求，她可能会去找其他人。

english: ~z~This obsession with really shit cars is really taking shabby chic to its limits Niko.
zh: ~z~你对这种破烂车的痴迷程度已经用古董风格都解释不了了

english: ~z~I want new experiences, I want to see things that I haven't seen before.
zh: ~z~我想要新的体验，我想见识以前没见过的东西。

english: ~z~Niko, please get a new car. I'm embarrassed to be seen in this thing.
zh: ~z~尼克，拜托你去弄辆新车。我坐这玩意里被别人看见很没面子的。

english: ~z~If I didn't know any better, I'd have thought you were trying to get me drunk.
zh: ~z~要不是因为我很懂，我就会以为你是想灌醉我了。

english: ~z~Or something, I guess. I don't think about clothes much.
zh: ~z~怪人之外吧，大概。我对衣服不大上心。

english: ~z~You're still driving this? I guess you aren't moving up in the world.
zh: ~z~还在开这玩意？那你应该是没能再上一层楼了。

english: ~z~They love me at this place. I swear, you spend enough money and people forget that you threw up on the manager.
zh: ~z~这地方的人很喜欢我。我发誓，只要花的钱够多，别人就会忘记你把店经理给甩了。

english: ~z~God, you know. I'll try anything once. I tried picking up guys on craplist, didn't I?
zh: ~z~天，你也知道，我什么都会试一试。我不就试着在craplist上约了人吗？

english: ~z~I hate tardiness. Come on, let's go.
zh: ~z~我讨厌别人迟到。好了，快走吧。

english: ~z~Well this is the place, Niko. I wonder who we'll see.
zh: ~z~好了，到地方了，尼克。不知道我们会遇见谁。

english: ~z~It gets where it's meant to go.
zh: ~z~平时开着也不会掉链子。

english: ~z~What's this obsession with strip clubs, Niko? Aren't I enough for you?
zh: ~z~你就这么喜欢脱衣舞俱乐部吗，尼克？有我在你还嫌不够吗？

english: ~z~You're taking me to play darts twice in a row. You're real imaginative, aren't you Niko?
zh: ~z~你又带我去玩飞镖啊。真是鬼才策划，不是吗尼克？

english: ~z~Can you please explain to me what the appeal of really shit cars is? I don't get it.
zh: ~z~麻烦你告诉我这辆破铜烂铁有什么好的？我是真搞不懂。

english: ~z~Hey, Niko. Is this like an off, off, off, off Burlesque show?
zh: ~z~嘿，尼克。这是不是那种、那种、那种、那种要脱衣服的表演？

english: ~z~Hey Niko, do you mind if we do something else?
zh: ~z~嘿，尼克，你介意我们再做点别的吗？

english: ~z~So you didn't dress up for the first date. Why would you?
zh: ~z~你连初次约会都没有好好打扮。怎么想的？

english: ~z~Thank God you've got rid of that thing you were driving before. I mean anything would be better than that.
zh: ~z~谢天谢地你终于不开那辆垃圾了。开啥都比那辆垃圾好。

english: ~z~It's so good that that hat is gone. It made you look like a thug.
zh: ~z~没戴那顶帽子真是太好了，那顶帽子让你像一个小混混。

english: ~z~Umm, well you've got to be hungry to eat in a place like this. It hasn't even got a Liberty Tree rosette.
zh: ~z~你一定是饿疯了才会来这里吃饭，这店连Liberty Tree认证都没有。

english: ~z~I didn't think anything could be worse than the car you used to drive, I was wrong.
zh: ~z~我还以为你上次开的车已经够差了，没想到还有更差的。

english: ~z~Uhh, this isn't going to work out. Can we do something else?
zh: ~z~呃，这个不太行啊。能不能换个别的？

english: ~z~If I'd known you weren't bringing a car I would have gotten Daddy to lend us a driver.
zh: ~z~早知道你没把车开过来，我就让爹地给我们派个司机了。

english: ~z~Hey, Niko. I hope you aren't planning on carrying me on this date.
zh: ~z~嘿，尼克。你不会打算背着我去约会吧？

english: ~z~Ooh, it is so nice to be driven around in a car you're used to, don't you think?
zh: ~z~喔，乘着坐习惯了的车四处转悠真好，你不觉得吗？

english: ~z~Can't we do something else instead?
zh: ~z~我们就不能弄点别的事做吗？

english: ~z~I'm pleased you've kept this car. Daddy gets rid of nice cars after driving them for a couple of weeks.
zh: ~z~很高兴你的这辆车还在。爹地的话好好的车没开几周就不要了。

english: ~z~Niko, can't you go for a more preppy look? That hat makes you look like a criminal.
zh: ~z~尼克，你就不能打扮的正经点吗？那顶帽子让你看起来像个罪犯。

english: ~z~It's a shame you got rid of those glasses, they made you look sophisticated.
zh: ~z~你不戴那副眼镜真是可惜，那副眼镜能让你看起来老成点。

english: ~z~I'll explain anything to you that you don't get afterwards.
zh: ~z~你没听懂的部分之后我会给你解释的。

english: ~z~Alright, change of plan. Take me somewhere else.
zh: ~z~好吧，计划有变。带我去别的地方。

english: ~z~Niko, you have got to learn you get what you pay for and you didn't pay much for those pants.
zh: ~z~尼克，你一定要明白自己买的是什么东西，这条裤子一看就没花多少钱。

english: ~z~Nice, car. I got one of those for my sweet sixteen.
zh: ~z~车子不错。我十六岁生日的时候就有了一辆。

english: ~z~What happened to your face? It's those cheap glasses.
zh: ~z~你脸上是怎么回事？便宜货眼镜不太行。

english: ~z~Yeah, well maybe you should have done more than buy coke off drug dealers since then?
zh: ~z~行吧，估计之后你做的应该不止是问那个毒贩子买可卡因吧？

english: ~z~God, are those shoes fashionable back in Europe? You must be so behind the Liberty City trends.
zh: ~z~天哪，这鞋不会还是欧洲流行款吧？你这人完全跟不上自由城的时尚潮流。

english: ~z~Okay, well you've wasted my time by being late. Don't waste my time getting me where we're going.
zh: ~z~好了，迟到已经浪费了我的时间，就不要在路途上多耽搁了。

english: ~z~This is getting boring. I thought we were meant to be on a date? Can you take me home?
zh: ~z~实在太无聊了，我们不是出来约会的吗？能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~Ooh, it is so nice to be taken in a car that isn't a death trap. Thanks for trading up, Niko.
zh: ~z~能乘上一辆不是死亡陷阱的车真是好事。感谢你换了辆好车，尼克。

english: ~z~God, this place really reminds me of being underage.
zh: ~z~上帝，这地方会让我想起我还没成年的时候。

english: ~z~Those shoes are nice, I might get some for Daddy.
zh: ~z~这双鞋很不错，我可以给爹地弄一双。

english: ~z~It was a sad day when the bouncer stopped asking me for ID at this place.
zh: ~z~这里的门卫不再问我要通行证就放我进去的那天是个悲伤的日子。

english: ~z~I don't normally like hats, but that one works for you.
zh: ~z~通常我不喜欢帽子，但你这顶很合适。

english: ~z~I guess you're having your other clothes washed. I mean, there can't be any other reason to be wearing these.
zh: ~z~你的衣服是不是都拿去洗了？除此以外，我也想不到别的穿现在这身的理由了。

english: ~z~I don't like waiting Niko. Let's just go.
zh: ~z~我不喜欢等待，尼克。我们走吧。

english: ~z~Okay, tell me how we're getting where we're going because I don't see a car.
zh: ~z~好吧，快告诉我我们怎么过去，我连你的车都没看见。

english: ~z~You were probably expecting some freak was going to kidnap you, right?
zh: ~z~你是不是觉得穿太好会被绑架，对吧？

english: ~z~A motorbike? I haven't been on one of these since I dated a drug dealer in high school.
zh: ~z~摩托车？自从在高中约上了一个毒贩子后我就再也没乘过。

english: ~z~Well if I'd known that you didn't have a car I'd have got the chauffeur.
zh: ~z~要是我早点知道你没有车，我就先把司机叫来了。

zh: ~z~抱歉，但我家里的事顾不过来了。

english: ~z~Kate - I'm sorry, something's come up... I can't make it to the hospital.
zh: ~z~凯特，我很抱歉，我有点急事...来不了医院了。

english: ~z~I can't, Niko - I'm busy doing something for Ma.
zh: ~z~我没空，尼克。我忙着替妈做事呢。

english: ~z~Oh, you... I wondered what had happened to you.
zh: ~z~噢，你...我之前在想你是不是出事了。

english: ~z~You up to anything? I'm bored.
zh: ~z~你现在忙吗？我无聊死了。

english: ~z~You've reached Kate McReary. I'm sorry, I can't take your call just now. Please try back another time.
zh: ~z~你呼叫的是凯特･麦克雷里。很抱歉，现在我没法接听你的电话。请过会儿再试。

english: ~z~I haven't heard from you in ages!
zh: ~z~我好久没接到你的电话了！

english: ~z~I can't again so soon - another time.
zh: ~z~我不能这么快就再约一次。改天吧。

english: ~z~Don't worry about it, Niko. Another time.
zh: ~z~别担心，尼克。改天吧。

english: ~z~Thanks - great to be missed.
zh: ~z~谢了，很高兴能被无视。

english: ~z~Listen, I haven't heard from you in a while.
zh: ~z~听着，我有一段时间没接到你的电话了。

english: ~z~I haven't heard from you in quite a while.
zh: ~z~我有段时间没接到你的电话了。

english: ~z~God, I must be really boring... even you don't want to know me.
zh: ~z~天哪，我这人一定很无聊...连你都不想了解我。

english: ~z~You're a fine one to call me after the way you've been treating me... I know - piss off. Call back when you're less annoying.
zh: ~z~你倒好，那样对我后还给我打电话...我知道。滚蛋。等你没那么令人恼火了再打回来。

english: ~z~I'm too pissed off to speak to you right now, amigo. Call back when I don't think you're a dick...
zh: ~z~我现在很生气，不想和你说话，老兄。等我不再认为你是个混蛋后再打回来...

english: ~z~Yes - how about now? I'm bored.
zh: ~z~可以，要么就现在吧？我快无聊死了。

english: ~z~I'd love to, but I'm in the middle of something.
zh: ~z~我很想去，不过我现在在忙事情。

english: ~z~I was wondering what exactly had happened to you.
zh: ~z~我还在想你是不是出事了。

english: ~z~You sure know how to make someone feel like an asshole, Niko. Thanks!
zh: ~z~你很懂怎么让别人感觉像个混蛋，尼克。谢了！

english: ~z~I was wondering if you were still alive.
zh: ~z~我在想你是不是还活着。

english: ~z~I haven't heard from you in ages.
zh: ~z~我好久没你的消息了。

english: ~z~Are you still alive? I haven't heard from you for a very long time. Did you lose my number?
zh: ~z~你还活着吗？我很久没接到你的电话了。你是弄丢了我的号码吗？

english: ~z~I was wondering if you were still alive?
zh: ~z~我都在想你是不是还活着了？

english: ~z~Sorry - I didn't realize what time it was. Go back to sleep.
zh: ~z~抱歉，我没意识到现在几点了。你接着睡吧。

english: ~z~You love pool, don't you, you freak!
zh: ~z~你喜欢台球，不是吗，你个怪人！

english: ~z~Please, next time, don't waste so much time.
zh: ~z~拜托，下次别浪费这么多时间了。

english: ~z~Pool - fun. I haven't played in ages.
zh: ~z~台球，有趣了。我好多年没打了。

english: ~z~Thanks, Kate. I didn't think you cared about that kind of thing.
zh: ~z~谢了，凯特。我没想到你还会在意这种东西。

english: ~z~In case you were wondering, the car still sucks.
zh: ~z~防止你抱有幻想，这车还是不行。

english: ~z~Not still driving this?
zh: ~z~又开这玩意？

english: ~z~I haven't played pool in ages.
zh: ~z~我好多年没打台球了。

english: ~z~It's super fancy, but I'm too hungry to care.
zh: ~z~是很棒，不过我太饿了不想管。

english: ~z~Next time, do me a favor and don't wear the same clothes again.
zh: ~z~下次，拜托你别穿这套衣服了。

english: ~z~This car still sucks, my friend.
zh: ~z~这车还是不行啊，朋友。

english: ~z~Okay, hit it, and don't tell me why you're late.
zh: ~z~好了，走吧，别跟我讲你为什么迟到。

english: ~z~Why don't you get some new clothes?
zh: ~z~你就不能换套衣服吗？

english: ~z~Thanks, Kate. Yeah, it's okay, isn't it?
zh: ~z~谢了，凯特。对，挺好的，不是吗？

english: ~z~Thank God you lost those silly glasses.
zh: ~z~感谢上帝，你不戴那副蠢蛋眼镜了。

english: ~z~Wasn't this where we came last time?
zh: ~z~这地方我们上次不是来过吗？

english: ~z~Great - I haven't been here in a long time.
zh: ~z~好啊，我很久没来这里了。

english: ~z~Didn't we come here last time?
zh: ~z~上次来的不就是这儿吗？

english: ~z~I haven't been here for ages.
zh: ~z~我很多年没来过这儿了。

english: ~z~Have I died and gone to hat hell with you Niko?
zh: ~z~我是不是已经死了，和你一起下了帽子地狱，尼克？

english: ~z~This is hysterical.
zh: ~z~笑得我停不下来。

english: ~z~Darts? Excellent, I haven't played in ages.
zh: ~z~飞镖？太好了，我好多年没玩了。

english: ~z~I'm glad the hat didn't make it out alive.
zh: ~z~很高兴那顶帽子没能活着出来。

english: ~z~Good - I want to play darts - I haven't played for ages.
zh: ~z~好啊，我挺想玩飞镖的，好多年没玩了。

english: ~z~Nice shoes, Niko.
zh: ~z~鞋子不错，尼克。

english: ~z~I'm glad you haven't changed - that looks suits you.
zh: ~z~很高兴你没换衣服，这身很适合你。

english: ~z~You're late, but whatever - let's go.
zh: ~z~你迟到了，不过算了，走吧。

english: ~z~I'm sorry, but I just don't want to do this just now.
zh: ~z~我很抱歉，但我现在不太想做这个。

english: ~z~Darts? One time, we should do something different.
zh: ~z~飞镖？下次，我们真的该做点别的事。

english: ~z~I don't know why you're late, but we're going to need a car.
zh: ~z~我不知道你为什么会迟到，但我们得有辆车。

english: ~z~I don't want to do this, Niko.
zh: ~z~我不想这么做，尼克。

english: ~z~Pool? Can we do something different next time?
zh: ~z~台球？下次我们能不能做点别的？

english: ~z~I still can't stand the car, by the way.
zh: ~z~顺便一提，我还是受不了这车。

english: ~z~You don't have to invite me in, but you could kiss me goodbye.
zh: ~z~你没必要邀请我进去，但你可以来个吻别。

english: ~z~Let's do something else before we head our separate ways?
zh: ~z~要么我们在各自回家前再做点别的？

english: ~z~Niko - I have only a limited time on earth and you're wasting too much of it.
zh: ~z~尼克，我的时间非常有限，你浪费了太多。

english: ~z~You think we can find something else to do?
zh: ~z~你说我们能找点别的事做吗？

english: ~z~Unlucky Niko.
zh: ~z~很不幸，尼克。

english: ~z~That's funny, I didn't know there were ties in bowling.
zh: ~z~很有趣，没想到保龄球也能打平。

english: ~z~I don't know what Packie will say when I tell him you weren't enough of a gentleman to let me win at bowling.
zh: ~z~要是我告诉派奇你不够绅士，打保龄球的时候没让我赢，我不知道他会说什么。

english: ~z~Why are we wandering aimlessly?
zh: ~z~我们为什么在漫无目的地乱转？

english: ~z~Are you alright, Niko? I hope you didn't stop bowling for a reason.
zh: ~z~你还好吧，尼克？希望你不是故意中途退出的。

english: ~z~Let's do something else now.
zh: ~z~我们现在做点别的吧。

english: ~z~Don't be a creep - we're friends.
zh: ~z~别那么讨厌，我们是朋友。

english: ~z~I've had more than enough of this.
zh: ~z~我已经受不了了。

english: ~z~That was fun - but this is goodnight.
zh: ~z~是很高兴，不过现在该道晚安了。

english: ~z~I guess you've got something better to be doing.
zh: ~z~我猜你也有别的事情要做。

english: ~z~You're a great guy, for a maniac - but I'm going to bed. Goodnight.
zh: ~z~作为一个疯子，你很不错。不过我要上床睡觉了。晚安。

english: ~z~Now, Niko. I beat you at bowling. Please don't get into a rage and go killing people.
zh: ~z~现在，尼克，我保龄球打赢你了。拜托你不要突然暴怒，开始杀人。

english: ~z~You're insatiable, Niko. Forget about it.
zh: ~z~你真是不知足，尼克。别想了。

english: ~z~Food was good, people suck.
zh: ~z~食物不错，环境太糟。

english: ~z~I had a decent time.
zh: ~z~刚才挺不错的。

english: ~z~You could always quit the professional killing and become a professional bowler.
zh: ~z~你随时可以不做职业杀手，改行当保龄球选手。

english: ~z~Well done - you beat a girl.
zh: ~z~还不错，你打败了一个女孩。

english: ~z~Well, you're good at robbing people and I'm good at bowling.
zh: ~z~你擅长抢劫别人，我擅长打保龄球。

english: ~z~This was great fun, but let's call it a night.
zh: ~z~刚才很有趣，不过今晚就到这儿了吧。

english: ~z~That place was okay.
zh: ~z~那个地方还不错。

english: ~z~That was great, but I already feel terrible.
zh: ~z~挺好的，但我已经感觉不舒服了。

english: ~z~I enjoyed myself but I'm worried about something I've got to do.
zh: ~z~我是玩得很高兴，但我还有别的要紧事要做。

english: ~z~That was so so, don't you think... anyway, it's getting late.
zh: ~z~刚才那个也就一般吧，你不觉得吗...总之，现在也有点晚了。

english: ~z~That was fun, but I've got things to do.
zh: ~z~刚才很有趣，不过我还有事情要做。

english: ~z~You were lucky.
zh: ~z~运气不错。

english: ~z~That was fun, but let's call it a night.
zh: ~z~刚才很有趣，不过今晚就到这儿了吧。

english: ~z~I really don't think that's going to happen, Niko.
zh: ~z~我想那种事是不会发生的，尼克。

english: ~z~I really shouldn't do this.
zh: ~z~我真的不该这样做。

english: ~z~Lord above - you don't even enjoy it? Then why do it?
zh: ~z~上帝啊，你自己都不高兴？那还做这种事干嘛？

english: ~z~My dad was a drinker and he sure had a temper, but I believe in my heart of hearts that he was a good man.
zh: ~z~我父亲是个酒鬼，脾气也不好，但我发自真心地相信他是个好人。

english: ~z~Well, for a murdering, thieving idiot who can't talk about things, you're kind of nice.
zh: ~z~算了，比起那种偷窃杀人还不会讲话的白痴，你已经算是好的了。

english: ~z~What was different about you and him?
zh: ~z~那你和他的关系又有什么不同？

english: ~z~This is nice, isn't it?
zh: ~z~这样挺好的，不是吗？

english: ~z~Why don't you want to live?
zh: ~z~为什么你们不想活？

english: ~z~That's it. But it's nice. I'm enjoying myself.
zh: ~z~就是这样。不过这样也挺好，我挺开心的。

english: ~z~You don't normally take the guys you date back to meet the family?
zh: ~z~平常你不会把约会对象带回家见家人吗？

english: ~z~Dad drove my brothers mad. I sometimes think that the reason they act the way they do is rebelling against him.
zh: ~z~我爸让哥哥们很不爽。有时候我都觉得他们的现状是对爸爸的叛逆。

english: ~z~The men in my family are just highwaymen and moralists, usually both in equal measure.
zh: ~z~家里男人不是拦路强盗就是道德卫士，通常还是一半一半。

english: ~z~Date? This isn't a date, Niko. We're just getting to know each other. We might be friends and that's all.
zh: ~z~约会？才不是约会，尼克。我们只是在互相了解对方。我们可能会做朋友，就是这样了。

english: ~z~What have you been up to? Actually, I don't think I want to know. I'm sure it made you feel big and strong.
zh: ~z~你最近在干嘛？不过我也不太想知道。肯定是能让你觉得自己高大威猛的事情。

english: ~z~I don't know if I'd agree that Packie was a moralist. He seems like a highwayman through and through.
zh: ~z~要是派奇也算道德卫士的话我就不敢苟同了。他似乎是个彻头彻尾的拦路强盗。

english: ~z~I don't know. I have lived a complicated life. I was in a war.
zh: ~z~我不知道，我的人生经历有点复杂。我参加过战争。

english: ~z~I was his princess, I was the little girl. And I didn't give him a reason to discipline me.
zh: ~z~我是他的掌上明珠，我是最小的女儿。而且我也没给他理由体罚我。

english: ~z~Can you do me a favor, and stop preaching? I'm fine.
zh: ~z~能不能麻烦你不要在这儿传教了？我很好。

english: ~z~Sounds like you still are.
zh: ~z~听起来你现在还没摆脱战争。

english: ~z~I guess I played up to it even more because my relationship with him was something I had that the boys didn't.
zh: ~z~我想我这么做更多是为了迎合他，因为我和他的关系是哥哥们没有的。

english: ~z~I hope so, I don't want to believe that every man in my family was as bad as my brothers.
zh: ~z~但愿吧，我不想相信我家里的所有男人都和我的哥哥们一样坏。

english: ~z~You seem well, Niko.
zh: ~z~你看上去不错，尼克。

english: ~z~I am what I am, for better or worse.
zh: ~z~我就是我，不论好坏。

english: ~z~I couldn't date you... someone like my brothers. I couldn't do that to myself.
zh: ~z~我不可能跟你约会的...约你这种和我哥哥们一样的人。我不会对自己做那种事的。

english: ~z~She wanted to send me too, but I wanted to fight. I was stupid.
zh: ~z~本来她想把我也送来，不过当时我想参战。我真是太蠢了。

english: ~z~You don't have to thank me, Kate. Needed what?
zh: ~z~你没必要谢我，凯特。你需要什么？

english: ~z~You poor bastard, you have. I don't normally socialize with people that know my family.
zh: ~z~你这可怜的混蛋，是很熟了。~n~平常我不跟熟悉我家族的人来往的。

english: ~z~Don't mention it.
zh: ~z~不客气。

english: ~z~Alright then, this isn't a date. We're just two people, hanging out.
zh: ~z~那好吧，这不是在约会。我们就是两个人出来玩。

english: ~z~Sorry, Niko. Talk about armchair psychology. I'm boring you.
zh: ~z~抱歉，尼克。净是些空谈心理学。无聊到你了。

english: ~z~I know - look at the company I keep.
zh: ~z~我知道，也不看看和我一起的人是谁。

english: ~z~It can't be easier, than having a job I mean?
zh: ~z~这总不会比找份工作还难吧？

english: ~z~Sorry. I knew it was a dumb question. It's just, I hoped it wasn't so awful for you.
zh: ~z~抱歉，我不该问这么蠢的问题。我只是希望那次战争对你不算太糟。

english: ~z~I wasn't suggesting that, Niko. I was just saying that therapy is one of the reasons I'm still here today.
zh: ~z~我不是那个意思，尼克。我只是想说，~n~那个治疗是我能坚持到现在的原因之一。

english: ~z~I'm sure you do, Niko. Maybe it's something other than forgetting that you need though.
zh: ~z~你肯定想的，尼克。或许你需要的不是忘记。

english: ~z~Are you okay Kate?
zh: ~z~你没事吧，凯特？

english: ~z~I don't want to get into that. But you know what I mean. What is the purpose of existence?
zh: ~z~我不想讲那个，但你知道我的意思。存在的目的是什么？

english: ~z~I don't think men can change.
zh: ~z~我觉得人没那么容易改变。

english: ~z~Doesn't really matter, you'll probably die tomorrow.
zh: ~z~不过也没必要，说不定明天你就死了。

english: ~z~It isn't a difficult question.
zh: ~z~这个问题不难吧。

english: ~z~We don't have to be friends anymore, if it upsets you.
zh: ~z~要是你伤心的话，我们不做朋友也可以。

english: ~z~Our mutual interest in wine, conversation, art house movies and long walks on the beach...
zh: ~z~我们兴趣相似，无论是在酒上、话题上、小众电影上，还是在沙滩上漫步...

english: ~z~Good. Because I don't want to think about it. I hang out with you to forget about that life.
zh: ~z~好。因为我也不想想这个。我和你出来就是为了忘记那种生活的。

english: ~z~I don't know, and I don't think I want to.
zh: ~z~我不知道，我觉得我不想。

english: ~z~I don't know - how is Packie?
zh: ~z~我不知道。派奇怎么样？

english: ~z~I don't know. I think life can be simple if you let it be. I think that life can have meaning.
zh: ~z~我不知道。我觉得只要你想，生活就可以很简单。我觉得生活可以有意义。

english: ~z~Why don't you get involved with someone?
zh: ~z~那你怎么不去找个人？

english: ~z~I want to be productive, I want to help people, I think that if I went back to school and became a teacher...
zh: ~z~我想做个有益的人，我想帮助别人，我在想要是我回到学校成了老师...

english: ~z~It isn't a difficult question if you don't care about the answer. What kind of a man do I want to be?
zh: ~z~如果你不在乎答案的话是不难。我想做怎样的人？

english: ~z~I don't know about you, but I have my fair share of physical scars.
zh: ~z~我不清楚你的情况，但我的身体创伤已经够多了。

english: ~z~My pleasure. You know what, Niko, I really... I really...
zh: ~z~没关系。你猜怎么着，尼克，我真的...我真的...

english: ~z~This is a good thing to do, you will help people. You should go back to school and become a teacher.
zh: ~z~这是好事，你会帮到别人的。你是该回到学校当老师。

english: ~z~Whether this will satisfy you though... that is another matter.
zh: ~z~至于这么做能不能满足你...那就是另一回事了。

english: ~z~Oh, shut up, I don't mean that. I like you. I really like you. You know I do.
zh: ~z~噢，闭嘴，我不是那个意思。我喜欢你，真的很喜欢你。你知道我喜欢的。

english: ~z~But you don't like me.
zh: ~z~但你不喜欢我。

english: ~z~God, sometimes do you think - what is the point?
zh: ~z~天，你有没有想过，目的何在？

english: ~z~I don't know, maybe the fact that we both understand that the world is a fucked up place.
zh: ~z~我不知道，也许是因为我们都明白这个世界是个狗屁地方。

english: ~z~There is a void in us that cannot be filled.
zh: ~z~但我们心中都有一个无法被填满的虚空。

english: ~z~Isn't that fun?
zh: ~z~这不是很开心吗？

english: ~z~I don't know - because my whole family does, and they're such a bunch of winners!
zh: ~z~我不知道。因为我全家都喝，他们还都是一群人生赢家！

english: ~z~I'm sorry... I'm so sorry... I'm so sorry.
zh: ~z~对不起...很对不起...真的对不起。

english: ~z~Fuck... I'm just a neurotic, aren't I?
zh: ~z~操...我有点神经质了，不是吗？

english: ~z~I'm half crazy, out drinking with a killer,
zh: ~z~我差不多疯了，和一个杀手出来喝酒。

english: ~z~They haven't invented a tranquilizer strong enough, but if she combines them with whiskey, she can get to sleep.
zh: ~z~现在的镇静剂药效都不够强，但只要混上一点威士忌，她就能睡着了。

english: ~z~and with this family so fucked up I don't even want to talk about it.
zh: ~z~还有一个乱七八糟到我都不想提的家庭。

english: ~z~I don't know about that.
zh: ~z~那我倒不知道。

english: ~z~Look at them... I can't take it any more...
zh: ~z~看看他们...我已经受不了了...

english: ~z~I'm sorry... I'm so sorry.
zh: ~z~对不起...真对不起。

english: ~z~Don't worry about it.
zh: ~z~没关系的。

english: ~z~You poor baby, let me give the judge a call and see if we can sort this out. See you soon.
zh: ~z~真可怜啊，我给法官打个电话，看看他能不能帮个忙。再见。

english: ~z~Can't wait, Kiki.
zh: ~z~我等不及了，琪琪。

english: ~z~Sorry, I'm heading into Alderney to see my parents. Speak soon?
zh: ~z~不好意思，我要去奥尔德尼看我父母了。以后再聊吧？

zh: ~z~你不应该让我喝这么多。我头有点晕了。

english: ~z~It's been so hard resisting you. I'm so pleased that it's time.
zh: ~z~拒绝你真的很难。我不用再拒绝你真是太开心了。

english: ~z~Yes - I knew you'd be nice, from your email.
zh: ~z~没错，我就知道你人很好，看邮件就知道了。

english: ~z~I was being sarcastic... don't worry about it... who is Dorian?
zh: ~z~我就顺口一说...别在意...多里安是谁？

english: ~z~You're seeing a different side of me meeting me this way. It's working out.
zh: ~z~跟我约会能让你见到我的另一面。挺不错的。

english: ~z~I'm a girl who wants to make it in the big city. You know, I grew up in the suburbs, bored out of my mind...
zh: ~z~我是个想在大城市有所成就的女孩。你看，我在郊区长大，从小就很无聊...

english: ~z~Because some people are having a miserable time, I guess. I don't know.
zh: ~z~可能是因为还有人在经历不幸吧。我也不知道。

english: ~z~"His clothes were covered in the victim's blood." An innocent man with a felony prior doesn't stand a chance.
zh: ~z~「他的衣服沾满了受害者的血。」曾犯重罪的良民是没有机会的。

english: ~z~I came here and I thought it would be different.
zh: ~z~我来这里时以为这里会不一样。

english: ~z~Don't you sometimes feel really guilty driving a car?
zh: ~z~你开车的时候会不会感到很内疚？

english: ~z~It doesn't matter why you do something as long as it's right.
zh: ~z~只要你的行为正确，动机就不重要。

english: ~z~There will always be people who suffer, Kiki. That is the way of the world.
zh: ~z~总会有人遭遇不幸的，琪琪。这个世界就是如此。

english: ~z~I'm going to warn you Niko, I'm not in the best of moods.
zh: ~z~先跟你说好，尼克，我现在心情很差。

english: ~z~Hey, you can't help everybody.
zh: ~z~嘿，你不可能帮助所有人。

english: ~z~this is so unlike me, but I'm giving it a go and it seems to be working out.
zh: ~z~这太不像我会做的事了，但我试了一试，似乎也还不错。

english: ~z~You can try. Most of the people from my law class just went to big firms on the Exchange to make their millions.
zh: ~z~不试试怎么知道。跟我同专业的同学大多去了证券交易所的大公司，年入百万。

english: ~z~Like I said, this is so unlike me.
zh: ~z~我也说了，这太不像我会做的事了。

english: ~z~None that are still on the outside. This government really annoys me, Niko.
zh: ~z~他们全都进去了。政府真的很让我恼火，尼克。

english: ~z~Relationships can't rarely last when they get sent out of state to a Federal Penitentiary though.
zh: ~z~不过等他们被送进联邦监狱以后，这段感情就难以维系了。

english: ~z~I wanted to help people. That's why I do pro bono work at City Hall.
zh: ~z~我想帮助别人，所以才会去市政厅做无偿法律援助。

english: ~z~Yeah, really sweet guys - misunderstood, you know?
zh: ~z~是啊，都是些好人，只是不被理解，懂吧？

english: ~z~He's serving life upstate. Can you believe that they revoked his conjugal visit privileges? It's inhuman.
zh: ~z~在北方终身监禁。他的配偶探望权居然还被剥夺了。太没人性了。

english: ~z~Just sometimes I feel like I can't do enough though. I feel like I can't help people as much as I want to be able to.
zh: ~z~不过有时我会觉得自己做得还不够，帮助他人时时常感觉心有余而力不足。

english: ~z~I'm a criminal, and a murderer. I arrived in your country and fell in with a bad crowd. What rights do I have?
zh: ~z~我是一个罪犯，还是杀人犯。我来到你们国家，和不法分子厮混。我能有什么权利？

english: ~z~I don't know, I just thought I'd try it. What made you?
zh: ~z~我不知道，我只是想试试。那你呢？

english: ~z~It sounds as if you're being as helpful as you can be.
zh: ~z~听起来你好像在尽可能地帮助别人。

english: ~z~I try not to lose touch though.
zh: ~z~但我会尽量保持联系。

english: ~z~It was a conspiracy. The government doesn't like free thinkers and autodidacts.
zh: ~z~这是个阴谋。政府不喜欢思想自由的人和无师自通的人。

english: ~z~Not everyone born in a project sells their ass for crack.
zh: ~z~出生在公屋社区的人未必会为了毒品卖身。

english: ~z~I cannot take grown men playing dressing up games very seriously.
zh: ~z~我不喜欢看一群成年人在那里过家家。

english: ~z~Finding what? I don't get it.
zh: ~z~什么怎样？我没听懂。

english: ~z~I'm so sorry! Our society let you down! My country failed you!
zh: ~z~真对不起！我们的社会让你失望了！我的国家辜负了你！

english: ~z~But, well... it was nice. It's strange. You always want something to be like it is in the movies, don't you?
zh: ~z~但是，嗯...普通就好。很奇怪，你会不会期待生活偶尔像电影情节一样发展？

english: ~z~So, Niko, are there any skeletons in your closet? Is anyone haunting you?
zh: ~z~那，尼克，你有什么不可告人的秘密吗？有人缠着你吗？

english: ~z~I represent the people who can't even help themselves.
zh: ~z~我代表那些甚至都无法自救的人。

english: ~z~The line is so blurry. I'm too close to be able to tell what he is.
zh: ~z~界线太模糊了。当局者迷，我区分不了。

english: ~z~Cars, clothes, my apartment, my education. I help the people who haven't been given anything.
zh: ~z~车子，衣服，我的公寓，我的教育。现在我帮助那些无法得到给予的人。

english: ~z~I mean, are there any ex-girlfriends who are still hung up on you? What did you think I meant?
zh: ~z~我是说，有没有哪个前女友现在还对你死缠烂打？你以为我是什么意思？

english: ~z~But I feel so guilty. Life is so unfair.
zh: ~z~但我十分内疚。人世不公啊。

english: ~z~Unlucky though. Hopefully that won't rub off on me.
zh: ~z~真是倒霉。好在我应该不会被传染。

english: ~z~It's just that I'm working these cases the whole time and I can't get out to meet new people.
zh: ~z~只是因为我每天忙着打官司，没空出去交新朋友。

english: ~z~You two have so much in common, I mean more than just me. You're both such peace loving men.
zh: ~z~你们两个有很多共同点，不只是都和我处得好。你们都是爱好和平的人。

english: ~z~And you've come out okay - you should be grateful.
zh: ~z~但你的命不差啊，你应该高兴才对。

english: ~z~But you have a value system, don't you?
zh: ~z~但你有自己的价值观，不是吗？

english: ~z~But I thought you had a nice time?
zh: ~z~原来你不享受之前那些时光吗？

english: ~z~What are they, then?
zh: ~z~不是犯罪是什么？

english: ~z~I mean I was just checking up on him. That's okay isn't it?
zh: ~z~我是说，我只是在调查他。这没什么关系吧？

english: ~z~Okay, I'm sorry.
zh: ~z~好吧，对不起。

english: ~z~We have a special understanding, haven't we? This is so real.
zh: ~z~我们之间有特别的理解，不是吗？这感觉很真实。

english: ~z~Are you the casual encounter kind of guy, is that it? The use them and lose them guy? Fuck 'em and sling them?
zh: ~z~你只是想搞一夜情，对不对？对女人用完就扔？提上裤子不认人？

english: ~z~You don't make me happy. You're breaking my heart.
zh: ~z~你没有让我开心。你伤透了我的心。

english: ~z~I don't know.
zh: ~z~我不知道。

english: ~z~I don't know. I mean, it seems a bit soon to be worrying about that.
zh: ~z~不知道。我是说，现在担心这个似乎有些早。

english: ~z~I like saying your name, Niko. You're amazing. This is just so so nice, isn't it?
zh: ~z~我喜欢念你的名字，尼克。你很出众。这样实在是太棒了，不是吗？

english: ~z~If we don't hold onto that, then we won't have anything.
zh: ~z~如果不能坚持这些，我们将一无所有。

english: ~z~I don't know about that... I err...
zh: ~z~我不是很确定...我...

english: ~z~Don't you find that when you're getting close to someone you just want to be with them the whole time?
zh: ~z~你不觉得当你和某人关系越来越好时，就会想一直和他在一起吗？

english: ~z~There's something special going on here. Can't you feel it? When you're inside me, Niko.
zh: ~z~我的身上有种奇妙的变化，你没感觉到吗？你我结合的时候，尼克，

english: ~z~I don't see a difference.
zh: ~z~我看没什么差别。

english: ~z~That made him think twice about taking advantage of his students and jumping to ridiculous conclusions.
zh: ~z~好让他不敢轻易占学生便宜，草率闹出笑话。

english: ~z~and when times are tough, I carry you on my shoulders.
zh: ~z~每当你不如意时，我都会背上你前行。

english: ~z~I don't know. These days, I think I'm just a whore, running around working for the highest bidder.
zh: ~z~我不知道。我觉得自己最近像个妓女，四处奔波，价高者得。

english: ~z~Nice? I'm talking about love, about passion, about the important stuff, not nice!
zh: ~z~享受？我在说的是爱情，是激情，是人生大事，严肃点！

english: ~z~I saw you looking at her. Don't pretend you weren't.
zh: ~z~我看见你看她了，别装你没看了。

english: ~z~I care about you, Niko. So, so, so, much.
zh: ~z~我很在乎你，尼克，非常非常在乎你。

english: ~z~I wasn't looking at anyone. Shit.
zh: ~z~我刚才没看谁啊，操。

english: ~z~I didn't force the alcohol down your throat.
zh: ~z~我也没逼着你喝下去啊。

english: ~z~What are you talking about Kiki? I wasn't the one who suggested those tequila slammers.
zh: ~z~你在说什么啊，琪琪？又不是我提议喝龙舌兰酒的。

english: ~z~Did you get me drunk so you could do the same thing to me?
zh: ~z~把我灌醉以后你是不是也能为所欲为了？

english: ~z~You don't need a real woman. You can't handle a real woman. You hate me.
zh: ~z~你不需要真正的女人。你应付不了真正的女人。你讨厌我。

english: ~z~Get a little buzz on. Is that so wrong?
zh: ~z~不过醉了一点而已，这有错吗？

english: ~z~I don't respond well to threats, Kiki. Chill the fuck out.
zh: ~z~不要随便威胁我，琪琪。给老子冷静。

english: ~z~So, you don't deny it? You have other whores out there. I feel so dirty. I feel used.
zh: ~z~好，你不否认是吧？你确实有别的妓女。我被玷污了，我被耍了。

english: ~z~I'm out with you tonight, Kiki. I wouldn't leave you on the sidewalk.
zh: ~z~今晚我陪着你，琪琪。我不会把你扔在路边的。

english: ~z~Don't try to fucking play me, Niko.
zh: ~z~别跟老娘耍心眼，尼克。

english: ~z~Look Kiki, I don't know what you're talking about.
zh: ~z~听着，琪琪，我不知道你在说什么。

english: ~z~You don't love me.
zh: ~z~你不爱我。

english: ~z~I haven't heard from you in a while, thought you'd forgotten about me.
zh: ~z~好久没有你的消息，我还以为你把我忘了。

english: ~z~Thanks for fucking nothing, you asshole.
zh: ~z~真是谢谢您啊，混帐东西。

english: ~z~I think you're a great guy, but I don't want to hang out again so soon. Another time.
zh: ~z~你的品性很好，但我不想这么快又出去。下次吧。

english: ~z~Niko, it's me, Michelle - it's been a while.
zh: ~z~尼克，是我，米歇尔。好久没说话了。

english: ~z~Sorry, Michelle. Something's come up - I can't make it to the hospital.
zh: ~z~抱歉，米歇尔。我临时有事，没法来医院了。

english: ~z~Niko - it's me, Michelle - why haven't you called me? Don't be cold and weird with me. Come on.
zh: ~z~尼克，是我，米歇尔。你为什么不给我打电话？别对我冷若冰霜，拜托了。

english: ~z~You're always too fucking busy!
zh: ~z~你他妈哪天不忙！

english: ~z~What? You can't pick me up from the fucking hospital? You dick.
zh: ~z~什么？你他妈不能来医院接我？你个混蛋。

english: ~z~I cannot, Michelle. Maybe some other time.
zh: ~z~我没空，米歇尔还是改天再说吧。

english: ~z~Oh you still have my number. I haven't heard from you in the longest time.
zh: ~z~噢，你还有我的号码。我很长时间没接到你的电话了。

english: ~z~Oh... you don't want to hang out? Well, thanks. Thanks a lot.
zh: ~z~哦...你不想出去玩吗？好，谢谢。非常感谢。

english: ~z~I haven't heard from you in a really long time. I miss you.
zh: ~z~我很长时间没接到你的联络了。我很想你。

english: ~z~I can't wait, Niko. See you in a bit.
zh: ~z~我等不及了，尼克。一会儿见。

english: ~z~Hey, Michelle, it's Niko. Niko Bellic - listen, it's annoying, but I'm going to have to cancel our date.
zh: ~z~嘿，米歇尔，我是尼克，尼克･贝利克。听着，不好意思，我们的约会不得不取消了。

english: ~z~Well, thanks for nothing - you know what? You might just lose me as a friend, Niko Bellic.
zh: ~z~好吧，谢谢您哪。你知道吗？你可能会失去我这个朋友，尼克･贝利克。

english: ~z~I'd love to, but I can't spare the time just now.
zh: ~z~我很想去，但现在抽不出时间。

english: ~z~Oh, it's you... it's been a while.
zh: ~z~哦，是你啊...你好久没联系我了。

english: ~z~Niko - it's me - Michelle - you remember me? The idiot you haven't called for ages? Anyway, I miss you.
zh: ~z~尼克，是我，米歇尔。你还记得我吗？你多年没联系的那个白痴。总之，我好想你。

english: ~z~Maybe we'll reschedule and maybe we won't, I guess.
zh: ~z~可能能重新安排，也可能不能。

english: ~z~Thanks - for absolutely nothing... asshole.
zh: ~z~我可谢谢您啊...混蛋。

english: ~z~Hi. You've reached Michelle's phone. Unfortunately, I can't get to the phone just now, but please call back later.
zh: ~z~嗨，这里是米歇尔。很抱歉，我现在不能接电话，请稍后再打来。

english: ~z~Great. Thanks... for nothing. Some other time, I guess.
zh: ~z~太棒了。我谢谢您啊。那还是下次吧。

english: ~z~Niko - hey, it's been a while since we spoke.
zh: ~z~尼克，嘿，我们好久没说话了。

english: ~z~Sorry - I guess I keep unconventional hours.
zh: ~z~对不起，是我的作息时间不正常。

english: ~z~Why are you late? Don't tell me... something came up. Let's go.
zh: ~z~为什么你迟到了？别告诉我是出了什么事...出发吧。

english: ~z~I'm so glad you've taken off that silly hat.
zh: ~z~你不戴那顶白痴帽子了我很高兴。

english: ~z~Hey, nice bike, by the way.
zh: ~z~嘿，你的摩托车不错。

english: ~z~Did you bring those shoes with you from Europe? They don't really work.
zh: ~z~这鞋是你从欧洲带来的吗？真的不太好看。

english: ~z~I still cannot bear this car.
zh: ~z~我还是受不了这辆车。

english: ~z~Hey, nice pants.
zh: ~z~嘿，裤子不错。

english: ~z~I love that outfit. I remember it.
zh: ~z~我很喜欢这套衣服，忘也忘不掉。

english: ~z~Surely you can get a nicer car than this?
zh: ~z~要你换辆好点的车应该不难吧？

english: ~z~This place looks okay.
zh: ~z~这地方看起来不赖。

english: ~z~This place looks okay.
zh: ~z~这个地方看起来不赖。

english: ~z~This bar looks okay.
zh: ~z~这家酒吧好像还不错。

english: ~z~Is that a new top? Very nice.
zh: ~z~这件上衣是新买的？很不错。

english: ~z~What is that? Haven't you got any new clothes?
zh: ~z~什么情况？你就没别的衣服吗？

english: ~z~I don't really like that hat, Niko.
zh: ~z~我不太喜欢你这顶帽子，尼克。

english: ~z~This is a nice car, I haven't seen it before.
zh: ~z~这辆车不错，之前没见你开过。

english: ~z~That hat - it doesn't really work for you.
zh: ~z~这顶帽子不太适合你。

english: ~z~I didn't know you had a new car, I like it.
zh: ~z~没想到你换了辆新车，我很喜欢。

english: ~z~I hope the food's as nice as the reputation says it is.
zh: ~z~希望这里的食物真有别人评价的那么好吃。

english: ~z~Nice bike, Niko.
zh: ~z~摩托车不错，尼克。

english: ~z~Darts? I haven't done that for the longest time.
zh: ~z~飞镖吗？我很久没玩了。

english: ~z~This isn't what we agreed at all.
zh: ~z~这根本不是我们约的地方。

english: ~z~Are those shoes new? They're great, they really suit you.
zh: ~z~这双是新鞋吗？这鞋很棒，非常适合你。

english: ~z~Darts? Again? Okay. But we should do something else sometime.
zh: ~z~飞镖？又来？行吧。但下次我们最好做点别的。

english: ~z~Pool? Cool. Haven't played for ages.
zh: ~z~台球？好啊。我好久没打了。

english: ~z~Okay - I haven't played darts for ages.
zh: ~z~好吧，我有一段时间没玩飞镖了。

english: ~z~Hey Niko, you look well, let's find a car.
zh: ~z~嘿，尼克，气色不错嘛，找辆车子吧。

english: ~z~Pool? Again? There are other ways to spend your time, Niko.
zh: ~z~台球？又来？别光把时间花在这上面，尼克。

english: ~z~Pool's quite fun, but there are other pastimes.
zh: ~z~台球是很有趣，但也有别的选择。

english: ~z~What's this? This isn't what we said. I don't want to do this just now.
zh: ~z~这是什么？我们说好的不是这样。我现在不想来这里。

english: ~z~Can't you afford any new clothes?
zh: ~z~你是买不起新衣服吗？

english: ~z~Cabaret - I wonder what's on? The crowd always scares me at this place.
zh: ~z~卡巴莱，不知道里面演的什么。这里的顾客让我有点害怕。

english: ~z~Man, it's good to be bad sometimes.
zh: ~z~天哪，偶尔干干坏事也不错。

zh: ~z~是的，我也不想有人受伤，来个吻怎么样？

english: ~z~I don't think you can afford me just yet, Niko.
zh: ~z~我想你现在还配不上我，尼克。

english: ~z~I don't know, drinking maybe?
zh: ~z~我不知道，也许是酒吧？

english: ~z~I really don't know about that sort of thing, Michelle.
zh: ~z~我真的不知道那种事，米歇尔。

english: ~z~I hope I don't have my cholesterol checked any time soon.
zh: ~z~希望我不会很快去检查胆固醇。

english: ~z~Thanks Niko - that was a lot of fun.
zh: ~z~谢谢，尼克，那真的非常有趣。

english: ~z~Great, but I hope you don't kiss and tell.
zh: ~z~好啊，但希望你不要拿这事到处吹嘘。

english: ~z~It's really good to experience Liberty City with someone else who isn't from here.
zh: ~z~和没来过自由城的人一起玩真是太棒了。

english: ~z~It's been interesting I guess, time to call it a night though.
zh: ~z~今天很有趣，不过这次就先这样吧。

english: ~z~This really is a beautiful city, isn't it? Sometimes you can just forget about all the crime and stuff here, can't you?
zh: ~z~这座城市真美啊，不是吗？在这里时甚至可以把一切罪过都忘掉，不是吗？

english: ~z~Oh my God - I can't believe this!
zh: ~z~我的天哪，真不敢相信！

english: ~z~Well, it's been fun, but I can't stay out any longer.
zh: ~z~玩得很高兴，但我不能再待在外面了。

english: ~z~I don't find this exactly funny.
zh: ~z~我不觉得这有什么好笑的。

english: ~z~It's amazing that this city can be so pretty but so dangerous too, don't you think?
zh: ~z~这个城市如此美丽，但也如此危险，不是很奇妙吗？

english: ~z~You really like that place, don't you?
zh: ~z~你真的很喜欢那个地方，不是吗？

english: ~z~This is funny - just not as they intended.
zh: ~z~某种意义上的有趣。

english: ~z~Yeah, her old boyfriend wants her back.
zh: ~z~不过她的前男友也想挽回她。

english: ~z~but move your fucking ass, pal.
zh: ~z~不过你他妈得快点，老兄。

english: ~z~Now we ain't getting shit.
zh: ~z~现在我们屁都得不到。

english: ~z~I'm screwed either way. If I don't give you the diamonds, you kill me here and you take 'em.
zh: ~z~反正我怎么着都是死。要是不给你们钻石，你们在这儿就会杀了我拿走它。

english: ~z~You might be right, Niko. Whose fucking diamonds were they anyway?
zh: ~z~说不定是这样，尼克。说起来这傻逼钻石到底是谁的？

english: ~z~Fuck, fuck, fuck. All that trouble for nothing.
zh: ~z~操，操，操。全他妈白忙活了。

english: ~z~That's a fucking tragedy. We should throw her a goodbye party.
zh: ~z~那还真他妈可惜。我们应该替她开一个送别派对。

english: ~z~Is good they are on their way to a landfill somewhere. Best place for them.
zh: ~z~现在进了垃圾场正好，再合适不过了。

english: ~z~I don't think I'll be getting out anytime soon.
zh: ~z~我觉得我多半是别想出去了。

english: ~z~A guy like Gerry can still do stuff in the joint. He organized this kidnapping shit, didn't he?
zh: ~z~格里这样的人就算在牢里也能做事，这次的绑架不就是他策划的吗？

english: ~z~I'll give you some fucking uses.
zh: ~z~老娘马上让你丫没用。

english: ~z~Unfortunately, it turns out he wasn't our only problem.
zh: ~z~不过很不幸，我们的问题似乎不止他一个。

english: ~z~You know you love it, Niko. Doesn't he Gracie?
zh: ~z~你不也很喜欢吗，尼克。对不对啊，格雷西？

english: ~z~Give her back, you animals. She's suffered enough.
zh: ~z~把她还回来，你们这些禽兽。别再折磨她了。

english: ~z~Screw that. I got close to knocking her teeth out. That was about it. We ain't got shit now.
zh: ~z~放屁，我差点没把她的牙给打下来。就是这样，我们现在屁都没了。

english: ~z~I know I'm too good for him, but sometimes a guy has got to hang out with lowlifes like Niko here.
zh: ~z~我知道我比尼克强太多了，不过有时候就是得跟他这样的底层人一起出去。

english: ~z~It can't be the only card he's got to play.
zh: ~z~这总不会是他手里的最后一张牌吧。

english: ~z~Give us that fucking ice, you're trapped.
zh: ~z~把钻石交出来，你无路可逃了。

english: ~z~She can't speak. We got a gag in her mouth.
zh: ~z~她回答不了，嘴被我们堵上了。

english: ~z~Shit, I don't wanna spend another minute in this crap-hole, let's get outta here.
zh: ~z~操，我不想在这个粪坑里多待一秒了，我们赶紧走吧。

english: ~z~Niko Bellic, how is it that whenever something is stolen from me you are not far away?
zh: ~z~尼克･贝利克，怎么每次我东西被偷都能在附近找到你？

english: ~z~They ain't getting back up, Niko. We put the bastards down.
zh: ~z~他们没有支援了，尼克。我们干掉了他们。

english: ~z~He coulda walked away from there. Instead, he's fucked and the diamonds are who knows where.
zh: ~z~大可放他走人。结果呢，他被搞了，也没人能知道钻石的下落。

english: ~z~The bastards didn't hurt you, did they?
zh: ~z~这帮混帐没伤到你吧？

english: ~z~Like a house on fire, ain't that right, Gracie?
zh: ~z~干柴烈火，不是吗，格雷西？

english: ~z~There ain't much that could cheer him up now that he thinks he's doing serious time,
zh: ~z~现在他日子不好过，本来就没多少能激励他的东西，

english: ~z~Is it finally beginning to sink in that my sister's chastity belt don't come off?
zh: ~z~你终于明白了吗，我妹妹的贞操带是拿不下来的？

english: ~z~I'm screwed either way. If I don't give you the diamonds, you kill me here and you take 'em.
zh: ~z~反正我怎么着都是死。不给你们钻石，你们就会当场杀了我拿走它。

english: ~z~At least I'm gonna be on the other side of some bulletproof glass to him.
zh: ~z~至少我还没有跟他在防弹玻璃的同一边。

english: ~z~We ain't exactly got much to exchange now, do we? Shit.
zh: ~z~看来我们没有交易的筹码了，对吧？妈的。

english: ~z~At least you didn't get what you wanted.
zh: ~z~不会遂你们的愿的。

english: ~z~Maybe they belong to this homosexual man, Gracie's friend. I don't know. Maybe to Bulgarin.
zh: ~z~可能属于这个男同性恋，格雷西的朋友。我不清楚。也可能是布尔加林。

english: ~z~Gracie, watch your mouth. Niko is good friend of mine. Don't say that about him.
zh: ~z~格雷西，嘴巴干净点。尼克是我的好朋友。别那么说他。

english: ~z~Jesus, Niko. You're gonna get killed. Get some cover.
zh: ~z~天哪，尼克。这样会没命的。找个掩体。

english: ~z~Maybe Gracie ain't so different.
zh: ~z~格雷西大概也没什么不同。

english: ~z~Probably a good thing you got out though. Wouldn't a met me if you'd stayed, would ya?
zh: ~z~不过你出来了也算是件好事。你呆在那儿就遇不到我了，不是吗？

english: ~z~Give us that fucking ice, you're trapped.
zh: ~z~把钻石交出来，你无路可逃了。

english: ~z~Gracie, it's been too long. We should hang out more often.
zh: ~z~格雷西，好久不见啊。我们应该多出去转转的。

english: ~z~At least I'm gonna be on the other side of some bulletproof glass to him.
zh: ~z~至少我还没有跟他在防弹玻璃的同一边。

english: ~z~It ain't gonna to make a blind bit of difference to me.
zh: ~z~对我来说根本没差。

english: ~z~Then some Russian turns up saying they're his. Then everything goes to shit. That's about right, isn't it?
zh: ~z~然后就有个俄国佬跳出来说钻石是他的。之后情况就完全不对了。是这样子没错吧？

english: ~z~Keep close, Niko boy.
zh: ~z~别分太开，尼克仔。

english: ~z~That rule even works for wishes as cheerful as yours.
zh: ~z~你这种令人愉快的愿望也不例外。

english: ~z~Hands off my woman, Bellic. Gracie and me is in love.
zh: ~z~别碰我的女人，贝利克。格雷西和我相爱了。

english: ~z~You normally just shove so much coke up a girl's nose she may as well be tied up.
zh: ~z~可卡因往姑娘鼻子上一洒，能不服服帖帖吗。

english: ~z~Stay close to me, Niko.
zh: ~z~别离我太远，尼克。

english: ~z~If I can get what went on straight in my head in the first place, that is.
zh: ~z~不过前提是我能弄明白刚才的状况。

english: ~z~Fuck, he weren't too chipper the last time I spoke to him and he's gonna be a long way from chipper when I tell him what went down.
zh: ~z~操，上次我跟他交谈的时候他就没什么生气，这次的事讲完他还不得直接断气。

english: Don't leave ~b~Dimitri~s~ in the shop.
zh: 别把~b~迪米特里~s~落在店里。

english: ~z~That's something else.
zh: ~z~那可真不错。

english: ~z~she's dirty, she's deep and she has her secrets, you betcha...
zh: ~z~她肮脏，她深沉，她有她的秘密，没错...

english: ~z~bodies, torn up as if by artillery. That, or giant teeth.
zh: ~z~尸体，如果不是被大炮轰过，就是被尖牙撕裂的。

english: ~z~oh yeah, good guy. I mean, I don't vote or anything but nice guy.
zh: ~z~他人挺好。我不是给他拉票，但他人确实好。

english: ~z~A sight usually reserved for transplant organs and the super rich.
zh: ~z~俯瞰不再是移植器官和超级富豪的特权。

english: ~z~all manner of ways for chubby, spoiled brats, to get whipped into a sugar frenzy.
zh: ~z~这里无所不用其极，诱使被宠坏的小胖子们陷入糖分狂热。

english: ~z~if those sheets could tell stories, right folks?
zh: ~z~只可惜那些床单不会说话，对吧？

english: ~z~Come back for food poisoning or a massage with the happiest ending in the City.
zh: ~z~这里不仅有食物中毒，还有全城最令人愉悦的按摩。

english: ~z~From us at Higgins, have a nice day and remember that tips are appreciated.
zh: ~z~我谨代表敝公司，祝您生活愉快。别忘记给小费哦。

english: ~z~these youngsters taunt death because they've never seen war. Bring back the draft.
zh: ~z~这些年轻人嘲笑死亡，因为他们从未见过战争。就该恢复兵役。

english: ~z~Give me a break.
zh: ~z~我受不了了。

english: ~z~Yep, when the hippies were distracted with weed and shit, those money guys never missed a beat.
zh: ~z~是的，虽然嬉皮士们正沉迷大麻之流，但有钱人的脚步从未停下。

english: ~z~physical or psychological, that you sustain during the trip.
zh: ~z~不论是物理上的受伤还是精神上的创伤。

english: ~z~let's hope Ochoa has the stones to protect us all. Great view, huh?
zh: ~z~希望控枪市长能靠石头保护我们。风景不错吧？

english: ~z~History, it's right there, and we haven't learned a thing.
zh: ~z~历史的教训还在，而我们没有吸取任何教训。

english: ~z~Of course, once you've seen war, God is a joke, but would you look at that architecture?
zh: ~z~当然，见过战争以后，上帝就是个笑话了，不过建筑还是值得欣赏的。

english: ~z~just a little reminder that we all need a guide through the rocky waters, don't we folks?
zh: ~z~提醒我们需要指引才能通过岩礁带，不是吗？

english: ~S~They are trying to escape in a ~r~car,~s~ don't let them get away.
zh: ~S~他们想要~r~驾车~s~逃跑，别让他们跑了。

english: ~r~You've bored ~a~.
zh: ~r~你让~a~无聊透了。

english: ~z~Get in the car, don't waste our time.
zh: ~z~赶紧给我上车，别浪费我们的时间。

english: ~z~The motherfuckers, trying to whack me at a sit down...
zh: ~z~这群杂种，想趁我不备对我重拳出击...

english: ~z~Sometimes literally. We're gonna need your skills again soon. Arrivederci.
zh: ~z~有时是字面上的没头脑。马上就会再次需要你的。再会。

english: ~z~You did good, kid. Kept your head when everyone else was losing theirs.
zh: ~z~干得不错，小子。别人都没头脑的时候你还能保持清醒。

english: ~z~You fired first. Lucky for you, they was out to whack me anyway.
zh: ~z~你为什么要先开火？不过无所谓了，他们本来就想把我干掉。

english: ~z~You gotta go, Niko. I can't move with this bullet in my gut.
zh: ~z~你自己去吧，尼克。我肚子上中了一枪，现在动弹不得。

english: ~z~They trying to make off with my tribute! The fucking nerve.
zh: ~z~他们要拿着我的礼物跑了！不要脸的。

english: ~z~At least they didn't whack me though. Drop in on me, Niko.
zh: ~z~至少他们没给我一闷棍。一会儿来找我，尼克。

english: ~z~Maybe you can pick up another one on craplist.net. Don't worry about it.
zh: ~z~或许你可以在craplist上再找一个。不要担心了。

english: ~z~Niko, you ain't gonna let them get away.
zh: ~z~尼克，你可别让他们跑了。

english: ~z~No way, Skip. Here you go.
zh: ~z~你放心吧，老大。枪给你。

english: ~z~You're a good earner, Niko. Take me back to my place.
zh: ~z~你很能干，尼克。送我回别墅吧。

english: ~z~You expect him to start throwing empty cans from up there if this thing kicks off?
zh: ~z~不拿枪出事了你让他从上面往下扔石头啊？

english: ~z~I don't know what you're busy with up there, but I need your immigrant ass down here now!
zh: ~z~我不知道你他妈在上面瞅什么，你这移民弱智赶紧给老子下来帮忙！

english: ~z~Don't leave the skipper behind.
zh: ~z~别把老大留在后面。

english: ~z~I don't know what you're busy with up there, but I need your immigrant ass down here now!
zh: ~z~我不知道你他妈在上面瞅什么，你这移民弱智赶紧给老子下来帮忙！

english: ~z~Shit, don't let these fuckers give you the shake.
zh: ~z~操，别让这群傻逼把你甩掉了。

english: ~z~This ain't pretty.
zh: ~z~这可不好。

english: ~z~The Peg won't take kindly to being left behind.
zh: ~z~你如果把老大留在后面，他会很不高兴的。

english: ~z~I ain't leaving this car with these injuries.
zh: ~z~我全身是伤，才不会下车。

english: ~z~I wouldn't have him any other way.
zh: ~z~不然我也不会让他一直在我身边。

english: ~z~Ask me why it matters. Women just don't understand this life of ours.
zh: ~z~一直说有必要吗。女人是真不明白我们这种生活。

english: ~z~It means something in Alderney even if it don't in Algonquin.
zh: ~z~就算在阿尔冈琴不太管用，但在奥尔德尼总有份量。

english: ~z~I dunno, I was just doing what Ray told me to.
zh: ~z~不知道。我只是忠实执行了雷的指令。

english: ~z~We gonna get that gift back and make this crew pay for their disrespect. Come on.
zh: ~z~赶紧夺回礼物，让他们为不尊重我付出代价。干他。

english: ~z~Ah, here they are, it's either them or the cops.
zh: ~z~啊，他们来了，不是他们就是条子。

english: ~z~Shit, sometimes I wish she'd just run off with some other guy. Leave me in peace.
zh: ~z~操，有时候我都希望回到家发现她跟别的男人跑了。让我得以安宁。

english: ~z~My old man, God rest his soul, didn't have the balls to bring the family to the level I got it to.
zh: ~z~我老爹，愿他安息，胆子没我大，没能让家族达到现在的实力水平。

english: ~z~Marco and Pete? Oh yeah, those guys didn't make it, did they? Well, too fucking bad.
zh: ~z~马可和皮特？哦对，他俩没活下来是吧？确实太可怜了。

english: ~z~I don't know. What do you think?
zh: ~z~我不知道。你怎么想？

english: ~z~Now the thing is, these guys ain't, shall we say...
zh: ~z~但现在的问题是，这些家伙没有...应该说，

english: ~z~Ray didn't go through the correct channels.
zh: ~z~雷根本没有找对路子。

english: ~z~Yeah, well, they seemed like good kids.
zh: ~z~唉，是啊，他俩都是挺不错的小伙子。

english: ~z~shown us the appropriate respect in the past.
zh: ~z~一直没给我们家族应有的尊重。

english: ~z~Keep an eye on things, 'cause they won't be looking out for you.
zh: ~z~仔细盯着情况，他们不会注意到你的存在的。

english: ~z~Don't tell me what's due to me. I been waiting for this and working hard for this for years.
zh: ~z~不用你告诉我该干什么。为此我辛苦努力了好多年。

english: ~z~When I say I wish she'd run off with another guy it's a figure of speech.
zh: ~z~我刚刚说的希望她跟别的男人跑路是夸张的说辞。

english: ~z~It ain't like she's my only woman. I got a nice little goomah set up in an apartment in Acter.
zh: ~z~她又不是我唯一的女人。我在阿克特的公寓那边还有个娘们。

english: ~z~I don't think so.
zh: ~z~我不觉得。

english: ~z~They didn't even send a fucking Capo.
zh: ~z~他们只派了几个小喽啰，连个组长都不派！

english: ~z~Rats seem to get everywhere you don't want them to be.
zh: ~z~不想见着老鼠的地方似乎也到处是老鼠。

english: ~z~Well, I didn't think you were here to sell me insurance.
zh: ~z~好吧，你长得不像是卖保险的。

english: ~z~Can't say I know.
zh: ~z~我也不知道啊。

english: ~z~They knew what they was signed on for. Weren't complaining on the way out, were they?
zh: ~z~他们知道当我手下的下场如何。在路上也没有怨言，对吧？

english: ~z~I know it's them. God, give me strength...
zh: ~z~我知道是他们。老天啊，真是受不了...

english: ~z~I don't understand.
zh: ~z~我不太明白。

english: ~z~That's just if the shit goes down, right boss? The Pavanos wouldn't fuck with you.
zh: ~z~只是防一手意外情况，对吧老大？帕瓦诺家族不会暗算你的。

english: ~z~I don't understand what you're talking about.
zh: ~z~我根本不知道你在说什么。

english: ~z~They can't give me a seat but they can help me get one.
zh: ~z~他们给不了我席位，但能帮我坐上去。

english: ~z~Yeah, well best ain't good enough. I did my best. Made a name for the Pegorinos.
zh: ~z~是啊，但光尽力还是不够。我已经为家族呕心沥血了，替佩戈里诺家族打出了名声。

english: ~z~This guy's everywhere, like a friggin' cockroach or something, ha?
zh: ~z~哪儿都能见到他，跟踩不死的蟑螂一样，哈？

english: ~z~Only, how much can I do with a guy who ain't a full Italian?
zh: ~z~但我能为一个不是纯种的意大利人做多少？

english: ~z~Exactly... I mean, we can pretty much guarantee you were followed.
zh: ~z~没错...我是说，我可以确认你百分百被跟踪了。

english: ~z~You do, but I ain't going to push.
zh: ~z~你知道的，但我也不会逼你说。

english: ~z~It don't do too well for the reputation of us Pegorinos having St Patrick that high up in our organization.
zh: ~z~组织高位有个绿帽子小精灵对我们佩戈里诺家族的声誉可不太好。

english: ~z~Yeah, even if you can't speak right, at least you can shoot straight.
zh: ~z~是啊，就算你这人不会说话，枪法也还是可以的。

english: ~z~Ah these kids come and go. It ain't worth paying attention to them until they prove they can survive.
zh: ~z~啊，这些小伙子来来走走的。如果他们不能证明自己的生存能力，就不值得我去关注。

english: ~z~Tell me about it. But I don't give a shit about them other people.
zh: ~z~这还用你说。但老子不在乎那些人是谁。

english: ~z~Or because they got too much power and they're too smart to get themselves clipped.
zh: ~z~要么因为他大权在握，头脑聪明到没那么容易被杀。

english: ~z~He's the one who's been keeping Ray from drowning in a pile of shit.
zh: ~z~之前就是他让雷不至于淹死在各种粪坑里面。

english: ~z~I didn't get where I am by believing what every schmuck told me.
zh: ~z~要是什么人说的话我都信，我就不会有今天的地位。

english: ~z~With guys like you, no wonder this 'organization' is doing so wonderfully.
zh: ~z~有你这样的「得力干将」，难怪这个「组织」运作得这么好。

english: ~z~They ain't gonna turn up their noses at that.
zh: ~z~礼物都给了，他们总不会反水吧。

english: ~z~I don't mind 'em taking a bite, I don't even make 'em give me a taste.
zh: ~z~我不介意他们来插一脚，我都没让他们给我分成。

english: ~z~Something real classy. Real nice.
zh: ~z~高级得很。非常好。

english: ~z~And right now, I don't know the answer to that question.
zh: ~z~现在，我还不知道这个问题的答案。

english: ~z~I need these guys if we're ever gonna be taken serious...
zh: ~z~没有他们，我们很难被正眼看待...

english: ~z~Sit down next to Jon Gravelli, if he survives that long,
zh: ~z~跟乔恩･格拉韦利平起平坐，如果他还没死。

english: ~z~Anyways, that's why Ray ain't ever gonna make it to the level he wants to reach.
zh: ~z~总之，这就是雷永远都得不到他想要的地位的原因。

english: ~z~They didn't come to your home while you and your wife were sleeping.
zh: ~z~至少没趁你跟你老婆睡觉的时候跑你家来暗杀。

english: ~z~You giving them a nice little offering though, skip.
zh: ~z~你不是给他们准备了一份挺好的小礼物吗，老大。

english: ~z~But to be honest, I don't really care neither.
zh: ~z~但老实说，我也根本不在乎。

english: ~z~you know, get on the Commission.
zh: ~z~真的，没法加入委员会。

english: ~z~Can't wait to see the look on their faces.
zh: ~z~我已经迫不及待地想看他们脸上的表情了。

english: ~z~Let's make 'em wish they was never born.
zh: ~z~让他们后悔出生在世界上！

english: ~z~Of course I wouldn't let some guy ball the mother of my children.
zh: ~z~我肯定不会让野男人碰孩子他妈。

english: ~z~Its okay, Mrs. P, I'll deal with this.
zh: ~z~没事的，P夫人。我来处理。

english: ~z~Earned a lot of good money for a lot of bad people. And this happens,
zh: ~z~给这帮坏蛋赚了不少钱。结果成这样了，

english: ~z~Check to make sure my ass is covered in each situation.
zh: ~z~确保我在任何情况下都万无一失。

english: ~z~You ain't the type of guy to follow orders if they weren't in your interest.
zh: ~z~你这种人不会服从不符合你利益的命令。

english: ~z~Phil's different. He's been my man for a while.
zh: ~z~菲尔不一样。他在我手下很久了。

english: ~z~I lost the guy. I couldn't find the deal.
zh: ~z~我跟丢了。没找到交易地点。

english: ~z~Tell me this job ain't as crazy as when you and me hit that bank together.
zh: ~z~告诉我，这活不会跟之前我们抢银行那件那么疯狂。

english: ~z~You'll lose your balls if you make a habit of fucking up like this. Come see me soon.
zh: ~z~你丫在像这次一样搞砸，你的蛋就别想要了。过会儿来找我。

english: ~z~You mean when Michael died? I couldn't possibly be having that much fun.
zh: ~z~你说迈克尔死的时候？我当时可没有那么「开心」。

english: ~z~Niko, I know you're probably occupied and don't wanna hang out but I thought I'd try. I'm bored.
zh: ~z~尼克我知道你现在很忙而且不愿意和我出去玩，但我现在真的太他妈无聊了。

english: ~z~Well done, my boy. I hope you made 'em suffer. Teach 'em that Alderney is Pegorino turf.
zh: ~z~干得不错，孩子。希望你让他们吃了苦头。让他们知道奥尔德尼是我佩戈里诺的地盘！

english: ~z~Too bad, my boy. Doesn't look like there's much in it for you then.
zh: ~z~不好啊，孩子。看起来没有你的份了。

english: ~z~Jackasses, all of them, all of you.
zh: ~z~一群混蛋，全这样，没一个好人！

english: ~z~We ain't a real family to them - just a bunch of Guernsey goombas.
zh: ~z~他们就没把我们当真正的家族，只把我们看作根西的小老弟。

english: ~z~Don't come back 'til you get a brain implant, or something.
zh: ~z~没安上脑子就别回来了，弱智。

english: ~z~I'm sorry... I... I'm so...
~z~Keep this fucker away from the witness.
zh: ~z~别让这个混蛋碰证人。

english: ~z~Oh, it looks like I messed something up. Sorry about that, Anthony.
zh: ~z~哦，我好像动了什么不该动的东西。不好意思了，安东尼。

english: ~z~Mr. Pegorino, I don't know what you're talking about. I came as quickly as I could.
zh: ~z~佩戈里诺先生，我不知道你在说什么，我已经尽可能快地赶过来了。

english: ~z~Boss... Peg, is that you? I'm sorry. I'm sorry.
zh: ~z~老大...是你吗？对不起，真的对不起

english: ~z~Okay, okay. Don't worry.
zh: ~z~好，好，不要担心。

english: ~z~he's such a moron, he leaves his cell phone on, so we speak.
zh: ~z~他是真的白痴，手机都不关，我们就聊了聊。

english: ~z~Hey, you can't go past here.
zh: ~z~嘿，你不能再进去了。

english: ~z~I'll go, but I ain't going quietly!
zh: ~z~我会溜走的，但不会偷偷摸摸地走！

english: ~z~Do I know you? I've seen so many green doctors, patients and cadavers, I don't recognize anyone anymore.
zh: ~z~我认识你吗？我见过了太多一身绿的医生、病人和尸体，现在认不出人了。

english: ~z~But the asshole lived and now he's in the Leftwood hospital under heavy guard.
zh: ~z~结果这混蛋没死，现在在左伍德的医院里被人严密保护。

english: ~z~Oh shit, I didn't have a choice. They was gonna put me away for some hard time.
zh: ~z~哦天哪，我真的没得选。不然我就要被关进去了。

english: ~z~I don't think you will be seeing Anthony on the witness stand.
zh: ~z~我想你不会在证言台上见到安东尼了。

english: ~z~Didn't I just?
zh: ~z~我不刚做过吗？

english: ~z~You think that coat's gonna fool me? You ain't a doctor.
zh: ~z~别以为穿个马甲我就不认识你了，你不是医生。

english: ~z~He may be a scumbag, but we need him for trial.
zh: ~z~尽管他是人渣，但审判不能没他作证。

english: ~z~I don't want to hurt you, so go. Get lost. Okay?
zh: ~z~我不想伤害你，你走吧。走远点，好吗？

english: ~z~Go for a walk. If anyone asks, you didn't see my face.
zh: ~z~散步去吧。有人问起来，你可没见过我。

english: ~z~Boss - I gotta tell you this... he's not straight.
zh: ~z~老大，我跟你讲，他有问题。

english: ~z~He should be heading over to a chop shop in BOABO. Don't get too comfortable with him, Niko.
zh: ~z~他应该是要去博阿博的改车店。不要掉以轻心，尼克。

english: ~z~I mean I don't agree with what he says - I agree that you know best...
zh: ~z~我不是同意他的建议，我同意你自有考量...

english: ~z~Like every rat, he's a survivor, he's got good instincts. He has a bad feeling about you in particular.
zh: ~z~他有叛徒的共性，擅长死里求生，直觉也很好。他对你也有不好的感觉。

english: ~z~Sorry, Mr. Pegorino. He's a cockroach, Ray would survive anything. Even a nuclear holocaust.
zh: ~z~不好意思佩戈里诺先生。雷就是个打不死的小强。估计就算核弹爆炸他也能活下来。

english: ~z~He bought some protection and he ain't gonna hang around and wait for "you know what" to happen.
zh: ~z~他雇了几个保镖，不会招摇过市等着「你懂的」发生。

english: ~z~Ray told us specifically he don't wanna see your ugly mug.
zh: ~z~雷特别叮嘱我们说不想看见你的丑脸。

english: ~z~I don't know... I gotta shut someone up, and show people I mean business.
zh: ~z~不知道...我要杀鸡儆猴，告诉他们我要动真格了！

english: ~z~I don't know, I don't trust him...
zh: ~z~我不知道...信不过他...

english: ~z~Then again, I'll get his chump muscle to stop for gas on the way.
zh: ~z~不过，我会让他的白痴保镖中途去加油的。

english: ~z~I know him and Angie are friends, but that don't worry me too much.
zh: ~z~我知道他和安吉是朋友...但他俩我不担心。

english: ~z~-The problem with this guy is, I can't even think straight, he's always talkin'. ~n~-Slow down Phil you take everything too personal.
zh: ~z~－这人的问题是，别打断我，他一直说个不停。~n~－嘿，你，慢慢讲，菲尔，别老在意别人。

english: ~z~Cleaning house is a tough job, Bellic. I don't got much left in mine, it's so clean.
zh: ~z~打扫屋子可不容易啊，贝利克。我家快打扫完了，很干净。

english: ~r~The runners were not stopped.
zh: ~r~毒贩逃走了。

-Immigrated to the US, possibly illegally, from Russia.
-Believed to be head of a car stealing ring based in Dukes.
-Wanted for questioning by the Russian government in connection with the bank rolling of terrorist activity around the Caspian Sea.

- 或以非法方式由俄罗斯移民美国。

english:
-Ex-lover of Pavano Crime Syndicate head Mary Valvona.
-Believed to be in charge of the Pavano Crime family's heroin distribution network.
-Often seen with African American drug dealers in North Holland.
-Ties to the Humboldt River Dock Workers Local Union - believed to use these connections to bring heroin into Liberty City.
zh:
- 曾是帕瓦诺犯罪家族头目玛丽･瓦尔沃纳的情人。
- 据信其负责管理帕瓦诺犯罪家族的海洛因销售网络。
- 常与北荷兰的非裔毒贩一起被目击。
- 与码头工会汉博尔特河分会关系密切，据信其利用这一关系将海洛因运入自由城。

english:
-Personal bodyguard of James Pegorino, head of the Alderney-based Pegorino crime family.
-Believed to be unhappy in his role and possible candidate for the Witness Protection Program.
-Recently admitted to hospital after a beating, possibly at the hands of Pegorino.
-Heart condition.
zh:
- 以奥尔德尼为据点的佩戈里诺犯罪家族头目杰姆斯･佩戈里诺的私人保镖。
- 据信其对自己的身份不满，可作为证人保护计划的候选人。
- 近期因遭受殴打被送入医院，或由佩戈里诺造成。
- 有心脏疾病。

english:
-Believed to have been in charge of blackmarket rackets selling contraband to US troops in Naples at the close of WWII - he was 15.
-Immigrated to the US in 1950 and worked in the Alderney Fruit Market which he now owns.
-Ran a loan sharking, fencing and extortion operation from the market.
-Believed to have taken control of the crime family since the death of his uncle in 1978
-Links to nightclub owner Tony Prince.
-Father of Gracie Ancelotti.
-Street name - Old Man Ancelotti
zh:
- 据信其于二战结束后向那不勒斯的美国驻军非法出售走私品，时年15岁。
- 1950年移民至美国，曾工作于奥尔德尼水果市场，该市场现已在其名下。
- 在此市场中进行放贷、赃物交易与敲诈勒索。
- 据信在其叔叔于1978去世后掌握家族大权。
- 与夜店老板托尼･普林斯有联系。
- 格雷西･安切洛蒂之父。
- 绰号「安切洛蒂头子」。
