-Head of the Gambetti Crime Syndicate since the death of Sonny Cangelosi in 1978.
-Indicted several times but never convicted of a serious crime.
-Resident of the Schottler Medical Center for the last 3 years due to an allegedly serious illness.
zh:
- 于1978年桑尼･坎杰洛西死后继位甘贝蒂犯罪家族头目。
- 多次受到起诉，但从未被判重罪。

english:
-Sexual deviant. Paid for his favorite stripper from the Triangle Club to have nursing training so she could look after him in hospital.
-Still believed to be the principle hitman for the Lupisella Crime Syndicate, despite his age.
-Suffered a massive heart attack in 2003 back on the job 10 days later - whacking a cardiologist with gambling debts.
-Believed to be the hitman behind a number of bodies that recently found floating in the West River with plucked eyebrows.

- 性癖异常。出钱赞助其在三角俱乐部最喜欢的一个脱衣舞女参加护士培训，以在医院受她照顾。
- 据信其仍为卢皮塞拉犯罪家族手下的头号杀手，尽管其年事已高。
- 于2003年突发心脏病，发病其十天前刚杀害一名背负赌债的心脏病医生。
- 据信其为近期West River众多无眉浮尸的制造者。

english:
-Head of the Alderney Chapter of the Lost Outlaw Motorcycle Gang.
-Recently convicted of drug related felony and sentenced to rehabilitation.
-Johnny Klebitz is believed to have taken over control of the Chapter while Grey was incarcerated.
-Some of the Lost's Alderney chapter worst confrontations to date with the Angels of Death OMG occurred under his command.

english: Keeping our constitutional rights off the streets of Liberty City?

english: Idealistic Liberty City Mayor, Julio Ochoa, vowed to rid our city's streets of illegal firearms yesterday, "Our gun laws are in place for a reason. It is my duty as Mayor to enforce those laws - whether that means prosecuting the thugs possessing weapons here in Liberty City, or the salespeople providing those weapons out of state." Mayor Ochoa's task force has launched cases against Ammu-Nation stores as far a field as Los Santos and Vice City. The mayor boasts of low crime rates in the city and a high murder conviction rate.
zh: 理想主义的自由城市长，胡里奥･奥乔亚于昨日发誓，要根除本市街头的非法枪支弹药：「我们的控枪法律是有必要存在的。作为市长，我有义务强化这些法律，无论是要起诉本市持有武器的暴徒，还是起诉来自其他州的武器贩子，我都在所不辞。」奥乔亚市长的专门工作组已对远在洛圣都和罪城的武装国度商店提起诉讼。市长以本市的低犯罪率和高谋杀案结案率为荣。

english: Last year over 10,000 illegal firearms were recovered by the LCPD. There were over 500 gun-related homicides. Is Ochoa's campaign a case of too little, too late? Will his jaunts to sunnier cities save our children from their almost certain fates? The sale or possession of firearms is illegal here, in Liberty City. Does that mean that weapons are only in the hands of people willing to use them for evil? It remains to be seen.
zh: 去年LCPD收回了超过一万支非法枪械。超过500起涉枪谋杀于去年发生。奥乔亚的行动是否会收效甚微，为时过晚？他到阳光更好的城市进行考察，能否让孩子们摆脱几乎注定的命运？在自由城，贩卖或持有枪支弹药是违法的。这是否意味着，武器只会出现在愿意用其作恶的人手中？让我们拭目以待。

english: It's a long time since the city has had a proper serial killer and we think this is going to get worse before it gets better. Detective Squad Chief Jon Atkinson said, "I'm going to be getting my name in the papers a lot if this guy turns out to be a serial killer, so I've got to make sure I don't say or do anything stupid. We strongly recommend people don't go out and, if they do, that they stay where there's lots of people and carry a cell phone or a policeman with them at all times. The most important thing, though, is that people don't panic more than is strictly necessary." We will keep you posted.
zh: 本市已经很久没出过像样的连环杀人犯了，而我们认为事态来不及好转就会急剧恶化。专案组指挥乔恩･阿特金森说：「如果这个人真的是连环杀人犯的话，我肯定会在报纸上声名鹊起，所以我的发言和行动都不能有任何闪失。我们强烈建议市民不要外出，非要外出，那也待在人多的地方，而且还要全程携带手机或警察。但最重要的还是，千万不要无缘无故慌张过度。」我们会为您持续报道。

english: Hold The Call
zh: 别挂电话

english: There's a war going on right here on our doorsteps. Everyone thinks that members of motorcycle gangs are friendly bearded rebels who want to take you for a ride. But there's more to that beard than meets the eye.
zh: 战争就在我们的家门口。摩托帮并不是友善的叛逆大胡子，也未必会骑车带你兜风。大胡子底下可没表面上那么简单。

english: Was Judge Barry Griffin's sentence too lenient for this hardened drug trafficker? If anyone deserved to be put into a maximum security correctional facility, it was Billy Grey. His sentencing to a country club rehabilitation center is an insult to all of us on the side of law and order.
zh: 巴里･格里芬法官对这个贩毒惯犯的判决是否过轻？比利･格雷这种人就该关进最高安保级别的监狱。判他去乡下戒毒所完全是对我们这些遵纪守法好公民的侮辱。

english: The Broker Bridge, the Algonquin Bridge, the East Borough Bridge, the Northwood Heights Bridge, the Hickey Bridge and the Booth Tunnel have remained closed since the threat of Terrorism escalated over the summer. Thousands of Liberty City residents are failing to reach work each day and having to resort to public transport. Experts estimate that this is costing Liberty City business millions of dollars a day. Surely it is time for Mayor Julio Ochoa to reopen these bridges?
zh: 自今年夏天的恐怖主义威胁升级以来，布洛克大桥、阿尔冈琴大桥、东区大桥、北伍德高地大桥、希基大桥以及布斯隧道一直处于关闭状态。成千上万的自由城居民无法准时上班，被迫搭乘公共交通。据专家估算，这种情况每天将给自由城的企业造成上百万损失。胡里奥･奥乔亚市长也差不多该开放这些大桥了吧？

english: Nameless Killer Strikes Again
zh: 无名杀手再度袭击

english: Brucie Kibbutz, the high-flying owner of Brucie's Executive Lifestyle Autos, is an expert on the street racing scene. "People come to my place to get their cars tricked out. They come to Brucie because his place is the best. He's genetically different! That's how he rolls.
zh: 布鲁斯･基布兹是布鲁斯高端生活豪车城的老板，也是街头赛车领域的专家。「人们来我的店改装爱车。之所以选择布鲁斯是因为我的店最好。他骨子里就不同！这就是他的风格。」

english: A group of young men are turning the streets of Liberty City into death traps. They meet in super-charged killing machines in order to race at insane speeds through city streets. In the world of illegal street racing, all that matters is the size of your stick, the smell of your leather, the garishness of your paintjob, and the sheen on your rims.
zh: 一群年轻人正在将自由城的街道变为死亡陷阱。他们驾驶着性能强劲的杀戮机器碰头，然后就在自由城的大街小巷一路狂飙。在非法街头赛车的世界里，最重要的是你的车贴大不大，皮革的味道好不好，你的涂装有多花哨，你的轮圈有多闪亮。

english: Tempers flared on Capitol Hill as Congress put aside health care and war legislation to discuss what is on everyone's mind - cocks. Specifically, man cock and another man with a dog collar. At times the debate centered on hot lesbian action, but conservatives defeated riders and focused on man-on-man debate. Politicians went at it fiercely into the night, tired and sore from hours of passionate exchanges. Legislation on same-sex marriage is expected soon.
zh: 国会山的气氛摩擦升温，但国会并不是在讨论暂时搁置的医保制度和战争法案，而在讨论所有人的关注的议题——屌。具体来说，是男人和另一个戴项圈的男人。辩论的焦点有时是性感的女同行为，但保守派会把话题引回来，回归关于男男的辩论。政客们激烈地争论到深夜，经过数小时的激烈交锋，他们疲惫不堪，浑身酸痛。同性婚姻的相关法律有望于近期颁布。

english: A gas, leather, and crystal meth-fueled war is raging on the streets of Liberty City. It isn't nations fighting but rival motorcycle gangs battling for control of the streets. Men have died in this war, like The Lost biker Jason Michaels who was killed in Broker recently. How long is it going to be before innocent civilians are killed as well? Mainly thanks to the Angels of Death and their public relations efforts, biker gangs have taken on a much more friendly image in recent years. They appear in family-friendly movies and are romanticized in video games and TV shows. They are thought to stand for a noble rebellion against the norms of society. Be warned, this image is just a smokescreen used to cover up their real criminal agenda - sleeping with your wife and selling meth to your kids.
zh: 一场由汽油、皮革和冰毒驱动的战争正在自由城的街道上演。这不是国与国的争斗，而是敌对摩托帮间的地盘争夺。这场战争已经出现了死者，比如失落帮的杰森･迈克尔斯就于近日在布洛克遇害。再过多久才会出现无辜平民遇害呢？多亏了死亡天使的公关工作，近年来民众对摩托帮的印象十分良好。他们在合家欢电影里出镜，在电视上和游戏里美化自己，将自己塑造成反抗社会陈规的高尚叛逆者。当心点，这幅表象只是伪装犯罪企图的烟雾弹，他们的真正目的是：睡了你的老婆，毒害你的孩子。

english: Menotti is just one of a number of mobsters who have recently turned on their fellow criminals in exchange for lenient sentencing. While some applaud the efforts of the FIB, others think that the convictions are futile. Ex-Secretary of Security Enforcement, Bobby Jefferson, had this to say, "There's always going to be organized crime. The mob in Liberty City is being weakened, but it's just opening up room for new gangsters coming to town. The Alderney-based mobsters are trying to take control of Liberty City rackets and gangsters are coming in from Eastern Europe. These guys are even worse than the likes of Vito Dog Meat. There's a lot of money in Liberty City and officials willing to be bought off, so there'll always be crooks here trying to take advantage of the situation. It's unfortunately the dark side of human nature."
zh: 最近有许多罪犯供出同伙换取减刑，梅诺蒂只是其中一个。有人认同FIB的贡献，但也有人认为这些定罪是无用功。前国安办主任博比･杰斐逊认为：「有组织犯罪无法根绝。自由城的罪犯的确遭受打击，但这只会为外来犯罪团伙提供空间。奥尔德尼系犯罪团伙试图掌控自由城黑社会，而东欧黑帮也开始猖獗起来。他们比维托･狗肉更加糟糕。自由城充满财富，官员也乐意受贿，所以总会有坏蛋想从中牟利的。很可惜，这就是人性之恶。」

english: Club owner bemoans loss of LC Nightlife
zh: 夜店老板哀叹自由城没有夜生活

english: Shipment intercepted at docks
zh: 码头货物被罚没

english: Liberals are complaining that our war mongering President has driven up the price of gas. Conservatives say immigrant cab drivers are greedy, un-American pro-union bullies and we should close the borders. The Taxi Drivers Association says the price increase is due to the increased risk of terrorism in Liberty City. We think it's because all the hipsters and neophytes have moved out of Algonquin and into Broker and drivers can't tell the difference between an unwashed trust fund kid who dresses like a street urchin and an actual hobo, so they cut their losses and overcharge everyone.
zh: 自由派控诉我们的战争贩子总统让油气价格大涨。保守派则称那些移民司机为贪婪、亲工会的异国恶霸，主张封锁边境。的士司机工会却说，车资提高是自由城遭恐袭概率大幅上升所致。我们认为是因为所有的嘻哈歌手都搬出了阿尔冈琴去了布洛克，而司机们无法区分哪个衣着破烂的人是受信托基金赞助的下层小孩，哪个是真正的小流浪汉。所以他们通过对所有人收天价车费来减少损失。

english: Another day, another body dragged from the Humboldt River. This time it is ship Captain, Zorba Philippidis - his body bloated and partially consumed by water rats. Autopsy results cite drowning as the cause of death but reveal massive quantities of alcohol in his system. Captain Philippidis recently arrived in East Hook Bay on his ship, the Platypus. All members of the crew of this ship remain unaccounted for since it was unloaded.
zh: 新的一天，新的尸体被从洪堡河中捞出。这次是一名船长，名为佐尔巴･菲利皮迪斯。他的尸体浮在水面上，也遭到了水鼠的啃食。验尸结果表明其死因为溺水，但其体内有大量酒精残留。菲利皮迪斯船长最近乘坐鸭嘴兽号抵达了东胡克湾。卸货完毕以后，此船的所有船员都下落不明。

english: Whatever the reason, this reporter is going to be driving home drunk, as he certainly can't afford a cab.
zh: 不论原因如何，撰写本文的记者要酒驾回家了。因为他肯定打不起的。

english: Ushering in a whole new wave of pro-America feeling, 30,000 new N.O.O.S.E agents were sworn in to help defend the homeland. In what are promised to be intense interrogation techniques by federal agents, the extension of the Jingoism Act removes the checks and balances that were hindering protecting America. Another part of the provision includes throwing out all history books that might indicate abandoning a free republic to be a bad idea.
zh: 伴随着一股全新的爱国浪潮，三万名新注册的国安办探员宣誓保卫祖国。沙文主义法案的更新放松了对联邦探员采用的过激审讯手段的限制，并且消除了阻碍保护美国的制衡措施。该条款中还包含这一内容：销毁所有或明或暗表示不应放弃自由共和国的历史书籍。

english: A Lawyer, Tom Goldberg, was murdered in his high security Algonquin office today. Mr. Goldberg was believed to be engaged in pursuing corruption charges against high ranking members of the LCPD along with several members of City Hall. Previously, Mr. Goldberg had been involved in cases against the mafia, class action suits against food companies and also won a case against the Strike Lite match company for failing to put a warning on their matches that the product could cause fire if used correctly. In a moment of hubris, he also unsuccessfully sued God for letting it rain on his parade. The killer gained entrance to the offices of Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster where Mr. Goldberg was a partner. Dick Shyster, another partner in the firm, eulogized Mr. Goldberg in a press release, "Tom will be sorely missed by all the people he got off. I'll be taking over a lot of his cases, so hopefully I'll get a media profile as big as his and eventually run for political office myself."
zh: 今日，辩护律师汤姆･戈德堡于其高安保标准的阿尔冈琴事务所遇害。据悉，戈德堡先生曾对LCPD高官和几名市政厅官员发起腐败指控。戈德堡先生此前经办过针对黑手党的诉讼、针对食品公司的集体诉讼，他还以未在火柴包装上写明「正确使用本品会产生火焰」为由起诉Strike Lite火柴公司，并且赢下了这场诉讼。其最傲慢的时刻当属控告上帝在其游行庆祝时下雨。犯人侵入了戈德堡等人共同经营的戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行。律师行的合伙人Dick 舒斯特在新闻通稿中称赞了戈德堡先生：「在汤姆帮助下得到减刑或无罪判决的委托人将会沉痛悼念他。之后我会接手他留下的大部分案子，因此我也很有希望获得他那样优秀的媒体形象，之后还能自己参选政治职位。」

english: Biker Lawlessness Continues
zh: 飞车党继续无法无天

english: The Police Commissioner has stated that, besides terrorists and peaceful political protest we don't approve of, the next biggest threat to civic order within Liberty City is motorcycle gangs. A recent barroom shootout resulted in several young Asian men dead at the hands of leather-clad, bike-riding harbingers of death.
zh: 警局局长称，除了恐怖分子和我们不认同的和平政治抗议外，对自由城公共秩序危害最大的就是那些摩托帮。最近某酒吧发生了一起枪击案，让数名年轻的亚洲男子死在了那些穿皮衣、骑摩托的牛头马面手中。

english: Some of us never have successful resolution of the Oedipus Complex, a situation that turned deadly in Rotterdam Hill. Joshua Hampton, age 6 months, was arrested by police after a neighbor called in a report of strange noises at the apartment next door. Police found the body of Abraham Hampton, 31, stuffed under a baby changing station in their Rotterdam Hill apartment and, just like Laius and Jocasta, Joshua and his mother were already planning their wedding.
zh: 我们中的一些人从未摆脱恋母情结，而这种情结在鹿特丹山出现了极端情况。约书亚･汉普顿，6个月大，在邻居因隔壁公寓有异响报案后被警方逮捕。警方在其家中发现了31岁的亚伯拉罕･汉普顿的尸体，尸体被塞在尿布台下面，就像拉伊俄斯和约卡斯塔的故事一样，约书亚和他的母亲已经在计划婚礼了。

english: Former Secretary of Security Enforcement, Bobby Jefferson, is coming to Liberty City from the nation's capital in order to give an address on the topic. Mr. Jefferson commented, "While the Mafia has been a constant parasite on the earnings of honest city workers, they are a known entity. We don't know how far this new breed of criminal will be willing to go in order to make a buck. Police are going to have to move quickly or this problem will get completely out of control." Liberty City, you have been warned.
zh: 前国安办主任博比･杰斐逊将从美国首都来到自由城，就这一问题发表讲话。杰斐逊先生说：「尽管黑手党长期在朴实工人身上吸血，但我们熟悉他们。而我们并不知道这个新的犯罪团伙为了钱会做到什么地步。我认为警方必须迅速采取行动，否则这一问题将会完全失控。」自由城，你被警告了。

english: It's been a long time coming, but finally the Hickey Bridge and Booth Tunnel that link Alderney to Liberty City have reopened, meaning lots of angry soccer moms with fake tans can get into the city to max out their credit cards and complain about the traffic they've caused while paying less taxes across the river. Great. We at the Liberty Tree cannot wait for the big haired invasion.
zh: 这一天终于还是来了，连接奥尔德尼和自由城的希基大桥与布斯隧道再次开放，来势汹汹、做过美黑的足球妈妈可以过来刷爆自己的信用卡，抱怨自己导致的交通堵塞了，而河对岸居民需要缴纳的税款还更少。真好。我们Liberty Tree编辑部已经等不及这群爆炸头的入侵了。

english: Now several employees are revealing that such doping products should also be banned from the board room. Interns have complained of 'roid rages' and terrifying outbreaks of acne. One former Eris employee told us, "Pete has become increasingly delusional and terrifyingly vain. As the drugs caused his testicles to shrink, he'd often use golf balls inside his cycling shorts so that he looked good in a spin class." We will stay with this story if it becomes interesting.
zh: 几名Eris的员工坦言，董事会中也应禁止此类兴奋剂。有实习生抱怨这类药物带来的「突然暴躁」和大量痤疮。一名前Eris雇员告诉我们：「皮特的精神状态越来越不正常了，他虚荣得可怕。由于药物导致他的睾丸萎缩，他经常会把高尔夫球放进骑行短裤，这样他在动感单车课上就会看起来很棒了。」我们会对此事的后续展开保持关注。

english: Keep-fit fanatic and chief executive and founder of Eris Sportswear, Pete Vassal, has been checked into rehab after admitting a chronic addiction to steroids. Mr. Vassal, the man famed as having the best abs of anyone running a BAWSAQ company, attributed his fitness to a punishing exercise regime. Now it emerges that Mr. Vassal also was a serious 'juicer', consuming a wide variety of steroids and doping products, including the deadly bull shark testosterone, a form of the male hormone so strong it induces terrifying rages and mood swings in all who take it. Mr. Vassal had only recently spoken out against performance-enhancing drugs in sport.
zh: 健身爱好者、Eris运动服饰的CEO和创始人皮特･瓦萨尔，承认自己对类固醇成瘾已久，随后他被送入戒毒所。瓦萨尔先生以拥有BAWSAQ上市公司高管中最好的腹肌闻名，他将这一成就归功于刻苦锻炼。现在看来，瓦萨尔先生也是一个严重的「药罐子」，他使用了多种类固醇和兴奋剂药品，包括致命的牛鲨睾酮，这是一种雄性荷尔蒙，其强度之大，会让服用它的人感到无比愤怒，情绪极易波动。瓦萨尔先生直到最近才公开反对在体育比赛中使用兴奋剂。

english: Community Leader Manny Escuela was bored of seeing government initiatives fail to improve social conditions in South Bohan, so he has taken matters into his own hands. He is pushing for change and documenting these pushes in a film to be released later in the year. Although the exact nature of the changes is as yet unclear, Mr. Escuela is confident that the community can pull together under his leadership. He told reporters yesterday, "I just wanna make a difference any way I can." Escuela went on to say, "I been bad, and now I wanna make a difference and document that in a film, so people can see a tough guy can have a heart of gold - inspire people. I ain't doing this for the fame. I'm doing it because I love my community. And people from the community need to see me in a movie." Who needs sociologists when you've got committed citizens like Mr. Escuela?
zh: 社区领袖曼尼･埃斯库埃拉已经厌倦了政府对南波汉的失败治理，于是他决定亲自出马。他正在推动改变，其行动也被拍成了纪录片，预计将于年内上映。尽管社区发生变化的具体原因尚不明了，但埃斯库埃拉先生非常自信，认为社区在他的领导下可以团结一心。昨日他告诉记者：「我不过是尽己所能让社区有所改变而已。」埃斯库埃拉继续说道：「我曾经也坏过，但现在我真的想为社区做出贡献，并且将此拍成纪录片。这样人们就能知道铁汉与善心并不矛盾，可以鼓舞别人改邪归正。我这么做不是为了出名，而是因为我爱我的社区。而且社区居民有必要在影片中看到我。」当有埃斯库埃拉先生这样无私奉献的人存在时，谁还需要社会学家呢？

english: Signaling that the war on vices has hit a red line pace, Congress made good on its pledge to outlaw online poker by moving the bill to the floor of the house. "Gambling is wrong. My religion says it's wrong, and I'm going to tell you how to spend your money and free time," said Congressman Shilton.
zh: 新生活运动并非口号，国会为了兑现禁止网络赌博的诺言，已将相关法案移交众议院进行讨论。「赌博是错误的，我的信仰告诉我这是错的。就由我来告诉你们钱该怎么花，时间该怎么用。」众议员希尔顿说。

english: Police officers spoke out yesterday about the incredible spate of urban myths that are damaging the image of Liberty City. The nonstop rumors of dead pop stars, sasquatches, giant alligators, secret cities, invincible criminals, and dogs have all been causing wide spread disturbances "in the minds of insane residents", said one spokesman, who was investigating reports a man had his drink spiked and a kidney stolen, which turned out to be spurious. We will stay with this story. In related news, police are investigating claims a whale was seen swimming in Middle Park.
zh: 昨日警方发表讲话，主题是正在破坏自由城形象的各种离奇都市传说。对于包括 已逝流行明星、长毛野人、巨鳄、神秘城市、无敌罪犯还有各种狗在内的引起广泛骚乱的都市传说，一位警官称它们为「疯子公民的臆想」。在这位警官的调查报告中，有一名男子被人在酒中下药，偷走了一个肾，而最终结果表明这是伪造的。我们将对此保持关注。顺带一提，警方正在调查有人在中央公园目击鲸鱼游泳的说法。

english: An audacious prison escape, like something you might see on a Weazel Network show, occurred ninety seven feet under the surface of the West River earlier. A convoy carrying convicted felon, Aiden O'Malley, was ambushed by two trucks. O'Malley was being taken from a police station in Algonquin back to the Alderney State Correctional Facility. Two men used the trucks to block the convoy from the front and the back in the middle of the Booth Tunnel while they freed O'Malley. O'Malley, 48, who is American born but spent much of his adult life in Ireland, was serving a twenty-year term for his involvement in a string of robberies.
zh: 不久前在西河之下30米的地方，发生了一起惊天劫狱案，就像Weazel电视台的节目演的那样。押运重罪犯艾登･奥马利的囚车车队正在将奥马利由阿尔冈琴警局押送至奥尔德尼州立监狱，途中遭到了两辆卡车截击。车队驶至布斯隧道中段时，两名男子驾驶卡车一前一后拦截了车队，随后劫走了奥马利。现年48岁的奥马利出生于美国，但他的成年生活大部分在爱尔兰度过，他因参加了一系列的抢劫活动被判20年有期徒刑。

english: A man in period dress was found literally headless after a brawl outside a Dukes movie theater that was showing the movie Dragonbrain. Fans of the movie franchise often dress as their favorite character from the movie and speak in Middle English. Police say the fans argue over movie minutia within the smallest point of trivia sometimes leading to violent conflict. The assailant in the altercation is still being sought by police, but witnesses say he was dressed in a jester costume and playing a lute when he got involved in an argument with the victim about whether it was a realistic plot point that a dragon could breed with a horse. The argument turned violent with the jester seizing the victim's sword and fatally wounding him. Police are requesting any court jesters in the area to come forward voluntarily so that they can eliminate them from their inquiries.
zh: 在上映《龙之脑》的公爵区电影院外，出现了一具身着古装的无头男尸。本片影迷常会扮演他们最喜爱的电影角色，说中古英语。警方表示，影迷会为电影中的一些细枝末节争吵，有时甚至会引发暴力冲突。警方仍在追捕犯人，但有目击者称当杀人犯与受害者争论「剧情中龙与马可以交配是否有据可循」时，杀人犯身穿小丑服装，弹着鲁特琴。而当争吵愈演愈烈时，犯人夺走了受害者的剑，并将其残忍杀害。警方要求这一地区的所有小丑主动来警局接受检查，以便洗脱他们的嫌疑。

english: Team owners are considering firing the Swingers head coach as the steroid scandal grows. Some key players weren't taking any steroids at all while others were only taking 50% of the maximum dosage. "This is absolutely unacceptable," said a statement from the team's owners, "The Swingers are here to play baseball and win games. Coaches are expected to push players to the limit, both physically and pharmacologically." Most fans agree after the several seasons of poor performance by the Swingers organization.
zh: 随着类固醇丑闻的发酵，球队老板们正在考虑解雇浪人队的主教练，原因竟是类固醇用得不够多。某些主力球员根本不使用类固醇，而其他人只服用了最高剂量的50%。「这样完全不行，」球队老板表示，「浪人队是来打棒球的，是要赢得比赛的。教练们应该在生理和药理上都让球员发挥极限。」在经历了几个赛季的低迷后，大多数浪人队球迷都表示同意此观点。

english: Passengers on the subway between Algonquin and Dukes saw an unusual sight earlier - members of The Lost biker gang in a dramatic fight for their lives. The bikers entered the tunnel system in North Holland and sped along the tracks at high speed, weaving between oncoming trains and exchanging gunfire. An unconfirmed witness reports that there were three bikes involved in the chase. Two bodies have so far been recovered. One being identified as Jim Fitzgerald, a member of the Alderney chapter of The Lost. Police are struggling to identify the other one. Authorities are appealing to other members of The Lost and their rival biker club, the Angels of Death, for any information.
zh: 早些时候，往返于阿尔冈琴和公爵区之间的地铁上的乘客看到了不寻常的景象——表演生死大战的失落摩托帮成员。飞车党从北荷兰进入了隧道，沿着铁轨高速行驶，在迎面而来的列车之间穿梭交火。一名未经证实的目击者报告说，有三辆摩托参与了追逐。目前已找到两具尸体。其中一人的身份被确认为吉姆菲茨杰拉德，系失落摩托帮奥尔德尼分会的成员。警方正在全力调查另一具尸体的身份。有关部门也在向失落摩托帮的其他成员和他们的敌对帮派死亡天使寻求有关信息。

english: Steroid Scandal Rocks Baseball As Swingers Team Admits Low Dosages
zh: 棒球界爆出类固醇丑闻，浪人队承认他们用药不足

english: Jittery investors scrambled to curb a growing crisis in financial markets. Emerging debt markets were affected when stockbrokers spent way too much money on Friday night, consuming 2.5 grams of Colombian exports and yielding a larger than average load on the tits of a Russian stripper.
zh: 不安的投资者们竭尽全力遏制金融市场日益增长的危机。由于股票经纪人在享乐上挥霍了过多金钱、消耗了2.5克哥伦比亚进口商品、让俄罗斯裔脱衣舞女的胸部承受了不可承受之重，新兴债券市场也受到了影响。

english: Today, the LCPD is hungry for blood. They're out to find a killer who took one of their own, Deputy Police Commissioner Francis McReary. McReary was gunned down in a small courtyard park in Algonquin. He was apparently killed with a high-caliber rifle shot from some distance. McReary's recent career has been mired in controversy. Some news outlets claim they have evidence of bribe-taking and corruption by Mr. McReary, claims he strongly denied until his death. In an unrelated incident his brother, Gerald McReary, a convicted felon, was recently arrested again on racketeering charges.
zh: 今天，LCPD的所有人都红了眼，他们倾尽全力地寻找杀害警局副局长弗朗西斯･麦克雷里的凶手。麦克雷里在阿尔冈琴的一个小公园里遭到枪击。他显然是被远处的一杆大口径狙击步枪所杀。最近麦克雷里的警察生涯深陷泥潭，一些媒体称他们掌握了麦克雷里先生腐败受贿的证据，而麦克雷里先生生前对此坚决否认。在另外一起与此案无关的事件中，他有重罪前科的弟弟格里･麦克雷里，最近又因为涉黑被捕。

english: Today the Liberty Tree witnessed an emotional reunion between an Algonquin couple and their son who was lost for six years in a KRAPEA store. A well-known pedophile at Krapea's Alderney branch alerted staff to a pallid youth whom he had spotted sleeping in the same bunk-bed on his last three visits. The child's mother told reporters, "It's a miracle. We were sure that our son was dead and had even converted his bedroom into a home gym. He appears to be a little institutionalized and cannot understand why we don't have fifteen adjacent kitchens but it's great to have him back."
zh: 今天，Liberty Tree目睹了阿尔冈琴的两夫妇和在宜室走失了六年的儿子的重聚。一位著名恋童癖提醒了宜室的奥尔德尼分店工作人员，称他在最近三次购物中发现一名面色苍白的年轻人睡在同一张双层床上。孩子的母亲告诉记者，「这简直是奇迹，我们都以为他死了，还把他的房间改成了健身房。我儿子似乎有一些缺乏常识，还执着于『为什么我们家没有15个连着的厨房』这种奇怪的问题，不管怎样，能找到他真是太好了。」

english: Deputy Police Commissioner, Francis McReary, witnessed his brother's murder as he was assassinated in an Algonquin park. Derrick McReary, 52, had recently returned to Liberty City from Ireland. Before he had left the country, he had been registered as an informant with the LCPD and investigators are taking this as a likely motive for the murder. In unrelated news, a third brother, Gerald McReary, was recently arrested on racketeering charges.
zh: 警察局副局长弗朗西斯･麦克雷里目睹了他哥哥德里克･麦克雷里在阿尔冈琴公园遇害的过程。德里克･麦克雷里，52岁，最近刚从爱尔兰回到自由城。离开爱尔兰前，他已被LCPD登记为线人，调查人员认为这可能是本案的作案动机。在另外一起与此案无关的事件中，他们的三弟格里･麦克雷里最近因涉黑被捕。

english: Video Games Fire Blanks
zh: 电子游戏导致性无能

english: Elizabeta Torres, a drug dealer from South Bohan, was handed a record prison sentence at the Civic Citadel yesterday. Liberty City Judge, Mitt Burrows, slapped her with a 300 year stretch for thirty counts of cocaine distribution. It is also believed that Torres murdered Bohan community leader, Manny Escuela, and documentary film maker, Jay Hamilton. They have been missing for several weeks but police cannot bring charges until their bodies are discovered. The District Attorney submitted hundreds of hours of surveillance audio in the trial. These tapes provided evidence of her working with international drug rings. The last tape before her arrest, played at her trial yesterday, features a heated conversation between her, a Jamaican man and an Eastern European man. Authorities have been unable to locate either of these individuals.
zh: 伊丽莎贝塔･托雷斯是一名来自南波汉的毒贩，昨日米特･伯罗斯法官在市政厅对其以30项关于贩卖可卡因的指控判处300年有期徒刑，刷新了司法史上的判刑纪录。托雷斯还被怀疑涉嫌谋杀波汉的社区领袖曼尼･埃斯库埃拉和纪录片制作人杰･汉密尔顿，两人均已失踪数个星期。目前警方尚未发现这两人的尸体，无法对其提出谋杀指控。地方检察官在庭审中提交了数百小时的监听录音带，为证明托雷斯涉嫌参与跨国走私毒品提供了证据。昨日庭审中还播放了托雷斯被捕前的最后一卷录音，录音内容是其与一名牙买加男性和一名东欧男性的激烈争吵。目前有关部门仍未找到这两人。

english: What would you do if the hard-earned American dollars in your wallet turned out to be cheap communist knockoffs? Unfortunately it's already happened. N.O.O.S.E operatives have started to find high-quality counterfeit $100 bills in circulation in Liberty City. They are believed to be so-called supernotes - fake currency using identical ink and paper to genuine bills printed overseas. Police believe the current batch originates from Asia. N.O.O.S.E estimates that among $100 bills one in every fifty is counterfeit.
zh: 当你钱包中的血汗钱变成了廉价的共产主义仿制品时，你会怎么做？很不幸，这一幕正在现实中上演。近日，国安办探员已在在自由城流通的美元中发现了高仿$100假币。这种假币在地下社会被称为「超级钞」，是一种国外印刷的假币，印刷时采用的油墨和纸张与真钞完全一致。警方认为目前流通的这批假币来源于亚洲。据国安办估算，目前每五十张百元大钞中就会有一张假币。

english: It appears that the final line of defense against identity crime has been breached, leaving the man on the street more vulnerable than ever before. You have read the news. You have seen the TV ads. Identity theft can happen to anybody, anytime, anywhere. Stay off the internet. Don't buy off foreigners. Pay cash for your porn. This is one war that you are going to have to fight on your own.
zh: 看来身份盗窃犯罪的最后一道防线业已土崩瓦解，让普通人比以往更易受到伤害。新闻你也读了，电视宣传你也看了。身份盗窃可能在任何时间、任何地点，在任何人身上发生。远离网络，别向外国人买东西，买黄片的时候付现金。这是一场必须由你独自战斗的战争。

english: The unnamed killer who has been terrorizing Liberty City remains one step ahead of police
zh: 持续威胁自由城的无名杀手仍将警方甩在身后

english: Cops still baffled as to what to do
zh: 警方仍然毫无头绪

english: Kerry McIntosh was barely 12 steps out of rehab last night when she was arrested for DUI and possession of a controlled substance, believed to be a small amount of cocaine. Once the police were made aware of Kerry's celebrity status, she signed some autographs and was released with a warning. According to a statement issued by her agent, McIntosh has decided to sue the rehab center in Los Santos, claiming that she is just as messed up as when she arrived four days earlier. Lenny Tinderman, who runs the $60,000-a-night treatment center and is an active alcoholic himself, told reporters, "Miss McIntosh checked out two hours early, against all our advice. If she cannot complete the program, we cannot take responsibility for the repercussions." In a posting on the supermodel's blog, Kerry told fans that she is now on her way to a new rest facility in the Bahamas, "An enema and a game of tennis and I'll be back on track. If I'm going to face my demons, I want to do it with an ocean view."
zh: 昨晚，凯里･麦金托什还没走出戒毒所12步，就因酒驾、毒驾和持有管制物品被警方逮捕。据悉，其持有的管制物品为少量可卡因。得知凯里的名人身份后，警方让她签了几个名，并对其警告了一番，随后释放了她。根据其经纪人发表的声明，麦金托什已决定起诉洛圣都的一家戒毒中心，因为她的状态与4天前进入戒毒中心时一样糟糕。经营这家六万一晚的戒毒中心的莱尼 廷德曼本人也是个酒鬼，他告诉记者：「麦金托什小姐不顾我们的劝阻，提前两小时结帐离开了我们中心。由于她没有完全完成戒毒疗程，我们不会对事后的复吸负责。」在这位超模的一篇博客中，她告诉粉丝说她即将前往巴哈马，去一家当地新开的设施进行疗养，「灌个肠，打局网球，我就能回到正轨了。如果我要面对心魔，我想在能看到海景的地方面对它。」

english: Bobby Jefferson, the Ex-Secretary of Security Enforcement, came to Liberty City in order to give a speech on the increasing threat of immigrant-led organized crime. However, Jefferson became a victim himself as his convoy was ambushed on the way to the Civic Citadel and he was nearly killed. Violent crime is becoming more and more prevalent in this city and people like Mr. Jefferson are asking why in highly paid speeches. The RICO statutes and the pressure put on organized crime by new forms of surveillance has for years undermined the traditional criminal elements in this city. This void is being filled by hungry and ruthless criminals coming into our city from abroad.
zh: 前国安办主任博比･杰斐逊来到自由城，就日益严重的移民犯罪组织的威胁发表演讲。然而杰斐逊自己也成为了移民犯罪的受害者，他的车队在前往市政厅途中遇袭，他也差点遇害。暴力犯罪在这个城市越来越普遍，像杰斐逊先生这样的人也常常在演讲中质问原因(这类人的演讲费也很高)。多年来，组织犯罪取缔法(RICO)和新式监视手段有效打击了本市的传统犯罪组织。而多年来打击下产生的空间正被饥饿无情的外国罪犯填补。

english: Don't turn us into a strip mall, says Prince
zh: 别让我们变成小商场——普林斯

english: These are lies. Our workforce is strictly volunteer now and besides, what would you rather do? Starve or earn 10 cents an hour? 401k and gym membership isn't going to put food on their floor. Children require less sleep and women are better at multi-tasking. It's simply good business sense. We spend billions every year on advertising and celebrity endorsements and that has to come from somewhere." The battle over morality vs. overpriced sports fashion continues to rage. Many of Eris's sponsored athletes came out in support of the company, saying they were each getting paid $10 million to wear the logo and the human rights scandal is overblown.
zh: 但这些抨击都是谎言。我们的工人一直都是自愿工作，如果让你选，你会选择饿死还是10美分的时薪？企业年金和健身房使用权可没法让他们填饱肚子。童工需要的睡眠时间更短，女性更擅长一心多用。这是很正常的商业考量。我们每年都会在广告宣传和名人代言上投入数十亿资金，这笔钱总得有个来由。这场关于道德和价格虚高的运动产品的争论仍在持续，而且愈演愈烈。许多Eris赞助的运动员为Eris公司发声，表示他们都拿到了一千万的代言费，所谓的人权丑闻是夸大其辞。

english: New lows - young man shot in cold blood on his wedding day
zh: 新低点－新郎于其婚礼被无情枪杀

english: New lows - guest shot in cold blood at wedding
zh: 新低点－嘉宾在婚礼上被无情地枪杀

english: The Internet is a terrifying place. Every click of the mouse leaves you wide open to online predators, sickening porn, identity theft or any number of other fraudulent schemes designed to bleed you dry and leave you penniless on the streets, turning tricks for scraps of food and swigs of ethanol. If you think that the Internet risk isn't real, it is time for you to think again. Darius Wolfe, Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, has admitted that he was duped into paying $20,000 to a con artist. The 'Roman Empire Wealth System' pyramid scheme, located at www.money2makemoney.com promised millions of dollars to investors if they could sign up enough people below them and then move up to the Senator or Emperor levels.
zh: 互联网是一个可怕的地方。你的每一次点击都可能让你遇到网络强盗、恶心黄片、身份盗窃，甚至是其他诈骗阴谋，让你倾家荡产、露宿街头，为了一点剩饭和酒出卖肉体。如果你认为互联网不存在这些风险，你就该重新考虑了。美联储理事会主席达里厄斯･沃尔夫承认他被骗子骗了2万美元。 www.money2makemoney.com 的「罗马帝国财富系统」是一个金字塔骗局，它向投资者承诺了数百万美元的收益，只要他们发展的下线够多，就能升级为「元老院议员」或「皇帝」。

english: Eunux Says "No Girls Allowed"
zh: Eunux说「女性止步」

english: Mob Boss, Jon Gravelli, alleged head of the Gambetti crime family, died peacefully in his sleep last night. Mr. Gravelli, 85, had been residing at the Schottler Medical Center for the last 3 years. Although some in the DA's office argued that this was a ruse to avoid a court case, Mr. Gravelli never left hospital after being admitted. Mr. Gravelli has been head of the Gambetti crime syndicate since 1978 and under his stewardship, the family had become the most powerful of Liberty City's crime families, rivaling the Pavano family. Although he had been indicted several times, Mr. Gravelli was never convicted of a serious crime. Some believed he had contacts within the government who protected him, and for whom he would get criminal associates to perform hits and other crimes, but these allegations were never substantiated. What happens now to the delicate balance of power amongst criminal gangs within Liberty City is unknown. It is unlikely to be pretty.
zh: 甘贝蒂犯罪家族的头目，乔恩･格拉韦利，昨晚在睡梦中安然离世，终年85岁。格拉韦利先生过去三年一直在舒特勒医疗中心住院。尽管地检署中有人认为住院是其回避庭审的诡计，但格拉韦利先生入院后从未离开医院。格拉韦利先生于1978年成为甘贝蒂犯罪家族的头目，在其管理下，该家族成为了自由城最强大的犯罪家族，与帕瓦诺家族分庭抗礼。尽管其已被指控多次，但格拉韦利先生从未被判任何重罪。有人认为政府内存在他的保护伞，为其实施谋杀等各类犯罪提供便利，但这些说法并未得到证实。自由城各大黑恶势力间的脆弱平衡或将发生变化，但很难向好发展。

english: The downside to sexism?
zh: 性别歧视的缺点？

english: A homeless Vietnam veteran, Jerry Kapowitz, has stumbled upon a haul of diamonds valued at over $2 million. They were in a small pouch amongst the rubble and trash at the Liberty City dump. Mr. Kapowitz had been living near the dump and surviving off of things he salvaged from there. "Before this, the best thing I'd found was a TV and that didn't even work," he told reporters. Mr. Kapowitz plans to take his newfound wealth down to Vice City where he will start a gun shop and liquor store, "They're real men down there and they need real guns and liquor in one convenient location." Mr. Kapowitz's ownership of the diamonds was immediately contested by over 100 people. Mayor Ochoa decided that it would be impossible to verify the claims so allowed Mr. Kapowitz to keep all of the proceeds from the diamonds' sale.
zh: 流浪的越战老兵杰里･卡波维茨捡到了价值超过两百万美元的钻石。这一小袋钻石竟然混在了自由城垃圾场的垃圾堆中。卡波维茨先生一直住在垃圾场附近，靠捡垃圾生存。「此前，我捡到过的最好的东西是一台电视，而且还是坏的，」他告诉记者。卡波维茨先生计划带着自己刚获得的财富去罪城，然后开一家枪店兼酒馆，「那边的人都是真汉子，他们需要一家同时具备真枪和好酒的店。」已有上百人对卡波维茨先生的钻石拥有权提出了异议，称自己是失主。奥乔亚市长则以无法证实失主为由，允许卡波维茨先生保留出售钻石所获得的收入。

english: Officials maintain the bridges will be closed indefinitely. Deputy Mayor Bryce Dawkins told the Liberty Tree, "When terrorists want to bomb something, you take it away and they won't want to bomb it anymore. That's the way to protect our families and family values." The BAWSAQ has been dropping as concerns about the terror scare affect markets around the world. "These terrorists want to take away our freedoms. But look, we've done it for them." said Dawkins.
zh: 政府坚持无限期封锁桥梁。副市长布莱斯･道金斯告诉Liberty Tree：「如果恐怖分子想炸掉什么，你先把它拿走，他们就不会去炸了。这就是保护我们的家庭与家庭观念的方式。」出于对恐怖主义会影响全球市场的担忧，BAWSAQ股指持续下跌。「这些恐怖分子想要夺走我们的自由。但是，我们先做到了。」道金斯如是说。

english: In a crazy week for stocks, prices went up, then came crashing down creating market instability and the chance for a lot of pundits to talk in a wide range of superlatives while pretending to understand what was going on. One pundit said, "It's carnage. It's like war out there. We've seen abstracts fall and futures hold steady. The bull is running, while the bear is taking it up the can." He declined to be named for this article.
zh: 过去一周的股市十分疯狂，股价先是上涨，随后暴跌，导致股市震荡，为许多所谓的专家提供了解读行情的机会。专家指出：「这是屠杀，就像一场战争。我们早已见证过崩溃论盛行而现实安然无恙的场景。公牛正在狂奔，但狗熊依然紧追不舍。」该专家拒绝本文出现他的姓名。

english: Markets Down, But Not Out
zh: 股市暴跌，但未暴死

english: Deputy Police Commissioner Francis McReary has been speaking to reporters at the LCPD media day about becoming Commissioner next year taking over from the retiring Mitt Fitzsimmons. One of several possible candidates, McReary's tireless work for the community and even more tireless promotion of that work have seen him emerge as the leading contender for the city's most important law enforcement job.
zh: 警察局副局长弗朗西斯･麦克雷里已在LCPD媒体公开日向记者表示，其将于明年继任即将退休的米特･菲茨西蒙斯的局长职位。作为可能的候选人之一，麦克雷里为社区不知疲倦做出的工作和对工作成果更加不知疲倦的宣传让他成为了本市执法部门最重要工作的领先角逐者。

english: He grew up in a tough Dukes neighborhood, part of an unruly family that has had several brushes with the law, but McReary himself is a moral crusader who has put the difficulties of his background behind him in an effort to put personal experience to the common good. Crime is currently spiraling out of control in the city at the moment, and a tough hand on the tiller is what's needed. We wish him well!
zh: 他在公爵区的艰难环境下成长，尽管他所处的家族于法律很不友好，但麦克雷里本人却是一个道德卫士，他反向利用了自己艰难的家庭背景，将个人经验用于公益事业。现在本市的犯罪率正在螺旋上升，而用铁拳将犯罪扼杀在萌芽阶段正是我们需要的。祝他好运！

english: Dawkins won't take it lying down
zh: 道金斯不会听之任之

english: In an effort to understand the growing meth threat to Liberty City, local narcotics agents have taken the mobile meth lab seized in the Steinway section and have it up and operational for educational purposes only. Agent Albert Thomas told reporters that law enforcement will not fully understand the threat they face unless they replicate the process of making and smoking the drug.
zh: 为了了解冰毒给自由城带来的增长性威胁，当地缉毒探员重启了在斯坦威地区查获的移动冰毒实验室，用于毒品预防教育。探员阿尔伯特･托马斯对记者说，只有亲自复现制造和吸食毒品的过程，才能让执法人员彻底理解冰毒带来的威胁。

english: Controversial deputy mayor, Bryce Dawkins, has been causing offense again - and standing up for family values - in a speech yesterday that has outraged liberals and gay rights groups. Mr. Dawkins, who has long attacked what he terms "the culture of vice that grips our city like an addiction", has attacked gay and lesbian groups as "undermining the family values that make this nation great." He added, "These are the kind of people who make our enemies laugh at us, and are directly contributing to the security problems we all face. Civil rights activists called his comments "prehistoric" and "half witted, but what do people expect from a man called Bryce, whose parents were first cousins?" Mr. Dawkins was unavailable for comment.
zh: 最近备受争议的副市长，布莱斯･道金斯，于昨日的一场以维护家庭观念为主题的演讲中再次发表攻击性言论，彻底激怒了自由主义者和同性恋权利组织。道金斯先生长期将同性恋批判为「如同毒瘾般掌控我们城市的毒瘤文化」，并在此次演讲中抨击同性恋群体「破坏了让本国伟大的家庭观念。」他还补充说，「就是这些人的存在让我们被敌人嘲笑，正是他们直接导致了我们如今面对的安全问题。」人权组织活动家认为他的言论是「迂腐的」「愚蠢的」，不过人们又能对一个近亲结婚所生的叫布莱斯的男人有什么指望呢？道金斯先生对此不予置评。

english: How much I've been given. I've had such a privileged life; I've been given so much that I feel guilty. I just want to give something back. I try to do that with my job and my charities. I hate conspicuous consumption and all that yuppie-scumbag shit. The three strikes law. Judges who don't give unlucky defendants a break. Republicans. Cheaters. Liars. Hypocrites. Etc. Etc. Etc.
zh:
我得到的给予之多。我如此优越的生活。我被给予了太多，多到令我内疚。我只想做出一些回报，于是我选择了现在的工作，资助了许多慈善机构。我讨厌炫耀性消费和那些白痴雅皮士。还讨厌三振出局法*、不给被告机会的法官、共和党人、骗子、伪君子，等等等等...

zh: 我真心不喜欢战争、仇恨和卑鄙小人。

english: Anything cheap. The mentality that spending less gets you more. People who don't respect a woman and her right to be looked after. Men who don't think that every moment a woman spends with him is a gift that should be celebrated and cherished.
zh: 所有便宜货。少买就是赚钱的心态。不尊重女性与女性受呵护权利的人。不珍惜女性与之相处的每时每刻的男人。

People who take pictures of their cats to put on the internet, man I'd like to get my hands on one of them. I dislike it when you get a guy's name tattooed on your ass and then he decides to move back in with his ex.

english: I'm really fun and friendly! And I'm open-minded too; I work right next to a gay guy. I work for a health insurance company, which is really, like, rewarding because I feel like I've helped people to get better, people who can afford to.
zh: 我是个有趣友好的人！思想也很开放，我旁边工位的人就是个基。我在一家健康保险公司上班，这份工作很有成就感，因为我觉得帮助到了别人，帮到了那些买得起保险的人。

english: I'm looking for a guy who is into the same stuff, like collecting really disturbing figurines from weird cartoons. I hate it when guys are all like, happy and stuff, trying to put a good spin on things, it's like, 'dude, cut it out with that shit, you're gonna give me diabetes'.
zh: 我在寻找一个和我兴趣相同的人，比如从奇怪的漫画中收集令人不安的小人像。我讨厌被那些高高兴兴的人婉言相劝。比如「兄弟，少吃点那玩意，再这样吃下去我都要得糖尿病了。」

english: Down for anything girl who doesn't mind hanging with the boys. I go out at night and get into the office late with a little booze on my breath and a man still asleep in my bed.

zh: ~z~记得穿正装，尼克。我们可不能让你穿得像乞丐一样进教堂。

english: ~z~I'll give her a call man, but I don't think she'll wanna see me.
zh: ~z~我会打给她的，老兄，不过我不觉得她会想见我。

english: ~z~I gotta be with me Ma, Niko. She don't got much left other than me. And that ain't much... see you, man.
zh: ~z~我得去陪妈了，尼克。她剩下的就只有我了。所剩无几了...再见了，兄弟。

english: ~z~I can't have my time wasted with calls like this.
zh: ~z~我的时间可不能浪费在这种电话上。

english: ~z~I don't think I like it any better than you and your brother do. We gotta make a living though, don't we?
zh: ~z~我和你跟你兄弟一样不喜欢这行。可日子总得过，不是吗？

english: ~z~Niko, I don't know if you've heard it but my brother, Derrick's dead.
zh: ~z~尼克，不知道你有没有听说，但是我哥哥德里克他死了。

english: ~z~Go down and check on him? Me and Gerald will cover any expenses incurred.
zh: ~z~你能不能去看看他？产生的开销我和格里会给你报销的。

english: ~z~Go down and check on him? Me and Gerald will cover any expenses incurred.
zh: ~z~你能不能去看看他？产生的开销我和格里会给你报销的。

english: ~z~This Whiz wireless cellphone is switched off.
zh: ~z~您呼叫的Whiz无线电话已关机。

english: ~z~I mean that my cop brother Francis McReary is no longer with us.
zh: ~z~我是说我的条子哥哥弗朗西斯･麦克雷里与世长辞了。

english: ~z~He's in a bad way. Last I heard he was spending his hours in some park in Acter.
zh: ~z~最近他情况不太好。我最后听说到的是他在阿克特的一个公园里消磨时光。

english: ~z~The guilt has destroyed him. I don't know. Somehow it was better to walk away.
zh: ~z~他的罪行已经毁了他。我也不知道。可能还是直接走开比较好。

english: ~z~Well he doesn't know I'm giving you this but he gave it to me so it's technically from him.
zh: ~z~好吧，他不知道咱要送你这个，不过这个就是他送咱的，所以严格来说算是他送的。

english: ~z~Being Deputy Mayor has to have some use, doesn't it?
zh: ~z~副市长还是得有点用处的，不是吗？

english: ~z~Don't mention it. What we've got is worth more than money.
zh: ~z~不客气，咱们的关系可比钱更有价值。

english: ~z~Must be hard, Derrick. But you didn't have a choice.
zh: ~z~你一定很痛苦吧，德里克。但你也没得选。

english: ~z~Thank you, Bryce Dawkins. I hope the cash for this didn't come out of city funds.
zh: ~z~谢谢你，布莱斯･道金斯。希望买车的钱不是从政府资金里榨出来的。

english: ~z~It was horrible. He says we can't see each other anymore.
zh: ~z~太可怕了。他说咱们不能再见面了。

english: ~z~I don't know if you'd heard Niko, but Kim, the Korean kid we brought into the country, got taken down.
zh: ~z~不知道你有没有听说，尼克。但是我们护送入境的朝鲜人，金，被杀了。

english: ~z~He can't worry about losing me as well.
zh: ~z~他不想担心有失去咱的可能。

english: ~z~Cryptic, Derrick. The suspense is killing me. Thanks.
zh: ~z~是什么啊，德里克。别我吊胃口了。谢谢。

english: ~z~I don't think I've ever played peacemaker, but I'll be there in a bit.
zh: ~z~我好像从来没当过和事佬，不过我会马上过来的。

english: ~z~Niko, Niko. You there? You there? Bet there are about a hundred cops listening to this shit and you can't even hear me.
zh: ~z~尼克，尼克，是你吗？是你吗？估计有一百个警察在听这通电话，你都听不见我说话了。

english: ~z~I'm sorry, Niko.
zh: ~z~对不起，尼克。

english: ~z~My husband is dead. Show Anna and I respect by leaving us be.
zh: ~z~我的丈夫已经死了。对安娜和我尊重一点，别管我们了。

english: ~z~Don't mention it.
zh: ~z~不客气。

english: ~z~This is Elizabeta. Sorry, I'm away from the phone at the moment. Try me again in twenty five years or so.
zh: ~z~我是伊丽莎贝塔。抱歉，现在我暂时无法接听。大概二十五年后再来找我吧。

english: ~z~I'm a walking cliché, Niko. An embarrassment, to him and to everyone.
zh: ~z~咱就是个傻子，尼克。无论对他还是对谁都是累赘。

english: ~z~Niko, Niko, I'm sorry, I just needed to speak to a friend.
zh: ~z~尼克，尼克，对不起，咱需要找个朋友聊聊。

zh: ~z~我好像从来没当过和事佬，不过我会马上过来的。

zh: ~z~好吧，他不知道咱要送你这个，不过这个就是他送咱的，所以严格来说算是他送的。

zh: ~z~是我，伊丽莎贝塔。很遗憾你进监狱了。应该跟我没什么关系吧？

english: ~z~Yeah, I guess every immigrant's story, ain't the fairytale yours is.
zh: ~z~是啊，我想也不是所有移民的故事都是你这样的童话。

zh: ~z~不过，号子也不算太坏。我有一个好狱友。

zh: ~z~嗯，我的生活是个童话，德里克。这个童话还是谁都别去读比较好。回见，老兄。

english: ~z~I don't know. I think he's tried everything he could.
zh: ~z~咱不知道。大概他已经尽力了。

english: ~z~Nothing's gonna get rid of the truth, I may as well be wandering with a mark on me head. Later on, Niko.
zh: ~z~但事实就是事实，也许我也要带着记号流离漂荡了。回见，尼克。

english: ~z~I don't know what she is, but she was lying to us all along and now I'm paying for it.
zh: ~z~我不知道她是什么，但她一直以来都在骗我们，现在我为此付出代价了。

english: ~z~He don't act like it. Piece of shit, when I get my hands on him I'm going to...
zh: ~z~他不能那么做。操他妈的，等我再见到他，我就要...

english: ~z~Give him some of his own medicine - find out if he was serious about me.
zh: ~z~想让他尝尝我对他乱搞的感受，试试他对我到底是不是认真的。

english: ~z~Niko, tell me straight. Was Roman with another woman last night? I swear I'm going to cut his balls off.
zh: ~z~尼克，跟我说实话。罗曼昨晚是不是又在找别的女人？我发誓我要把他给阉了。

english: ~z~Good thing you haven't been hanging around with them too much. That shit is fucked up. I'm sorry for getting you involved.
zh: ~z~幸好你没跟他们混太久。那边全他妈完了。很抱歉把你牵扯进去了。

zh: ~z~要是他就是你要找的人，我会不直接告诉你吗？

zh: ~z~一定是我想太多了，罗曼当然不会这样。谢了，尼克。

zh: ~z~我已经为你顶了不少压力了，尼克。总该帮我点忙了吧。

zh: ~z~你知道罗曼，他外面是有些别的女人，但你才是他唯一爱的人。

english: ~z~I've already helped you but I'll help you again. Wait for me to be in touch.
zh: ~z~我已经帮过你一次了，不过会再帮一次。等我的联络吧。

english: ~z~Don't worry about it. You've got enough on your plate looking after Roman. See you soon.
zh: ~z~别担心。你光是照顾罗曼就已经够忙了。之后见。

english: ~z~Is your johnson so big you can't keep it in your pants, Bellic? I told you to be calm.
zh: ~z~你的老二已经大到裤子里装不下了吗，贝利克？我告诉过你要冷静了。

english: ~z~Roman and I are getting on well now, and I don't want this shit to jeopardize anything. Thanks Niko.
zh: ~z~罗曼和我现在处得很好，我不想因为他让生活被破坏。谢了，尼克。

english: ~z~I haven't heard anything, but I'm sure it would be a really good thing for both of you.
zh: ~z~他没跟我说过。不过我敢肯定，这对你们两个都是好事。

english: ~z~I don't know what she is, but she was lying to us all along and now I'm paying for it.
zh: ~z~我不知道她是什么，但她一直以来都在骗我们，现在我为此付出代价了。

english: ~z~Hey, sometimes I just can't help myself.
zh: ~z~嘿，有时候我就是控制不住自己。

english: ~z~Now, you're useless to me. We need someone who wants something, someone with burning desires.
zh: ~z~你对我已经没有用了。我们要的是有欲望的人，要的是欲望强烈的人。

english: ~z~I guess when he found out about me and Vlad he couldn't help himself.
zh: ~z~我想他发现我跟弗拉德的事的时候，就控制不住自己了。

english: ~z~Hey Niko, you tired of Manny yet?
zh: ~z~喂，尼克，你有没有和曼尼处腻了？

english: ~z~After all that trouble, you didn't even kill him. Remarkable.
zh: ~z~大费周章之后，你都没有杀了他。神奇。

english: ~z~Shit, I got a two. This isn't good, NB. I might be going to the pawn shop later. See you.
zh: ~z~妈的，我拿到一张 2。不妙啊，NB。我等会儿可能得去当铺了。回见。

english: ~z~Hotter than the models we'll be bedding. I can't lose.
zh: ~z~比我们要睡的模特还火热。输不了的。

english: ~z~Maybe that will stop you fucking her around. If you love her like you say you do you should show her respect.
zh: ~z~说不定这样你就不会背着她乱搞了。如果你真有那么爱她，就拿出行动来。

english: ~z~Promise me you won't do anything hasty, cousin.
zh: ~z~向我保证你不会草率行事，堂弟。

english: ~z~What about Mallorie, Roman. I thought you said you loved her?
zh: ~z~那玛洛丽算什么，罗曼。你不是说你爱她吗？

english: ~z~Don't crush my high, man. Of course I'll be careful. Cover for me, alright.
zh: ~z~别坏了我的兴致，老弟。我当然会小心的。替我圆场，好吧。

english: ~z~You know Roman, I haven't been having that much fun since I got here. Has been a lot like hard work.
zh: ~z~你也知道，罗曼，自从我来到这儿，我就没享过多少乐。感觉做苦工比较多。

english: ~z~Don't lose any more money. Stick with your original bet.
zh: ~z~别再输了。就按原来那注押。

english: ~z~Maybe, I don't know.
zh: ~z~也许吧，我不知道。

english: ~z~And you have paid for this place?
zh: ~z~那你把钱付清了没？

english: ~z~I think I'm enough of a man to satisfy her but she can do what she likes.
zh: ~z~我觉得我这男人满足她绰绰有余，不过她想怎么样随她。

english: ~z~It wasn't so long ago that your debts got you kidnapped by the Russian mob.
zh: ~z~不久之前你才刚因为欠钱被俄罗斯黑帮绑架过。

english: ~z~Now that I know where Dimitri is, I might just go there and take him out instead.
zh: ~z~既然我知道迪米特里在哪儿了，说不定就该过去干掉他。

english: ~z~If you're near a shop can you pick up some adult diapers for me? See you later, Niko.
zh: ~z~你附近要是有超市，能不能帮我带点成人纸尿布回来？一会儿见，尼克。

english: ~z~Then watch the TV here and get nostalgic, I don't know. Later on.
zh: ~z~那就在这儿看个电视怀下旧，我不知道。回见。

english: ~z~Yeah, maybe it would have been if he hadn't screwed me over and nearly got me killed.
zh: ~z~嗯，如果他没节外生枝还差点害死我就好了。

english: ~z~I already feel sorry for her, and them.
zh: ~z~我都替她和别的男人感到遗憾。

english: ~z~There's a lot of money on the line. Do I double down on eleven?
zh: ~z~这把押了不少钱。十一点的牌要加倍吗？

english: ~z~If you're near a shop can you pick up some adult diapers for me? See you later, Niko.
zh: ~z~你附近要是有超市，能不能帮我带点成人纸尿布回来？一会儿见，尼克。

english: ~z~NB. NB, you're a great cousin. Thank you for convincing Mallorie that I wasn't cheating.
zh: ~z~NB。NB，你真是个好堂弟。谢谢你让玛洛丽相信我没有乱搞。

english: ~z~But he didn't get you killed. You got the money and you survived.
zh: ~z~但他没害死你。你拿到了钱，人也还在。

english: ~z~Ha, ha. Yeah right. I've put the money into another cab depot.
zh: ~z~哈哈，也没错。我把钱投到另一家出租车行了。

english: ~z~You shouldn't cry wolf, Roman. Who knows when you will really need help.
zh: ~z~你不该玩狼来了的，罗曼。说不定哪天你就真需要求助了。

english: ~z~Michelle is some kind of cop or informant or something, I don't know. What the fuck, man?
zh: ~z~米歇尔好像是条子还是线人之类的，我不清楚。什么鬼啊，老哥？

english: ~z~This time is different because I haven't pissed anyone off.
zh: ~z~这次不一样，因为我没惹恼任何人。

english: ~z~Roman, have you been gambling? I will give you any money you need.
zh: ~z~罗曼，你是不是又在赌了？缺钱了我可以给你。

english: ~z~That's probably because you are always either working or being hassled by loansharks.
zh: ~z~大概是因为你不是在工作就是在被债主骚扰吧。

english: ~z~You know, we don't have enough fun together.
zh: ~z~你也知道，我们一起享受的乐趣不是很多。

english: ~z~Not really, I got caught up in an argument between a drug dealer and his drug dealing mentor.
zh: ~z~有点事，我被卷入了一个毒贩和他师傅之间的争吵。

english: ~z~I couldn't understand completely, something about Babylon. That guy is crazy.
zh: ~z~我没怎么听懂，好像跟什么条子有关。那家伙太疯狂了。

english: ~z~Right about Brucie. He's more than just a steroid fuelled maniac, he's a good guy.
zh: ~z~对布鲁斯的看法。他不只是一个嗑药疯子，他还是个好人。

english: ~z~NB, Jacob told me some weird shit went down with Michelle.
zh: ~z~NB，雅各布跟我说米歇尔她不太对劲。

english: ~z~If you're losing money at the tables you might be able to sell some body parts to him for a quick buck.
zh: ~z~要是你在赌桌上输了钱，说不定你还能卖他点器官赚个快钱。

english: ~z~Maybe you were right about him being fun to hang with but he's crazy.
zh: ~z~和他一起出去很有趣这点可能没错，不过他太疯了。

english: ~z~All the better for hearing your voice, NB. You sound down. Are you okay?
zh: ~z~听到你的声音我就好了，NB。你听起来有点难过。你没事吧？

english: ~z~It's okay, hard to be happy when your wedding goes the way ours did.
zh: ~z~挺好的，不过经历这样的婚礼也很难开心起来。

english: ~z~I know you wouldn't, Niko. Let's hang out soon.
zh: ~z~就知道你不是那种人，尼克。有空一起出去吧。

english: ~z~I wouldn't abuse our friendship like that, Roman. Don't worry.
zh: ~z~我不会这样利用我们的友情的，罗曼。别担心。

english: ~z~Yeah, I'm fine. How's married life?
zh: ~z~嗯，我没事。婚后生活如何？

english: ~z~If things are looking up now, I hate to think what they were like before I arrived.
zh: ~z~如果现在叫好起来了，那我真的是不敢想我来之前的情况。

english: ~z~I don't want you running off to the other side of Liberty City and only calling me to ask for cabs.
zh: ~z~我可不想你到了自由城另一边后，只会在打车的时候找我。

english: ~z~There's no one else to blame, Roman. It's my fault, because I refused to do that deal for Pegorino.
zh: ~z~这一切只能怪我，罗曼。都是我的错，因为我拒绝了替佩戈里诺进行交易。

english: ~z~I don't know, this and that. I've been hanging out with Little Jacob.
zh: ~z~我不知道，这个那个的。我和小雅各布出去过了。

english: ~z~Kate's death was very unfortunate. Niko, don't blame yourself.
zh: ~z~凯特的死十分不幸。尼克，不要责怪自己。

zh: ~z~你说的不会是有漂白的金发和D杯奶子的那种双胞胎吧。
