zh: ~z~他说的话我基本听不懂，不过我挺喜欢他的。

english: ~z~It's like a dating site only these girls are really up for it. You know? Later on, NB.
zh: ~z~就像交友网站，只不过这些姑娘是真的想要。懂吗？回头见，NB。

english: ~z~That makes two of us. Later on, Roman.
zh: ~z~我也没想到啊。回见，罗曼。

english: ~z~It's my fault because I got close to her. I shouldn't get close to anyone.
zh: ~z~都怪我和她走得太近。我不该亲近任何人的。

english: ~z~I'm afraid I haven't met these women of your dreams, Roman.
zh: ~z~恐怕我是没见过你的这些梦中情人，罗曼。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko, I'm sorry for putting the two of you together.
zh: ~z~妈的，尼克，对不起，是我把她介绍给你的。

english: ~z~I didn't think she'd be a cop.
zh: ~z~没想到她是个警察。

english: ~z~Those other times I hid, I was right to be nervous, wasn't I?
zh: ~z~我之前那几次躲起来，紧张得没错，对吧？

english: ~z~That wasn't what I wanted to ask you, I wanted to know what it was like to be kidnapped.
zh: ~z~我不是要问你这个，我要问的是被绑架是怎么样的？

english: ~z~I don't know, I just met someone in the street. It was weird.
zh: ~z~不知道，我只是在路上碰到了一个人。很奇怪。

english: ~z~Thanks, for putting things in perspective, Roman. Later on.
zh: ~z~感谢你能提供不同的观点，罗曼。回见。

english: ~z~You are a Bellic, remember, and you can't help playing the field. You don't want her getting jealous.
zh: ~z~你可是贝利克家的，记住，你就是爱脚踏几条船。你也不想她吃醋吧。

english: ~z~Hello, Niko. How's it going, killed anyone recently?
zh: ~z~你好，尼克。近况如何啊，有没有又杀了谁？

english: ~z~I thought this time would come, Niko, but, to be honest,
zh: ~z~我就知道会有这一刻，尼克，不过说实话，

english: ~z~It wasn't like that. You don't get it.
zh: ~z~我不是这个意思。你没听懂。

english: ~z~They say they will give me Darko. You don't know how long I have waited for this, Roman. It is nearly over.
zh: ~z~他们说他们会给我达尔科。你不知道我为了这一刻已经等了多久，罗曼。就快结束了。

english: ~z~They were nice titties, yes?
zh: ~z~那对奶子很不错，对吧？

english: ~z~I don't know how I'm so successful with the ladies. They just love me.
zh: ~z~我真的不知道为什么我这么受女性欢迎。她们就是喜欢我。

english: ~z~Don't get ahead of yourself, Niko. Be careful around these men. Talk to you soon.
zh: ~z~别做力不能及的事情，尼克。和这些人一起的时候当心点。以后再聊。

english: ~z~He just got out of prison and he hasn't got much but... I made the right decision.
zh: ~z~他才刚出狱，身上也没几个子，不过...我做了正确的选择。

english: ~z~A less violent one. I'll speak to you soon, okay?
zh: ~z~一条没那么暴力的路。我会再和你联系的，好吧？

english: ~z~You don't want to get caught up in that shit. Take your cut of the diamonds and get out of there.
zh: ~z~你不会想招上这种事的。拿到你那份钻石的分成就脱身吧。

english: ~z~Yeah, the head of the family. Is he a big time gangster like in the movies then?
zh: ~z~嗯，家族老大。那他是不是像电影里演的那种黑帮大佬一样？

english: ~z~Don't worry, Roman. I'm on my way.
zh: ~z~别着急，罗曼。我来了。

english: ~z~And at least tell me that you got her titties out? Maybe then your betrayal would be worthwhile.
zh: ~z~有没有摸到她的奶子？摸到的话你的背叛倒还算值得。

english: ~z~Some trust-funder called Alex. I don't really like her but it's something to do, isn't it?
zh: ~z~一个叫亚历克斯的啃老族。我不太喜欢她，不过也是一种消遣，对吧？

english: ~z~Roman, you are right about Liberty City. It is a crazy place.
zh: ~z~罗曼，关于自由城你说的没错。这是个疯狂的地方。

english: ~z~I can't think who else would. Speak to you soon, cousin.
zh: ~z~我也想不到还有谁能找到了。以后再聊，堂兄。

english: ~z~NB, you are certainly my cousin.
zh: ~z~NB，真不愧是我的堂弟。

english: ~z~Who says I didn't.
zh: ~z~谁说我没干的。

english: ~z~He was a cockroach - a pest. But I don't know how long I can keep on dealing in death.
zh: ~z~他是个蟑螂，是害虫。但我不知道这种杀人买卖我还能做多久。

english: ~z~Anyway, I was seeing Michelle. I thought you wanted me to date her?
zh: ~z~再说了，刚才我去找米歇尔了。之前不是你想让我去约她吗？

english: ~z~He should be paranoid. The Feds are after organized crime in a big way.
zh: ~z~他是该多疑点。FIB打击组织犯罪的力度可不小。

english: ~z~Secondly, I don't think that your loan shark friends could hospitalize me. I can look after myself.
zh: ~z~其次，我不觉得你那些高利贷朋友能把我送进医院。我能保护好自己。

english: ~z~Look you'll have to have some fun with the nurses because I can't pick you up. See you soon.
zh: ~z~我没法来接你，看来你得和护士们找会儿乐子了。回头见。

english: ~z~It's been a fucking hassle and all for nothing.
zh: ~z~这回惹了一身麻烦还空手而归。

english: ~z~You shouldn't have borrowed money from them in the first place, Roman.
zh: ~z~一开始你就不该问他们借钱的，罗曼。

english: ~z~I think it's my conscience. I don't know.
zh: ~z~可能是我的良知吧。我不清楚。

english: ~z~Remember to make it clear that you are a red blooded animal though and you won't be tied down
zh: ~z~不过记得先跟她说好，你是一个血气方刚的猛兽，这样就不会被

english: ~z~You're an animal, Roman. Nothing can stop you being horny.
zh: ~z~你这个禽兽，罗曼。什么时候都能发情。

english: ~z~Stay disorganized would be my advice, Niko. Don't let them get you for racketeering.
zh: ~z~建议你保持无组织，尼克。别让他们以涉黑罪逮捕你。

english: ~z~You're an animal, Roman. Nothing can stop you being horny. I'll see you soon.
zh: ~z~你这个禽兽，罗曼，什么时候都能发情。我马上来接你。

english: ~z~He tried to get me to get rid of a friend of his for him but, uh, I liked the friend better.
zh: ~z~他让我帮忙除掉他的一个朋友，不过...我更喜欢他的朋友。

english: ~z~Hey Roman. You ever wonder if things are just coincidence or if everything is all planned?
zh: ~z~喂，罗曼。你有没有想过有些事是巧合，还是说都是被计划好的？

english: ~z~Don't worry, Niko. Call me soon.
zh: ~z~别担心，尼克。有空打给我。

english: ~z~to a monogamous relationship.
zh: ~z~忠贞不二的要求束缚住了。

english: ~z~I can't tell you what happens when it ends, friend. I can tell you that we'll all find out at some point though.
zh: ~z~朋友，我没法告诉你一切结束时会怎样。但我可以告诉你，我们总有一天都会知道的。

english: ~z~Hey, it ain't our problem, Playboy - it's yours. That said, I know what I'm going to do.
zh: ~z~嘿，那可不是我们的问题，花花公子，是你的问题。这么说吧，我知道我要做什么。

english: ~z~Did it hurt? Tell me it didn't hurt him.
zh: ~z~疼吗？告诉我他没受苦。

english: ~z~Yo Money, don't be trifling with me. You made a decision?
zh: ~z~哟，老弟。别跟我耍花招，你决定了吗？

english: ~z~Yeah, that's what he think. He got friends all over the shop but he living in the past.
zh: ~z~对，他就这么想的。他的朋友到处都有，不过他还活在过去。

english: ~z~Don't help him out when it fucks up my business interests. Damn, son. That ain't cool.
zh: ~z~他动到我的生意利益的时候就他妈别帮他。干，小子。那可不好。

english: ~z~Yo, this is streets. Streets need to sleep, streets need to eat so they don't answer the phone the whole time.
zh: ~z~哟，我是街道。街道需要睡觉，街道需要吃饭，所以不可能全天接电话。

english: ~z~I owe that fool - ain't payback a bitch? Peace out, money.
zh: ~z~我欠那个傻逼的——不是要报答那贱人吗？再见，老弟。

english: ~z~Niko, tell me it weren't you that shot up the strip club in Bohan.
zh: ~z~尼克，告诉我在波汉大闹脱衣舞俱乐部的人不是你。

english: ~z~I owe that fool - ain't payback a bitch? Peace out, money.
zh: ~z~我欠那个傻逼的——不是要报答那贱人吗？再见，老弟。

english: ~z~This is the X, giving everyone out there some advice. You don't know what you got 'til it's gone. Leave a message.
zh: ~z~我是X，正在给别人讲人生经验呢。失去之前你也不知道拥有什么。留言吧。

english: ~z~Yo Money, don't be trifling with me. You made a decision?
zh: ~z~哟，老弟。别跟我耍花招，你决定了吗？

english: ~z~Man, fuck Yusuf Amir. I got bigger problems. Come see me now.
zh: ~z~操他妈的尤瑟夫･阿米尔。不过还有更大的问题。现在就来找我。

english: ~z~Hey, it ain't our problem, Playboy - it's yours. That said, I know what I'm going to do.
zh: ~z~嘿，那可不是我们的问题，花花公子，是你的问题。这么说吧，我知道我要做什么。

english: ~z~Yeah, that's what he think. He got friends all over the shop but he living in the past.
zh: ~z~对，他就这么想的。他到处都有朋友，不过他还活在过去。

english: ~z~Dammit, Nicky. Cut the bullshit. You got 'em? Where are they?
zh: ~z~干他妈的，尼克。别说那个了，到手了吗？在哪儿呢？

english: ~z~Yo, this is Dwayne. I'm out and I ain't letting shit get me down.
zh: ~z~哟，我是德维恩。我现在在外面，不会让别的事妨碍的。

english: ~z~Don't get smart with me.
zh: ~z~别跟我耍小聪明。

english: ~z~I don't wanna see you get caught up in it, that's all. Just looking out for ya, pal.
zh: ~z~我只是不想看你卷进去，就这样。照顾你才提醒你，伙计。

english: ~z~You all got love for a fool at the top and don't know a fool at the bottom. Out.
zh: ~z~有钱有势被人捧，一无所有没人问。滚。

english: ~z~You a good friend, Niko. She ask about me? You think she been thinking about this fool?
zh: ~z~够朋友，尼克。她有问到过我吗？你觉得她还在不在乎我这个傻子？

english: ~z~Well, we took it off Tony in the first place, but it shoulda ended there.
zh: ~z~虽然一开始就是从托尼那里偷的，但不该有这么多事的。

english: ~z~Hey, Ray. I got some bad news for you. You weren't the only one who thought they owned those diamonds.
zh: ~z~喂，雷。我有一些坏消息要说。你不是唯一一个觉得钻石是自己的的人。

english: ~z~Liberty City Dump... I don't know. They got thrown into traffic.
zh: ~z~自由城垃圾场...我不知道。钻石被扔到垃圾车里了。

english: ~z~Yeah? Well, remember who made the introduction. Remember who brought you in, don't you forget about me.
zh: ~z~是吗？记住是谁替你做的介绍。记住是谁引荐的你，你可别忘了我。

english: ~z~Sorry, man. She's gone. Maybe things coulda been different in another life.
zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟。她已经走了。可能下辈子会不一样吧。

english: ~z~Sorry, Ray. I'm freelance. I don't buy into that tribute stuff.
zh: ~z~抱歉，雷。我是自由职业者。贡金之类的我不买账。

english: ~z~This work has many disadvantages, but, hey, at least it is tax free.
zh: ~z~这个工作是有很多缺点，不过，嘿，至少它不用交税。

english: ~z~I thought I was doing that.
zh: ~z~那不是我的功劳吗？

english: ~z~Sorry, you've gone past my jurisdiction. Don't mention my name if you get caught.
zh: ~z~抱歉，你的事已经不是我能摆平的了。就算被捕也别提我的名字。

english: ~z~Hey, I don't like the sound of sirens. Tell your cop friends to stay away from me.
zh: ~z~嘿，我不喜欢警笛的声音。告诉你的条子朋友别来烦我。

english: ~z~Yo, Frankie. The smell of bacon is starting to get on my nerves. Get these cops off my back.
zh: ~z~哟，弗兰基。条子的味道搞得我很不爽。让他们别来追我。

english: ~z~If that asshole ever comes back from Ireland, I can't be held responsible for what I'd do.
zh: ~z~要是那个混蛋从爱尔兰回来了，我可不能对我会做出的事负责。

english: ~z~We apologize for the inconvenience but this number has been disconnected.
zh: ~z~很抱歉给您带来不便，但此号码已被注销。

english: ~z~This is Gerald. Don't leave me a message 'cause I ain't gonna listen to it and I sure as shit ain't gonna return your call. Fuck off.
zh: ~z~我是格里。别给我留言，我听不了，而且也回复不了。滚蛋。

english: ~z~I just heard that Clarence Jones - that no good, kid killing, drug dealer I paid you to whack - is still alive.
zh: ~z~我刚听说克拉伦斯･琼斯——那个我出钱让你做掉的、杀孩子的烂人毒贩——还活着。

english: ~z~Shit, something came up. I didn't make it. Maybe they'll schedule another one.
zh: ~z~操，突然有点事。我没去成。他们可能会另外安排一次。

english: ~z~I knew Irish families were big but I didn't expect to run into brothers in a place the size of Liberty City.
zh: ~z~我知道爱尔兰家族很大，不过我倒没想到会在自由城这么大的地方遇见一对兄弟。

english: ~z~Easy there, Niko. You think this has been easy for me? I ain't sleeping nights. I'm a wreck.
zh: ~z~别激动，尼克。你以为我轻松吗？我夜夜睡不着。整个人都垮了。

english: ~z~Packie's just a hood but Gerald is into some serious shit. And Derrick. He's the worst.
zh: ~z~派奇只是个小苍蝇，不过格里就涉及到大案子了。至于德里克，他是最坏的。

english: ~z~She didn't need to say goodbye to Derrick with that going on.
zh: ~z~妈不该在那样的情况下跟德里克告别。

english: ~z~Alright already. You want me to turn water into wine as well?
zh: ~z~好了。你是不是还想我变个魔术？

english: ~z~Don't make me do something I'll regret.
zh: ~z~等我后悔的时候就来不及了。

english: ~z~What, are you mental? You shouldn't even be calling me when you're this hot. I don't know you.
zh: ~z~什么，你疯了吗？这么严重了还给我打电话？我不认识你。

english: ~z~If you don't want to make things real difficult for him you're going to come to Comrades Bar on Mohawk. I have a work for you.
zh: ~z~你要是不想让他难做，就到莫霍克的Comrades酒吧来。我有活给你。

english: ~z~Hey, sorry things didn't work out, goodbye.
zh: ~z~嘿，事情没成很遗憾，再见。

english: ~z~I guess I will. The horse is gone and I can't get Phil on the phone.
zh: ~z~我想会的。货没了，菲尔的电话也打不通。

english: ~z~She won't be impressed with the way you look, so clean car is good thing. Later on.
zh: ~z~她不会对你的长相留下好印象的，所以一辆干净的车也还不错。回见。

english: ~z~Don't get cute, kid. It don't suit you. You're staying in Alderney now, just like me and Phil.
zh: ~z~别耍小聪明，小子。不适合你。你现在就待在奥尔德尼，跟我和菲尔一样。

english: ~z~And that means we're looking after your cousin too. That guy likes to gamble, don't he?
zh: ~z~那就意味着我们也照应着你表哥。那家伙好赌，不是吗？

english: ~z~I'd prefer to be a paid employee than a relative.
zh: ~z~我宁可做拿钱的雇员，也不做亲戚。

english: ~z~Forget about it. I'm gonna hold onto it for a while. Least I could do. Ciao.
zh: ~z~别提了。这钱我先留一阵。算我一点心意。再见。

english: ~z~You don't need to do that for my cousin, Mr. Pegorino. I can handle all his debt. I'll cover it.
zh: ~z~不用为我表哥这么做，佩戈里诺先生。他的债我来担。我全包了。

english: ~z~Dimitri and I had unfinished business so I went ahead and finished it.
zh: ~z~迪米特里和我有笔没完的账，所以我去把它了结了。

english: ~z~Niko, the shit has gone down. I need to see you. Come to the club in Tudor.
zh: ~z~尼克，情况不太妙，我需要见你。到都铎的俱乐部来。

english: ~z~For a peasant you did okay. Car looks good. Girl I'm taking out tonight is going to be impressed.
zh: ~z~作为一个乡巴佬你的表现还不错。车子看上去很好。今晚我带出去的姑娘会有个好印象的。

english: ~z~Vlad? Name doesn't ring any bells. I'm sorry.
zh: ~z~弗拉德？好像不认识啊，抱歉。

english: ~z~So, Niko, why couldn't you come on the date earlier? What happened?
zh: ~z~尼克，你怎么不早点来赴约？有什么事吗？

english: ~z~Roman? He's made some mistakes, got involved with people he shouldn't have but
zh: ~z~罗曼？他确实犯了些错误，认识了一些不该认识的人，但

english: ~z~I hope the police didn't see that.
zh: ~z~但愿没被警察看见。

english: ~z~Come on, I asked you first.
zh: ~z~别这样，我先问你的。

english: ~z~Really? Does Roman get himself into a lot of trouble? Is he involved in criminal stuff?
zh: ~z~真的？罗曼是不是经常惹上一堆麻烦？他有没有和什么犯罪勾当扯上关系？

english: ~z~I don't know - I'm new here.
zh: ~z~不知道，我才刚到这儿。

english: ~z~You know, the carnival isn't open this time of year. I don't know if it would pass safety regulations anyway.
zh: ~z~嘉年华每年这会儿都不开门。不知道能不能通过安全审查。

english: ~z~You already know Roman. I don't hang out with anybody else really.
zh: ~z~罗曼你已经认识了。剩下就没别的人和我一起出去过了。

english: ~z~Please do, Niko. See you soon.
zh: ~z~别忘了，尼克。下次见。

english: ~z~Oh, the Midwest. You probably know more people here than me.
zh: ~z~呃，中西部来的。说不定在这你比我认识的人还多。

english: ~z~More assholes maybe.
zh: ~z~混蛋倒认识不少。

english: ~z~I was really looking forward to that, Niko. I'm sorry if it wasn't your thing. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~我本来还很期待的，尼克。如果不是你的事，我很抱歉。再见。

english: ~z~There's a bowling alley over on the boardwalk. Why don't we play a few frames?
zh: ~z~那边的木板道上有家保龄球馆。要不我们去打几球？

english: ~z~I'm sorry about that, Michelle. I get carried away sometimes.
zh: ~z~很对不起，米歇尔。有时候我会有点情绪失控。

english: ~z~I think you do. There must be something that made you leave your home and come here.
zh: ~z~你应该知道吧。总不会无缘无故就离开老家来这里吧。

english: ~z~What's anybody doing here? I don't know.
zh: ~z~什么在干嘛？我可不知道。

english: ~z~Niko, the carnival isn't open. I think they're going to turn it into a big Las Venturas style theme park.
zh: ~z~尼克，嘉年华没有开门。我觉得这里会被改造成拉斯文加斯风格的主题公园。

english: ~z~I thought you'd be better at that, Niko. We had fun, didn't we? Will you take me back home now?
zh: ~z~我还以为你不止那么点水平呢，尼克。玩得挺开心不是吗？你现在能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~I'm working the whole time. Sometimes I think all I am is my job.
zh: ~z~我一直在工作。有时候我都觉得没了工作我就什么都不是了。

english: ~z~All your stuff is new. Some even still have tags on.
zh: ~z~房间里的东西都是新的，有的连标签都没摘。

english: ~z~Shame we couldn't finish that game, Niko. It was fun playing though. Can you take me back now?
zh: ~z~没能打完真是遗憾，尼克。不过我还是玩得挺高兴的。你现在能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~I didn't realize you were so violent, Niko. Have you got caught up with the Hove Beach criminals?
zh: ~z~真没想到你是个这么暴力的人，尼克。你是不是和霍夫海滩的犯罪团伙有关系？

english: ~z~things get on my nerves and I just throw them out.
zh: ~z~看着不顺眼的就直接扔了换新的。

english: ~z~Is that a fact? You haven't gotten involved in anything dubious here in Liberty City, have you? You'd tell me if you had, wouldn't you?
zh: ~z~是这样吗？你该不会是跟一些可疑的事情扯上关系了吧？就算扯上了，你也会告诉我吧？

english: ~z~I can look after myself Michelle, don't worry about me. Sorry again.
zh: ~z~我可以照顾好自己米歇尔，不用这么操心我。很对不起。

english: ~z~Just a little difference. Ah... whoop-de-doo!
zh: ~z~还是有点区别的。啊...管它呢！

english: ~z~We don't know each other very well, Michelle. I'll talk to you soon.
zh: ~z~我们还不是很熟，米歇尔。下次我会告诉你的。

english: ~z~Good game, Niko. We had fun. Will you take me home now?
zh: ~z~打得不错，尼克。挺开心的。你现在能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~A lot of people feel that way. It's hard to keep what you do from taking over your life.
zh: ~z~很多人都这样。很难让工作不占据你的生活。

english: ~z~Come on, I asked first...
zh: ~z~别这样，我先问的...

english: ~z~I can see that... but, er... everything is new.
zh: ~z~看得出来...不过...全都是新的。

english: ~z~Do you mean you'd steal one? Have you got caught up with the Hove Beach criminals, Niko?
zh: ~z~你是不是要去偷车？你是不是和霍夫海滩的犯罪团伙有关系，尼克？

english: ~z~I can't wait for ever, Niko. Come on.
zh: ~z~我不可能一直等着，尼克。快点。

english: ~z~Thanks for taking me out. I haven't been on a date for a while. I'm kind of lonely here.
zh: ~z~谢谢你带我出来玩。我已经很久没有约会了。我在这儿还有点寂寞。

english: Each friend and girlfriend you have will have their favorite and least favorite activities.
zh: 你的每个朋友和女朋友都会有他们最喜欢和最不喜欢的活动。

english: There are many different types of restaurant around the city where you can take them for food.
zh: 城里有许多不同类型的餐馆，你可以带他们去搓一顿。

english: ~z~Get rid of our tail. We can't be followed.
zh: ~z~甩掉尾巴。我们不能被跟踪。

english: ~z~Very good, very good indeed.
zh: ~z~很好，非常好。

english: ~z~This will show every arrogant shit in the city that we are to be respected.
zh: ~z~这会让城里每个自大的混蛋知道，我们不是好惹的。

english: ~z~You have done a good job.
zh: ~z~你干得不错。

english: ~z~Let me have it. You have done well.
zh: ~z~拿来给我。你干得不错。

english: ~z~Eliminate those that follow us. We cannot have them calling in backup.
zh: ~z~干掉跟踪我们的人。不能让他们叫来支援。

english: ~z~I don't care what it takes, but keep these men away from me.
zh: ~z~不惜一切代价，让这些人离我远点。

english: ~z~Most satisfactory. Go now.
zh: ~z~非常满意。你走吧。

english: ~z~A car, a bike, a fucking chopper - I don't care just get me some transport.
zh: ~z~轿车、摩托、该死的直升机都行——我不管，给我弄辆载具。

english: ~z~This isn't funny. Get me out of here now.
zh: ~z~这一点都不好笑。马上带我离开这儿。

english: ~z~Only we are going to be there, too.
zh: ~z~只不过我们也会到场。

english: ~z~You must destroy these choppers. We cannot be followed.
zh: ~z~必须摧毁这些直升机。我们不能被跟踪。

english: ~z~How have I surrounded myself with such incompetence? Bring me a vehicle.
zh: ~z~我身边怎么净是无能之辈？给我弄辆车。

english: ~z~I hate every biker in this city, man and woman.
zh: ~z~我恨这座城里的每一个飞车党，不分男女。

english: ~z~This is what we were looking for. You have done well.
zh: ~z~这正是我们要找的。你干得不错。

english: ~z~You have done well, now go.
zh: ~z~你干得不错，走吧。

english: ~z~What the fuck? They don't even let me get over my jet lag.
zh: ~z~搞什么？他们连倒时差的时间都不给我。

english: ~z~Our men in the field are running low on supplies.
zh: ~z~我们外头的弟兄快没补给了。

english: ~z~Maybe if you destroy his ~r~car, ~s~he will see sense.
zh: ~z~说不定你毁了他的~r~车，~s~他就能想通了。

english: ~z~~r~Scabs ~s~are continuing to work despite the strike.
zh: ~z~~r~工贼~s~们不顾罢工还在继续干活。

english: ~z~I don't want to get tied to all the murders.
zh: ~z~我不想跟这些谋杀案扯上关系。

english: ~z~We will teach this shit for his reluctance to cut us in on the ~b~cars ~s~he has stolen.
zh: ~z~这混蛋偷了~b~车~s~却不肯分我们好处，得给他点教训。

english: ~z~I knew something was wrong. Show ~r~him ~s~what death really feels like, okay? Argh.
zh: ~z~我就知道不对劲。让~r~他~s~尝尝死亡到底是什么滋味，好吗？唉。

english: ~z~Only, we can't leave the heads on because we don't want them identified.
zh: ~z~只是，脑袋不能留在身上，我们不想让他们被认出来。

english: ~z~Russians, we know how to keep mouths shut. Americans just yabber, yabber, yabber.
zh: ~z~我们俄罗斯人懂得闭嘴。美国人就知道叭叭叭个没完。

english: ~z~Stupid ~r~punk ~s~is trying to blackmail me. Get rid of him so I don't have to pay.
zh: ~z~蠢货~r~小痞子~s~想勒索我。解决了他，我就不用付钱了。

english: ~z~Vanya is burying the bodies of a stickup crew we had to get rid of.
zh: ~z~瓦尼亚正在埋掉我们不得不解决的那伙持枪劫匪的尸体。

english: ~z~Fuck. I don't care if it was stolen in the first place.
zh: ~z~操。我才不管那东西本来是不是偷来的。

english: ~z~I just have problem with her screwing two bit gangsters. Take her ~r~boyfriend ~s~off the market.
zh: ~z~我只是受不了她跟三流混混上床。把她的~r~男朋友~s~从这世上抹掉。

english: ~z~My new girlfriend is kosher. She cannot stand all these ~r~hot dog stands ~s~in the area.
zh: ~z~我的新女友守洁食戒律。她受不了这一带满地的~r~热狗摊~s~。

english: ~z~Crazy bikers are up all night on meth. They getting too fucking lazy to run their own stills even.
zh: ~z~那帮疯飞车党整夜嗑冰毒。他们他妈的懒到连自己的酿酒坊都不开了。

english: ~z~See if they are still there when you have destroyed his ~r~campaign posters ~s~and killed his ~r~campaign manager.
zh: ~z~等你毁了他的~r~竞选海报~s~、杀了他的~r~竞选经理，再看他们还在不在。

english: ~z~Sink these ~b~cars ~s~in water before they stink too bad.
zh: ~z~把这些~b~车~s~沉进水里，趁它们还没臭得太厉害。

english: ~z~Only we cannot afford to leave them alone. You must take ~b~cars ~s~anyway and deliver them.
zh: ~z~只是我们不能放着不管。无论如何你得把~b~车~s~弄来交付。

english: ~z~I cannot get the bloodstains off the upholstery of these ~b~cars.
zh: ~z~这些~b~车~座椅套上的血迹我怎么都弄不掉。

english: ~z~There is too much money in this crack cocaine to ignore it. Take out all the ~r~dealers ~s~so we can gain control.
zh: ~z~这批快克可卡因里的钱多到不能无视。把~r~毒贩~s~全部干掉，我们就能接手。

english: ~z~I thought accountants were too boring to steal, I was wrong.
zh: ~z~我原以为会计师太无聊不值得偷，我错了。

english: ~z~They won't be so happy with themselves when you have killed ~r~them ~s~and brought me the chapter leader's ~b~bike, ~s~will they?
zh: ~z~等你杀了~r~他们~s~、把分会长的~b~摩托~s~带来给我，他们就得意不起来了，是吧？

english: ~z~The local government is reluctant to give us the trash collection contracts.
zh: ~z~当地政府不肯把垃圾清运合同给我们。

english: ~z~The local government is reluctant to give us the trash collection contracts.
zh: ~z~当地政府不肯把垃圾清运合同给我们。

english: ~z~The piece of shit who got lucky is going to be boastful. Destroy the ~r~bike ~s~so he cannot be.
zh: ~z~那个走了狗屎运的混蛋肯定要到处吹嘘。摧毁那辆~r~摩托~s~，让他吹不成。

english: ~z~This detective, he is like herpes, keeps coming back.
zh: ~z~这个警探就像疱疹，老是阴魂不散。

english: ~z~Someone steal his ~b~car. ~s~That might piss him off enough so he will listen to me.
zh: ~z~谁去把他的~b~车~s~偷了。说不定能气得他乖乖听我说话。

english: ~z~~r~She ~s~wants more money or she will go to my wife. Stop this from happening.
zh: ~z~~r~她~s~想要更多钱，不然就去找我老婆。别让这事发生。

english: ~z~I had to whack Ivo last night. It wasn't pretty, but these things happen, yes.
zh: ~z~我昨晚不得不做了伊沃。场面不好看，但这种事总会发生，是的。

english: ~z~They refuse to accept that I am in charge of garbage collection in this area now.
zh: ~z~他们不肯接受现在这片垃圾清运归我管的事实。

english: ~z~but they don't speak English or Russian. We will screw them like they screw me.
zh: ~z~可他们既不说英语也不说俄语。他们怎么坑我，我们就怎么坑他们。

english: ~z~I am having to have some meetings. One of you must show my ~b~wife ~s~the good times while I am away.
zh: ~z~我得去开几个会。我不在的时候，你们谁得带我的~b~妻子~s~好好快活快活。

english: ~z~Make sure the ~r~manager ~s~and his ~r~traders ~s~can't do anymore deals.
zh: ~z~确保~r~经理~s~和他的~r~经销商~s~再也做不成生意。

english: ~z~The people at the Panoramic TV company send my call to centre in who knows where,
zh: ~z~全景电视公司的人把我的来电转到不知道哪里的客服中心，

english: ~z~Destroy some other ~r~Voodoos ~s~so the value of mine increases.
zh: ~z~摧毁几辆别的~r~巫毒~s~，我那辆就更值钱了。

english: ~z~The Pavanos are not living in the present.
zh: ~z~帕瓦诺家活在过去。

english: ~z~My dumb nephew won a big motorcycle race. The organizers want to see his ~b~bike ~s~to make sure he didn't cheat.
zh: ~z~我那个蠢侄子赢了一场大型摩托赛。主办方要看他的~b~摩托~s~，确认他没作弊。

english: ~z~I just bought a new car, but I feel common. Everybody is driving these ~r~Sultans.
zh: ~z~我刚买了辆新车，却觉得很没面子。人人都开这种~r~王者。

english: ~z~I am so horny I can barely walk, let alone drive.
zh: ~z~我欲火焚身，路都走不动，更别说开车了。

english: ~z~Is worse than back home. I need to get this done though, go and pick up my ~b~wasted crew.
zh: ~z~比老家还糟糕。不过这活儿我得干完，去把我那帮~b~烂醉的手下~接来。

english: ~z~These ~b~grenades ~s~are too noisy for my liking. You can use them though. Please, they are here.
zh: ~z~这些~b~手榴弹~s~对我口味来说太吵了。不过你可以用。请便，就在这儿。

english: ~s~If the auto-aim option is set to disallow, you cannot use the targeting system to lock onto opponents.
zh: ~s~如果「自动瞄准」选项设为禁止，你就无法用锁定系统锁住对手。

english: ~s~Your opponents are also represented on the radar by icons. Each has a unique color.
zh: ~s~对手也会在小地图上以图标显示，每人有各自不同的颜色。

english: ~s~When locking onto a target for the first time, if you lightly press ~INPUT_ATTACK~ the reticule will reduce in size. This means your first shot will be very accurate.
zh: ~s~首次锁定目标时，轻按~INPUT_ATTACK~会让准星收缩，这样第一枪会非常准。

english: ~s~The mic icon indicates whether you have an Xbox 360 Headset attached or not.
zh: ~s~麦克风图标表示你是否接入了 Xbox 360 耳麦。

english: ~s~The mic icon indicates whether you have a headset or not.
zh: ~s~麦克风图标表示你是否接入了耳麦。

english: ~s~Sustained firing of your weapon will cause recoil and bullets will spread inaccurately. The aiming reticule will grow larger to indicate when this is happening.
zh: ~s~持续开火会产生后坐力，子弹会散布得不准。此时准星会变大，提示这一点。

english: ~s~Use ~INPUT_MOUSE_WHEEL_UP~ and ~INPUT_MOUSE_WHEEL_DOWN~ when aiming to switch between differing levels of zoom.
zh: ~s~瞄准时用~INPUT_MOUSE_WHEEL_UP~和~INPUT_MOUSE_WHEEL_DOWN~切换不同缩放倍率。

english: The transport is full. Petrovic won't leave the jet unless there is a free seat.
zh: 运输工具已经满员了。除非有空位，否则彼得罗维奇不会离开飞机。

english: Clear the area. Petrovic won't come out until its safe.
zh: 消灭这个地区的敌人。彼得罗维奇在这儿安全之前不会出来。

english: You must secure the area. Petrovic won't leave the jet while there are cops nearby.
zh: 你必须保护好这个地区。只要附近有警察，彼得罗维奇 就不会离开飞机。

english: ~r~You killed too many innocent people.
zh: ~r~你杀了太多无辜民众。

english: Don't get too close or the Ancelottis will spot you.
zh: 不要跟得太紧，否则安切洛蒂家族的人会发现你。

english: ~r~You failed to follow the Ancelottis to the meeting.~s~
zh: ~r~你没能跟着安切洛蒂家族的人找到会议地点。~s~

english: ~R~You failed to detonate the bomb.
zh: ~R~你没能引爆炸弹。

english: ~R~You let the driver escape before killing him.~s~
zh: ~R~你没能杀死司机，被他逃了。~s~

english: Follow the ~r~Ancelottis~s~. Don't let them know you're following them.
zh: 尾随~r~安切洛蒂家族的人。~s~别让他们发现你在跟踪他们。

english: ~s~You better back off, don't spook the ~r~Ancelottis.
zh: ~s~你最好退后些，不要惊动~r~安切洛蒂家族的人。

english: ~z~This a real sound investment you making.
zh: ~z~你做的这笔投资非常划算。

english: ~z~Go for a walk. If anyone asks, you didn't see my face.
zh: ~z~自己走吧。有人问起来，就说你没见过我。

english: ~z~I mean, I was a dick. But I'm making up for it.
zh: ~z~我是说，以前我是个屌人。不过我现在已经在弥补了。

english: ~z~You were hitting the rocks alright.
zh: ~z~你不是在嗑石头吗。

english: ~z~These injuries are only physical, at least I didn't feel the hunger again.
zh: ~z~这些伤只是物理上的，至少我没有再感到那种饥渴。

english: ~z~Would you come with me? I hate to ask, but I'm afraid the temptation might get to me.
zh: ~z~你能一起来吗？我讨厌求人，不过又害怕自己经不住诱惑。

english: ~z~I'm out of the tunnel now though.
zh: ~z~不过我现在已经出坑了。

english: ~z~At least I won't have to put myself in that position again.
zh: ~z~至少我不会再把自己逼到那个境地了。

english: ~z~Hey, apology accepted. Don't worry about it.
zh: ~z~嘿，你的道歉我接受了。不用担心。

english: ~z~Tell you what, have a hundred bucks.
zh: ~z~没想到吧，给你一百块。

english: ~z~I don't know.
zh: ~z~不知道。

english: ~z~Thanks for everything, here's a token of my gratitude. Stay safe.
zh: ~z~万分感谢，小小心意不成敬意。注意安全。

english: ~z~But I'm over that now. I'm engaged!
zh: ~z~不过现在不会了。我要结婚了！

english: ~z~You have to have the serenity to accept the things you cannot change,
zh: ~z~应当平和对待那些无法改变的事物，

english: ~z~You're excused, comrade. You're excused, now go and mine salt for fifty years...
zh: ~z~没事了，同志。你可以走了，去挖五十年盐矿吧...

english: ~z~Are you upset that you couldn't make amends?
zh: ~z~没能补偿他们你伤心吗？

english: ~z~I mean that makes sense, I just can't always live it...
zh: ~z~对吧，哥们？话是合情合理，我就是坚持不了。

english: ~z~I don't want to hurt you, so go. Get lost. Okay?
zh: ~z~我不想伤害你，走吧。躲远点，好吧？

english: ~z~He over in the project up on Frankfort Avenue, please don't kill him.
zh: ~z~他人在法兰克福大道的公屋社区，求你别杀他。

english: ~z~I give her the carrot as well but she don't complain about that.
zh: ~z~我又不是没给她胡萝卜，只是她没跟你说而已。

english: ~z~Please don't do anything!
zh: ~z~求你别动他！

english: ~z~Oh man, I don't get what your problem be.
zh: ~z~噢，伙计，我不知道你哪根筋搭错了。

english: ~z~You know, no more gang bangers and drug dealers. Turn over a new leaf, you know?
zh: ~z~就那种远离帮派份子和毒贩子的。翻开新的一页懂吧。

english: ~z~Damn, don't you beat on your bitches?
zh: ~z~干，难道你丫还不打你家婊子不成？

english: ~z~Hell, I didn't even give Cherise everything I got.
zh: ~z~靠，我就差没把全部家产交给谢丽丝了。

english: ~z~How that bitch expected to learn if I ain't giving her the stick?
zh: ~z~我不给她来顿大棒她怎么可能会学乖？

english: ~z~If I tell this guy to stay the fuck away from you, I don't want to hear about you going back to him.
zh: ~z~我叫这人离你远点，你可别主动把自己送回去啊。

english: ~z~You right, I'll stay away from him.
zh: ~z~确实，我不会去找他了。

english: ~z~You won't think this is so funny when you're the one crying like a bitch.
zh: ~z~等你像个婊子一样在地上哇哇大哭的时候就不会这么想了。

english: ~z~You right, I should find a man who ain't in the life.
zh: ~z~你说的对，我是该找个不在道上的人过。

english: ~z~Stay the fuck away from Cherise and any other woman you'd think about beating.
zh: ~z~你丫以后别碰谢丽丝了，只要你还想着打女人就别碰任何女人。

english: ~z~I like danger. The only thing is... danger don't like me!
zh: ~z~我喜欢危险人物。问题在于...危险人物不喜欢我！

english: ~z~Yeah, and things was... they were going pretty well, but...
zh: ~z~是的，一切都...一切都挺好的，不过...

english: ~z~Hey, you think beating women is cool?
zh: ~z~喂，你是不是觉得打女人很爽啊？

english: ~z~Good for you.
zh: ~z~这不挺好嘛。

english: ~z~Don't worry about it. What are you up to?
zh: ~z~不过别担心。最近你怎么样？

english: ~z~Yeah, you know me... Cherise?
zh: ~z~见过，你肯定见过...谢丽丝记得不？

english: ~z~Shit, Mr. Boss man. Didn't expect this, did you?
zh: ~z~见鬼，老大先生。没想到吧？

english: ~z~This ride is wild enough for me, so can you stop with that weird shit, pal? Now.
zh: ~z~这趟便车就已经够狂野了，能不能拜托你别扯那些诡异的淡了，老兄？别扯了。

english: ~z~Because maybe that's what makes us different... from the animals, I mean. Masturbating.
zh: ~z~可能就是这点才让我们不同...和动物相比，我是说。因为自慰。

english: ~z~I don't sleep.
zh: ~z~我不睡觉。

english: ~z~They don't know what the other smell would be though.
zh: ~z~不过是因为他们不知道另外还有什么味道。

english: ~z~Hey, have you ever wondered what it would be like to be eaten by a shark?
zh: ~z~嘿，你有没有想过被鲨鱼吃掉是怎么样的？

english: ~z~Because I have this rather heavy bag and I really need a lift. I can pay you.
zh: ~z~因为我拖着这个超级重的包，非常需要有人载我一程。我会付钱的。

english: ~z~I like girls too. Both are fun in different ways.
zh: ~z~我也喜欢女孩子。在不同方面各有各的趣味。

english: ~z~Have you ever let someone else take charge of you? It could be a wild ride!
zh: ~z~有让别人控制过你吗？这会是次很狂野的经历的！

english: ~z~Can... can you take me to Westminster?
zh: ~z~能不能拜托你送我去威斯敏斯特？

english: ~z~The neighbors don't like it when Eddie burns his tires.
zh: ~z~邻居们不喜欢埃迪烧轮胎。

english: ~z~Do you hurt other people, Niko?
zh: ~z~你会去伤害别人吗，尼克？

english: ~z~I don't let people get close to me.
zh: ~z~我不会让别人靠得我太近。

english: ~z~Ewww. I don't like doing that. It's smelly.
zh: ~z~哎哟，我可不喜欢那个。味道太大了。

english: ~z~You are cold! You really don't like other people, do you? You don't like to play!
zh: ~z~太冷酷了！你真的不喜欢别人，对不对？你不喜欢玩！

english: ~z~Aw, we're good friends now, uh-huh? Special friends.
zh: ~z~嗷，现在我们是好朋友了吧，啊哈？特别的朋友。

english: ~z~I agree. You're clever. Apart from squirrels.
zh: ~z~我同意，你太聪明了。不过松鼠是例外。

english: ~z~Do you think that a shark's mouth smells of fish when it opens up to eat you?
zh: ~z~你说鲨鱼张嘴吃你的时候会不会有一大股鱼味的口臭？

english: ~z~Have you ever had to say goodbye to someone close to you?
zh: ~z~你有跟身边亲近的人道过别吗？

english: ~z~But I suppose we all do... Neee... in the end.
zh: ~z~不过我想我们都会...咿...早晚的事。

english: ~z~You wouldn't like that, would you?
zh: ~z~你也不想那样吧，对吗？

english: ~z~We're friends, aren't we?
zh: ~z~我们是朋友，对不对？

english: ~z~I'm kidding. Isn't the world strange and nasty?
zh: ~z~我开玩笑的。这个世界不是又怪又糟吗？

english: ~z~I wouldn't want to get in your way, Niko. I wouldn't want you to get in mine either.
zh: ~z~我不想妨碍你，尼克。我也不想你妨碍我。

english: ~z~Glad I got rid of that. Wouldn't want to get caught with it - people can be so narrow minded.
zh: ~z~终于甩掉了，我可不想带着它被抓。有时候人类的心胸真的是太狭隘了。

english: ~z~You always have to say goodbye to them, though. It's really sad.
zh: ~z~不过总得跟他们道别的。真是悲伤。

english: ~z~I wouldn't let that happen.
zh: ~z~我不会让这种事发生的。

english: ~z~Do you want to come out to Hercules with me?
zh: ~z~你想不想出柜然后陪我去大力神？

english: ~z~Wait here for me, friend. Special friend. I'm just dropping the kids off.
zh: ~z~在这儿等我，朋友，特别的朋友。我是去送孩子们出海。

english: ~z~I mean, a girl looks at you, but it turns out she doesn't love you at all.
zh: ~z~就是说，有个女孩和你对上了眼，结果她完全不爱你。

english: ~z~Do you think that sharks are evil?
zh: ~z~你有没有觉得鲨鱼很邪恶？

english: ~z~Eddie doesn't like it when people push him away. Eddie pushes back.
zh: ~z~埃迪不喜欢被别人推开。埃迪会推回去。

zh: ~z~所以他才会结婚三次还不肯承认自己喜欢男人。

english: ~z~That's a bad omen if ever I saw one. We didn't even get to the damn bank. I'll speak to you soon, Niko.
zh: ~z~这要还不算凶兆，我就没见过凶兆。咱们连银行都没进去。回头再聊，尼克。

english: ~z~I dunno. Nodding off with a needle sticking outta your arm?
zh: ~z~我不知道。胳膊上插着针管打盹儿？

english: ~z~That's government money they're carrying, don't let them get away!
zh: ~z~他们拿的是政府的钱，别让他们跑了！

english: ~z~Fuck these people, fuck your cause. That shit's over.
zh: ~z~干他们全家，干你丫的理由。差不多得了。

english: ~z~Shut up and handle the safe.
zh: ~z~别说了，拿下金库。

english: ~z~Had a bit of trouble with that. Couldn't find a pager to rig the blasting cap to.
zh: ~z~那个有点问题。弄不到引爆雷管的接收器。

english: ~z~Don't screw up.
zh: ~z~别搞砸了。

english: ~z~We ain't going back to me ma's house with all this heat, man. Shake the cops.
zh: ~z~风头这么紧，我们可不能就这么回我妈家，老兄。把条子甩掉。

english: ~z~Luis... but this ain't such a good idea bro.
zh: ~z~路易斯...不过这可不是个好主意，兄弟。

english: ~z~I haven't seen combat like this since Belfast.
zh: ~z~贝尔法斯特那次以后我还没见过这样的阵仗。

english: ~z~Michael didn't get lucky, did he? Fucking have-a-go-hero. What was he thinking? He shoulda sat tight.
zh: ~z~是迈克尔运气不好，是吧？去他妈的英勇就义。~n~什么傻逼路人？趴着又不会死。

english: ~z~Another van load of these guys, God give me strength.
zh: ~z~又是一车人，受不了啊。

english: ~z~cause I broke my leg in thirteen places. But...
zh: ~z~因为那次搞得我的腿十三处骨折。不过...

english: ~z~Jesus Christ, we didn't get into this for people to die. Shit.
zh: ~z~老天，我们干这个可不是为了死人。妈的。

english: ~z~Don't need to tell me twice, Packie. I'm ready to go. Pumped, is what I am.
zh: ~z~用不着再跟我说一次，派奇。~n~我已经准备好了。热血沸腾就是我了。

english: ~z~Why're you tellin' them we're brothers, you idiot? That's going to make it hard for them to find us, isn't it?
zh: ~z~你丫说我们是兄弟干嘛，傻逼吗？这不是更容易让我们被抓？

english: ~z~Gerald was very clear about the way things is going down, boys.
zh: ~z~格里制定的流程非常详细，小子们。

english: ~z~You shouldn't be near here, please move on.
zh: ~z~你不该待在这儿，请继续往前走。

english: ~z~Can't wait to see what sort of kick C4 residue is going to give me when I snort up a line of chop though one of them notes.
zh: ~z~我都忍不住想见识下~n~沾着C4的钞票卷出来的大麻烟有多爽了。

english: ~z~They don't make things easy for us, do they? Damn bridge is blocked.
zh: ~z~他们就是不让我们省心，是吧？该死的桥被封了。

english: ~z~Don't hurt the hostages.
zh: ~z~不要伤害人质。

english: ~z~Don't lose me, boys.
zh: ~z~别走散了，小子们。

english: ~z~There's been too many casualties already. Don't make this any more difficult.
zh: ~z~伤亡已经太多了。别让事情更加难办。

english: ~z~when you stop shoving half of Bolivia up your nose every Saturday night!
zh: ~z~只要你别每周六晚上都把半个玻利维亚的毒品吸到肚！

english: ~z~Don't bring my parents into this, Packie.
zh: ~z~别扯上我的父母，派奇。

english: ~z~Fucking Frankie, he'd be pissed if he could see us now.
zh: ~z~狗逼弗兰基，现在他见着我们不得被气死。

english: ~z~Everyone keep your heads down.
zh: ~z~所有人都不准抬头。

english: ~z~Really Michael? You don't think I know that?
zh: ~z~是吗，迈克尔？你当我不知道吗？

english: ~z~We ain't got time to go back in. Let's move out, boys.
zh: ~z~没时间再下去拿了。撤了吧，小子们。

english: ~z~We lost Michael and Derrick, it ain't worth it.
zh: ~z~我们丢了迈克尔和德里克，这票不值。

english: ~z~Shit, before the job even fucking started.
zh: ~z~妈的，活儿还没他妈开始呢。

english: ~z~Now you've said bloody Ireland, that's gonna narrow the search ain't it?
zh: ~z~你他妈说了爱尔兰是吧，这不是又把范围缩小了？

english: ~z~Wrong time, wrong place. I'll see you around.
zh: ~z~时候不对，地方不对。我们回头见。

english: ~z~Eyes on the floor, people.
zh: ~z~都不许抬头。

english: ~z~Don't you speak about my parents like that.
zh: ~z~不许你这么说我的父母。

english: ~z~I wasn't just driving you two, the money was in the car as well. Remember that.
zh: ~z~我不只是替你俩开车，车里面可还有钱呢。记着点。

english: ~z~Gerry was right about you, Mikey. Your parents must have been twins to produce a kid as dumb as you.
zh: ~z~格里说你说的是一点没错，迈基。~n~你爸妈得是龙凤胎才能生出你这么个白痴。

english: ~z~Use your head, Niko. We ain't gonna be able to lose the pigs in a cop car.
zh: ~z~动动脑子，尼克。开着警车甩不掉那群猪的。

english: ~z~Nothing like a sibling's love, eh Derrick?
zh: ~z~还是自家人最亲啊，德里克？

english: ~z~I ain't having this argument with you, Patrick.
zh: ~z~不跟你多逼逼好吧，帕特里克。

english: ~z~I got all the money I could. There's still some in there though.
zh: ~z~能拿的钱我都拿上了。不过里面还剩了些。

english: ~z~We've got a clean line of sight, take 'em down!
zh: ~z~视野开阔无遮挡，放倒他们！

english: ~z~We won't forget it, Niko. Here's your cut. I'll tell Gerry you did good. He might give you a call or something.
zh: ~z~我们不会忘的，尼克。这是你的那份。~n~我会告诉格里你干得很好的。改天他可能会打电话找你。

english: ~z~Neither do I.
zh: ~z~我也不想。

english: ~z~Niko, that thing can't take all of us and this cash. Use your head, man.
zh: ~z~尼克，那破车坐不下我们几个加这一堆钱。用用脑子吧，兄弟。

english: ~z~Get down, we don't wanna hurt civilians.
zh: ~z~趴下，我们不想伤到平民。

english: ~z~You ain't invincible, Niko. Get in cover.
zh: ~z~尼克，你不是无敌的。找掩护。

english: ~z~Shit, just staying here ain't going to work. There are too many of them.
zh: ~z~操，光守在这儿不行。他们人太多了。

english: ~z~I ain't going to jail in this country.
zh: ~z~我可不想在这个国家坐牢。

english: ~z~We ain't doing that neither. Follow me. We'll lose them in the subway.
zh: ~z~不用这么做。跟我来，进地铁站甩掉他们。

english: ~z~Niko, you gotta hang in there. Don't die on us.
zh: ~z~尼克，撑住。可别死在我们前头。

english: ~z~I got plans for this money. I ain't dropping it.
zh: ~z~我都想好这钱咋花了，我是不会放弃的。

english: ~z~This ain't the type of thing I agree with. I ain't in it for the money. I believe in something, you know?
zh: ~z~这种事我可不认同。我不是为了钱入的伙。我是有信仰的人，懂吗？

english: ~z~I ain't built for being underground like this.
zh: ~z~我这种人受不了钻地道。

english: ~z~We don't want another casualty on this job. Hang in there, Niko.
zh: ~z~这一单不想再多一条人命。撑住，尼克。

english: ~z~Chinatown always smells like Chinatown no matter where you are or how much gun powder is in the air.
zh: ~z~火药打得再多，唐人街还是一股唐人街的味儿。

english: ~z~This ain't working. We need to get out of here.
zh: ~z~这样撑不住了。我们得离开这儿。

english: ~z~We just made a withdrawal, what's the problem?
zh: ~z~我们不过是要撤退而已，搞什么啊？

english: ~z~And you coulda been more careful of your boy Michael. He should be with us right now.
zh: ~z~你咋不多护着点你手下的迈克尔，~n~否则他哪会没命啊。

english: ~z~Go back home to your kids. You don't wanna die here.
zh: ~z~回家带孩子去吧。你们不会想死在这儿的。

english: ~z~I'm getting screwed here, boys.
zh: ~z~我这边快顶不住了，小子们。

english: ~z~You've been beat up good, Niko. Pull through, okay?
zh: ~z~尼克，你被打得不轻。撑下去，好吗？

english: ~z~Jesus, Packie. Show some fucking consideration. Sorry if I'm a man of principle unlike you and Gerald.
zh: ~z~我的天，派奇。多少替人考虑考虑，行吗。对不起了，不像你和格里，我可是有原则的人。

english: ~z~Get in cover, Packie. Ma'd be real upset if you got hit.
zh: ~z~找掩护，派奇。妈要是知道你挨了枪非得伤心死。

english: ~z~Fuck, boys. I ain't doing too good over here.
zh: ~z~操，小子们。我这边情况不妙。

english: ~z~You ain't looking too good, Niko. Hang in there.
zh: ~z~尼克，你状态不太好啊。撑住。

english: ~z~I don't like this.
zh: ~z~这不对劲。

english: ~z~Packie, get in cover before you get yourself killed.
zh: ~z~派奇，赶紧找掩护，别把命丢了。

english: ~z~Hurry up and shoot the fucking lock, will you?
zh: ~z~快点，把那破锁打烂，行不行？

english: ~z~I'm gonna knock myself out for the fucking count. Try to forget about all this shit.
zh: ~z~非得把自己折腾到不省人事，好把这些破事统统忘掉。

english: ~z~Shit, I don't wanna die down here.
zh: ~z~操，我不想死在这地下。

english: ~z~I ain't giving up this money.
zh: ~z~我不会放弃这笔钱的。

english: ~z~We can't let these cops pin us down in here. Fuck!
zh: ~z~不能被条子困在这儿。操！

english: ~z~Let us go fucking peaceful like!
zh: ~z~就不能让我们和平撤离吗！

english: ~z~You don't wanna stand in our fucking way.
zh: ~z~你们最好别他妈挡我们的路。

english: ~z~Don't stand in our way because we don't want to hurt you.
zh: ~z~别挡路，我们可不想伤了你。

english: ~z~You almost lost me and a big bag of money there, boys.
zh: ~z~你们刚才差点就要没了我和一大包钱，小子们。

english: ~z~You ain't taking me down!
zh: ~z~别想干掉我！

english: ~z~Watch the bags, boys. We don't want holes in our notes.
zh: ~z~包当心点，小子们。大家都不想钞票上长眼儿。

english: ~z~Shit, that was closer than I'm comfortable with.
zh: ~z~操，刚才那下有点顶不住。

english: ~z~This ain't my idea of fun, boys. Would ya give me a hand?
zh: ~z~要我说这可算不上寻开心，小子们。谁来搭把手？

english: ~z~Make sure these pricks don't shoot the bags. Notes with bullet holes in 'em are gonna be mighty hard to get rid of.
zh: ~z~别让这些屌人打到包上面。有弹孔的钱可花不出去。

english: ~z~You don't wanna die for the bank's cash.
zh: ~z~银行的钱不值得你们送死。

english: ~z~I ain't gonna be around much longer at this rate. Fucking help me!
zh: ~z~照这么下去我撑不了多久了。快来帮帮我！

english: ~z~Michael was unlucky. It wasn't anybody's fault what happened to him and the explosive did its job.
zh: ~z~迈克尔运气差了点。~n~他出事怪不了谁，炸弹也够好了。

english: ~z~Don't be fucking stupid, get in cover, Niko.
zh: ~z~别犯傻了，快找掩护，尼克。

english: ~z~Don't get this money shot up, boys.
zh: ~z~别让钱被打烂了，小子们。

english: ~z~Will you shoot the fucking lock already, Niko?
zh: ~z~尼克，你能不能快点把那破锁打烂？

english: ~z~The can't be another truck full of them. Jesus. They're blocking the roads.
zh: ~z~不会又是一整车他们的人吧。我的天。他们把路都封了。

english: ~z~You'll be okay. Just chill out.
zh: ~z~你会没事的。放轻松。

english: ~z~Why didn't I fucking control myself?
zh: ~z~为什么以前我他妈控制不了自己？

english: ~z~I don't wanna spend them staring into the bottom of a glass.
zh: ~z~我可不想花钱盯着酒杯底。

english: ~z~Can't you remember coming over to my place and throwing the TV out the window?
zh: ~z~你是不是忘了你之前来我家把我电视砸窗户外边的事情了？

english: ~z~Be smart, friend.
zh: ~z~别犯傻，朋友。

english: ~z~I'm through with problems. Now they are just opportunities.
zh: ~z~我不再畏惧问题了。现在问题都是机会。

english: ~z~I know... this is a lot to ask, but I was wondering...
zh: ~z~我知道...这个要求有点过分，不过我在想...

english: ~z~I don't suppose you could come along and keep him cool?
zh: ~z~你能不能陪我一起去，好让他冷静点？

english: ~z~Don't worry. I'll make sure everything's cool.
zh: ~z~不用担心，我会保证一切顺利的。

english: ~z~You got a lot of debt to pay, Mel.
zh: ~z~你要还的可不止这么点，梅尔。

english: ~z~But I'm all sorted out now.
zh: ~z~不过现在我改正了。

english: ~z~Obviously, the DTs hit me pretty hard when I first got sober.
zh: ~z~显然，我头一回没醉的时候戒断反应很明显。

english: ~z~Ha ha! That's about right. I was a mess, a mess!
zh: ~z~哈哈！就是这个。不堪回首啊，不堪！

english: ~z~I don't think those guys are going to be calling that debt in.
zh: ~z~我想这些人再也不会来催债了。

english: ~z~Maybe just one drink would calm my nerves?
zh: ~z~说不定来上一杯能让我镇定一点？

english: ~z~Mel ain't nearly hit rock bottom yet.
zh: ~z~梅尔都还没沉沦到底呢。

english: ~z~Didn't I see you at Comrades, pal?
zh: ~z~我不是在Comrades见过你吗，哥们？

english: ~z~I want to be someone, help people... seriously!
zh: ~z~我想做点什么，帮助别人...真的！

english: ~z~You seemed to like it when I last met you?
zh: ~z~我上次见着你的时候你不就这样吗？

english: ~z~I'm over that shit!
zh: ~z~不是那个烂人了！

english: The so called "War on Terror" is now a war on commuters and the poor, who don't have helicopters but instead are forced to use trains, bridges and tunnels, many of which are closed after an unsubstantiated Internet threat. Rather than broker peace talks and work to end global warming, Liberty City politicians and federal agents are flush with anti-terror cash which they stuff down the panties of defense contractors to turn this city into a war zone.
zh: 所谓的「反恐战争」却成为了一场针对通勤者和穷人的战争。他们没有直升机，只能选择城铁、桥梁和隧道，而未经证实的网络恐怖威胁封堵了他们仅剩的选择。自由城的政客和联邦探员并没有选择和平谈判，也没有尝试解决气候变暖，反倒将反恐资金塞进国防承包商的口袋，把本市变成了战区。

english: The Panoramic e-fridge 5000 detects the user of your fridge and monitors nutritional habits. A midnight snack of frozen French fries, pizzas with mustard and fishstick bacon omelets will trigger the intelligent engine and send an email to mom and dad that their child is most likely high as shit. If the e-fridge 5000 detects that it hasn't been accessed by your daughter in a few days, an eating disorder alert will be sent. The price is planned at $6,000.
zh: 全景牌5000型智能冰箱会检测冰箱使用者的身份，并监测其营养习惯。一份速冻薯条、芥末披萨和炸鱼条培根蛋卷组成的夜宵将触发智能引擎，向父母发送一封电子邮件，告诉他们的孩子很可能在家嗨到不行了。如果5000型智能冰箱检测到你的女儿数日没有使用记录，就会发送饮食失调警告。目前产品的计划售价为$6000。

english: While most liberal-minded voters are opposed to the constant electronic monitoring of American citizens, as parents, we owe it to our children to track their every move. Whether it's the Trackify device or hiring a private investigator, it's your responsibility to make your kids safe. But it's very difficult to know if your child is using drugs. We've all dabbled in a little reefer and the occasional rail but, once you become a parent, it's time to change your tune and pretend your child won't go through the same adolescent trials and tribulations you did and get sanctimonious on them.
zh: 虽然大多数持有自由主义观念的选民反对对美国公民进行长期电子监控，但作为父母，我们有责任监视孩子的一举一动。无论是使用追踪设备还是雇佣私家侦探，保证孩子的安全都是你的责任。但想知道你的孩子是否在吸毒很难。我们都碰过大麻，偶尔还吸吸白粉，不过一旦为人父母，你就该改变你的态度，假装你的孩子不会经历你曾经历过的青春期的考验和磨难，在他们面前装作自己没有吸毒之类的陋习。

english: It's tough being a godless liberal in a theocracy, but it's about to get even worse if Congress has its way. "Everyone should be able to get married," says Phil Kensington of the American Society of Same Sex, "I want to marry my life partner, who is a 79 year old man, but very wealthy, and I am 26 and love to club and we have a great time. If we don't marry, how can I ride this old git for a couple of years, cringing every time he slobbers on me and calls it a kiss, just so I can take his millions?"
zh: 在一个神权政体中，成为一个无神论的自由主义者很难，但如果国会执意这样行事，情况将变得更糟。「每个人都应该能够结婚，」 美国同性恋协会的菲尔･肯辛顿说「我想和我的终身伴侣结婚，他79岁了，但是很富有。而我26岁，喜欢去夜店，我们在一起很开心。要是我们不结婚，我怎么会骑这老家伙好几年、每次他管对我流口水的行为叫亲吻就巴结他，然后拿走他的百万家产呢？」

english: Well, it's finally over. The King has won and Rome is burning. The conservatives have had their way and the constitution is in shambles. With the renewal of the Jingoism Act, EVERY SINGLE THING YOU DO will be monitored. There are 300 million people in America and a reported 300 million people will need to be hired to track the every movement of every American. These are scary times and I am so glad to be a liberal journalist who doesn't interject her personal feelings into stories. The blogosphere is the only thing that can save us from this tyranny.
zh: 好了，终于结束了。国王赢了，罗马正在燃烧。保守派成功了，宪法成了一团糟。在沙文主义法案更新后，「你所做的一切」都将受到监控。美国有3亿人，据报道需要雇佣3亿人来监视所有美国人的一举一动。坏时代要来了，幸好我是自由派记者，不必将自己的私情融入报导。博客圈是唯一能从这种暴政中拯救我们的东西。

english: After a Freedom of Information Act request to the FIB, I found out that they had done surveillance on me and found out that I liked to visit trannies under the Broker Bridge. It is inexcusable that the government is reading my blog TranEELuvr. It is this kind of surveillance state that will bring this country down.
zh: 在向FIB提请《信息自由法案》后，我发现他们对我进行了监视，发现我喜欢在布洛克桥下见变性人。政府阅读我的博客TranEELuvr是不可原谅的。正是这种监视状态将让国家衰落。

english: You drive your child to school and teach them that minorities are all ok (but just can't afford your neighborhood because of conservative racism) and that they should treat everyone with kindness. But what about adults who prey on our children? In a recent report, there are over 8 million registered sex offenders with MyRoom accounts.
zh: 你开车送孩子上学，告诉他们少数族裔也是好人(只是因为保守的种族主义，他们住不起你的小区)，他们应该善待每一个人。但是那些「掠食」我们孩子的成年人呢？最近的一份报告指出，有超过800万的性犯罪者注册了MyRoom账户。

english: The bridge and tunnel crossings between Algonquin and Alderney were finally reopened yesterday as the terror threat caused by the mismanagement of the war on terror was deemed to have sufficiently reduced enough to allow us to carry on destroying the planet by the burning of fossil fuels. It's global warming stupid. It's a win - win for big business as usual. As income from the war goes down, oil revenues go up as people start increasing their carbon footprint again.
zh: 鉴于由反恐战争管理不当造成的恐怖主义威胁已经降低，连接阿尔冈琴和奥尔德尼的大桥及隧道终于于昨日重新开放，我们又可以照常燃烧化石能源破坏地球了。全球变暖诶，白痴！这次又是政界与商界的双赢。随着由战争带来的收入减少，通过石油取得的收入又一次随着民众碳排放的提高而提高。

english: A blast from the past today as former talk show host Lazlow is trying to get back on the airwaves. Lazlow used to host a popular show on a station called Chatterbox at the turn of the millennium, then things turned bad for him and he disappeared from our airwaves after a string of personal humiliations and bad choices, including several payola scandals, and a series of sexual shenanigans led to major credibility issues. But it appears he is back. Or trying to get back. He's been trying to raise financing for a new radio station to be launched in Liberty City in which the listener is put right into the action.
zh: 爆炸性新闻，前脱口秀主持人拉兹洛竟想重回电台。21 世纪初时，拉兹洛曾在Chatterbox电台主持一档热门节目，后来情况一落千丈。先是被曝数次受贿放歌，而后是种种性骚扰丑闻，让他的形象完全崩塌。不过他似乎又回来了，或者是想回来了。他一直在努力筹资，以在自由城成立一家听众导向的新电台。

english: Announcing his plans at a poorly-attended press conference yesterday, he said, "This is radio 2.0, this is Lazlow 2.0, I'm back." When asked to explain what on earth this could mean, the popular shock jock said, "I don't really know - it's up to you, the listeners, to decide.' We will stay on this story in the hope this guy makes something of himself.
zh: 昨天，他在门庭冷清的记者招待会上公布了他的计划，他说：「这就是电台 2.0，这就是拉兹洛 2.0，我回来了。」当被问及所谓2.0究竟有何区别时，这名人气DJ回答道：「我也不清楚。主要还是看你们——听众们——的意见。」我们会持续跟进此事，希望他能有所成就。

english: Young men are ruining their lives by playing video games - this is something we all already knew. Obviously, video games also cause global warming and a lot of antisocial behavior, including farting, but now it turns out they also cause impotence in 90% of men, according to reports published yesterday. It makes a lot of sense - for years people put the falling birth rate down to the hopelessness of contemporary society and the terror of living in a godless world, but thankfully we have a new enemy.
zh: 众所周知，年轻人已经因游玩电子游戏毁掉了他们的人生。显然，电子游戏也导致了全球变暖和种种反社会行为，比如放屁。但根据昨天发布的报告，电子游戏也让90%的男人患上阳痿。这就说得通了，多年以来人们一直将出生率下滑归咎于对当代社会的绝望和对无神论世界的恐惧，但谢天谢地，我们现在有新的敌人了。

english: Our kids don't have much to look up to anymore. I work tirelessly with civic groups and politicians to ban video games, indecent words in movies, tobacco billboards, skateboarding, teen sex and eating meat that isn't free range. So when I want to take my kid to a baseball game and he sees these overpaid losers down there full of chemicals, what am I supposed to tell him? That mommy is on Ampheterate since starting therapy years ago? That daddy has to take a Mollis in order to bypass his biological response to throw up on my saggy tits? That we sneak gin martinis at lunch? What? These players deserve to be fired.
zh: 我们的孩子再也没有什么榜样了。我不辞辛劳地和公民团体与政客们一起推动禁止电子游戏、电影粗口、烟草广告、滑板运动、儿童色情和食用非放养肉类。结果我带孩子观看棒球比赛时，看见的却是收入过高的药罐子，你让我怎么跟他解释？告诉他妈咪在接受治疗之前就已经在服用Ampheterate吗？告诉他爹地必须靠Mollis才能避免对着我下垂的奶子感到恶心想吐吗？告诉他我们在午餐时偷喝金马提尼吗？怎么了？这些球员就该被解雇。

english: Soon the conservatives will come out in self-righteous indignation saying that you can't marry your clone. This is asinine. Marriage is what you want it to be. You should be able to marry your clone. It will be like a gum commercial. It's time to get hate out of the political process and let love rule. Love yourself.
zh: 不久后，保守派就会愤慨地用自以为是的腔调说你不能娶你的克隆人。太蠢了，怎样才算婚姻是由每个人自己决定的。你应当能与自己的克隆体结婚。就像口香糖广告一样。是时候让仇恨离开政坛，让爱掌权了。爱你自己。

english: But, when they have, I'm thinking green lawsuits are the next big thing. If you can sue a tobacco company for giving you lung cancer, why can't you sue an oil company for putting a hole in the ozone layer and giving you skin cancer? Or a car company for polluting the environment and screwing up your lungs. A professional skier would have good cause to sue someone for causing global warming and stopping it snowing. These cases are the future." The potential for a class action suit involving loss of income and medical complaints due to global warming could be huge.
zh: 不过在此之后，我觉得该侧重于环保方面的诉讼了。既然可以起诉烟草公司害你得肺癌，为什么不能起诉石油公司让臭氧层漏了，害你得皮肤癌呢？还可以起诉汽车公司破坏环境，害你生了肺病。职业滑雪运动员完全可以控告某人造成全球变暖，使得降雪减少。以后主要是这方面。因全球变暖导致的收入损失或健康损害类案件还有很多可以深挖。

english: Mr. Dawkins, who has long attacked the gay community was himself revealed to be a practicing homosexual. That's his business. What is our business is the money he has stolen from the city. Rather than rehab he should be working on a chain gang. Mr. Dawkins is a typical conservative - hypocritical, repressed and corrupt. We just wish he would hurry up and resign.
zh: 常年抨击同性恋社群的道金斯先生被发现是同性恋。不过那是他的事，我们更关心他从本市偷走的钱。比起康复中心，他更应该去接受劳改。道金斯先生是典型的保守派——虚伪，压抑而腐败。我们只希望他能尽快辞职。

Rather than rehab he should be working on a chain gang. Mr. Dawkins is a typical conservative - hypocritical, repressed and corrupt. We just wish he would hurry up and resign.

english: Or maybe we are being too harsh? After all, we all fell for the greatest pyramid scheme of all time: Social Security. Now that our pensions have been blown on conservative war-games, it is easy to see how even the most ludicrous online scam could start to look appealing. President Lawton and his band of thieves have turned the US economy into a ticking time bomb. Move to India - you will be better off in the long run.
zh: 还是说我们太严格了？毕竟我们都身陷史上最大的金字塔骗局：社会保障。我们的养老金已经在保守派的战争游戏中灰飞烟灭了，由此不难发现就连最假的网络诈骗都会如此诱人。劳顿总统和他手下的贼已经让美国经济变成了一颗定时炸弹。移民到印度去吧——长远来看那边会让你过得更好。

english: A code of sexism?
zh: 代码也有性别歧视？

english: A young woman in Alderney City, who installed the Eunux open-source operating system on her home computer, has become the victim of an evil hate campaign. The Eunux community has taken the girl's attempts to infiltrate their little white boys' club as a personal attack on their inadequate masculinity and has thrown all their joint efforts into publicly bashing her on blogs and newsgroups. What gives a bunch of losers who spend their Saturday nights recompiling a kernel, fantasizing about sleeping with their mother and shuddering if a female brushes past them on the subway the right to take out their fear of women and lack of social skills on a 13-year-old girl? Are they afraid that she will disturb their circle jerk session? Since when was a penis a prerequisite for computer programming?
zh: 一位奥尔德尼市的年轻女性，因为在自己的电脑上安装了开源操作系统Eunux，就成了恶毒的反对运动的受害人。Eunux社区将她试图融入白人年轻男性社群的行为认定为对他们缺乏阳刚之气的人身攻击，并且不遗余力地在博客和新闻讨论组上抹黑她。是谁给了他们权利，让这些周六晚上写内核、每天意淫睡他妈、地铁上被女的碰到都发抖的失败者，可以将他们对女性的恐惧和匮乏的社交能力发泄在一个13岁的小女孩身上？他们是怕她搞乱他们的弱鸡循环会话控制吗？从什么时候开始写代码还一定要有屌了？

english: Activists are outraged at what the blogosphere has dubbed the "Broker Bridge Massacre." Members of the media and activist groups charged into police headquarters to hear talking head Police Commissioner for Public Affairs, Tom Pireni, attempt to deflect complaints of brutality. In a slick propaganda slideshow and musical performance targeted to sooth activists, the show did nothing but enrage them. We should be able to do anything and go anywhere we want. What do we need police for?
zh: 社会活动家对博客圈称为「布洛克桥大屠杀」的事件感到愤怒。媒体人员和社会活动团体冲入警局总部质问警局公共事务处处长，汤姆･皮雷尼。他本想转移对暴力执法的控诉，但这场用于安抚社会活动家的空话宣传讲座和音乐表演反而激怒了他们。我们应该能做任何事情，去任何想去的地方。我们要警察干嘛？

english: Police brutality must stop. Searches and seizures must stop, especially among epileptics. And those announcements in the subway are creepy. What year are we in? 1984? Bloggers unite. Only by complaining to each other in the cold, hollow halls of cyberspace can we stop this police brutality.
zh: 暴力执法必须停止。搜查和罚没必须停止，尤其是不合理的搜查罚没。而且地铁站里的那些布告十分骇人。我们现在是哪一年？1984年？博主们联合起来。只有在寒冷、空洞的网络世界中相互控诉，我们才能阻止警察的暴力执法。

Contacts who now ensure the city is run to support the rich and keep money out of schools and into government-funded spying programs through a complicated conspiracy I don't quite have the space to explain here. As usual, it's just another example of the big attacking the small and the rich using power systems to destroy the aspirations of the poor.

english: ~z~You didn't change the game, the game changed you.
zh: ~z~你没有改变游戏，游戏改变了你。

english: ~z~Always hungry though, always wanted more. Maybe I shoulda seen it then. Kept a closer eye on him.
zh: ~z~一直很饥渴，永远不满足。早该想到的，当时就要盯紧他。

english: ~z~Dwayne is a little troubled.
zh: ~z~德维恩只是有点不安。

english: ~z~But what else is there?
zh: ~z~不这样还能怎样？

english: ~z~I can't do it myself. He was my boy back in the day.
zh: ~z~我自己下不了手。这小子是我一手带大的。

english: ~z~On the down low, I think Playboy wants me dead.
zh: ~z~不瞒你说，我觉得花花公子想杀我。

english: ~z~Nah. It'll make me remember the kid too much.
zh: ~z~别。我会睹物思人的。

english: ~z~Well neither do I, man. But if he goes insane, we all dead anyway.
zh: ~z~我也不想啊，兄弟。但是一旦他疯起来，我们都得完蛋。

english: ~z~I know what loyalty means, unlike some people. You and me is tight now.
zh: ~z~我知道忠诚的意义，不像某些人。咱俩现在是铁哥们了。

english: ~z~That's something I won't be able to forget.
zh: ~z~忘都忘不了。

english: ~z~Might just let him do it, put a cap in my dome. End it all.
zh: ~z~说不定这样也好，给我做个了结，一了百了。

english: ~z~Nah, fuck that shit. I ain't ready to go out yet. I need you to get him for me.
zh: ~z~算了，门都没有。我还不打算死。我需要你帮我解决他。

english: ~z~Man, you ain't cool. You try to find something to live for, man. Peace.
zh: ~z~兄弟你不行。你得想想自己为什么而活，兄弟。别了。

english: ~z~Always hungry though, always wanted more. Maybe I shoulda seen it then. Kept a closer eye on him.
zh: ~z~一直很饥渴，永远不满足。我早该发现的，盯得他紧一点。

english: ~z~I took shit to the next level, cats like you just can't accept that.
zh: ~z~我已经升到了新的境界，你这样的小鬼还无法接受而已。

english: ~z~That's something I won't be able to forget.
zh: ~z~忘都忘不了。

english: ~z~I don't have many friends left, you know.
zh: ~z~我现在没多少朋友了。

english: ~z~but because I won't bow down to him and treat him like he The Almighty,
zh: ~z~就因为我不对他卑躬屈膝，不把他当上帝供着，

english: ~z~So it's best if we just stay the hell away from each other, man.
zh: ~z~所以我们最好还是不相往来，兄弟。

english: ~z~You can't predict what people will become.
zh: ~z~谁都不知道一个人会变成什么样。

english: ~z~I was an example to all the kids, man. You can't take that away from me.
zh: ~z~我是孩子们的榜样，兄弟。这你不能否认吧。

english: ~z~I showed you the world, gangster. You don't control this shit.
zh: ~z~我带你见了世面，小子。你把持不住的。

english: ~z~But I got the deed to Playboy's fancy silk sheet loft. You can have it.
zh: ~z~不过花花公子锦衣玉食的顶楼公寓的房产证还在我手里，房子就归你了。

english: ~z~I mean, I am cold, but... motherfucker.
zh: ~z~我是说，我确实冷酷，不过...狗日的。

english: ~z~Don't play me like that, Niko.
zh: ~z~别这么耍我，尼克。

english: ~z~he's gone crazy. I mean he's gone. Prison does that.
zh: ~z~他已经疯了。我是说他回不来了。监狱让他成了这样。

english: ~z~Ain't got much else to do. So long, Niko.
zh: ~z~也没别的好做了，再见，尼克。

english: ~z~Maybe your problem is that you don't understand that. I'll be seeing you soon.
zh: ~z~你的问题大概就出在不明白这一点，走着瞧吧。

english: ~z~Even if you kill me, you gonna have this whole town after your ass.
zh: ~z~就算你杀了我，城里还有无数人会来追杀你。

english: ~z~You shouldn't have asked me to kill Dwayne, Playboy.
zh: ~z~你不该叫我去杀了德维恩的，花花公子。

english: ~z~On the down low, I think Playboy wants me dead.
zh: ~z~不瞒你说，我觉得花花公子想杀我。

english: ~z~I didn't kill Dwayne.
zh: ~z~我没有杀德维恩。

english: ~z~Well, you can't kill him.
zh: ~z~那你也不能杀他。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko.That weren't cool.
zh: ~z~靠，尼克。这样可不好。

english: ~z~No, I tried talking. I... I... I tried giving him half of the business.
zh: ~z~早沟通过了。我...我...我跟他说分一半产业给他。

english: ~z~Do you think that I do? But it's kill or be killed out there. And you got a lunatic after you?
zh: ~z~你当我喜欢？现在不是干他就是被干。还是说你想被个疯子追杀？

english: ~z~Well what you doin' back here then? Step to it, motherfucker.
zh: ~z~那你丫回来干啥？还不快去，狗逼玩意。

english: ~z~Do diamonds burn, cousin? How about gold, will that melt in a fire?
zh: ~z~钻石会烧着吗，堂弟？黄金呢，会不会在火里熔了？

english: ~z~I know a bunch of people who might be able to help out.
zh: ~z~我认识挺多人的，说不定能帮上你。

english: ~z~Then we shut everything up and get to Bohan.
zh: ~z~然后我们就二话不说直达波汉。

english: ~z~More or less.
zh: ~z~差不多吧。

english: ~z~We will, but I have left something important at the apartment. Something I must show you, cousin.
zh: ~z~肯定会，不过我在公寓里落了样重要的东西。你一定要看看那个，堂弟。

english: ~z~An idiot, not an optimist.
zh: ~z~就一傻子，还乐天派。

english: ~z~This place is gone.
zh: ~z~这地方是没了。

english: ~z~Maybe they will let us live with them in their crack dens.
zh: ~z~说不定就让我们跟她们一起住烟馆里了。

english: ~z~Do you know how long it took me to get set up here? You don't because it was easy for you.
zh: ~z~你知道我为了在这里开店花了多久吗？~n~你不知道，因为你过得太容易了。

english: ~z~I got scared... people started calling the house and hanging up.
zh: ~z~我吓坏了...家里的座机响个不停。

english: ~z~-bunch of idiot Russians... ~n~-I will kill every one of them.
zh: ~z~－不就是群俄罗斯傻蛋吗...~n~－我会把他们一一杀掉。

english: ~z~What's done is done.
zh: ~z~做过的事也改变不了。

english: ~z~I don't want to talk about back home.
zh: ~z~我不想说以前的事。

english: ~z~I don't get it!
zh: ~z~我搞不懂！

english: ~z~I was thinking about getting out of the cab business. Last night I had a dream...
zh: ~z~我刚好有想过不做的士生意。昨晚我做了个梦...

english: ~z~Any of your cousins have a place we could use out in Bohan?
zh: ~z~你有没有哪个亲戚在波汉有地方给我们住的？

english: ~z~You weren't answering your phone! What happened?
zh: ~z~你还不接电话！怎么搞的？

english: ~z~We don't have time for revenge. We can't afford it.
zh: ~z~我们没时间复仇了，负担不起的。

english: ~z~Well, it doesn't matter. Now it's gone along with everything else.
zh: ~z~现在都无所谓了，全都化为灰烬了。

english: ~z~I mean, I don't think we'll be impressing women with our wonderful hot tub, but, err, this looks okay...
zh: ~z~我是说，虽然我不觉得这个豪华开放浴缸会给女士们留下好印象，不过...看起来还挺好。

english: ~z~You are a sick fuck, cousin. No wonder half of Broker wants you dead.
zh: ~z~你这人哪，堂弟。难怪半个布洛克的人都想要你的命。

english: ~z~Yes, you and I had a place of our own. A place where people come to eat and relax.
zh: ~z~对，你和我有了自己的一亩三分地。别人来这儿吃饭休闲。

english: ~z~In here. I'm stuck. Let me out...
zh: ~z~我在这儿，动不了。放我出来...

english: ~z~You cannot escape the past. Only thing is future, right?
zh: ~z~人无法逃避过去。眼前只会有未来，对吧？

english: ~z~I can't see myself settling down.
zh: ~z~我是不觉得自己能安定下来。

english: ~z~Thank God you're okay...
zh: ~z~谢天谢地你没事...

english: ~z~It is a place of distinction, you know?
zh: ~z~一家非凡的店，懂吧？

english: ~z~I guess you cannot escape your past.
zh: ~z~我想你也逃避不了你的过去。

english: ~z~Fifteen minutes ago you were cowering in fear because you didn't know what was going to happen.
zh: ~z~一刻钟之前，你还因为不知道会发生什么吓得瑟瑟发抖。

english: ~z~There were not diamonds and gold in that apartment.
zh: ~z~那公寓里哪来的钻石跟黄金。

english: ~z~I will add that to the long list of your secrets that are safe with me.
zh: ~z~我会把它加进你的秘密清单里的，不会泄露的。

english: ~z~Come on, Roman, pull yourself together. You've been here before.
zh: ~z~振作点，罗曼，鼓起劲来。也不是没这样过。

english: ~z~I haven't been crying, it's my allergies. Niko's wearing this new cologne.
zh: ~z~我没在哭，只是过敏了。尼克喷了点新香水。

english: ~z~Leave it, cousin.
zh: ~z~别拿了，堂兄。

english: ~z~Roman, you sound like you did in those emails you sent me before I arrived here.
zh: ~z~罗曼，你发给我的邮件里面不都是梦话吗。

english: ~z~Stay away or he is dead.
zh: ~z~你不退后他就死了。

english: ~z~You are Niko Bellic. Turn around and walk away or your cousin is dead.
zh: ~z~你就是尼克･贝利克吧。转身走人，不然我就杀了你堂兄。

english: ~z~Stop spending all our money?
zh: ~z~别成天挥霍我们的钱了？

english: ~z~I haven't got all day. Leave here.
zh: ~z~我可没那么闲。出去。

english: ~z~You shouldn't have invaded my personal space.
zh: ~z~你不该侵入我的私人空间的。

english: ~z~You won't need to wait much longer.
zh: ~z~用不着等多久了。

english: ~z~Okay, I messed up... I know I did. I thought things would be different.
zh: ~z~行，是我的错...我知道怪我，我还以为这里会不一样。

english: ~z~Are you okay?
zh: ~z~你没事吧？

english: ~z~Stop sitting in front of the computer gambling our money?
zh: ~z~别搁电脑前边坐着把钱赌个精光了？

english: ~z~That seemed like a lot of protection to be giving a man who ran up some gambling debts.
zh: ~z~看守一个欠赌债的人可用不着这阵仗。

english: ~z~These people will wish they did not take you, Roman.
zh: ~z~这些人会后悔绑架了你的。

english: ~z~-What are we going to do?~n~-I don't know.
zh: ~z~－这我们可怎么办？~n~－我不知道。

english: ~z~I don't understand this place so good.
zh: ~z~我也不是很懂这里。

english: ~z~Can't we just all be friends?
zh: ~z~我们不能交个朋友吗？

english: ~z~I'd go for anything as long as I could be guaranteed safety, that's all I want. Shit.
zh: ~z~只要能确保安全，选哪个我都无所谓。就这么个要求。操。

english: ~z~Niko. I'm getting worried. Roman didn't get back at all last night.
zh: ~z~尼克，我有点慌了。罗曼昨天整晚都没回来。

english: ~z~Dimitri was right. You come to collect your fat cousin right away.
zh: ~z~迪米特里说的没错，你果然马上就来找你的胖子堂兄了。

english: ~z~I don't want to die, Niko.
zh: ~z~我不想死，尼克。

english: ~z~I don't fucking know! I'm scared you cold bastard. What are we going to do?
zh: ~z~我他妈不知道！我很害怕，你个冷酷混蛋。我们该咋办？

english: ~z~You know how to hold a grudge as well, Niko. Don't forget about that.
zh: ~z~可别忘了，你自己也很记仇，尼克。

english: ~z~Oh! Isn't America great?
zh: ~z~嚯！美国不是很好吗？

english: ~z~I know you wouldn't, Roman. I thought we were done with Dimitri when we got out of Hove Beach.
zh: ~z~我知道你不会，罗曼。我以为离开霍夫海滩就能和迪米特里了结了。

english: ~z~And stop thinking about the Russians.
zh: ~z~也别想着那些俄国人了。

english: ~z~Your cousin will die if you come close, I promise this.
zh: ~z~再靠近一步你堂兄就没命了，说话算话。

english: ~z~I didn't know... give a guy a break.
zh: ~z~我又不知道...下不为例。

english: ~z~Get back or I will cut his fucking head off.
zh: ~z~回去，不然我砍了他的狗头。

english: ~z~Step away or he will be slaughtered like a pig.
zh: ~z~快走开，不然我把他当猪宰了。

english: ~z~Stop getting into illegal card games?
zh: ~z~别再去什么地下赌场了？

english: ~z~Fine. But leave the Russians alone.
zh: ~z~成。就是别把俄国人扯进来。

english: ~z~Roman? You put on a few vanity pounds.
zh: ~z~罗曼？你可长了不少肥膘啊。

english: ~z~He wasn't the one I was looking for.
zh: ~z~他不是我要找的人。

english: ~z~It's Bernie now. After I came here, I wanted a complete change. So I became Bernie Crane.
zh: ~z~现在是伯尼了。来这儿以后咱就想告别过去，所以咱成了伯尼･克兰。

english: ~z~Last thing I heard, you was itching to whack this guy? Must be some heavy shit.
zh: ~z~之前你不是还说很想干死这个人吗？那估计是个大岔子了。

english: ~z~Ummm. I really don't recognize this. I can't help you from here I'm afraid.
zh: ~z~呃，这里我真不认识。在这儿我恐怕帮不了你了。

english: ~z~Anything for you, cousin. Just name it. You want some women? I met this...
zh: ~z~赴汤蹈火在所不辞，堂弟。开口吧。你想找女人吗？我这儿有个...

english: ~z~Hey, slow down. I can't see the turns.
zh: ~z~喂，慢点。我看不见路口了。

english: ~z~Shit, NB, I haven't got time to sit here while you fuck about.
zh: ~z~妈的，NB，我可没时间坐在这儿看你磨蹭。

english: ~z~Oh yeah, I should probably say, you ain't gonna get those ten Gs from Talbot.
zh: ~z~哦对了，有件事我得说，那一万你没法从塔尔博特手里拿回来了。

english: ~z~Ease up a little, big fella. I can't see when you're going that fast.
zh: ~z~慢一点，大哥。你开那么快我不认路。

english: ~z~Niko, that was unfortunate. There will be some other way to find Florian.
zh: ~z~尼克，太不幸了。总会有其它能找弗洛里安的法子的。

english: ~z~He doesn't act well under pressure, NB. Beat him a little.
zh: ~z~一有压力他就演不下去了，NB。稍微揍一顿。

english: ~z~Don't fuck around, Talbot. I have seen this block before.
zh: ~z~别想搞事，塔尔博特。这里刚才来过。

english: ~z~It wasn't you, was it.
zh: ~z~不是你干的，对吧。

english: ~z~We're looking for a guy named Talbot Daniels. Hangs out in the Triangle.
zh: ~z~我们要找的是一个叫塔尔博特･丹尼尔斯的人。经常在三角区出没。

english: ~z~Come up with me Roman. I cannot do this alone.
zh: ~z~和我一起上来，罗曼。这我不能一个人去。

english: ~z~Ummm, I might be lost but keep going and I'll see if I can get there.
zh: ~z~呃，我可能迷路了，但你继续开，我看看还能不能认出来。

english: ~z~We aren't going to find this place if you keep messing around.
zh: ~z~你再这么瞎折腾，我们就找不着地方了。

english: ~z~It wasn't me. It wasn't!
zh: ~z~不是咱干的，不是咱！

english: ~z~Get out of here. I don't want to see you at any more tournaments either.
zh: ~z~滚出去。以后什么比赛也别让我看见你。

english: ~z~but then I heard that you had joined the circus so information can be unreliable.
zh: ~z~不过咱也听说过你加入了马戏团，所以消息不一定靠谱。

english: ~z~Stay right there, Talbot. Don't think you can push me around.
zh: ~z~乖乖站好，塔尔博特。别想着你能从我这儿逃了。

english: ~z~Niko, you didn't need to kill him. He brought us here.
zh: ~z~尼克，没必要杀了他的。他都把路带到了。

english: ~z~Easy there, man. You need to go slow if I'm gonna be able to get you there.
zh: ~z~开慢点，老兄。你不开慢我没法带你到地方。

english: ~z~Can't say I'm entirely sure about this, head on though.
zh: ~z~不敢说这条路我很有把握，不过继续往前开吧。

english: ~z~Can we stop with the fat jokes, Florian?
zh: ~z~我们能不开关于肥的玩笑了吗，弗洛里安？

english: ~z~Oh don't remind me...
zh: ~z~噢，别跟咱提那儿...

english: ~z~Don't think you're going anywhere, Talbot. I'm going to go easy on you for now. But if you push me, you're in big trouble.
zh: ~z~你哪儿都别想去，塔尔博特。我现在先对你客气点，不过你要是逼我，那你麻烦就大了。

english: ~z~Stop fucking about and get to this place, cousin.
zh: ~z~别磨叽了，赶紧过去，堂弟。

english: ~z~This is impossible when you're going this fast. I can't see any of the turnoffs.
zh: ~z~你开这么快就找不着了，我连路口都看不见。

english: ~z~Come on, NB. We won't ever find Florian unless you follow these directions.
zh: ~z~来吧，NB。你不按这些提示走，我们永远找不着弗洛里安。

english: ~z~Okay, I don't recognize this but keep going.
zh: ~z~好吧，这儿我不认得了，但继续开。

english: ~z~I wouldn't do that!
zh: ~z~我做不出来的！

english: ~z~I'd be rich even if you weren't here. I'm an entrepreneur. Things would have taken off for me.
zh: ~z~就算你不来我也会很富。我是个企业家，早晚都会腾飞的。

english: ~z~Alright, this isn't the normal route I take but keep going.
zh: ~z~好吧，这不是我平时走的那条路，但继续开。

english: ~z~Don't turn here.
zh: ~z~不要转弯。

english: ~z~Don't be stupid, man. I know you are just taking us about in circles.
zh: ~z~别犯蠢，老兄。我知道你在带我们转圈圈。

english: ~z~Chill, cousin. If you go so fast we aren't going to find it.
zh: ~z~放松点，老兄。你开这么快，我们找不着的。

english: ~z~Who set us up. It was you or Darko. I thought it must be him.
zh: ~z~背叛我们的人，不是你就是达尔科了。我想一定是他。

english: ~z~Slowly, slowly, catchy monkey, NB. We won't find him if you are racing.
zh: ~z~心急吃不了热豆腐，NB。你开这么快咱们找不着他。

english: ~z~What wasn't me?
zh: ~z~什么不是我干的？

english: ~z~You're a fucking loose cannon my friend.
zh: ~z~你他妈也太反复无常了点吧，我的朋友。

english: ~z~Florian Cravic? I don't know what you're talking about.
zh: ~z~弗洛里安･克拉维克？我不知道你们在说什么。

english: ~z~Get in and don't try anything stupid, Talbot.
zh: ~z~上车，别做任何蠢事，塔尔博特。

english: ~z~Shit NB, are you cranked on speed? We have to go slow to find the address.
zh: ~z~妈的 NB，你嗑了安非他明吗？得慢慢开才找得到地址。

english: ~z~Something's gone wrong. I don't wanna talk about it.
zh: ~z~出了点岔子。我不是很想提。

english: ~z~Ray, I ain't gonna find the guy I'm after.
zh: ~z~雷，我没法接着找要找的人了。

english: ~z~All that has changed is that I am hunting one man instead of two...
zh: ~z~唯一的区别是，我要追的人从两个变成了一个...

english: ~z~I couldn't find Florian. Your man, Talbot, he was annoying the shit out of me.
zh: ~z~我找不到弗洛里安。你的人塔尔博特他搞得我暴跳如雷。

english: ~z~Nicky, you ice him?
zh: ~z~尼克，做掉他了没？

english: ~z~You don't want to piss me off today, man.
zh: ~z~你不会想在今天惹我的，老兄。

english: ~z~Okay, ummm, if I'm right Bernie's place is somewhere Uptown.
zh: ~z~好的，呃，我没弄错的话伯尼就住在市郊某处。

english: ~z~Why isn't Roman with us? What's going on?
zh: ~z~罗曼怎么不跟咱们在一起？怎么回事？

english: ~z~Oh. This isn't easy.
zh: ~z~噢，这可不简单。

english: ~z~Where is it? Why aren't we there yet?
zh: ~z~在哪儿呢？我们怎么还没到？

Containers that originated at a false address in the Guangdong Province of China were intercepted by N.O.O.S.E operatives in charge of customs and border security. America decides what's right and wrong. Articulating anti-American thoughts is a form of terrorism and should be treated as such.

The only way to be sure that business is conducted fairly in this city is for the unions to be dissolved and the labor market totally deregulated.

english: So, they've opened the bridge and tunnel into Algonquin from Alderney? What a pathetic liberal copout! Allow people their freedom? We'll be free when we are all dead at this rate. The fact is terrorists use bridges to cross rivers and to kill innocent lives. Families will die because of this - we are at war, and when you're at war, you should suffer.
zh: 他们居然开放了连接阿尔冈琴与奥尔德尼的大桥和隧道？自由派的退缩真是可悲！竟然给予民众自由？照这样下去我们都会自由的，死得自由。事实是恐怖分子会用大桥过河残杀无辜，家庭也会因此遭到破坏。我们陷入了战争，而一旦陷入战争，民众就会受难。

Some liberal news outlets are trying to spin this into a story about the Mafia. They're saying that the explosion was related to organized crime rather than terror. These leftist loons are crazy. They'll say and do anything before they admit that terrorism is the number one problem facing the nation and much more important than any of their pet projects, the environment, health care and ludicrous foreign welfare projects.
zh: 尽管警报不断播报，恐怖分子还是袭击了自由城。这次的袭击目标是位于北伍德的一个燃料仓库。某些自由派新闻媒体妄图把本次事件编造成黑手党所为。他们称本次爆炸事件应归类到有组织犯罪案件，而非恐怖袭击。这些左派野蛮人简直就是疯子。他们无论如何都不会承认，解决恐怖主义问题才是我国的燃眉之急，他们只会关注动保、环保、医保和滑稽的外国福利保障。

It is more than likely that this was just the first of many planned bombings. If you see a foreigner using a cell phone, he is probably a terrorist. Act first, ask questions later. You have the safety of your fellow Americans to consider as well as your own.
zh: 更可怕的是，LCPD鉴证科还在现场发现了一个起爆器，可能是通过手机进行操作。这多半会是连环爆炸袭击的开端。要是你瞧见一个外国人在用手机，他很可能是恐怖分子。记住，先行动，后提问。你要考虑的不只是自己的安全，还有美国同胞的安全。

english: Liberty City's Deputy Police Commissioner, Francis McReary, was ruthlessly gunned down earlier. To most of us he is a hero, a man dedicated to serving the city who was taken before his time. Liberal "Blame America First" news outlets have been sullying the man's reputation. Rather than celebrate this patriot's great career, they dig up some unsubstantiated accusations of corruption. Francis McReary valiantly served Liberty City until he was murdered. We should remember him as an American Hero.
zh: 自由城的警局副局长弗朗西斯･麦克雷里于早些时候惨遭枪杀。对于我们大多数人来说，他是英雄，是一个为自由城勤恳奉献的人，但他却英年早逝。那些「凡事都怪美国」的自由派媒体一直在抹黑他，他们不去称赞这位爱国英雄的丰功伟绩，却在宣传无凭无据的贪污指控。弗朗西斯･麦克雷里为自由城鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已，我们应当把他当作美国英雄纪念。

english: Suspicion is good enough evidence for us to send a terrorist to an internment camp, so why shouldn't that be enough in a drug case? Dropping an ounce of crack cocaine on an elementary school is just as bad as dropping a bomb on the subway. Let's make this Dimitri Rascalov character pay in the same way.
zh: 既然光靠怀疑就足以将恐怖分子关进拘留营，为什么对毒贩就不能这样呢？在小学门口扔一盎司霹雳可卡因跟在地铁上安炸弹一样恶劣。我们得让迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫以同样的方式付出代价。

english: It is an act of war. When our government systematically devalues our currency 40% we accept it's for the common good. When a foreign country plays with our economy, it's war.

english: It's feels like the 80's all over again, but instead of communists besting our sports heroes and boycotting our Olympics, now they've invaded your wallet. The American dollar is being systematically devalued by counterfeit $100 bills thought to have originated in communist countries. Previously, US authorities had only found these bills in Europe and Asia. Suddenly, they are appearing in huge quantities on home soil. These counterfeits are too sophisticated to be manufactured on a homemade press in this country.
zh: 感觉我们好像回到了80年代的冷战时代，但不同的是，以前共产主义者大败我们的体育英雄、抵制我们主办的奥运会，现在他们入侵了我们的钱包。美元受百元假钞影响持续贬值，而这些假钞被怀疑是由共产主义国家制造。此前，美国当局只在欧洲和亚洲发现过这种假钞。现在这种假钞在美国本土大量出现。这种假钞的制作工艺过于复杂，不是美国产印刷机所能生产的。

english: The nation was shocked and outraged that any doctor would do such a sick and disgusting thing rather than working to clone a hot celebrity like Cloe Parker so that men could buy a clone of her and enjoy a fantastic life fucking a super celeb instead of a fat piece of shit they picked up from the airport bar.
zh: 他的行为引起举国震惊，民众对科学家作出这种恶心的变态行为感到愤怒，也为科学家没有克隆克洛伊･帕克这样的名人愤怒。否则他们就可以买个克隆体回家和名人享受性福生活了，而现在他们只能面对在机场酒吧捡回来的肥猪八婆。

english: It's disgusting. These people are American heroes. They have involuntarily given their lives for all of our freedom; what right do we have to dig into their past and make accusations and muddy the reputations of the dead? If N.O.O.S.E tells us these were acts of terrorism, then that's what they were. It's un-American of us to question that. N.O.O.S.E has said that a number of suspects have been extracted to offshore questioning centers. All I can say is thank god for that constitutional loophole.
zh: 实在太恶心了。这些人可都是美国的英雄。他们都在无意中将生命献给了我们的自由事业，我们又有何权利去乱挖他们的过去、妄图控告他们，甚至去玷污遇难者的英名呢？如果国安办说这些屠杀都是恐怖袭击，那它就是恐怖袭击。谁敢质疑，谁就是反美国。国安办说嫌疑人已被运送到海外的讯问中心，我只能说得亏宪法存在这些漏洞。

english: Why do attempts to bring this kind of class and distinction to American soil always grind to a halt? Who are these local groups insistent upon whingeing about big business and necessary developments? Is this a secular progressive conspiracy to stop bringing money into Liberty City from overseas? Would these leftist loons rather the deservedly wealthy residents of Liberty City gave their money to war-dodging Frenchmen in Paris than Yusuf Amir here in Liberty City?
zh: 为什么这种将阶级隔离带入美国土地的尝试总会慢慢消沉？这些整天抱怨大型私企跟必要建设的本地组织到底是什么来头？这是不是世俗改革派(对自由派的蔑称)妄图阻止海外资金流入自由城的阴谋？这些左派蠢人是不是宁可把富有的自由城居民的钱交给高举双手的法国人，也不愿意交给自由城本地的尤瑟夫･阿米尔？

english: The Kerry McIntosh self-destruction rollercoaster, that has increased circulation and replaced real news for weeks now, spiraled out of control yet again last night when the supermodel checked herself out of a luxury rehab spa in Los Santos only three days into her four-day program. Less than an hour after telling paparazzi that she had been "humbled by the recovery experience," McIntosh was jacked up on a cocktail of booze, pills and coke and crashed her car into the side of a Wigwam Burger restaurant.
zh: 数周以来，有关凯里･麦金托什自我毁灭欲望的各种新闻提高了报纸的发行量，顶替了真正的新闻。昨晚，这名超模又一次创下了记录。当时她在洛圣都一家内有温泉的豪华戒毒所接受四天的戒毒计划，仅仅经过三天，她就结帐离开了。离开后她告诉狗仔队这家戒毒所的待遇是在侮辱她，不到一小时后，她就因喝下混有酒精、药片和可卡因的鸡尾酒，驾车撞上了Wigwam汉堡店的外墙。

english: There is only one way. They must learn our ways. Learn to hate everyone, even your next door neighbor. Stay inside, become lazy, don't read the paper or contact politicians. You can do it illegal immigrants - be like us. We need you on our side. Weazel News supports the Indoctrination Act currently before Congress that would round up all illegal immigrants and put them into reform camps where they will watch hours of television, eat Cluckin' Bell and Burger Shot and get lethargic. Cocoon conditioning works - and it will solve illegal immigration once and for all.
zh: 方法唯有一种。让他们入乡随俗。学会憎恶所有人，包括你的隔壁邻居。窝在家里，变得懒惰，从不看报，不接触政客。亲爱的非法移民们，你们可以做到的——变得跟我们一样。我们需要你成为同伴。Weazel新闻现在就对国会尚未通过的《教化法案》表示支持，该法案会集中所有非法移民，将他们送至改造营，让他们每天看电视，吃饭不是铛铛钟就是吃得饱汉堡，从而变得跟我们一样慵懒。封闭调教效果极佳，能够一劳永逸地解决非法移民的问题。

english: Well, beat them to it. Restrict your own freedom and help the environment, if you care about that sort of nonsense - support the proposals to shut the bridges permanently. These radical ideas were suggested by Martin Hawes, a man so freethinking the liberals locked him up. We say close the lunatic asylums. Turn them into detention centers for undesirables of a different sort, and close the bridges now.
zh: 那就抢占先机吧。限制你的自由然后保护环境吧，如果你真的在乎什么环境——拥护永久关闭大桥的议案吧。这些激进的想法是由马丁･霍斯提出的，他的思想太过自由，以至于自由派把他关了起来。我们提议关闭疯人院，改造成看守所关押各种不良分子，然后立刻封锁大桥。

english: Alright, so Bobby Jefferson went out of his way to praise some immigrants while he was damning others in his speech at the Civic Citadel. He argued that 99% of the people who come into this country are honest (I'd like to see the statistics to back that one up, by the way) and believe in the same things that patriotic American citizens do. He then went on to say that, besides terrorism, the biggest threat to American safety at the moment is these gangsters coming into Liberty City from Russia and Eastern Europe and setting up shop in immigrant communities like Hove Beach.
zh: 好吧，所以说博迪･杰斐逊在市政厅发表的演说可谓是煞费苦心地赞美移民，同时也毫不留情地咒骂其他人。他认为，这个国家99%的外来者都是诚实的(顺便一提，我倒想瞧瞧支持这一观点的数据)，且与我们美国的爱国者信仰相同。他还强调，除了恐怖主义，目前对美国国民安全的最大威胁，就是自由城中来自俄国和东欧的黑帮歹徒，他们还在霍夫海滩这样的移民社区里开张店铺。

english: Leave Eris alone
zh: 别烦Eris了

english: Firstly, if people are going to come over to our country they should adopt to our customs of growing obese and loving bad sitcoms. Also, learn our language, even if we haven't quite properly mastered it yet. They shouldn't go somewhere like Hove Beach which is more Russian than some parts of Moscow. If these guys are such a threat, then why don't we just close the borders to everyone? I say close the borders to these bastards. Remember, 9 in 10 terrorists are foreign too.
zh: 首先，如果有人想移民我们国家，他们应该学会适应我们的肥佬习惯、爱上垃圾情景剧。同时，还要学习我们的语言，尽管我们自己也没有完全掌握。他们不该去类似于霍夫海滩这种俄国佬比莫斯科的某些地区都多的地方。要是这些家伙是一种威胁，那我们为什么不对所有人都封锁边境呢？我是说，对所有的那些混蛋封锁边境。时刻记住，10个恐怖分子里面，有9个是外国佬。

english: For years, sneaker manufacturer Eris has been made the villain by work-shy lefties for choosing to help third world countries. Historically, Eris's visionary founder, Pete Vassal, has kept quiet, refusing to descend to the level of veggie hypocrites who are more than happy to take a welfare check from the same government that they profess to despise. However, after years of silence, Vassal has now chosen to speak out against the rants of stoned human rights activists the world over.
zh: 多年来，运动鞋制造商Eris一直被好吃懒做的左派塑造成坏人，只因为Eris在帮助第三世界国家。此前，富有远见的Eris创始人皮特･瓦萨尔始终保持沉默，拒绝把自己降低到和那些素食伪君子同样的水平，后者一边反对政府，一边巴不得政府给他发福利支票。然而在经过数年的沉默后，瓦萨尔终于发声反对了那些吸毒的人权活动家。

english: Some strategists are saying that, "We should focus on this war, so we don't make the same mistake as the Nazis and try to fight a war on two fronts. Let's defeat fun first then focus on everything else we hate, like Europe."
zh: 某些决策者称：「我们应该专注于这场战争，不能犯下与纳粹同样的错误两线作战。我们要先干掉娱乐，再集火我们所憎恨的别的东西，比如欧洲。」

english: Why do we think this? Mr. Dawkins admitted he took pity on Mr. Crane and gave him somewhere to stay. If this isn't an awful example of people expecting state handouts, I don't know what is. Quite frankly, I think we'd all prefer it if Mr. Crane was Mr. Dawkins' lover. It is an awful example to set. Pity is for the weak.
