english: Despite Wolfe's baseless allegations, the 'Roman Empire Wealth System' has been an upstanding sponsor of Weazel News and we cannot allow some cretin to sully its name. Life is full of risks and, as civilization goes down the toilet, it only means more ratings and sponsors for us.
zh: 尽管沃尔夫的指控毫无根据，「罗马帝国财富系统」一直是Weazel新闻的强力赞助商，而我们绝不容许某些白痴玷污它的清誉。生活充满风险，而且随着文明的衰落，我们的收视率只会更高，赞助商也会更多。

english: We've all covertly mouthed something to someone, such as "Let's get out of here," or "I'm going to kill you," or "Hurry, before my husband gets back." But lip reading isn't just important for communicating quests for infidelity. It is a fundamental part of the academic process, and this year it was being celebrated at the inaugural Lip Reading Bee.
zh: 我们都悄悄地用口型跟别人说过话，比如「我们赶紧跑吧」「我要杀了你」或者「快点，我老公要回来了」。但是读唇不仅对偷情时的交流重要，在学术研究中也十分重要，今年的读唇大赛也备受人们关注。

english: Patriotic Police Can't be Charged with Brutality
zh: 爱国警察不得被诉暴力执法

english: In related news, solar power has been studied in a new report which found it is too expensive and actually takes energy to make the panels. The President and Congress are working on a bill to protect industries like gas, coal and electric in the face of the solar threat.
zh: 相关新闻称，一份新的研究报告指出建造太阳能面板过于昂贵，制造时也会消耗能源。总统与国会正致力于通过法案，以保护油气、煤炭和电力等产业不受太阳能威胁。

english: In a bold and courageous move by city and federal officials, bridges and tunnels will be closed indefinitely while officials root out what is rumored to be a terror cell in Liberty City. While activists and other un-Americans have questioned the war on terror, to those who have died at the hands of police during protests, it is quite clear. "These terrorists want to take away our freedoms. But look, we've done it for them. Ha. We win. You lose. Eat my shit terrorists. Yeah, you like that? Do you? Daddy is in charge," said Deputy Mayor Bryce Dawkins. Income from tolls has dropped to zero, and officials say that bankruptcy is a small price to pay for safety. The stock market won't crash.
zh: 市政府和联邦官员通过大胆而有魄力的措施，无限期封闭了各个大桥和隧道，直到根除所谓的自由城中的恐怖分子才会解除。尽管社会活动家与其他非美国人已对反恐战争发起质疑，但对那些在抗议时死于警察手中的人来说，答案十分明确。「这些恐怖分子想要夺走我们的自由。但是，我们先做到了。哈，我们赢了，你输了。吔屎啦，恐怖分子。呵，你喜欢吗？中意吗？你爸爸我做主。」副市长布莱斯･道金斯说。来自收费站的收入已经降到了零，而政府官员则称「为了安全，破产不值一提。」证券市场不会崩盘。

english: Bridges closed indefinitely

english: It's the news our enemies love - the terrible price of freedom - the catastrophe of the falling stock market. The BAWSAQ has been in freefall the last few days, and it's the kind of news that makes terrorists rejoice and liberals wonder how they can interfere to bring prices down further. It's a natural consequence of years of over-regulation, big government and the killing of the entrepreneurial spirit that made this country the envy of foreigners everywhere. The country will enter a serious recession and be governed by a combination of Islamic terrorists, homosexuals and communists unless action is taken immediately - the government must cut the highest rate of income tax for the rich, abolish capital gains tax and liberate the rich to make investments wherever they see fit.
zh: 又是我们敌人喜欢的新闻：自由的可怖代价——股市跳水。BAWSAQ股指近日几乎是自由落体，这种新闻能让恐怖分子狂喜，还会让自由派思考如何继续拉低股价。这是多年过度管制、政府干涉和企业家精神消散带来的必然后果，我国让外国人羡慕的正是企业家精神。如不立刻采取行动，我国将会陷入大萧条，还会被一群伊斯兰恐怖分子、同性恋和共产主义者统治。现在政府必须降低富人的个人所得税，废除资本利得税，并且允许富人进行任何可以获利的投资行为。

english: Otherwise, an important part of our population is going to suffer unfairly - the wealthy will be punished again as they have to pick up the tab for the government's mismanagement of the economy and the war on terror. We have said it before on Weazel: we are a nuclear power; we should blitz the economy and our enemies.
zh: 如不行动，我国人口中的重要组成部分就会受到不公平对待：富人们不仅要为政府在经济方面的失策和反恐战争买单，还要再被割一刀。之前我们在Weazel电台说过：我们是核国家，我们应当闪击经济和敌人。

english: Still underperforming globally, the markets have been volatile due to the underperforming economies of Europe. With everything twice as expensive due to the ridiculous price of gas, cigarettes and liquor, the underperforming continent is having a major effect on the rest of the world.

english: Senator Charles Martin said, "We were in a never-ending loop with border security. You keep seeing the same faces again and again. However, we have broken that cycle. Giving greater authority to our brave men and women who are sitting in the hot desert for days straight to find a permanent solution to this problem is working. Granted, a few families driving back from a vacation in Mexico have been gunned down at border checkpoints, but security is our number one concern. There will always be some collateral damage."
zh: 参议员查尔斯･马丁说：「过去我们在边境问题上陷入了死循环，来来回回看见的永远是那几张脸，但现在这个循环被打破了。守在炙热沙漠中的勇敢男女一直在寻找一劳永逸的解决方案，而将更大的裁量权交给他们正是灵丹妙药。的确，有几户从墨西哥度完假回来的人家在边检站被枪杀，但安全才是最重要的。有一些副作用也是在所难免。」

zh: ~z~你想去看演出吗？别跟兄弟们说。

english: ~z~Show could mean anything coming from you but, fuck, yeah, I'm in. Come pick me up.
zh: ~z~你嘴里的演出我都摸不准意思。操，好吧，我来。过来找我吧。

english: ~z~What are you up to? Wanna go look at some tits?
zh: ~z~在干嘛呢？想不想去看奶子？

english: ~z~I haven't heard shit from you in days.
zh: ~z~我好久没收到你的联系了。

english: ~z~I need some mindless entertainment of a non-sexual kind. You wanna go see a show?
zh: ~z~我想找点与性无关的无脑乐子。你想去看演出吗？

english: ~z~Yeah, let's go argue with some lap dancers over the touching rule. I'll wait here for you.
zh: ~z~好啊，一起去找几个舞娘聊聊不准上手的规矩吧。我在这等你。

english: ~z~Fuck Johnny, sure, we can hang out. But, shit, brother, you've gotta keep in touch. I thought you were dead or something.
zh: ~z~傻逼强尼，出来玩当然可以。但是，妈的，兄弟啊，没事常联系好吗。我差点以为你已经死了。

english: ~z~I'm done with all this pussying around. I say we hit the Deadbeats right now.
zh: ~z~我也不想接着泡妞了，这就去干那帮死妈天使。

english: ~z~I could eat a nun's ass through a wicker chair right now. Do you wanna get something to eat?
zh: ~z~我现在都饿得饥不择食了。你想不想去吃点东西？

english: ~z~Have I ever said no? Let's tear it up, brother. I'll wait here for you.
zh: ~z~哪次我拒绝了？大喝一场吧，兄弟。我在这等你。

english: ~z~Sure, it's about time I did something other than get wasted. Pick me up in the next two hours.
zh: ~z~好啊，我差不多也该干点扑街以外的事了。过两个小时来找我吧。

english: ~z~What are you doing? Do you wanna go out and get smashed?
zh: ~z~在干啥呢？要不要一起去喝个痛快？

english: ~z~My liver hasn't been pummelled for a good few hours. What d'ya say we go for a beer or two?
zh: ~z~我的肝好几个小时没被糟蹋了。一起去喝两杯如何？

english: ~z~I'm with you, Johnny. Make it soon, though. Before the boys are too drunk.
zh: ~z~我跟你来，强尼。不过你得快点，否则兄弟们就要喝高了。

english: ~z~Listen, I've got a serious thirst on me now. Why don't we go get some drinks?
zh: ~z~听着，我现在渴得要死。咱为啥不去搞点喝的？

english: ~z~I'm heading over the clubhouse. You wanna come?
zh: ~z~我在去会所的路上。你来不来？

english: ~z~Are you busy? Wanna game of pool?
zh: ~z~你忙吗？想不想打台球？

english: ~z~Hell yeah man. Definitely, let's eat. It'll have to be in the next couple of hours, though.
zh: ~z~太好了，哥们。那必须的，去吃饭吧。不过我就这两个钟头有空。

english: ~z~I hear you been talking about how fast you are. Well, I want to see these new-found balls of yours.
zh: ~z~听说你一直吹自己飙车多快。好啊，我倒想看看你新吹的牛皮是不是真的。

english: ~z~Shit, sorry man. I'll call back later.
zh: ~z~妈的，不好意思啊哥们。我晚点再打给你。

english: ~z~Sure thing, brother. I can't even remember the last time I ate. Come get me.
zh: ~z~可以的，兄弟。我都不记得上次吃饭是哪天了。来找我吧。

english: ~z~Listen, why don't we go for a game of darts?
zh: ~z~听着，要不要一起去玩会儿飞镖？

english: ~z~I'm thinking of investing in some female company. Do you wanna join me?
zh: ~z~我打算去投资一家女性公司。你想不想一起来？

english: ~z~Sure, I'll play. Beats sitting here alone with my thoughts. Let's make it soon, though.
zh: ~z~可以，我来。总比一个人傻坐着胡思乱想好。不过你快点过来。

english: ~z~Listen man. I'm thinking it's about time we had ourselves a race.
zh: ~z~听着哥们。我觉得我们差不多该来场赛车了。

english: ~z~It was only an idea. I'll catch you later.
zh: ~z~来不了就算了吧。之后再联系你。

english: ~z~I'm gonna go check out a show. Do you wanna come?
zh: ~z~我打算去看场演出。你想不想来？

english: ~z~Okay it's been a little while since you and me been on a prank like this together,
zh: ~z~好吧，我俩确实很久没这样一起恶作剧过了，

english: ~z~Too bad about those bikes, man. We missed out on a payday.
zh: ~z~车子的事可惜了，兄弟。这下赚不到钱了。

english: ~z~Jackie and the baby, yeah it's nice and all. And shit, I mean I love them and stuff,
zh: ~z~杰基和孩子，这样是不错。我是说，我确实很爱他们，

english: ~z~It would take a real dumb civilian to screw with our bikes on club turf.
zh: ~z~再傻逼的人都不会在我们的地盘偷车。

english: ~z~I guess you gotta tell your contact he ain't getting those bikes and his truck is screwed.
zh: ~z~我想你该跟买家说一声他拿不到摩托了，而且他的卡车也毁了。

english: ~z~Well, you ain't gonna like what I'm about to do in the next few hours.
zh: ~z~接下来我准备做的事你可能不大喜欢。

english: ~z~You'd think the Deadbeats would know when they were beat.
zh: ~z~这些死妈天使妈死了都不会懂事啊。

english: ~z~You haven't brought them to the house in a while.
zh: ~z~你有段时间没带他们来会所了。

english: ~z~We're cool, Johnny. The AOD won't come this far into Lost territory.
zh: ~z~我们安全了，强尼。死亡天使不会贸然踏入失落帮的地盘的。

english: ~z~They just don't know when to quit, do they?
zh: ~z~他们真是不懂得放弃啊，不是吗？

english: ~z~Now, you know only a Chapter Head like Billy can ask for that kind of help. So don't go telling him we're coming to ya.
zh: ~z~先说好，你也知道只有比利这样的分会会长才能呼叫武力支援。别告诉他我们来帮你了。

english: ~z~Don't you fucks know when to give up?
zh: ~z~你们这些傻逼难道不懂什么时候该放弃吗？

english: ~z~These assholes don't have the balls to follow us to the clubhouse. We're in the clear, man.
zh: ~z~这些傻逼不敢跟着我们去会所。我们安全了，兄弟。

english: ~z~If it ain't one load of bullshit, it's a God damn n'other.
zh: ~z~不是这里一团糟，就是那里一团糟。

english: ~z~Would somebody tell the Deadbeats that possession is nine tenths of the law.
zh: ~z~死妈天使都不知道占有人在诉讼中有优势吗。

english: ~z~Hey man, Jackie can handle herself but it ain't exactly a family friendly environment at the moment, is it?
zh: ~z~我说，杰基能照顾好自己，但现在的会所不适合带家人来，懂吧？

english: ~z~You're persistent motherfuckers, I'll give you that.
zh: ~z~你们这些混蛋很固执啊，不得不承认。

english: ~z~That's right we saw the whole thing you fucking jerk-offs.
zh: ~z~没错，我们看得一清二楚，两个傻逼。

english: ~z~turn the cameras off and interrogate her real hard?
zh: ~z~严刑拷打一顿，看你还觉不觉得自己聪明。

english: ~z~Fucking Deadbeats. Don't know when to leave good enough alone.
zh: ~z~傻逼死妈天使。都不知道适可而止的。

english: ~z~Feels good to be doing something like this. Not just breaking heads 'cause Billy feels like it.
zh: ~z~做这种事的感觉真好。比起因为比利一时兴起就打得头破血流好多了。

english: ~z~for some time or, or maybe not ever...?
zh: ~z~分离一段时间，甚至永远分离...？

english: ~z~We got all we can carry, Johnny boy. You and me gotta get outta here.
zh: ~z~再多也装不下了，强尼仔。我们得走了。

english: ~z~Get your hands off our bike, Loser.
zh: ~z~别碰我们的车，失败帮。

english: ~z~It ain't as fast as your bike, but this is our ride, Johnny boy.
zh: ~z~卡车是没你的摩托快，但就是这次的坐骑，强尼仔。

english: ~z~Johnny, man. I thought you'd lost my number.
zh: ~z~强尼，兄弟。我还以为你没有我的号码了。

english: ~z~Where'd you get the van, Jim? You ain't turned into some kind of trailer queen have you?
zh: ~z~这车哪弄来的，吉姆？你该不会变成拖车女王了吧？

english: ~z~Man, we're only meant to stand up on the Chapter leader's say so, but who gives a fuck? We'll be there.
zh: ~z~兄弟，原则上只有会长才能叫我们支援，不过去他妈的。我们马上就到。

english: ~z~Too bad times weren't always this easy...
zh: ~z~可惜不能永远都这样轻松...

english: ~z~You should call them, man. They're still cool. Their heads are probably in the same kind of place as yours.
zh: ~z~多联系他们吧，兄弟。他俩还是你哥们儿，估计想法也跟你差不多。

english: ~z~But I think long and hard about what I'm gonna order at Burger Shot as well,
zh: ~z~不过我去汉堡店点餐的时候也需要深思熟虑。

english: ~z~Luck's a perverse thing ain't it? How are Jackie and the kid?
zh: ~z~运气就是这么反复无常啊。杰基和孩子最近好吗？

english: ~z~Yeah? Can't think of what I'd prefer, time in the joint or hanging with some sleazeball lawyer.
zh: ~z~是吗？我都不知道哪个更好，是去蹲号子，还是跟混球律师厮混。

english: ~z~You know what, I can't wait to get them down the precinct so we can really stomp on those fuckers.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，我等不及想把他们抓进局子，好爆踹他们一顿。

english: ~z~Looks like you're outnumbered, friends!
zh: ~z~看来你们寡不敌众了，朋友们！

english: ~z~The second I start thinking maybe the law is okay.
zh: ~z~我刚开始觉得法律没有问题。

english: ~z~Here's as good a place as any.
zh: ~z~这地方再好不过了。

english: ~z~Didn't even save me any, you fat fuck. Thanks a lot.
zh: ~z~是没什么好处，你这肥猪。多谢了。

english: ~z~You think he's smart enough to realise that we got expensive tastes?
zh: ~z~你说他知不知道我们不是好伺候的主啊？

english: ~z~Hey, brother, this is about to get real unpleasant.
zh: ~z~喂，兄弟，这样下去不太妙啊。

english: ~z~There'll be another chance to deal with them. Don't you worry about that.
zh: ~z~总有机会对付他们的。别担心。

english: ~z~Fuck me man, the whole LCPD are gonna be after us now. You can't just do that to a cop.
zh: ~z~他奶奶的，现在整个LCPD都要盯上我们了。条子不是随便就能杀的。

english: ~z~You know, cheap sarcasm should be beneath you, Johnny.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，阴阳怪气没好处的，强尼。

english: ~z~I know, but they can't all be all bad.
zh: ~z~我知道，但他们不可能都是坏人。

english: ~z~You still know a few tricks, old man. I'll give you that.
zh: ~z~不得不说，你这老家伙还真有两下子。

english: ~z~The second they shook us down for money, man, they came down to our level.
zh: ~z~在他们向我们索取贿赂的那一刻，他们就和我们没有差别了。

english: ~z~Hey Sarge, me and Matthews need a hand. Send out some boys who ain't afraid to break some fucking heads.
zh: ~z~喂，警长，我和马修斯需要支援。派一些不怕死的弟兄们过来。

english: ~z~Poor assholes don't know what they're in for.
zh: ~z~俩傻逼还不知道自己在往哪走。

english: ~z~We ain't the pussies you thought we were.
zh: ~z~我们没有你们想的那么懦弱。

english: ~z~Don't let 'em catch you now, Jim.
zh: ~z~别让他们逮着你，吉姆。

english: ~z~You shouldn't have played dirty, coppers.
zh: ~z~你们不该动歪脑筋的，警官。

english: ~z~Stop screwing around, Johnny.
zh: ~z~别胡闹了，强尼。

english: ~z~You got no idea the shit storm that's going to come down on you, you fucking pricks.
zh: ~z~马上你们就要面临血雨腥风了，一群猪头。

english: ~z~I don't like people having a hold on me like this. People ask me why I dislike cops...
zh: ~z~我不喜欢被别人这样束缚。有人问我为什么讨厌警察...

english: ~z~A dirty cop's just like a Deadbeat or a Triad or any other crook in this town.
zh: ~z~腐败警察跟死妈天使、三合会这样的坏人之流没有区别。

english: ~z~There'll be another chance to deal with them. Don't you worry about that.
zh: ~z~总有机会对付他们的。别担心。

english: ~z~You pigs chose to play dirty, didn't you?
zh: ~z~你们这些条子选择了耍手段，不是吗？

english: ~z~You're going to pay for that coffee and donut fat man.
zh: ~z~毁了我的咖啡跟甜甜圈就别想跑了，肥猪。

english: ~z~Let's see if you still got it, old man. Let's drop the fuckin' hammer on this run to those assholes.
zh: ~z~看看你的车技有没有退步吧，老家伙。比比谁先开到那俩混蛋那儿。

english: ~z~Mommy. He's crying like a little fucking bitch. Matthews you kill me you prick.
zh: ~z~妈咪。他像婆娘一样哭个不停。马修斯，我快笑死了。

english: ~z~We can't let 'em call for backup, Johnny boy. Close 'em down.
zh: ~z~不能让他们呼叫支援，强尼。干掉他们。

english: ~z~Now you know we ain't going out like that, Jim. I'll see you soon.
zh: ~z~这下就不会了，吉姆。我们之后见。

english: ~z~Oh yeah. You messed with a dirty cop's donut. You're one badass biker.
zh: ~z~哦，没错。你抢了臭条子的甜甜圈，真是一个大坏蛋。

english: ~z~We don't have time for this, man.
zh: ~z~我们没时间了，兄弟。

english: ~z~We just couldn't take 'em out in the open like that. They're still cops. See you soon, man.
zh: ~z~我们不能大摇大摆地干掉他们。他们可是警察。之后见，兄弟。

english: ~z~Worse; at least we ain't pretending to respect the law.
zh: ~z~他们更糟，我们至少不用装作守法。

english: ~z~Oh, Man. I'm getting to old for this shit.
zh: ~z~噢，兄弟。我这年纪快干不动了。

english: ~z~Johnny man, we can't have the cops catching us now. Lose this heat.
zh: ~z~强尼兄弟，现在还不能让条子抓到我们。甩掉他们。

english: ~z~I know, I know, it's just there's only so many you can carry. Who'd think there'd be five of them.
zh: ~z~我懂，我懂。可是我没这么多枪啊，谁知道他们有五个人。

english: ~z~Man, I want the old Billy back, the one before the heroin.
zh: ~z~老兄，我更想要以前的比利，没沾上海洛因的比利。

english: ~z~Something tells me they weren't the only ones in the LCPD, Johnny. Back to the house, my man.
zh: ~z~我觉得LCPD里不会只有他们两个坏警察，强尼。回会所吧，好兄弟。

english: ~z~Assholes don't know how much it's worth. They're screwing it up on the beach at Firefly.
zh: ~z~有一群不识货的臭傻逼，在萤火虫的海滩上瞎搞。

english: ~z~If I could use my legs, I'd jump for joy Johnny boy. Later on, Brother.
zh: ~z~要不是腿瘸了，我就高兴得跳起来了，强尼。之后见，兄弟。

english: ~z~Hey, Angus. Know any bikes that need to be liberated from their owners?
zh: ~z~嘿，安格斯。有没有需要脱离车主魔爪的摩托？

english: ~z~Angus, I got a feeling there might be a bike you're looking for.
zh: ~z~安格斯，你是不是又看上了哪辆摩托啊？

english: ~z~Don't worry about it. Stay safe.
zh: ~z~别担心。保重。

english: ~z~Fuck if I can pronounce it, but a Ha-ha-coochie-koo is now in your possession, Angus.
zh: ~z~这名儿真念不来，那辆哈哈库奇库现在是你的了，安格斯。

english: ~z~All cool, Johnny. Later on.
zh: ~z~没事，强尼。回见。

english: ~z~Angus, man, I'm sorry but shit got fucked up and I couldn't get that bike.
zh: ~z~安格斯，兄弟，很抱歉事情搞砸了，我没弄到车。

english: ~z~Brother, Man, something's come up. I can't get the bike for you. Another time.
zh: ~z~兄弟，出了点意外。我没法替你弄车了。下次再说吧。

english: ~z~Hey, your contact better still want that bike 'cause I got it for him.
zh: ~z~嘿，你的上家最好不要跑单，因为我已经得手了。

english: ~z~Too bad, brother, but that guy won't be getting his hands on that bike today.
zh: ~z~太糟了，兄弟，但你老板今天见不到车了。

english: ~z~Cool, Johnny, cool. I'll let the man know what went down.
zh: ~z~没事，强尼，没事的。我会跟他说明情况的。

english: ~z~Brother man, we're going to get paid. Don't get too fucked up.
zh: ~z~兄弟，又有钱进账了。别乱挥霍。

english: ~z~Hey Angus, hate to do this to a brother, but I can't go get you that bike. Sorry.
zh: ~z~嘿，安格斯，虽然不想这样，但我不能你搞到那辆摩托了。抱歉。

english: ~z~That's cool, Brother. The man will just have to wait.
zh: ~z~没事的，兄弟。就让老板多等会儿吧。

english: ~z~Stop jacking up my new ride, fuckhole.
zh: ~z~别糟蹋我的新车了，傻逼。

english: ~z~You always were the most reliable brother, Johnny. Too cool.
zh: ~z~不愧是我最可靠的兄弟，强尼。太棒了。

english: ~z~Hey, asshole, you're fucking up my new bike!
zh: ~z~喂，傻逼，别乱搞老子的新车！

english: ~z~There's a guy detailing it like he knows it's for sale or something. Outside the tattoo guy in Alderney City.
zh: ~z~车主正在洗车，这不正好要帮他卖车吗。车在奥尔德尼市的纹身店外面。

english: ~z~Johnny, man. We haven't been able to source any. It's only a matter of time though so call back.
zh: ~z~强尼兄弟，暂时没有看中的车。但早晚会找到目标的，有空再聊。

english: ~z~Well, you didn't get the last one, but who cares, right? There's another one lined up for you.
zh: ~z~上次你就失手了，但也没关系。新的目标已经给你安排好了。

english: ~z~I'm taking a bike. Don't be a jackass.
zh: ~z~我只要车。别犯傻。

english: ~z~Hey man, I can't do that delivery anymore. Hope that's okay?
zh: ~z~嘿，兄弟，我现在没法弄车了。没问题吧？

english: ~z~Angus, dude, I gotta postpone getting that bike. Hope that's cool?
zh: ~z~安格斯兄弟，车子我得晚点去弄了。没关系吧？

english: ~z~If it ain't my true brother.
zh: ~z~这不是我的好兄弟嘛。

english: ~z~How about that, man. We haven't been able to find what we need. Call again soon and they'll be one.
zh: ~z~这么说吧，兄弟。我们还没找到目标。过段时间应该就有了。

english: ~z~Hey dude, your man isn't going to get his ride. Let him down easy.
zh: ~z~嘿，哥们。你老板拿不到摩托车了。让他放宽心吧。

english: ~z~Malc, I don't know where you got that shit man,
zh: ~z~马尔科姆，我不知道你从哪弄来的炸弹，

english: ~z~We're at war again, boys. That means we get to kill this Lost motherfucker.
zh: ~z~现在又开战了，兄弟们。不要放过失落帮的傻逼玩意。

english: ~z~With this, we could take the Angels of Death out of business
zh: ~z~有了这个，我们就能把死亡天使干到不省人事，

english: ~z~Didn't your daddy teach you how to use fireworks? Shit!
zh: ~z~你爹没告诉你别乱玩烟花吗？操！

english: ~z~I'm getting sloppy.
zh: ~z~大不如前了啊。

english: ~z~But remember this - you get into any trouble, you ain't meet me.
zh: ~z~但是记住，万一出事，跟我无关。

english: ~z~Might even do them some good to get off their asses. Later on.
zh: ~z~偶尔给他们找点正事干也不错。一会儿见。

english: ~z~There's some A.O.D. wagons that ain't gonna be round tomorrow, men.
zh: ~z~死亡天使的货车见不到明天的太阳了，兄弟们。

english: ~z~Put the hammer down, alright. This Loser might be making a play.
zh: ~z~油门往下踩。这个废物可不是善茬。

english: ~z~Man, this war is fuckin' with my head. I can't take anymore of this shit.
zh: ~z~帮派战争搞得我头疼。我受不了了。

english: ~z~Job done, my man. Those Deadbeats ain't a problem and you introduced me to your new friends.
zh: ~z~搞定了，兄弟。死妈天使不成问题了，你还把我介绍给了你的新朋友。

english: ~z~Put some distance between us and this Loser, will ya?
zh: ~z~和这个废物拉开些距离，行不？

english: ~z~Is it me, or does that Loser look like he's in need of having his neck broken
zh: ~z~我看错了吗，那个废物是不是在自寻死路？

english: ~z~That's right.
zh: ~z~没错。

english: ~z~This Loser don't smell right. Let's go.
zh: ~z~来者不善。我们走。

english: ~z~I'm good man - I don't need one of them hairdryers.
zh: ~z~我很好，兄弟。不需要他们的日系「吹风机」。

english: ~z~If it ain't a soon to be dead member of The Lost MC.
zh: ~z~这不是失落帮的期货死人吗。

english: ~z~I'll give you mature shit, Malc.
zh: ~z~那你还不听老人言，马尔科姆。

english: ~z~Aw man, you got to ask a question like that?
zh: ~z~别吧，这种事情还用问吗？

english: ~z~Are you down?
zh: ~z~干不干？

english: ~z~With that it looks like we could take the whole fucking town out of business.
zh: ~z~我看拿它干烂整座城市都不是问题。

english: ~z~I told them to go fuck themselves. I may be an asshole but I won't talk about my brothers.
zh: ~z~我叫他们滚蛋。我也许不是好人，但绝不会出卖兄弟。

english: ~z~Maybe you should do the talking, man. I don't know if I can trust myself.
zh: ~z~还是你去跟他交涉吧，兄弟。我有点信不过自己。

english: ~z~We don't need numbers, man. We need brothers.
zh: ~z~我们需要的不是人数，是兄弟。

english: ~z~You backstabbing fucks.
zh: ~z~一群无耻的叛徒。

english: ~z~These are tough times. How's Jackie feel about what's going down?
zh: ~z~帮会不太平啊。杰基对现在的情况怎么看？

english: ~z~Clubhouse ain't exactly gonna be crowded after this.
zh: ~z~以后会所就没那么热闹了。

english: ~z~An he don't give a shit about the brothers.
zh: ~z~他根本不在乎弟兄死活。

english: ~z~Yeah, and your babysitter, Billy's on the inside now.
zh: ~z~没错，你的保姆比利现在还在蹲号子呢。

english: ~z~Pin it, man. We can't lose 'em.
zh: ~z~加速，兄弟。不能放过他们。

english: ~z~That taste nice, asshole?
zh: ~z~感觉不错吧，傻逼？

english: ~z~Hey man, last thing I want is to talk to that snivelling little shit bag.
zh: ~z~喂，兄弟，我才不想和那个爱哭鼻子的小混蛋说话。

english: ~z~Don't apologize, Johnny. Brian's the one with something to be sorry for. Another time.
zh: ~z~别道歉，强尼。布莱恩才是需要道歉的人。下次再说吧。

english: ~z~Billy was always good to you and you ratted him out.
zh: ~z~比利待你不薄，而你却出卖了他。

english: ~z~Not your call, Jew boy.
zh: ~z~你胡说，犹太崽。

english: ~z~If Billy wasn't inside I'd kill him myself.
zh: ~z~要是比利没进去，我亲手杀了他。

english: ~z~Don't I know it, man. But what choice do we got? It's them or us!
zh: ~z~我也恶心啊，兄弟。但也没得选了，水火不容啊！

english: ~z~Shit, I wish we'd pinned down Brian. That little weasel.
zh: ~z~操，就是没杀掉布莱恩。那个狡猾的小人。

english: ~z~Twist the wick, my brother. These guys aren't getting away.
zh: ~z~加速啊，兄弟。这些家伙别想逃走。

english: ~z~So long, assholes.
zh: ~z~永别了，傻逼。

english: ~z~Come on, man. We can't let these pricks get away.
zh: ~z~快点，老兄。不能让这些混蛋跑了。

english: ~z~I couldn't do it to a brother, even him. He's dead inside anyway.
zh: ~z~我无法对兄弟下手，即使是他。反正他已经是具行尸走肉了。

english: ~z~Hell, man. I don't want to, but I'm with you on this.
zh: ~z~妈的，兄弟，我也不想啊。但这回我站你这边。

english: ~z~I don't feel like that shit means too much anymore.
zh: ~z~但这些「兄弟」已经不是兄弟了。

english: ~z~I was just thinking how selfish it was of me to deal with Brian all by myself.
zh: ~z~我在想我一个人去找布莱恩算账会不会有点自私。

english: ~z~I mean I wouldn't want to be in prison or anything, but I, you know, I'd take it.
zh: ~z~我也不想去蹲监狱受苦啥的，但是，那个吧，我接受了。

english: ~z~You're mine, you weasel.
zh: ~z~你别想逃，黄鼠狼。

english: ~z~We're gonna wait out here man. Don't worry about Brian escaping.
zh: ~z~我们在这里守着。不用担心布莱恩逃跑。

english: ~z~I'm sorry! Please!
zh: ~z~对不起！求你了！

english: ~z~James, I couldn't do it, man. He getting out of town.
zh: ~z~杰姆斯，我下不了手，兄弟。他滚出这座城市了。

english: ~z~You swore an oath, Johnny. Don't do this to your brother, man. I'll get out of town.
zh: ~z~你发过誓的，强尼。别这么对你的兄弟。我会消失的。

english: ~z~Help Brian, will you?
zh: ~z~去救布莱恩，行不？

english: ~z~Get on Brian, he can't look after himself.
zh: ~z~带上布莱恩，他保护不了自己的。

english: ~z~You wouldn't kill a brother, you wouldn't. I'll be a ghost man, gone!
zh: ~z~你不会杀兄弟的，不会的。我会从你们眼前消失的，消失！

english: ~z~It's hard to kill a man when he isn't behaving like one.
zh: ~z~很难下手去杀一个不成人样的人。

english: ~z~I'm gonna wait for our brother round back with Clay. Send him out to us, will you?
zh: ~z~我和科雷去后面等我们的好兄弟。把他熏出来，行不？

english: ~z~Why isn't Klebitz dead yet?
zh: ~z~克雷比兹怎么还没死啊？

english: ~z~and on one hand, I don't give a shit.
zh: ~z~再说了，我他妈不在乎。

english: ~z~Why don't you put a grenade through that window, man?
zh: ~z~为什么不往那扇窗户来颗手雷呢，老兄？

english: ~z~Lost MC forever, my brother. Don't do it. I'll leave the city, I promise you man.
zh: ~z~失落帮万岁，好兄弟。别这么做。我会离开这座城市的，说话算话。

english: ~z~ I hope he doesn't stay disappeared for too long. I'll call you.
zh: ~z~ 希望他不会消失太久。有空再联系。

english: ~z~I'm sorry, please!
zh: ~z~对不起，求你了！

english: ~z~Yeah? Sounds like shit to me but whatever.
zh: ~z~是吗？我看挺糟的，不过无所谓。

english: ~z~I don't care if he's a brother, get Johnny.
zh: ~z~我才不管他是不是兄弟，干掉强尼。

english: ~z~but now that you mention it so does Brian, and right now he's our problem.
zh: ~z~不过转念一想，布莱恩也一样。现在他还是我们的麻烦。

english: ~z~That's why I didn't become a politician. So long, sport.
zh: ~z~所以我才没有成为政客。再见了，哥们。

english: ~z~I wish it didn't have to be this way, but we don't got much choice.
zh: ~z~我不希望变成这样，但我们也没得选。

english: ~z~Well things should be better for a whole heap of people.
zh: ~z~很多人的人生都不该如此的。

english: ~z~More shit storm than steam room, Congressman. We weren't all born into money.
zh: ~z~烂得没空去蒸汽浴室，议员。不是所有人都生来富贵的。

english: ~z~That Ashley, sure. I just want her to be okay so I ain't leaving her to die, you know.
zh: ~z~是那个阿什莉，没错。我只是不想见死不救，让她能保住小命而已。

english: ~z~Yeah, I know it, but you know me, always had a soft spot for someone in trouble.
zh: ~z~是啊，我也知道。你了解我的，见不得别人陷入窘境。

english: ~z~Yeah, I don't know what the committee would think of your body art, personal hygiene or "fuck you" attitude, but,
zh: ~z~好啊，不知道委员会对你的身体艺术、个人卫生和「操你妈」的态度有什么看法，但是，

english: ~z~Don't want some fed with a stick up his ass connecting the dots, you know?
zh: ~z~我不想让哪个麻烦的探员发现我俩的关系，懂吧？

english: ~z~No, some of us married into it. Ha ha ha.
zh: ~z~确实，有些人是嫁入豪门。哈哈哈。

english: ~z~That's because you're way down in your chair, Angus, and it's hard to see ya.
zh: ~z~谁让你现在坐轮椅呢，安格斯，不低头都看不见。

english: ~z~I dunno, man. We'll see. Catch you round, huh?
zh: ~z~不知道，兄弟。慢慢来吧。回头见吧。

english: ~z~I just hope you weren't getting massaged.
zh: ~z~别是做按摩的时候想找我吧。

english: ~z~I mean he'd hardly make eye contact since I got hurt.
zh: ~z~出车祸后他都没看过我几眼。

english: ~z~My, my, A man of principle. Impressive, Klebitz. You must find Liberty City an awful place to live!
zh: ~z~天哪，有原则的人。厉害啊，克雷比兹。你一定和自由城的生活格格不入吧！

english: ~z~turn on brothers and your world turns to shit.
zh: ~z~绝不能当作无事发生。

english: ~z~You're a good man, Johnny. Things should have worked out better for ya.
zh: ~z~你是个好人，强尼。你的人生不该是现在这样的。

english: ~z~Nah, brother. Shit got fucked. Too much craziness, we couldn't hold it together.
zh: ~z~不，兄弟。都他妈完了。过于疯狂了，我们撑不住了。

english: ~z~Man, oh, man. What women can do to us. Don't get in over your head, Johnny.
zh: ~z~我的天哪。女人的魔力啊。可别被冲昏头脑，强尼。

english: ~z~That crown feeling heavy, is it? For what it's worth, I'd follow you, man. I'm sure the other brothers will too.
zh: ~z~皇冠果然很重吧？无论如何，我支持你，兄弟。相信弟兄们都是如此。

english: ~z~I don't know what's left for her other than that need to fuck up everything around her.
zh: ~z~都不知道她脑子里还剩什么，只会把一切搞得一团糟。

english: ~z~Those that ain't gonna stab me in the back. You gonna go see Billy? I don't think I can after what he said.
zh: ~z~也是那些不会背刺我的弟兄。你去探望比利吗？他说了那种话，我可能去不了了。

english: ~z~It's past that, dude. We're over. Long gone.
zh: ~z~早就没感情了，兄弟。已经分了。早分了。

english: ~z~I dunno. I'll probably keep sending money to Jim's old lady and her kid, I owe him that.
zh: ~z~不知道。可能会每月给吉姆的老婆孩子生活费吧，我欠他的。

english: ~z~You see, we got a set of codes that mean you can't keep on like nothing's happened after brothers
zh: ~z~你看，我们帮会有一套规矩，一旦兄弟反目秩序崩塌，

english: ~z~He'll see anything within smoking, fucking and drinking proximity, but he won't see the two ton truck bearing down on him.
zh: ~z~他的眼里只有吸毒、日逼还有喝酒，根本看不见朝他开过来的大卡车。

english: ~z~That don't sound very presidential.
zh: ~z~这话说的就没有领导范了。

english: ~z~Due to minor technical difficulties, Bellic Enterprises cannot accomodate you with a vehicle.
zh: ~z~由于某些技术故障，贝利克集团无法为您安排车辆。

english: ~z~He wouldn't want me there either. Adios, John boy. Chapter president.
zh: ~z~他也不会希望我去的。再见了，阿强。分会会长。

english: ~z~That mobster is cold as all hell. Look after yourself, man.
zh: ~z~那个黑手党可是冷酷无情的。自己保重，兄弟。

english: ~z~He's gonna run himself into some hole, I know that. Shit, Billy doesn't really talk to me.
zh: ~z~反正他肯定会自讨苦吃。妈的，比利真没怎么跟我聊过。

english: ~z~Sure, sure, so are you gonna put me up for membership of your little sauna club, now that I've helped you out?
zh: ~z~当然，当然。既然我帮了你那么多，你那桑拿俱乐部是不是该给我登记个会员了？

english: ~z~Oh. Does that mean I'm gonna have to find something else to pursue in my free time?
zh: ~z~噢。那我是不是只能找点别的事打发时间了？

english: ~z~Ha ha ha. That'd be a damn sight funnier if I didn't think it was true, John.
zh: ~z~哈哈哈哈。可惜这就是现实，我笑不出来。

english: ~z~It don't work out that way, do it? Adios, amigo.
zh: ~z~可惜天不如人意啊，不是吗？再见了，兄弟。

english: ~z~These calls tell me you're full of shit. You wanna talk to me again, get me in bracelets.
zh: ~z~打电话就说明你没有证据。还想跟我说话，就先逮捕我吧。

english: ~z~You've still got it Bernie. You don't need this stupid car. You're the precision machine.
zh: ~z~你还是可以的，伯尼。你不需要这辆破车。你可是精密仪器。

english: ~z~Yeah, only problem was your friend the UC. He nearly blew my ass off.
zh: ~z~是啊，只不过你那买家朋友是个卧底。差点没把我阴死。

english: ~z~I heard 'em alright, but we're cool. Girl does bring heat to a deal, Billy.
zh: ~z~我全听说了，但是没事。女人确实会让交易被盯上，比利。

english: ~z~Nope. You want me, come and get me.
zh: ~z~不。想见我，就亲自来抓。

english: ~z~(Shouting) Get out of the way, you stupid man!
zh: ~z~(大喊) 好狗不挡道，傻逼玩意！

english: ~z~The problem is we can't have a real discussion, and can't solve any real fuckin' problems,
zh: ~z~如果你不来会所，不肯和弟兄们坐下聊聊，

english: ~z~if you aren't gonna come to the house and sit down with your brothers.
zh: ~z~我们就谈不成事，更没法成什么事！

english: ~z~I was on fucking rails back there. You didn't stand a chance.
zh: ~z~我刚才状态极佳，你不可能赢的。

english: ~z~Why aren't you here, Johnny?
zh: ~z~你怎么没来，强尼？

english: ~z~Don't get me started on the brats. Don't get me started! I'm having a hot flush here, people.
zh: ~z~别让我想到臭小孩。别让我想到它！这可是我的逆鳞，各位。

english: ~z~Nice buns though, sugar.
zh: ~z~屁股还不错，宝贝。

english: ~z~Fuck. I'll beat your slow ass next round, man.
zh: ~z~操，下次比赛看我不干烂你，老兄。

english: ~z~So many boys get off that bus everyday.
zh: ~z~要想留住布莱斯可不容易。每天都会遇到那么多人。

english: ~z~I hope you ain't slow in your old age, Bill.
zh: ~z~希望你的年龄不会影响发挥，比利。

english: ~z~Him and The Lost MC. Me and the brothers are tight.
zh: ~z~失落帮也一样。弟兄们和我绝不告密。

english: ~z~You tried to offload some smack to a colleague of mine called Charlie. Costly mistake.
zh: ~z~你之前想把毒品卖给我的同事查理。交了不少学费。

english: ~z~I got work, Johnny. You should be grateful. While them other markets be dropping...
zh: ~z~有新活，强尼。快感谢我吧。现在其他地方可不景气...

english: ~z~I don't know what the fuck you're talking about.
zh: ~z~老子不知道你在说什么。

english: ~z~Sorry man, what'd you expect?
zh: ~z~抱歉，老兄，没失望吧？

english: ~z~Are you too good for that now, Johnny?
zh: ~z~看不上了弟兄们了是吧，强尼？

english: ~z~Jonathan, man, I was thinking you and me could enter a race together. How about it?
zh: ~z~乔纳森，兄弟，我在想要不要一起去赛车。你说呢？

english: ~z~Hercules was a dream, wasn't it? The music! The bodies!
zh: ~z~大力神太梦幻了，不是吗？那音乐！那肉体！

english: ~z~(SINGING) I don't care what you do to me, just be good to me.
zh: ~z~(唱歌) 不在乎你怎么对我，对我好就行

english: ~z~Stop saying that. It's meaningless. You don't even know what the words mean.
zh: ~z~别说了，这样没有意义。你都不知道什么是爱。

english: ~z~Johnny. Thought you'd never call.
zh: ~z~强尼，你居然会联系我。

english: ~z~Congressman Stubbs cannot come to the phone right now.
zh: ~z~斯塔布斯议员现在无暇接听电话。

english: ~z~Next thing you're gonna tell me we're doing some shit kicking for the LCPD.
zh: ~z~下次你是不是要让我们替LCPD跑腿啊。

english: ~z~Yeah, we haven't seen one another in a time.
zh: ~z~是啊，我们有段时间没见面了。

english: ~z~They might give you two a conjugal visit trailer if you ask the screws nice.
zh: ~z~肯去拜托狱警的话，你俩说不定还能来次夫妻探视。

english: ~z~Oh, spare me the lectures. This is important, Jonathan.
zh: ~z~噢，别耍嘴皮子了。这次是正事，乔纳森。

english: ~z~It's just opposite the Libertonian. Go pay him a visit, if you're still thinking about your brothers and not just your own ego, that is.
zh: ~z~那家店在自由城博物馆对面。如果你还把弟兄们放在心里，就给我过去找他。

english: ~z~Ha ha. It can't be any more screwed up than what the club's really like. I'll check it out when I'm next in the House.
zh: ~z~哈哈。总不能比帮会的实际情况还差吧。我下次回会所去看看。

english: ~z~You ever think like you're the only sane person in this fucked up world?
zh: ~z~你会不会觉得自己是这个傻逼世界中唯一的正常人？

english: ~z~And you ain't even asked Clay or Terry to help out on a job.
zh: ~z~结果你连差事都不找科雷和特里帮忙。

english: ~z~I can't really talk. Just come over to my place, okay. Hurry, baby.
zh: ~z~说不来话，麻烦你过来找我，好吗？快点，宝贝。

english: ~z~The pay will be more than adequate.
zh: ~z~报酬不只是丰厚。

english: ~z~Johnny. You coming here or what, sugar?
zh: ~z~强尼，你到底来不来，甜心？

english: ~z~Come on, Ash, give it up. You seriously got time to dream in between your three day ice binges?
zh: ~z~得了吧，阿什莉，别扯了。你溜了三天冰，哪有工夫做梦啊。

english: ~z~I ain't got a hand-out for ya. Sorry.
zh: ~z~我没工夫救济你，抱歉。

english: ~z~If it isn't my white knight. My saviour. Johnny K.
zh: ~z~这不是我的白衣骑士、我的救星，强尼 K吗。

english: ~z~They gonna be able to handle themselves?
zh: ~z~他们不会惹出什么乱子吧？

english: ~z~Once you go down the dark path, it just keeps goin', don't it, Stubbs?
zh: ~z~一朝走错路，没有回头路，不是吗，斯塔布斯？

english: ~z~I ain't your saviour, baby. I might have beaten up a few pimps and pushers.
zh: ~z~我不是你的救星，宝贝。我确实收拾了几个拉皮条的和毒贩子。

english: ~z~A hand-out ain't gonna fix it, Johnny boy. I'm into something bad.
zh: ~z~光救济也没有用，强尼仔。我现在的情况很糟。

english: ~z~If you ever feel like this war we're in ain't worth it, that'll persuade you it is.
zh: ~z~要是你觉得开战不值得，看完网站就不会这么想了。

english: ~z~As long as it ain't gonna get us in the shit with any more dirty cops.
zh: ~z~别害我们再被臭条子盯上就行。

english: ~z~Didn't seem like that when I last saw you. Just checking you're okay. Bye, Ash.
zh: ~z~我上次见到你的时候可不是这样。你没事就好。再见，阿什莉。

english: ~z~I like it fine. Look, I got to go. Take care of yourself.
zh: ~z~我无所谓。听着，我要挂了。你多保重。

english: ~z~I didn't think I'd call you. You hear about Billy?
zh: ~z~我也没想到啊。听说比利的事了吗？

english: ~z~This is too much.
zh: ~z~别那么多废话。

english: ~z~Sounds real dumb to me. But if that's what you want done,
zh: ~z~听起来真傻逼啊。不过既然是你的要求，

english: ~z~But you know, you and me broke up. You was with that Leila girl.
zh: ~z~说实话，你我早分手了。你不是有莱拉了吗。

english: ~z~Evan, take them to the club and don't fuck about, okay?
zh: ~z~埃文，把钻石带回店里，别搞砸了，好吗？

english: ~z~maybe down the line,
zh: ~z~说不定到头来，

english: ~z~He's got a temper, Johnny. Shit. How the fuck could you do this to me? Thanks for nothing.

zh: ~z~我很抱歉，甜心。太可惜了。我觉得雷不会给你钱了，抱歉。

zh: ~z~是啊。快到不可能有好事发生。我的人受伤了。我会问雷要这部分损失费的。

zh: ~z~说不定能替帮会赚点钱。

zh: ~z~我没跟他上过床，

english: ~z~Come on, can we do the hand off please and get out of here?
zh: ~z~拜托，咱能不能快点完事走人？

english: ~z~Johnny! Don't get too clever.
zh: ~z~强尼！别耍小聪明。

english: ~z~Problem! I can't be seen near them.
zh: ~z~问题是！我不能在附近出现。

english: ~z~Nice dinosaur you got there.
zh: ~z~小恐龙真不错。

english: ~z~That money ain't yours!
zh: ~z~那钱不是你的！

english: ~z~I don't trust that Ray Boccino from the moment I saw him.
zh: ~z~我刚见到雷･博奇诺就觉得他信不过。

english: ~z~I wouldn't want this Niko Bellic coming for me. Guy is deranged.
zh: ~z~我可不想被尼克 贝利克这家伙追杀。这人太猛了。

english: ~z~Shit. You don't wanna get in that Slav's way.
zh: ~z~操。可不想跟那个斯拉夫人作对。

english: ~z~Anything for the Chapter, my brother, even pizza. We'll see you soon.
zh: ~z~为了帮派在所不辞，好兄弟，连披萨都得吃。咱们晚点见。

english: ~z~Nicky? Fuck, I mean Nicky, I didn't like the guy. But, hell, they don't normally come that cheap.
zh: ~z~尼克？操，不是，尼克？我不喜欢这人，但是这么便宜的杀手上哪儿找啊。

english: ~z~Yeah, boo fucking hoo. Where's the money? And don't you hang up on me. Don't you hang up on me...
zh: ~z~是吗，关我屁事。老子钱呢？你别挂我电话，你别挂我电话啊...

english: ~z~Mind waiting here while I get the cash. All these tattoos might scare em.
zh: ~z~你们别动，我去拿钱。一群纹身男会吓死他们的。

english: ~z~That don't sound too salubrious, Jonathan. Ah fuck sign us up, brother.
zh: ~z~听上去就对身体不好，乔纳森。啊，算了，带上我们吧，兄弟。

english: ~z~These bills ain't going back to Raymond.
zh: ~z~这些票子不会回到雷蒙德那里了。

english: ~z~John John. Ashley sends her love, yeah.
zh: ~z~强强，阿什莉让我向你问好，没错。

english: ~z~Don't worry about me, dude.
zh: ~z~不用担心我，老哥。

english: ~z~You didn't even need to open your mouth and shit got screwed. Pucchiacha.
zh: ~z~你不开口我都知道事情搞砸了。你个贱逼。

english: ~z~Where's the fucking money, John? I'm getting anxious.
zh: ~z~你妈的老子的钱呢，约翰？我等不及了。

english: ~z~Awww, man. You mean I got to sit here with Terry. Shit.
zh: ~z~啊，哥们。那我只能和特里坐着发呆。妈的。真无聊。

english: ~z~Whoa. Surpirse. You are a fuckin' ape. Who woulda guessed it.
zh: ~z~哇哦，太惊喜了。你没进化全是吧？真没想到啊。

english: ~z~I don't know what happened to the money. I just wanted to get out with my life.
zh: ~z~我不知道钱在哪里。光顾着埋头逃命了。

english: ~z~Haven't been in here since I was a kid. Shit don't change, do it?
zh: ~z~小时候来过一次就再没来过了。这里还是没有变化啊。

english: ~z~And just so you know, I am a very serious person.
zh: ~z~而且你也知道，我都很不好惹了。

english: ~z~I didn't start this shit.
zh: ~z~不是我惹的事。

english: ~z~Man. I dunno. But, uhhh, I'd start looking for a new buyer.
zh: ~z~哥们，我不知道。但是...你最好找个新买家。

english: ~z~I'm hunting you down, assholes.
zh: ~z~都别想活着跑掉，混蛋。

english: ~z~Thanks for the advice, Ray. I was thinking the same thing about you and a coffin. You got that diamond money?
zh: ~z~谢谢你的建议，雷。我觉得你和棺材也挺配的。钻石变现了没？

english: ~z~That scene wasn't all that kosher. Call me.
zh: ~z~场面不太符合犹太规矩。再联系吧。

english: ~z~Come back here, you chicken shit motherfuckers.
zh: ~z~回来啊，一群没种的弱鸡玩意！

english: ~z~Rest of you motherfuckers wanna die - do something stupid okay!
zh: ~z~哪个狗逼不想活命，就给我动一下试试！

english: ~z~You've got to give that girl another chance, you know. You kids are perfect for each other.
zh: ~z~你能不能再给她一次机会啊？其实你俩挺般配的。

english: ~z~You ain't walking out of here with that cash.
zh: ~z~你别想带着钱跑掉。

english: ~z~Gentlemen, gentlemen, pardon the precautions. You know how things are.
zh: ~z~先生们，先生们，恕我带了保镖。这年头不安全啊。

english: ~z~The fucking diamonds. Don't let anyone get the diamonds.
zh: ~z~操他妈的钻石。别让别人抢走钻石。

english: ~z~Isaac and Mori ain't happy Johnny. I am telling you these are serious people.
zh: ~z~艾萨克和莫里很不高兴，强尼。这些人都不是好惹的。

english: ~z~You're gonna have to work for it, friend. Hope you don't mind sweating a little.
zh: ~z~这事儿还得你出力，朋友。希望你不介意啊。

english: ~z~Nice tattoos. Your mommy do 'em for you?
zh: ~z~刺青不错啊，你妈给你刺的？

english: ~z~We had a problem, Raymond. I didn't like the look of some of the muscle at the Libertonian.
zh: ~z~我们有麻烦了，雷蒙德。博物馆里有些打手的臭脸让我很不爽。

english: ~z~What's this I hear about you backing out on this deal?
zh: ~z~我怎么听说你小子还没交易就跑了？

english: ~z~You mean all Ray's money?
zh: ~z~那不都是雷的钱吗？

english: ~z~Of course he has, baby. Thanks for the heads up.
zh: ~z~不愧是他啊，宝贝。多谢你提醒。

english: ~z~It ain't your fault.
zh: ~z~不是你的错。

english: ~z~Where're your friends, Johnny? I can't see 'em from way up here.
zh: ~z~你的朋友呢，强尼？我在上面怎么没看见呢。

english: ~z~I don't know what you're talking about.
zh: ~z~不知道你在说什么。

english: ~z~Me and Ray neither, sugar.
zh: ~z~我和雷也不是，甜心。

english: ~z~But Johnny, Ray ain't the problem.
zh: ~z~但是强尼，雷不是问题所在。

english: ~z~I don't got you. Crystal gone and got you babe.
zh: ~z~我拥有不了你。你已经被冰毒俘获了，宝贝。

english: ~z~For everything. He told me everything.
zh: ~z~什么都对不起。他都告诉我了。

english: ~z~Ray ain't gonna have many friends left after this.
zh: ~z~这票之后，雷就没多少朋友了。

english: ~z~Why bother? I'd be better off dead.
zh: ~z~何苦呢？我巴不得去死。

english: ~z~I don't know.
zh: ~z~不知道。

english: ~z~Are you telling me that a backstabbing mob guy who wants to kill me ain't the problem?
zh: ~z~你想跟我说，这个背刺我的黑手党不是问题所在？

english: ~z~Fucking hell! Stop that shit, asshole.
zh: ~z~操你妈的！别折腾了，混蛋。

english: ~z~I bet Billy wouldn't have made you do shit like this.
zh: ~z~我打赌比利不会让你们干这些破事。

english: ~z~Man, I don't know how many brothers we're gonna have left to have a meeting with.
zh: ~z~哥们，都不知道下次集会还剩多少弟兄了。

english: ~z~Anyhow, he... he told me you wouldn't get hurt...
zh: ~z~要不是他说你不会出事，

english: ~z~Clay, man. What would you do if you had an unknown number of mobster hitmen on your tail?
zh: ~z~科雷，哥们。要是被数量不明的黑帮杀手追杀，你会咋办？

english: ~z~Billy was right about both of yous. Back-stabbing fools.
zh: ~z~比利对你俩的评价没错。傻逼叛徒。

english: ~z~Hopefully you ain't so stupid.
zh: ~z~希望你没那么蠢。

english: ~z~Fuck me, man. I hope Jim ain't in trouble.
zh: ~z~我操，哥们。希望吉姆没事。

english: ~z~You see genius over here would rather get crème-brûléed before he dies.
zh: ~z~你眼前的这个睿智宁愿变成肉酱也不开口。

english: ~z~These hitmen aren't so tough, Johnny.
zh: ~z~这帮杀手不难对付，强尼。

english: ~z~Jim... he ain't...
~z~You're speaking a foreign language to me now lady.
zh: ~z~你这句话我可听不懂，女士。

english: ~z~Yeah, well why shouldn't I kill you?
zh: ~z~是吗，给我个不杀你的理由。

english: ~z~Come over to Keneckie Ave. and we'll see if those greaseballs can handle The Lost MC.
zh: ~z~你来基内基大道吧，看看这帮意大利佬打不打得过失落帮。

english: ~z~I wouldn't have done it otherwise.
zh: ~z~我是不会答应他的。

english: ~z~Ray Boccino's nobody, you shitheads.
zh: ~z~雷･博奇诺是个鸡巴，一帮傻逼。

english: ~z~You mean you couldn't handle these guys by yourself, Jonathan?
zh: ~z~你觉得自己一个人打不过他们吗，乔纳森？

english: ~z~Hot damn, baby girl. Your friend Ray ain't so friendly.
zh: ~z~他妈的，宝贝。你朋友雷好像不太友好啊。

english: ~z~Johnny K you're alright. I'm sorry, sweets. I think Ray sent some guys after you.
zh: ~z~强尼 K，你还好吗？对不起，甜心。我想雷已经派人追杀你了。

english: ~z~so I thought I'd fit right in here.
zh: ~z~我不是很适合这里吗。

english: ~z~Don't you have any bags to rifle through or something. Get lost.
zh: ~z~你没有带着装有武器之类东西的包包吧？滚开。

english: ~z~Well, now that you mention it... I'm starting to feel a little queasy.
zh: ~z~好吧，被你这么一说...我还真有点不舒服。

english: ~z~We're looking after a VIP and he doesn't wanna see your ugly face. So long.
zh: ~z~咱们在找一位VIP，但他不想看你那丑逼脸。再见。

english: ~z~I need people to elect me so that I feel marginally less bad about myself
zh: ~z~我需要人们选我，当选了我才不会那么内疚，

english: ~z~This ain't any of your business, bag monkey. Clear off.
zh: ~z~这不关你的事，吃屌佬。滚蛋。

english: ~z~Oh, don't get sentimental, Klebitz. It's unappealing. I am a WASP, after all.
zh: ~z~哦，别煽情了，克雷比兹。这很不爽。毕竟我是个大佬。

english: ~z~or a poignant sense of guilt afterwards.
zh: ~z~也不会留下强烈的负罪感。

english: ~z~Trust me man, nothing would please me more,
zh: ~z~相信我，哥们，我也想直接出去。

english: ~z~Don't worry about that. We've got terrorism insurance up to our eye balls.
zh: ~z~别担心。咱的眼珠子买了恐怖主义保险了。

english: ~z~I think you should leave, sir, before I call the police.
zh: ~z~请您自己出去，先生，不然我报警了。

english: ~z~"I think you should leave sir, before I...", dude, it is the twenty-first century.
zh: ~z~「请您自己出去，不然...」老哥，这都二十一世纪了。

english: ~z~You don't racially profile like a terrorist, but I'm about to start treating you like one.
zh: ~z~虽然你长得不像恐怖分子，但我还是得把你当作恐怖分子招待了。

english: ~z~And thank you, best massage I ever had that didn't involve a happy ending
zh: ~z~谢谢了，这是我做过最好的按摩，既没有性服务，

zh: ~z~很不幸，有个坏家伙让我再次当选的几率趋近于零。

english: ~z~My father died years ago, thank god. No. My uncle.
zh: ~z~我爸几年前就死了，谢天谢地。目标是我叔叔，

english: ~z~Don't lose any bags today, alright.
zh: ~z~今天别出啥岔子，好吗？

english: ~z~I'm guessing you don't want me to hurt the precious family chopper.
zh: ~z~我寻思你你不想弄坏家里那架宝贵的直升机。

english: ~z~For my conscience's sake, I hope your lack of humanity is a genetic quality.
zh: ~z~天地良心，希望你的没人性是家族遗传。

english: ~z~Ah, Mr. Klebitz, in need of some help, are we?
zh: ~z~啊，克雷比兹先生，咱是不是需要点帮助？

english: ~z~I'm afraid you boys aren't gonna start your stretch yet.
zh: ~z~恐怕你们没法进去服刑了。

english: ~z~A man's organs ain't meant to look like that. Come on.
zh: ~z~正常人的器官不该是那副模样。快点。

english: ~z~Long way from the Exchange now, aren't you, you yuppie pricks? Still think you're better than guys like me, huh?
zh: ~z~这里可不是你们的证券交易所，雅皮士屌毛。还觉得自己比我们优越吗？

english: ~z~Oh shit. Oh shit. I can't get arrested again.
zh: ~z~哦操，哦操，我不能再被逮住了。

english: ~z~There are some bad people in here, sir. Please stand back.
zh: ~z~现在里面有坏人，先生。请勿靠近。

english: ~z~Don't leave us here. Help us get out of this.
zh: ~z~别抛下我们，帮我们逃出去。

english: ~z~Nothing like running from the cops to get the blood pumping.
zh: ~z~还是跟条子玩躲猫猫最刺激。

english: ~z~Get back here. Don't leave us.
zh: ~z~回来啊，别抛下我们。

english: ~z~Get out the fucking way.
zh: ~z~别他妈挡路。

english: ~z~while my whole life falls to shit all around me. But fuck it. I'm alright.
zh: ~z~同时我的整个人生都变得一团糟。不过没事，爷很好。

english: ~z~You're in my world now, son.
zh: ~z~你逃不出我的手掌心了，小子。

english: ~z~Well, isn't there something you can do about that yourself man?
zh: ~z~你自己就没有什么办法吗，哥们？

english: ~z~Where are you going? Don't leave us with him.
zh: ~z~你去哪呢？别把我们留给警察。

english: ~z~For these fellas it's white collar shenanigans. Caught with their hand in the cookie jar.
zh: ~z~这帮白领手脚不干净，被人逮到现形了。

english: ~z~Believe me, a short recession and a trip to Panama isn't going to finish those boys off.
zh: ~z~相信我吧，短暂的经济衰退和巴拿马之行弄不垮他们的。

english: ~z~I'm guessing it wasn't you I got paid to bail out anyways.
zh: ~z~估计别人掏钱雇我捞的人也不是你。

english: ~z~Oh don't you worry, those boys don't need luck. You shoulda seen them in '73.
zh: ~z~哦，别担心，那帮人不需要运气。你该看看他们73年的表现。

english: ~z~Don't think you ain't gettin' caught in this thing, Deadbeats.
zh: ~z~别以为这样你们就不会被捕了，死妈天使。

english: ~z~Well, Mr. Stubbs. The good news is the cops aren't going to get there hands on those voters.
zh: ~z~呃，斯塔布斯先生，有个好消息，那些选民不会被警察抓回去了。

english: ~z~I was thinking their problem might lie with one of the other passengers on their little cruise. Later on, Mr. Congressman.
zh: ~z~主要是船上还有个不妙的家伙。回见，议员先生。

english: ~z~No, all you need to know is that, uh,
zh: ~z~你需要知道的只有...

english: ~z~Don't sweat it Klebitz.
zh: ~z~别担心，克雷比兹。

english: ~z~Unless you yuppies want me to throw you to the pigs, shut the hell up.
zh: ~z~你们这帮雅皮士，不想被我送给傻逼条子就他妈闭嘴。

english: ~z~I don't really know what you mean, sir.
zh: ~z~我不太理解您的意思，先生。

english: ~z~Do me a favor and don't fucking eat me, back there.
zh: ~z~帮兄弟个忙，别把我吃了，后面的。

english: ~z~Get them out of there and we will make it worth your while.
zh: ~z~把他们救出来，报酬不会让你后悔的。

english: ~z~Dead men don't talk, Klebitz. This, I can work with. I'll talk to you soon.
zh: ~z~死人不会说话，克雷比兹。这样，我来处理吧。晚点找你。

english: ~z~He just wears a different uniform.
zh: ~z~只不过行头不同。

english: ~z~I'm trying to save your preppie asses, so calm down.
zh: ~z~我忙着救你们这帮小屁孩出去，都别吵了。

english: ~z~You're going to need to step away from the building, sir.
zh: ~z~请您不要再靠近了，先生。

english: ~z~Can you keep it down? In case you ain't noticed I'm trying to keep you boys outta prison.
zh: ~z~能不能小点声？生怕没人知道我带你们越狱吗？

english: ~z~Yes, sir. Something like that. And tell me sir, are you happy?
zh: ~z~是的，先生。差不多是这样。告诉我，先生，您快乐吗？

english: ~z~Please, sir. We cannot have civilians approaching the station house today.
zh: ~z~请回吧，先生。今天我们不能让平民靠近警局。

english: ~z~Hold it right there!
zh: ~z~站住别动！

english: ~z~Look, it was a victimless crime. My taxes pay your salary.
zh: ~z~听着，这是无受害人犯罪，是我交税养你们的。

english: ~z~I'm afraid I can't get your yuppie friends out of the city, Mr. Stubbs.
zh: ~z~恐怕我不能带你的雅皮士朋友逃出生天了，斯塔布斯先生。

english: ~z~Hey, my preppie friends, will you shut the hell up?
zh: ~z~嘿，小朋友们，能不能他妈闭嘴？

english: ~z~Those coveralls chafing you? Well you must be used to wearing Perseus suits and shit.
zh: ~z~这身囚服是不是硌得难受？你们肯定只穿得惯神之子的垃圾西装。

english: ~z~This bus ain't going to Alderney State Correctional I'm afraid.
zh: ~z~恐怕这辆囚车的目的地不是奥尔德尼州监狱。

english: ~z~I mean, has giving the man, the, err, finger,
zh: ~z~我是说，整天找别人，呃，麻烦，

english: ~z~Bad news, Mr. Congressman. Something more important than your career has come up and I can't help you.
zh: ~z~坏消息，议员先生。我突然有些比你的政治生涯更要紧的事，帮不了你了。

english: ~z~Oh, appreciate the heads up and the friendly patter. Another time, Johnny.
zh: ~z~哦，感谢你毫无意义的友情提示。那就下次吧，强尼。

english: ~z~Ouch, Klebitz. Let a fellow down easy.
zh: ~z~噢，克雷比兹。别让别人失望。

english: ~z~Mr. Congressman. I can't do that thing right now. Deal with it.
zh: ~z~议员先生。我现在没法替你办事。面对现实吧。

english: ~z~Hey, Mr. Stubbs, working for you makes me feel like a piece of shit. I can't do that thing for you. Sorry.
zh: ~z~嘿，斯塔布斯先生，替你做事让我感觉很糟。我不能为你做那件事。抱歉。

english: ~z~I guess the old horn dog couldn't get it up. When I last saw him in the changing room he looked virile enough.
zh: ~z~我猜这只老色鬼硬不起来了。我上次在更衣室见他还挺有男子气概的。

english: ~z~I can't get the shot, Mr. Congressman. I'm sorry.
zh: ~z~我没能拍到照片，议员先生。我很抱歉。

english: ~z~It's very sweet and really very embarrassing. Trust me.
zh: ~z~会很甜蜜但又不失尴尬的。相信我。

english: ~z~The cops have scared off all the women, Mr. Stubbs. Your guy ain't gonna get his dose of VD.
zh: ~z~条子吓跑了那些妓女，斯塔布斯先生。你那同事肯定得不了性病了。

english: ~z~Stubbs, I can't get the shot.
zh: ~z~斯塔布斯，我不能帮你拍照了。

english: ~z~How about it?
zh: ~z~你干不干？

english: ~z~a little hypocrisy is hardly a sin. He's over on Traeger St in Port Tudor. Get a good one.
zh: ~z~有点虚伪算不上罪过。他就在都铎港的特雷格街。拍张好点的。

english: ~z~Is that what you're after? Run out of tennis partners when you killed off your uncle?
zh: ~z~是说你的需求吗？杀了你叔叔后就没人当你的网球搭档了？

english: ~z~Wouldn't be in this situation if it wasn't for positive discrimination, dammit.
zh: ~z~要不是为了少数族裔的特别优待就没这回事了，妈的。

english: ~z~Oh, you've got a mind for damage control, Johnny. If this rebel thing doesn't work out,
zh: ~z~噢，你还真有损害管制的头脑，强尼。哪天叛逆不下去了，

english: ~z~Fair enough. I can't claim to like it, but I also can't claim to have a choice.
zh: ~z~也行。我谈不上喜欢这个主意，但我的确也没得选。

english: ~z~In all seriousness though, some jumped up little twerp is about to go to the press with sensitive information.
zh: ~z~回归正题，有个无耻混蛋要把一个敏感信息透露给媒体。

english: ~z~Kiss your freedom goodbye, sir.
zh: ~z~跟你的自由告别吧，先生。

english: ~z~Ah, if it isn't the road warrior, himself. Still sticking it to the man, man?
zh: ~z~啊，这不是公路战士吗。还是原来那样叛逆吗，兄弟？

english: ~z~Good news for you is that it ain't your ugly mug.
zh: ~z~好消息是头版上没有你的丑脸。

english: ~z~So you're fighting positive discrimination with some good old fashioned negative discrimination?
zh: ~z~所以你是想用老派的歧视待遇打败特别优待喽？

english: ~z~Stubbsy, I didn't get the chance to talk to that friend of yours. He was too busy getting killed.
zh: ~z~斯塔布西，我没能跟你的朋友说上话。当时他忙着去死。

english: ~z~Appreciate the tip, but I think I'll stick to terrorism, the economy and the environment.
zh: ~z~不错的主意，但我还是会坚持恐怖主义、经济和环境的议题。

english: ~z~But, I've been working twelve hour days on a six month unpaid internship...
zh: ~z~但是，我每天工作12小时的无薪实习已经持续半年了...

english: ~z~Leave it in the moth balls, Congressman. Your old friend's funeral may not be for some time.
zh: ~z~还是挂在衣柜里吧，议员先生。你老朋友的葬礼可能还得过段时间。

english: ~z~And don't use my credit card.
zh: ~z~不许用我的信用卡开。

english: ~z~Now that is awkward. Thanks for the heads up, sport.
zh: ~z~那就不好办了。谢谢你提醒我，哥们。

english: ~z~Make sure you don't scratch this on the way back, okay. Otherwise, he'll be wise to you, man.
zh: ~z~回去的路上别把车刮花了，好吗？不然的话，他会看出来的，老兄。

english: ~z~Charming, Klebitz. I'm thinking this means I won't be able to tune into radio Dawkins tonight?
zh: ~z~太好了吧，克雷比兹，意思是我今晚没法收听道金斯电台了。

english: ~z~Now, calm down, work out the tension, get a massage, beat off, kill someone, I don't care.
zh: ~z~现在，你冷静点，不要紧张，做个按摩，撸一管，杀个人，我不在乎。

english: ~z~Charming, Klebitz. I'm thinking this means I won't be able to tune into radio Dawkins tonight.
zh: ~z~太好了吧，克雷比兹，意思是我今晚没法收听道金斯电台了。

english: ~z~Oh Johnny, I wouldn't want to hog all the fun for myself, I'll text you the number so you can have a listen, too.
zh: ~z~哦，强尼，我可不想独享这份快乐。之后我把号码发给你，这样你也能一起偷听了。

english: ~z~Klebitz, Klebitz, you caught me in a fine mood. Just heard some good news about a bill I've been championing.
zh: ~z~克雷比兹，克雷比兹，我刚好心情不错。刚收到了个关于我支持的法案的好消息。

english: ~z~It's like talking to a vampire whose just spotted a virgin. Sucking more money outta hard American workers, I bet.
zh: ~z~这话说的跟刚发现处女的吸血鬼似的。我看你又从辛苦劳动的美国工人身上吸了不少血吧。

english: ~z~Sorry, man. You probably got enough listening to boy's jerk off at your fancy prep school. I shoulda known.
zh: ~z~抱歉，老兄。是我没考虑到你上高级预科学校的时候就听过太多男孩子撸管了。

english: ~z~Drop the formalities, Klebitz. Dawkins has reported the car stolen.
zh: ~z~别客套了，克雷比兹。道金斯报警说他的车被偷了。

english: ~z~Well, who says campaign donations don't buy you anything? I'm on it, Stubbs.
zh: ~z~好吧，谁说竞选捐款没法带来收益的？我来干，斯塔布斯。

english: ~z~I don't even wanna guess what that means, but I'm thinking Juan ain't one of the schmucks who invested in your company.
zh: ~z~我都不想猜这句话的意思，但我觉得胡安不是唯一一个给你公司投资的傻逼。

english: ~z~Spare me the fucking lectures, you self righteous prick.
zh: ~z~别他妈教我做事，你个自以为是的屌毛。

english: ~z~I can't say I've enjoyed your listening to your socialist hypocritical nonsense, but thanks for the ride.
zh: ~z~我也谈不上是欣赏你那番社会主义者的伪善废话，但还是要谢谢你救我出来。

english: ~z~Ha. I haven't had an annual salary since I punched out licence plates for a year in the joint.
zh: ~z~哈，自从我进局子造车牌劳改一年后，我就没领过年薪了。

english: ~z~I, ummm, dig, Johnny. Good to see you can't be rattled by something like this. Call me, okay?
zh: ~z~我，嗯，懂了，强尼。很高兴看见你没被像这种差事吓到。再电话联系吧，好吗？

english: ~z~Now that is awkward. Thanks for the heads up, sport.
zh: ~z~那就不好办了。谢谢你提醒我，哥们。

english: ~z~Going on the lamb's gonna be real different from your life on the exchange.
zh: ~z~东躲西藏和在证券交易所里的日子截然不同。

english: ~z~Get me a vodka tonic and some sedatives, okay. This hasn't been easy.
zh: ~z~给我来杯伏特加汤力，再来点镇静剂，好吗。今天太不容易了。

english: ~z~Johnny, sorry, thought you were my broker mate. These markets, oh boy, I'm getting raped.
zh: ~z~强尼，不好意思，我把你当成股票经纪人了。那股市，哦伙计，我要亏大发了。

english: ~z~Well done. Well done.
zh: ~z~干得不错，干得不错。

english: ~z~Now that is awkward. Thanks for the heads up, sport.
zh: ~z~那就不好办了。谢谢你提醒我，哥们。

english: ~z~Oh, well done, well done. Conscience aside, I'll send her your best on my next holiday to the Caribbean. Thanks.
zh: ~z~哦，干得好啊，干得好啊。抛开良心不谈，下次去加勒比海度假的时候我会替你问候她的。谢了。

english: ~z~I didn't move funds into an offshore account so I could downgrade my lifestyle.
zh: ~z~我没把钱转到海外账户上，所以我可以降低点生活标准。

english: ~z~Her chopper lost it's pilot.
zh: ~z~她直升机的驾驶员没了。

english: ~z~I mean it wasn't enough we had to be drug dealers,
zh: ~z~光是变成毒贩还不够，

english: ~z~You're gonna have to comp these weapons. They're needed.
zh: ~z~这些武器就别收钱了，征用了。

english: ~z~This ain't a prison break.
zh: ~z~这可不是劫狱。

english: ~z~Rush them, you fearless motherfuckes. Come on.
zh: ~z~干翻他们，不怕死的弟兄们。来吧。

english: ~z~Whoa, not particularly.
zh: ~z~喔，还是算了吧。

english: ~z~I appreciate this, man. It ain't gonna be easy.
zh: ~z~多谢了，哥们。这次不会那么容易的。

english: ~z~I might have something to help you with it.
zh: ~z~我说不定能帮你。

english: ~z~Don't worry about him.
zh: ~z~别担心他了。

english: ~z~Ain't you got rioting prisoners to worry about?
zh: ~z~你们不用担心暴动的犯人了？

english: ~z~Nice place you've got here, Johnny -
zh: ~z~你这地方不错啊，强尼。

english: ~z~You're getting outta here, man? Aww haven't you enjoyed your time in the State's care?
zh: ~z~你要出狱了？吃国家住国家的不香吗？

english: ~z~Brothers, don't let anyone in or out. Terry, Clay, we're going in.
zh: ~z~兄弟们，别让任何人进出大门。特里，科雷，咱们进去。

english: ~z~but I think I like the smoking policy.
zh: ~z~但室内不禁烟就是好地方。

english: ~z~Get away from the entrance or you will be moved.
zh: ~z~离入口远点，不然你们就会被抬走。

english: ~z~Let's get outta here, boys. Billy stopped talking bullshit for good.
zh: ~z~咱们走吧，伙计们。比利再也不会为了得到好处开口扯淡了。

english: ~z~You know how it happens,
zh: ~z~你又不是不知道，

english: ~z~The guy on the roof is down. We're cool.
zh: ~z~房顶上的家伙死了。没事了。

english: ~z~Killing everyone around me isn't an option, Mr. Congressman. Goodbye and thank you.
zh: ~z~杀死我身边的人这事不是我能选的，议员先生。再见，谢谢你。

english: ~z~Is there a ramp you can use? Can you get hold of a guard's uniform?
zh: ~z~你有没有好使的小技俩，能骗来件警卫的制服？

english: ~z~There's one prisoner you don't gotta worry about now.
zh: ~z~现在这有个囚犯你们不用操心他了。

english: ~z~This is a zoo, newbie. Don't feed the animals, don't rattle the cage. You should be fine.
zh: ~z~这是个动物园，新来的。不要投喂动物，不要触碰笼子，否则罚款。

english: ~z~You ain't talking your way outta this, Billy.
zh: ~z~你别想靠告发出狱，比利。

english: ~z~We're in the safest place in the city. Providin' there ain't a riot, that is.
zh: ~z~我们在城里最安全的地方，如果没有暴乱的话。

english: ~z~We ain't paying for this stuff, Terry. It's being used for the Club.
zh: ~z~这批货就不给钱了，特里。失落帮征用了。

english: ~z~Clay wouldn't be dead if Billy had just taken his time like a man.
zh: ~z~要是比利该爷们的时候不娘们，科雷就不会死了。

english: ~z~Shit, if only Jim was with us now.
zh: ~z~妈的，可惜吉姆现在不在了。

english: ~z~They'll either be dead or inside within a month or so.
zh: ~z~不出一个月就都下地狱坐大牢去了。

english: ~z~Ain't that the truth.
zh: ~z~可不是嘛。

english: ~z~Shit, I can't get another ticket, dude. Can I, like, suck you off or something? Come on.
zh: ~z~妈的，我搞不到另外的门票了，老哥。我，能不能，抱你大腿啥的？好不好嘛。

english: ~z~I ain't been smugglin' nothin' into Alderney State, officer. It's all for personal consumption, man.
zh: ~z~警官，我可没走私东西进奥尔德尼州，这些都是我自用的，哥们。

english: ~z~Oh, man. I'm thinking you're thinking we don't have a choice. We'll come meet you.
zh: ~z~哦哥们，我就知道你觉得咱们没得选。咱们见个面吧。

english: ~z~I'll forgive him the insults and injuries, but I can't forgive him that.
zh: ~z~我可以原谅他的冒犯中伤，但破坏帮派无法原谅。

english: ~z~The laundry van doesn't look right. Get to the main gate.
zh: ~z~洗衣房的货车看起来不太对劲。到正门来。

english: ~z~It ain't worth dying for the prisoners of Alderney State.
zh: ~z~为了奥尔德尼监狱的囚犯去死不值得。

english: ~z~Well, Billy isn't going to be talking to anyone about us. We can clear on outta here.
zh: ~z~好了，比利再也不会开口提到我们任何人了。咱们收拾收拾走吧。

english: ~z~Fuck, but that van was bound to be volatile, wasn't it? Later, man.
zh: ~z~操，但那货车早晚会出问题，不是吗？再见吧，哥们。

english: ~z~You know, I'm really lost as to what that's got to do with me, sport. I did all I could for you.
zh: ~z~你懂的，我真不懂这和我有啥关系，老兄。我尽力了。

english: ~z~You check the visitors list?
zh: ~z~你检查过来访名单没？

english: ~z~You won't find salvation here, my friend. It's too late for that.
zh: ~z~你无法在此得到救赎，我的朋友。为时已晚。

english: ~z~I don't care what happens to me as long as we get Billy. Come on.
zh: ~z~只要能抓到比利，我在所不惜。来吧。

english: ~z~That shit needed to be done. Billy needed to be shut up.
zh: ~z~攻打监狱是迫不得已，比利必须保持沉默。

english: ~z~Do you wanna go fuck yourself?
zh: ~z~你能不能滚蛋啊？

english: ~z~Ten bucks says this asshole don't last the week.
zh: ~z~赌十块钱，这混蛋活不过一星期。

english: ~z~Sorry screws, you ain't stopping us now.
zh: ~z~抱歉，杂种，别想阻止我们。

english: ~z~Authorised personnel only. Leave the area now.
zh: ~z~非请勿入，马上离开。

english: ~z~Keep your heads, boys. We might just survive this.
zh: ~z~冷静点，兄弟们。说不定能扛过这波。

english: ~z~We got to clear these screws outta here or they'll take us from behind.
zh: ~z~必须干掉这帮杂种，不然就等着腹背受敌吧。

english: ~z~Get out the fucking way.
zh: ~z~别他妈挡路。

english: ~z~There's a chance we might make it outta here boys. Let's fuckin' do it.
zh: ~z~说不定我们能活着出去，兄弟们。加油干吧。

english: ~z~This place is about to descend into anarchy.
zh: ~z~这里就要陷入无政府状态了。

english: ~z~Johnny the jew. Come on, man.
zh: ~z~犹太佬强尼。不会吧，哥们。

english: ~z~I couldn't get at Billy. He's locked down too tight.
zh: ~z~我没逮到比利。他被看得死死的。

english: ~r~The van is stuck.~s~
zh: ~r~货车无法行驶。~s~

english: ~s~Don't speak so soon Johnny - cops up ahead!
zh: ~s~话别说得这么绝强尼，警察来啦！

english: Glad you are well.
zh: 你没事就好。

english: Man, i fucked things up. I know I did. But you weren't a saint. You weren't. You're who you are, and you do bad shit. and hanging out with you made me do bad shit, even though it ain't your fault. but i did bad shit to you, because you were my world. i thought you would kill me and you didn't. so that makes you a better person than some. i'm so glad we are friends now.
zh: 老兄，我是个烂人，这我知道。但你也不是什么圣贤，绝对不是。你就是你，你也会做坏事。跟你混在一起害得我也跟着做坏事，尽管这不是你的错。但我做了蠢事拖你下水，因为你就是我的全部。我以为你会杀了我，但你没有，说明你比某些人强多了。很高兴我们现在还是朋友。

english: I ain't in the mood for internet chit chat, Ash. Have a nice life. Johnny.
zh: 我现在没心情在网上闲聊，小艾。祝你幸福。 强尼

english: Good luck Ashley. Please don't contact me again.
zh: 祝你好运，阿什莉。 请不要再联系我了。

english: I don't care, Ash. Stay away from me. Please.
zh: 我不在乎，小艾。离我远点，求你了。

english: i fucked up. it weren't my fault. i got thrown out of the facility. it weren't my coke. I love you, Johnny. i love you. drugs ain't shit. you're my drug. Listen, Johnny, can i borrow some money, for a few days? I miss you. i miss you so much.
zh: 我搞砸了，明明不是我的错。我被从设施里赶了出来。那不是我的可卡因。我爱你，强尼。我爱你。毒品算什么，你才是我的毒品。呃，强尼，你能借我点钱吗，就几天？我真的很想你。

english: I love you, too bro. And out of a place of love I make one comment - you get on some very strong medication to deal with the fact you've lost your fucking mind, you messianic dip shit.
zh: 我也爱你，兄弟。出于对你的爱，我不得不说一句：赶紧找点猛药治下你的失心疯吧，你这白痴圣母。

english: What about the life you chose led you to make such stupid choices? Billy Grey? Give me a break. He always was an arsehole. Back in the neighborhood, he was a jackass thinking he was Jesus on an acid trip when we were fifteen and you were 10. That was a long time ago. i hope you don't still look up to that asshole, pardon my fucking French.
zh: 你是犯了什么傻才会走上这么蠢的路的？因为比利･格雷吗？饶了我吧。他向来是个混蛋。以前住在一起的时候，我跟他15岁，你10岁，这个混蛋已经在嗑药后的幻觉世界当上帝了。很久以前就是这样了。希望你已经没有在敬重那个混蛋了，恕我说话粗俗。

english: I hope this mail finds you well and happy and law abiding. I doubt the later, but a brother can hope, can't he? I got shot at yesterday and saw someone have their leg blown off. i saw three kids die last week. My life is one long orgy of death and horror. At least i know i am on the right side. i miss you, man. You have a heart.
zh: 希望收到这封邮件的你是个安好快乐的守法公民。让你守法可能有点难，不过哥哥总是盼着弟弟好的。昨天我中弹了，还有人腿被炸断了。上周我看着三个孩子死去。我的生活就是死亡和恐惧的漫长狂欢。但至少我没有走上歧途。我很想你，老弟。发发善心吧。

english: You will throw your whole life way. For a guy who wouldn't piss on you if you were on fire. I know we've been over this a thousand times, but my life is kind of stressful right now.
zh: 不然你这辈子就完了，浪费在一个你要死了都不会来鸟你一下的人身上。我知道这件事我们已经聊过几千次了，但是现在我的生活有点压力。

english: Thanks for your input Mikey. I miss you, man. I think about you, but I made different choices to you. Doesn't seem like either of our choices panned out so good. We both get shot at. And both of us are fighting other people's battles. Look after yourself. John
zh: 感谢你的建议，迈基。我也想你，老哥。我有想过你的情况，但我做了与你不同的选择。不过我们的选择好像都没什么好结果。枪子你挨我也挨，到头来都是为别人而战。你也保重。约翰

english: thank you for your e mail. It made me cry. At least you are well and happy. I know you cannot live here and be well. I hope happiness finds you. Look after cousin. He is good boy. I dream of both of you settling down with nice women. It is what his mother would have wanted, as well. I will write soon.
zh: 感谢你的来信。我哭了。 至少你过得很好并且很快乐。我知道你不能在这里平静的生活。我希望幸福能够找到你。 照顾你的堂兄吧。他是个好孩子。我梦见你们都和贤惠可人的女孩成家了，作为一个妈妈还能指望什么呢，保重，我很快还会再给你写信的。

english: Life here is the same as it always was. People argue, the farms suffer, we pay taxes for new parliament buildings and government reports, and live in poverty. For country people, life is the same the world. Please write me.
zh: 这里的生活和往常一样一成不变。 人们在争吵，田地减产， 我们为了议会大楼和政府的年度报告而纳税， 并且生活在贫穷中。对乡下的人们来说，生活也是如此，一定要再写信给我啊。

english: I was thinking about you, and I thought I write. I receive nice e mail from your cousin. He say you had seen Florian Cravic again. Did he become a professional wrestler, as he say? He was always strange boy. Roman also tells me he has woman nice in his life and that maybe there was someone special for you too. Life here is much same - crops grow,
zh: 我刚好想起你，所以我就想写信了。 我刚刚收到了罗曼的一封电子邮件。他说你和他再次见到弗洛里安･克拉维克了。 他变成一个专业的摔跤手了吗，就像他说的？ 他一直是个奇怪的孩子。罗曼也告诉我他的生命中有一个不错的女人，也许你很快也会遇到你的另一半呢。这里的生活还是那个样子——种庄稼，

english: thank you for your mail. I am glad you well. Look after Roman. I am excite to hear maybe wedding bells are in air soon? What about you, my son? I will write again, soon.
zh: 谢谢你的来信。 很高兴你过得不错。照顾好罗曼。每当幻想起婚礼的大钟很快敲响的时候我就激动万分。你怎么样，我的儿子？ 很快我就会再次写信。

english: Let's give him a chance, man. Brothers for life. No matter what. Johnny.
zh: 给他一次机会吧，哥们。毕竟大家是一辈子的兄弟。强尼。

english: World ain't what we thought it was, and people we trusted turned out to be scum. I miss Jim. More than anything. He was the real deal. The man we all wanted to be.
zh: 世界不是我们想象的那样，我们信任的人其实是些人渣。我很想念吉姆，想念他超过一切。他才是真正的好汉，我们都想成为的好汉。

english: So, they let him out? Ridiculous in some ways. Man, it's tough. I love my brothers, all of them, but there's brothers who stood by me, (you, Jim, Clay and a few others) and brothers who said they would, and I think we know which camp Billy and Brian fall into. This is my life now. I can't ride into the sunset. I can't ride into anything. I'm stuck in a chair and I need money.
zh: 他这就被放出来了？真的是有点荒谬。兄弟，真的太难了。我爱我的兄弟们，我爱所有兄弟，但有的兄弟确实念着我(你、吉姆、科雷和其他几个)，还有的只在嘴上念着我。比利和布莱恩是哪种你我应该心知肚明。这就是我现在的生活，我不可能骑车奔向夕阳，不可能骑车奔向任何地方。我被困在了轮椅上，我还需要钱。

english: I hear you, brother. Whatever happens, you know me and you are brothers. Johnny.
zh: 我知道了，兄弟。不管发生什么，我们两个都是兄弟。强尼。

english: I need it so we have to keep making it. It's tough. I hope Billy don't fuck it up for all of us. He nearly did last time. We are a small crew. We can't beat the Deadbeats, but we can live alongside them. Billy will come out and go on a rampage. And Brian and those other clowns will drag us all along. It ain't going to be good. It's just a question of how bad.
zh: 我需要钱，所以我们就得努力打拼。实在太难了。希望比利出来后不会把我们的事情搞砸。上次他差不多就搞砸了。我们只有一小撮人，无法打败死妈天使，但可以选择与他们共生。比利出来后肯定会找他们干架，布莱恩和其他傻子肯定也会把我们拉上。以后肯定没好日子过了，就是不知道会有多糟糕。

zh: 考虑到我未能找到我委托人的亲属，我不得不诚恳地紧急寻求您的帮助，并希望让您作为上述死者的近亲出现，因为您与死者同名。

english: I know that a solitication of this gravitude may cause you apprehension but I assure you wholeheadedly of the good faith in which it is solicited. My sincere apoligies for emptying myself into you unsolicitedly and I trust this letter reaches you in fine health. Please contact me at your earliest comfort. You will be rich.
zh: 我知道这样重大的请求可能会让您不安，但我向您保证，这是一个诚恳的要求。我为我唐突地向您说了这么多深表歉意，我相信您能完好无损地收到这封信。请尽快与我联系。您就要发财了。

english: Knowing of your high trustworthiness and repute, I seek your consent if you are unequivocably interested to present you as Next Of Kin of the deceased so that the funds of $15.5m would be released into your bank account as the aforementioned Next Of Kin.
zh: 我知道您非常值得信赖，也很有声望，若您愿意接受死者最近亲属的身份，之后1550万美元的遗产就会进入您的账户。

english: This Bank of the deceased has issued a notice instructing me to produce the Next of Kin to the aforementioned account within the next four working days or have the account confiscated.

english: After the recent murderous incident at Alderney State Correctional Facility, a security review is being called for. Sally Butters of Moms for a Police State says she's "sick and tired of criminals stealing from us. We want to put them to work in order to make the US economy the powerhouse it once was. The private medical sector has worked so well for this country, why can't we privatize everything?"
zh: 发生杀人案件以后，奥尔德尼州立监狱遭到安全检查。「警察国家之母」的成员萨莉･巴特斯表示：「犯罪者一直在窃取我们的劳动果实，我已经受够了。我们想让他们参与劳动，好让美国的经济再次强大。私营医疗机构在国内很成功，我们直接把一切都私有化不就好了？」

english: After several incidents of wrongful shooting by the Liberty City Police Departments this year, it seems that the shoe is finally on the other foot. The bodies of several police offices were found in Acter Industrial Park earlier. Amongst them, Detectives Jimmy Matthews and Ed McCornish.
zh: 在今年的多起LCPD警员不正当开枪事件后，情况发生了反转。这一次，警员成为了受害者，他们的尸体在阿克特工业园被发现。警探吉米 马修斯和埃德･麦科尼什也在受害者之列。

english: Every human needs water to survive and must expel that water - both of which have airline execs seeing green. The announcement that beleaguered airline, Air Sol, has started charging passengers to use the restrooms on all domestic and international flights could have passengers hiding their daily dump in the front seat pocket.
zh: 人类生存离不开水，也离不开排水，而这两者都被航司高管视为商机。饱受批评的Air Sol航空公司发布公告，宣布将在该公司的所有国际国内航班中推行收费厕所，这一举措或将导致某些乘客在前排座椅背后的口袋中解决三急。

english: Sources within the District Attorney's Office have revealed that there were multiple Internal Affairs investigations against these officers who were suspected of involvement in several corruption scandals. At the time of their death, the two were thought to be investigating the Angels of Death Motorcycle Club. An AODMC spokesman denied any club involvement in illegal activities. "This is typical of the LCPD, a bent cop gets what's coming to him and they blame it on decent hardworking American bikers."
zh: 据地检署内部人士透露，此前这两名警察因涉嫌腐败遭到内务部调查。遇害时他们似乎正在调查死亡天使机车俱乐部。死亡天使的发言人否认了指控，拒绝认同俱乐部涉嫌非法行为：「这就是LCPD的典型做派，明明是罪有应得的腐败警察，到头来却怪罪到正派勤劳的美国骑手身上。」

english: It's time to wake up and smell the lukewarm, germ-infested airplane coffee. This recession is barely out of the starting block. Buy gold, stay at home and pray that your pension and healthcare policy are worth more than the paper they're written on by the time you reach retirement. The time to panic has arrived.
zh: 是时候清醒过来了，闻闻这杯温热的、充满细菌的机上咖啡吧。经济萧条尚处于相当早期的阶段。购买黄金，待在家里，祈祷退休时你的养老金和医保没有贬值到不如打印纸值钱。现在该开始恐慌了。

english: It appears that it takes more than a boatload of booze and a smorgasbord of tiny reproductive organs to have a hit series these days. It was billed as: 'One island full of genetic disasters' but CNT's primetime show, Hermaphrodite Island, has been cancelled after just one season following disastrous viewing figures. The producers tried everything from Bikini Tuesdays to Absinthe Thursdays to Jockstrap Fridays but, apart from a confusing fumble between Dave and Ken in the mud pit, passion failed to ignite between the contestants and angry reality TV fans began switching off in their droves. Phoebe, the star of the show, says her calendar will be out in time for Christmas and will excite both men and women.
zh: 现在看来，爆款节目需要的不仅是一船酒水和一大票生殖器。以「充斥着灾难般基因的岛屿」为宣传标语的CNT电视台的黄金时段节目《双性岛》仅仅拍摄了一季，就因惨不忍睹的收视率被迫腰斩。制片人拿出了百般花样：比基尼周二，苦艾酒周四，三角裤周五。但除了戴夫和肯在泥坑中的混乱争球之外，参赛者之间没能擦出任何激情火花，愤怒的真人秀粉丝也纷纷换台。该节目的红人菲比表示，她的写真日历会在圣诞节推出，男人和女人都能从中找到亮点。

english: Remember the good old days of air travel? Getting served endless miniature bottles of cheap vodka by statuesque blondes in low-cut tops and short skirts? Flying used to be considered the height of luxury. Now you have to print off your own ticket, check in your own bags and submit yourself to humiliating security checks before being herded like cattle onto a filthy plane to sit for 2 hours on the runway because an undertrained stoner in air traffic control hit ESC by mistake.
zh: 还记得航空旅行的辉煌曾经吗？低胸短裙的金发美女不断为你续上廉价伏特加？坐飞机曾被认为是一种奢侈的体验。现在你得自己打印机票，自己托运行李，还被迫接受耻辱的安检，然后才能像牲口一样被赶上肮脏的飞机，再在机舱里坐上两个小时等待起飞，仅仅因为一个训练不足的瘾君子在空管室手滑按下了ESC键。

english: In an ironic twist of fate, this patriot's children were also killed by rogue acts of terrorism. The family is now headed by Congressman Thomas Stubbs, Arthur Stubb's nephew. Mr Stubbs told reporters at a conference he hastily convened "This is a tragedy. My family has given so much to this country and to freedom. Arthur Stubbs was a great. Great man. I will carry on his work fighting justice and honor wherever I find it. His death had made me a very rich man and I will use that money for good, and for insuring my re-election."
zh: 或许这是命运开的一个玩笑，这名爱国者的子女先前同样是因恐怖主义暴行遇害。现在率领家族的重任降临到了阿瑟･斯塔布斯的侄子，众议院议员托马斯 斯塔布斯身上。他在一场匆匆召开的发布会上告诉记者：「这是一场悲剧。我的家族为自由和这个国家贡献了太多。阿瑟･斯塔布斯是一位伟人，十分伟大的伟人。我会继承他的遗志，为正义和荣耀而战。他的死使我现在非常富有，我会将这笔钱用于正途，还会用于资助我的连任竞选。」

english: Arthur Stubbs, elder statesman of the legendary Stubbs political clan was gunned down by terrorists yesterday shortly after arriving at Francis International Airport. Mr. Stubbs, 83, was arriving in the city for a family meeting and to help to discuss bailing out a lot of rich people upset by the recent problems on the exchange. A passionate democrat when it suited him and also an elitist who hated poor people, Mr. Stubbs embodied an America that has mercifully disappeared. He was brutally killed standing up for freedom by a splinter cell now on the loose in Liberty City. Police are searching for the terror cell and advise people to be very afraid and report any activity by brown people.
zh: 阿瑟･斯塔布斯是传奇的斯塔布斯政治家族中的老政治家，他于昨天到达弗朗西斯国际机场的不久后惨遭恐怖分子杀害。83岁的斯塔布斯先生本要到自由城参加家族会议，并会协助商讨如何帮助近期因证券交易所爆出内幕交易而大失所望的富人。他是一个热诚的民主党人(当民主党符合他的需求时)，也是一个讨厌贫民的精英主义者，斯塔布斯先生身上颇有美国曾经的糟粕之风。他因弘扬自由被一名「独狼特工」残忍杀害，目前凶手仍然在逃。警方正在搜寻恐怖分子的窝点，并建议民众保持恐惧，及时汇报棕种人的一切活动。

english: These are just some of the words that our editors thought would lead you into reading this story. But they are also words that could be used to describe how local recently graduated workers feel about Liberty City companies who are taking advantage of them. We wish we'd been there to see it / film it / join in / all of the above. Sadly we weren't and the paps were too soggy to get some good photo journalism for us. :( Anyway, we love your newest RomCom Poppy, we don't care if you're a cum guzzling slut queen.) xxx
zh: 还有一则来自9号豪宅的新闻。波比･米切尔似乎参与了VIP包厢里的群交！波比･米切尔！我们之前还认为她是个好姑娘？我们真希望能够亲身 观看/拍摄/加入/以上全部 这场淫趴。可惜的是我们不能，而狗仔队当时都湿透了，没法拍到好的新闻照片。:( 不管怎样，我们喜欢你新拍的浪漫喜剧，波比，即便你是吞精的荡妇我们也不在乎。么么哒

english: Some paparazzi got a nasty surprise outside Maisonette 9 the other night as a rogue fire truck accidentally sprayed them with their hose. I know some people who'd kill to have a fireman turn his hose on them, but these paps aren't so happy. Several of them are getting together to launch a class action suit against the LCFD. Keeping the paps' cameras working is a hell of a lot more important that the firemen's pension plans so I say go for it. Who ever saw an old fireman anyway?
zh: 一天晚上，一些狗仔队在9号豪宅外得到了一份惊喜，他们被失控的消防车意外地喷了一身水。我知道有人很愿意被消防员的水枪射到浑身湿透，但这些狗仔队可没那么乐意。他们中的一些人计划对自由城消防局提起集体诉讼。让狗仔队的摄像机正常工作可比消防员的养老金重要多了，所以我是支持诉讼的。话又说回来了，谁又见到过上年纪的消防员呢？

english: Tourists in Star Junction got a surprise earlier when they looked up to see aging action star Chris Hunt's flaccid member flashing across the Weazel News Mega-Screen. Our sources hear that an explicit video featuring him and British debutante Daisy Cash-Cooze was broadcast to passers-by before being leaked on the internet. It was like briefly time travelling back to the nineties when people actually went to see Chris Hunt movies. They're about as old as the dinosaurs, people. That oh so familiar sense of disappointment came back too, when we realised that the only thing you get to see is a hand job! Boo! I watch hand shandies every morning in my shower! Come on Chris, you're going to have to do better than that if you expect any of us to believe that you stand to attention for anyone other than your little Filipino house boy! P-lease!
zh: 早些时候，路过星汇广场的游客一抬头就会大吃一惊，年迈的动作明星克里斯･亨特那疲软的老二正在Weazel新闻的大屏幕上播放。据我们的线人所言，当时播放的是他和英国富家女黛西 卡什-库兹的露骨视频，而这则视频甚至还没有在网络上流出。这就像短暂地回到了90年代，那时人们还会去看克里斯･亨特的电影。那些人现在已经像恐龙一样古老了。当我们发现银幕上唯一的内容是撸管时，那种熟悉的失望感也回来了！切！我每天早上洗澡的时候就能看手冲啊！别这样嘛，克里斯。如果你想让我们相信，能让你保持「坚挺」的不止是你的菲律宾男佣，那就拿点更劲爆的东西出来嘛！求求你了！

english: Want to know the real reason Vinewood leading man Bruce Spade fired his agent? He couldn't book him a gig at the Civilisation Committee. A source close to El Spado says "Bruce has been reading a lot of pamphlets on international relations recently. He's got some really interesting theories he wants to share with luminaries from around the world and thought addressing the Citadel was the perfect way to do it." When his agent couldn't secure the appointment (normally reserved for world leaders) he threw a hissy fit and tore up their contract. Hopefully his next agent will be able to help him get that Peace Prize he's been eying for the awards cabinet.
zh: 想知道好麦坞男一号布鲁斯･斯佩德解雇经纪人的真正原因吗？那位经纪人没能给他在全球文明委员会预约一场演讲。一名与这位斯佩德佬关系密切的消息人士说：「布鲁斯最近读了很多关于国际关系的刊物。从中他得出了一些非常有趣的理论，想与世界各地的杰出人士分享。而他认为在自由城的市政厅演讲就很合适。」但他的经纪人无法保证能够预约这场演讲(通常是留给世界领导人的)时，这令他大发雷霆，直接撕毁了与经纪人的合同。希望他的下一任经纪人能够帮助他获得他期待已久的诺贝尔和平奖，好摆在奖牌陈列柜里。

english: Hey Mr. Celebinator, we're big fans of your site at the club, so it's kind of confusing when we read this spiteful shit. I'm sure you don't wanna offend us, so give us a call and we'll try to work it out.
zh: 嘿，名人终结者先生，我们来自您博客中提到的夜店，同时也是您网站的忠实粉丝。您博客上这些充斥着恶意中伤的文字实在是让我们有点困惑。您肯定也不想冒犯我们，给我们打个电话，我们一起想办法解决吧。

english: Once legendary night club Mr. Big, Gay Tony is losing his touch. Rumors persist he's too wrapped up in his rent boy, Luis Lopez, to worry about running a decent club any more. Tony, who was a big star before the internet but has seen his popularity begin to wane, really should try relaxing his notoriously strict door policy and letting people in. Now it seems Tony and Luis are too busy staring into each other's eyes to worry about the fact their drinks are overpriced, their music is lame and even worse, the cool people simply don't go to their shitty clubs anymore. Bye bye!
zh: 曾经的传奇夜店大亨，基佬托尼，正在淡出人们的视野。有传言称他把精力都放在他的男妓路易斯･洛佩兹上，已经无暇经营一家像样的夜店了。托尼是互联网时代之前的大明星，但他的知名度正在逐渐下滑。早该放宽他那出了名严格的准入政策了，多放点人进去吧。估计现在托尼正忙着和路易斯深情对视，根本没空关心店里饮料价格虚高、音乐太差劲之类的问题。更糟糕的是，潮人根本就不去他们的垃圾夜店了。拜拜！
