zh: ~z~我倒想看看对面不老实的时候你们有多能打。

english: ~z~Look look look look look - I know you think we small, I know you think we ain't shit - but that's why I hit you up man.
zh: ~z~喂喂喂喂喂，我知道你看不起我们，知道你不把我们当回事。但就是这样我才会找你，兄弟。

english: ~z~This deal ain't completely worked through and we thought it might look good having you along.
zh: ~z~这桩生意其实还没谈拢，我们觉得叫上你会有气势点，显得我们没那么菜。

english: ~z~Fuck them. You had some good times here. Don't forget about that shit. Remember the summer of '99?
zh: ~z~去他妈的。这里还有你的快乐回忆，别把这忘了。还记得99年的夏天吗？

english: ~z~Yeah. Don't condescend at us. Especially since prison was a good thing for you.
zh: ~z~是啊，别对我们秀优越。何况上次进局子对你也是好事。

english: ~z~Luis, you don't got to worry about shit. Papi's a businessman. Legit.
zh: ~z~路易斯，用不着担心这个。帕皮是生意人，正经的。

english: ~z~It ain't gonna look good if we bring cops to the meet, bro. Ditch them.
zh: ~z~带着条子去见面不太合适，兄弟。甩掉他们。

english: ~z~We, ummmm... we need to put out a public face.
zh: ~z~我们...光我俩不够有牌面。

english: ~z~I hope they don't pick up your connect, bro. He knows my name.
zh: ~z~希望那个上家不会被抓，兄弟。他知道我的名字。

english: ~z~Yo, enough with the gay jokes, you moron. For once, give me a break.
zh: ~z~哟，别讲基佬笑话了，傻逼。真的，放过我吧。

english: ~z~Hit you with what? I ain't dickslapping you, homo.
zh: ~z~嗦一嗦个屁啊？我不会拿屌甩你脸的，基佬。

english: ~z~ Package don't mean shit if we get our asses shot off or incarcerated. Let's get outta here.
zh: ~z~要是没了小命或者进了局子，进到货也没用。赶紧跑路吧。

english: ~z~Five-0 think you do.
zh: ~z~条子不这么想。

english: ~z~Good for you guys, but what's this got to do with me?
zh: ~z~那还挺好的，不过跟我有什么关系？

english: ~z~Papi ain't gonna stick around if we got this attention. We need to lose it.
zh: ~z~被警察盯着的话，帕皮就不会出现了。得先甩掉他们。

english: ~z~H is still back there, bro.
zh: ~z~H还没跟上，兄弟。

english: ~z~Oh yeah. Sure it ain't, man. How many kids from our class stuck around up here?
zh: ~z~哦对，是不太坏，老兄。我们班多少人一辈子就在这儿了？

english: ~z~Sorry, L. We didn't mean to get you into this shit.
zh: ~z~对不起，L。我们不是故意找你麻烦的。

english: ~z~Yeah, dick sucking's well below board. You right.
zh: ~z~确实，舔屌这事见不得光，没错。

english: ~z~Nothing quite like college girls.
zh: ~z~还是学生妹好啊。

english: ~z~We can't meet no connect with a police escort. We got to lose these fucks.
zh: ~z~有警察护送还怎么做生意，得甩掉这帮混蛋。

english: ~z~You ain't going back inside, L. We look after you.
zh: ~z~你不会再进去的，L。有我们在。

english: ~z~Luis, take your life more seriously, baby. Please. Don't be like your father.
zh: ~z~路易斯，你一定要好好活，宝贝。求你了。别像你爸那样。

english: ~z~Yo, H, I'm sorry, but life don't quite work that way. Stay safe, okay?
zh: ~z~哟，H，对不起，但计划还是赶不上变化。注意安全，好吗？

english: ~z~Alright bro, I was young. I was stupid. But more importantly you getting any toto yourself at the moment?
zh: ~z~行了兄弟。那会儿我还小，很傻逼。不过现在你们都有女人了吗？

english: ~z~We was just close friends. Whatever anyone told you is fucking bullshit, man. Fucking bullshit!
zh: ~z~他就是我一哥们儿。别人说的那些都他妈是扯淡，兄弟。全他妈扯淡！

english: ~z~We got a minor problem with this door. Hold on.
zh: ~z~车门一时半会儿打不开，等下。

english: ~z~Nice work, bro.
zh: ~z~干得不错，兄弟。

english: ~z~There's enough chumps out there to do that work for you. Just get involved in the high level shit.
zh: ~z~随便找个白痴就能替你们派货，别在底层给人打工了。

english: ~z~Well shit did fuck up and I nearly got killed so I think I earned the right to be heard for a second.
zh: ~z~但确实出岔子了，我也差点没命。所以我应该有权利让你们听我说话。

english: ~z~I had to cut that girl loose, bro. You're lucky I did, otherwise you wouldn't be getting shit right now.
zh: ~z~我只能跟她分手，兄弟。幸好我跟她分了，否则你压根就操不到她。

english: ~z~Let's go! Let's go! We screwed if we stay here.
zh: ~z~走吧走吧！不动命就没了。

english: ~z~I don't think you do.
zh: ~z~这你不会吧。

english: ~z~I ain't getting caught up in another narco bust. Fuck!
zh: ~z~我不会再被缉毒队抓回去的，操！

english: ~z~How the fuck we gonna get rid of this thing? Check the NOOSE van, L. They might be something in there.
zh: ~z~这他妈要怎么打？看看NOOSE的车，L。里面说不定有武器。

english: ~z~That wasn't blood running down your leg, bro. You just wet yourself.
zh: ~z~你腿上沾的不是血，兄弟。你尿了而已。

english: ~z~They ain't exactly gonna call up five-0 are they?
zh: ~z~冤大头可不会为此报警吧？

english: ~z~You don't know us.
zh: ~z~你不了解我们。

english: ~z~Who hasn't had this piece of ass?
zh: ~z~这破鞋还有谁没上过？

english: ~z~Yeah, I ain't lecturing. I'm just looking out for my boys.
zh: ~z~喂，我没在讲课，是在关心兄弟。

english: ~z~This thing is holding us down, bro. Check that motherfucking NOOSE van. See if they got something can help.
zh: ~z~直升机在跑不了，兄弟。看看傻逼NOOSE的卡车，说不定有能用上的家伙。

english: ~z~You don't got shit on us.
zh: ~z~你们没有证据。

english: ~z~Putting him to work on a corner don't seem much like protecting him to me man. I'm out.
zh: ~z~我不觉得让他去路边贩毒是保护他，哥们。我走了。

english: ~z~That all well and good, bro. But selling ain't our issue. It's getting hold of product.
zh: ~z~确实很有道理，兄弟。但销售不成问题，重点是找到货源。

english: ~z~I'm cool, L. I thought for a second they mighta shot my freaking balls off.
zh: ~z~我没事，L。不过我差点以为蛋被打爆了。

english: ~z~You run Tony's shit, do you? Where's the money then?
zh: ~z~你给托尼打杂呢，不是吗？那钱呢？

english: ~z~Thanks, bro. Me and Rique mighta been fucked up if you weren't around for us.
zh: ~z~谢了兄弟。要不是有你在，我跟恩里克可能就被抓了。

english: ~z~We ain't staying still. Come on.
zh: ~z~别傻站着，快上。

english: ~z~We ain't moving with that thing there. See if there's something we can take it out with in that NOOSE van.
zh: ~z~直升机在我们跑不掉的。看看NOOSE的卡车里面有没有能用的装备。

english: ~z~Thanks for the lecture, professor. I didn't know a two year stretch qualified you to teach Street Life 101.
zh: ~z~说得太好了，教授。没想到你进号子蹲了两年，出来都能教我们黑社会入门了。

english: ~z~Armando ain't here, bro. Shit.
zh: ~z~阿曼多人没了，兄弟。操。

english: ~z~At least I didn't abandon him for some rich downtown assholes. Fuck off.
zh: ~z~至少我没为了城里的哪个阔佬就抛弃他。你滚吧。

english: ~z~What are you talking about? There's product all over the city. Just take it off motherfuckers.
zh: ~z~你说什么呢？城里最多的不就是货？找个冤大头就是了。

english: ~z~Look. As you say, I ain't an expert in this shit, but I do run a business.
zh: ~z~听着。如你所说，我不是道上的专家，但我确实在做生意。

english: ~z~Fuck! Rique, bro, pop test. What you do when you got cops behind you and a dead end in front?
zh: ~z~操！恩里克，兄弟，我考考你。后有追兵前无出路该怎么办？

english: ~z~We ain't getting out of here with her pinning us down like this. Take this and get her out the sky, shooter.
zh: ~z~被她这样咬着咱是跑不掉的。拿这个把她从天上打下来，射手。

english: ~z~These boys ain't going down.
zh: ~z~这些人就是不肯松手。

english: ~z~I don't see why you guys are giving me shit. You was the ones who asked me to come along on this thing.
zh: ~z~你们没事找我麻烦干嘛？这次就是你把我拖下水的。

english: ~z~I ain't going back.
zh: ~z~我不会二进宫的。

english: ~z~This don't look good, L. Can you take this and try to sink the chopper. I don't trust my aim.
zh: ~z~情况不太妙啊，L。你能拿这个把直升机打下来吗？我准头不大好。

english: ~z~We might just have to start ripping people off. You gonna help us?
zh: ~z~我们说不定是该开始抢货了。你会帮我们吗？

english: ~z~Demolitions! We got us a dead end. You ready?
zh: ~z~拆了它！前面没路了。准备好没？

english: ~z~Thanks, bro. You know I hate to ask this now you all Johnny lawful and shit,
zh: ~z~谢了兄弟。你现在是守法公民，我也不太想拉你下水。

english: ~z~That wasn't good, bro. I thought we was gonna be rich after today.
zh: ~z~这可不好啊，兄弟。我还以为过了今天我们就发财了。

english: ~z~Yo, man. I don't know. I could do with the money but you boys is clowns.
zh: ~z~哟，兄弟。我不知道。给钱我就肯帮，但你俩有点菜。

english: ~z~You neither, captain. Later on.
zh: ~z~你不也是，大哥。再见了。

english: ~z~Mrs. Lebowitz? Didn't you go back and screw that bitch, L?
zh: ~z~莱博维茨老师？你没回去干那婊子吗，L？

english: ~z~I ain't letting them cops get H. We got to go back.
zh: ~z~不能让条子抓住H。快回去找他。

english: ~z~Whole load of work for nothing, bro. Fuck!
zh: ~z~竹篮打水一场空，兄弟。操！

english: ~z~Fuck! We can't leave H.
zh: ~z~操！咱不能抛下H。

english: ~z~I pissed myself, did I? You the one who couldn't hold it in in Mrs. Lebowitz's class?
zh: ~z~我是尿了，怎么？在莱博维茨老师的课上没憋住的是谁来着？

english: ~z~Chill out, bro.
zh: ~z~别急，兄弟。

english: ~z~You ain't getting this shit.
zh: ~z~你们拿不到的。

english: ~z~Don't get distracted, yo. Load that shit up.
zh: ~z~别被干扰了，哟。赶快装货。

english: ~z~He always was a college fool. Kid loved the Vespucci scene more than us, didn't he?
zh: ~z~他一直是个书呆子。这逼比咱还怀念韦斯普奇的满园春色呢，不是吗？

english: ~z~Yo L, can you check out the boats for anything that seems funky?
zh: ~z~哟L，你去检查下船上有没有什么可疑物品好吗？

english: ~z~You boys gonna tell me what's happening here?
zh: ~z~你俩打算不告诉我来这儿干嘛吗？

english: ~z~Go to school. Go somewhere. It's not too late, my baby.
zh: ~z~去念书，干点正事。还来得及，我的宝贝。

english: ~z~There gonna be too many people under our purview to cope on our own.
zh: ~z~这么多人光靠我俩盯不过来。

english: ~z~What we meant to do if we don't got the rep to be able to control our own shipments?
zh: ~z~我们的信誉还拿不到一手的货源，你说怎么办？

english: ~z~You saw what went down the other day.
zh: ~z~上次你又不是不在。

english: ~z~I mean, it's a beautiful thing, but you gotta let them into the house?
zh: ~z~照顾他们是件好事，但没必要让他们进屋吧？

english: ~z~Fool couldn't even spell SAT, let alone GED, I doubt he can even spell ABC.
zh: ~z~但这蠢逼一不识SAT，二不认GED，估计都不会写ABC。

english: ~z~Okay. Okay. Enough of the flattery. I'll help you guys.
zh: ~z~得了，得了。别吹了，这忙我帮了。

english: ~z~We can't bring five-o to this party, bro. Lose them.
zh: ~z~咱不能把条子带进场地，兄弟。甩掉他们。

english: ~z~You ain't ripping off these motherfuckers.
zh: ~z~别想把货抢走，傻逼玩意。

english: ~z~I mean you a fuckin' Dominican. All Dominican mommas ride their hijos like that. You think me and Rique don't get shit too?
zh: ~z~你他妈是多米尼加人啊。多米尼加人的妈都爱数落自家孩子。我和恩里克又不是没被数落过。

english: ~z~Yeah well, call one of your other kids. The one you ain't ashamed of.
zh: ~z~那好，你不是还有俩孩子吗，找那俩骄傲去啊。

english: ~z~It would be a serious bad idea to show the law this shipment. We better lose them before we head there.
zh: ~z~带着执法大队卸货可不是个好主意。到之前最好甩了他们。

english: ~z~We don't get paid we don't protect this shit.
zh: ~z~保不住货我们就没钱拿了。

english: ~z~Yo. I don't think so.
zh: ~z~哟，你们别想了。

english: ~z~Hope this is worth it.
zh: ~z~希望这波不亏。

english: ~z~Hanging downtown made you forget who you is, L.
zh: ~z~城里待久了都不记得自己是谁了是吧，L。

english: ~z~I had a bad feeling about this.
zh: ~z~我早就有不祥的预感了。

english: ~z~Professor Lopez from the University of Downtown. Department of "I'm a expert in fucking everything".
zh: ~z~来自都市大学「没有人比我更懂XX学院」的洛佩兹教授。

english: ~z~That don't sound good, bro.
zh: ~z~声音不太对，兄弟。

english: ~z~You ain't robbing us today.
zh: ~z~今天你们别想把货抢走。

english: ~z~My pleasure, bro
zh: ~z~不客气，兄弟。

english: ~z~That just the way things is in the business. Bro, we walked away with the shit.
zh: ~z~做生意就是这样的。兄弟，货不是还在手里吗。

english: ~z~Luis, I love you, bro. But you part time. Life up here keeps going when you off with them rich people.
zh: ~z~路易斯，我爱你，兄弟。但你不常在啊。你跟阔佬打交道的时候我们就不过日子了吗。

english: ~z~Nah, bro. I just like saying it.
zh: ~z~不知道，兄弟。单纯喜欢这个词而已。

english: ~z~He didn't see that one coming, did he? Stay in touch, bro.
zh: ~z~那是他没想到的，对吧？保持联系，兄弟。

english: ~z~They came at us, bro. It weren't our fault they gone now.
zh: ~z~是他们找上来的，兄弟。他们死了不怪我们。

english: ~z~That all they got. They pussies, boy.
zh: ~z~他们没人了，都是菜鸡，兄弟。

english: ~z~I need to eat, bro. We can't get fussy.
zh: ~z~要吃饭的啊，兄弟。咱没得选。

english: ~z~I think that's all of them.
zh: ~z~估计他们没有后手了。

english: ~z~Then see if that shit's real money.
zh: ~z~你看这钱算数不算数。

english: ~z~Only way to work.
zh: ~z~咱也干不了别的。

english: ~z~You everyone's bitch! I'm sorry, Henrique, but you ain't got shit.
zh: ~z~谁都把你当狗使！我很抱歉，恩里克，但你真不是什么人物。

english: ~z~Luis, bro, what the fuck? They some important party downtown that you forgot about? You have to run off?
zh: ~z~路易斯，兄弟，搞什么鬼？赶着去城里的哪个大派对吗？非得现在跑去？

english: ~z~I ain't the one being paid to oversee the shipment.
zh: ~z~我又没被人雇来保护货物。

english: ~z~This ain't real money. Take how much you get paid for this and divide it by how many bodies you had to drop back there.
zh: ~z~这钱没有用。数数你到手多少钱，除上刚才杀掉的人数。

english: ~z~You'd be surprised.
zh: ~z~跟你想的不一样。

english: ~z~Nah, bro. You don't need to work this hard. It's just the only way you know about.
zh: ~z~不，兄弟。没必要这么拼。只是你们不知道能干别的而已。

english: ~z~This may be shit, but at least we work for ourselves. We ain't someone's bitch.
zh: ~z~可能是不太好，但至少我们是为自己工作，不是给谁当狗。

english: ~z~We can't just leave Henrique behind. Dumb as he is, he's useful.
zh: ~z~咱不能把恩里克落下。虽然他傻，但他还是有用的。

english: ~z~Bet you don't get action like this with them downtown rich kids.
zh: ~z~估计跟城里的富家子弟处一起见不到这种场面吧。

english: ~z~Seems like we always are, H.
zh: ~z~有哪次没遇上，H。

english: ~z~Don't shoot me.
zh: ~z~别打我。

english: ~z~We don't all got what you got, L. I ain't got your looks. I ain't got your brains.
zh: ~z~我们没有你的条件，L。我没你那么帅，没你那么聪明。

english: ~z~Luis, man. We need your help. Don't go nowhere.
zh: ~z~路易斯，哥们。咱需要你的帮助。别乱跑。

english: ~z~Something like that. Look, I'll call you soon, okay. Later on.
zh: ~z~差不多吧。听着，我晚点给你电话，好吗？再见了。

english: ~z~Fuck, bro. At least we ain't there when the police is showing up. That's the one consolation I can think of.
zh: ~z~操，兄弟。至少我们没被警察抓到现行，让我还算欣慰。

english: ~z~Hey, you got me too, bro. Don't forget about that.
zh: ~z~嘿，你不还有我吗，兄弟。别忘了呀。

english: ~z~I wasn't meant to be doing anything. I was doing you a favor. See you soon, bro.
zh: ~z~本来我根本不用来这儿，我只是来帮你个忙。再见了，兄弟。

english: ~z~Oh shit! Captain Downtown can't be doing that well after all.
zh: ~z~哦操！城里的大佬也没那么能干嘛。

english: ~z~I guess they don't got tables for you to practice on at your Downtown haunts.
zh: ~z~你们城里人是不是没地方练桌上冰球啊。

english: ~z~There a Burger Shot near here, ain't there? Unless you too good for that shit now.
zh: ~z~附近是不是有家吃得饱汉堡来着？你不会已经高贵到不吃这些垃圾了吧。

english: ~z~You part time motherfucker. I can round up Rique for you. I think he probably forgot who you are though.
zh: ~z~这可是位稀客啊。我可以帮你叫上恩里克。不过他可能都不认识你了。

english: ~z~This some homo game you playing. I don't like it.
zh: ~z~这种基情四射的游戏是你玩的。我不喜欢。

english: ~z~If you ain't gonna have time to finish bowling why you start in the first place.
zh: ~z~要是你都没空打完整局，那你约你妈呢。

english: ~z~I always had a better eye than you. Yeah.
zh: ~z~我眼睛一直比你好，没错。

english: ~z~Me and H had a bet on whether you'd show. Thanks, L. You just made me some money.
zh: ~z~我和H赌了你到底会不会来。谢了L，你让我赢钱了。

english: ~z~I spent enough on gas. I ain't giving you shit as well. Sorry, bro.
zh: ~z~油钱已经是倒贴了，不可能连枪都白送。对不起，兄弟。

english: ~z~I should stop selling drugs, bro. Getting these guns is so much easier.
zh: ~z~我还贩什么毒啊，兄弟。倒卖军火不是比贩毒赚钱。

english: ~z~Yo. What time is it? I ain't even nearly awake yet.
zh: ~z~哟，现在几点？我还没睡醒呢。

english: ~z~Why don't you ask your sugar daddy for a loan?
zh: ~z~你咋不去找干爹借点钱呢？

english: ~z~I ain't got money to replace this. Chill, bro.
zh: ~z~我没钱换车，冷静点，兄弟。

english: ~z~Oye, I'd love to hang with you and H, but the schedule don't permit.
zh: ~z~喂，我很想跟你和H一起出去，但实在排不出时间啊。

english: ~z~Them pucks move too fast for a man in my state. Shit's a blur.
zh: ~z~我刚才都看不清球在哪里，太糊了儿。

english: ~z~Darts motherfucker! Ain't so bad hanging with us.
zh: ~z~傻逼飞镖！和我们出来也没那么无聊吧。

english: ~z~If you ain't got time for golf, what do you got time for?

zh: ~z~那这样行不行，L？只要你也尊重我们，我和恩里克就不再逼你回心转意了。

english: ~z~You ain't going, man. I told you that.
zh: ~z~你不能回去，哥们。我说过的。

english: ~z~Just don't drag H down with you, street genius, that's all.
zh: ~z~那你别把H也拖下水，街头天才。就这样。

english: ~z~Maybe some people do. But, yeah, whatever, bro.
zh: ~z~也有人会变吧。不过确实，随便吧，兄弟。

english: ~z~And it don't mean I can't help you guys go legit neither.
zh: ~z~也不代表我不愿意帮你们上岸改行。

english: ~z~Listen, I know you didn't get me in worse shit, but I do know you got someone in worse shit. And I don't give a fuck.
zh: ~z~听着，我知道你当年没害得我更糟，但我知道你害了别人。但我不在乎。

english: ~z~Dope ain't a long term game.
zh: ~z~贩毒可不是长远的工作。

english: ~z~Damn right I am.
zh: ~z~可不就是我吗。

english: ~z~Damn straight.
zh: ~z~哈哈，可不是嘛。

english: ~z~You'd get a medal for that - services to humanity.
zh: ~z~那不得给你送面锦旗——为民除害。

english: ~z~Well, I went down and you didn't. So what was it, huh? Did you squeal?
zh: ~z~当年我进去了，你没有。那算什么，啊？你丫告密了？

english: ~z~Well, I gotta change.
zh: ~z~是吗，以后就不是了。

english: ~z~Jesus - that's funny coming from you. We hear what you've been getting up to. We know what you like.
zh: ~z~天哪，这话轮不到你说。我们知道你平常干什么，知道你是什么人。

english: ~z~He's like that 'cause you the least dependable guy, A. And you always getting into us fuckin' fights.
zh: ~z~他变成这样，都是因为你太靠不住，A。而且你还整天给我们找架打。

english: ~z~I guess I ain't so riddled with insecurity as you. I'm happy with who I am.
zh: ~z~大概我没你那么缺乏安全感。我对自己很满意。

english: ~z~You know that ain't how I think, H.
zh: ~z~你知道我不是这么想的，H。

english: ~z~Yeah, only I hope with better results. Maybe this time, I can avoid a bid in a correctional facility.
zh: ~z~是啊，希望这次有更好的结果吧。说不定这次我不会被抓去坐牢。

english: ~z~Let's try to keep things cool, okay?
zh: ~z~不要惹是生非，好吗？

english: ~z~I ain't talking "when you can". I'm talking ditch this other shit and we gonna make something go.
zh: ~z~我不是问你「哪天有空」。我的意思是让你抛下别的，我们一起干些大事。

english: ~z~even though we seem to hate each other.
zh: ~z~虽然嘴上都不客气。

english: ~z~Yo man! Fuck, I don't wanna abuse your generosity, but I need a Bullet like right now. That cool, bro?
zh: ~z~哟，哥们！操，我不想滥用你的好意，但我现在需要一辆Bullet。可以吗，兄弟？

english: ~z~We can't right now, man. Armando has some scheme we working on. Another time.
zh: ~z~现在来不了，哥们。阿曼多跟我在忙呢。改天吧。

english: ~z~We can't leave A like that. He my boss. Let's go back.
zh: ~z~我们不能抛下A不管。他是我老板。回去找他吧。

english: ~z~Thanks Luis. For nothing.
zh: ~z~谢了，路易斯，我谢谢你啊。

english: ~z~L, nice to talk to you, but I can't help out. I got some things to handle in the Heights. I hope you gonna be okay.
zh: ~z~L，跟你聊天很高兴，但我帮不了你。我在高地这边有事要忙。希望你没事。

english: ~z~I don't like leaving shit unfinished.
zh: ~z~我不喜欢半途而废。

english: ~z~What we got to do that better than darts.
zh: ~z~不玩飞镖的话还要去哪儿？

english: ~z~Sorry man, I'm having a nap.
zh: ~z~不好意思，哥们，我在补觉呢。

english: ~z~Hey, bro. I don't want you taking uneccessary risks, but I could really use a NOOSE Tank. There somewhere you can find one?
zh: ~z~嘿，兄弟，我不想让你冒不必要的险，但我急需一辆NOOSE的装甲车。你能去哪儿弄一辆吗？

english: ~z~Sorry dude, I'm resting - some other time.
zh: ~z~不好意思，老兄，我休息呢。改天吧。

english: ~z~Sorry bro, but I can't hang.
zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟，我来不了。

english: ~z~Sorry H, but I can't hang right now. Some shit came up.
zh: ~z~抱歉，H，但我现在来不了。有急事要忙。

english: ~z~Sorry I didn't get your call. Please try back later.
zh: ~z~抱歉，现在接不了电话。晚点再打吧。

english: ~z~Hey, you seen that. We even, bro.
zh: ~z~嘿，看到没。打平了，兄弟。

english: ~z~Okay man, sure. We'll be waiting for you. Don't leave us waiting too long.
zh: ~z~好的哥们，没问题。我们等你过来。别让我们等太久。

english: ~z~It a shame we didn't finish that frame, L. Damn.
zh: ~z~这把没打完真是可惜，L。该死。

english: ~z~Oye monstruo, I got a problem, I can't hang out right now.
zh: ~z~喂，猛男。出了点事，我现在来不了。

english: ~z~Sorry, homie, but I can't hang right now. Something just came up.
zh: ~z~抱歉，哥们儿，但我现在来不了。有事情要忙。

english: ~z~You can't say I'm dumb, bro. Because that, like, a tactical game too.
zh: ~z~你不能说我傻，兄弟。因为打台球是要动脑子的。

english: ~z~Sorry I was boring you, man.
zh: ~z~对不起，我无聊到你了，哥们。

english: ~z~I thought you was dead, bro. I miss you, man. Come on, come pick us up, but trust me, Armando gonna be annoying, but I look forward to seeing you.
zh: ~z~原来你没死啊，兄弟。我好想你，哥们。来吧，过来接我们吧，我很想见你。

english: ~z~Dimelo, fam. I don't wanna trouble you but I got need for a Turismo. You think maybe you could bring one?
zh: ~z~说真的，哥们，我不想麻烦你，但我需要一辆远途。你能给我送一辆来吗？

english: ~z~I know they ain't eighteen holes on a driving range, but we shoulda like gone the whole eighteen. You get me?
zh: ~z~我知道练习场不是标准的18个洞，但是我们还是得打完全程。懂了吗？

english: ~z~Sure man, we ain't up to shit, come and pick us up.
zh: ~z~当然了，哥们。现在没啥忙的，来接我们吧。

english: ~z~Sometimes I wish I could bowl instead of working in the corners.
zh: ~z~有时候我都希望自己能靠保龄球吃饭，不用贩毒。

english: ~z~L man, of course, but I ain't from you in time... you know how annoying Mando gets and you leave me with him? So hurry the fuck up.
zh: ~z~L哥，当然了，但你好久没联系我了...你知道阿曼多现在有多烦人吗？快他妈过来。

english: ~z~We can't right now, L. Armando has gone off some place and I've got to wait for him. Later, though, for sure.
zh: ~z~现在不行啊，L。阿曼多不知道去哪儿了，我得等着他。以后再说吧。

english: ~z~Where you been fool? You wanna hang out or have you finally given up on us?
zh: ~z~你去哪儿了，傻逼？出来玩吗？还是说终于瞧不上咱们了？

english: ~z~Do you and your angry little friend want to hang out?
zh: ~z~你和你家的不高兴想出来玩吗？

english: ~z~I didn't wanna say but I was getting' real dizzy staring at that board.
zh: ~z~我也不想说出来，但盯着那块板看得我头晕。

english: ~z~Is'nt Hercules your favorite spot, L? I know you got a job there.
zh: ~z~大力神不是你最爱的地方吗，L？我知道你在那儿上班。

english: ~z~Okay ,an, but where you been? You getting too cool for us, I guess, but be good to see you any how.
zh: ~z~好吧，哥们，不过你去哪儿了？你也太冷落我们了吧，不过还能见到你就好。

english: ~z~Why didn't we finish the game, yo.
zh: ~z~怎么不打完再走呢，哟。

english: ~z~Mira, monstruo. What you doing? You think you could swing by in the pickup truck.
zh: ~z~听着，猛男。在忙啥呢？你能不能开你的皮卡车过来呢？

english: ~z~Sorry dude, but you always was shit at that.
zh: ~z~不好意思，老兄，但你桌上冰球是真菜。

english: ~z~You ain't bad at this shit, L.
zh: ~z~你技术还不错嘛，L。

english: ~z~Oye, bro. I'm in a real rush, and I was thinking I could use a Buffalo. You think you could get your hands on one?
zh: ~z~喂，兄弟。我现在很急，我在想能不能弄辆猛牛开。你能帮我弄一辆吗？

english: ~z~Hey bro - remember me? You wanna hang?
zh: ~z~嘿兄弟，还记得我吗？出来玩不？

english: ~z~Shit, bro. I'm real sorry, but I can't help you. Sorry, bro.
zh: ~z~操，兄弟。真不好意思，我实在帮不了你。对不起了，兄弟。

english: ~z~Sorry man, but it's different when you play with men... wait.. that sounded wrong.
zh: ~z~不好意思，哥们，和男人打跟和男人打是不一样...等等，这话不太对。

english: ~z~Oh, it's you... where you been man? We been missing you, sure we can hang, I'm just saying it's sad that's all.
zh: ~z~你去哪儿了，哥们？我们一直在想你。我们都有空，但你一直不来我们会难过的。

english: ~z~I coming right at you with that shit, L. Anything to help out a friend.
zh: ~z~我开着车过来了，L。为了朋友在所不辞。

english: ~z~I won, yo. You see that, bro? I won.
zh: ~z~我赢啦，哟。看到没，兄弟？我赢啦。

english: ~z~You didn't go easy on me, L? I won fair.
zh: ~z~你没给我放水吧，L？我正经地赢了。

english: ~z~You owe me a rematch now, bor. Don't duck out on it. You owe me a rematch.
zh: ~z~你现在欠我场重赛，兄弟。别想逃。你欠我场重赛。

english: ~z~We done with the pool shit. Man, I'm getting real horny.
zh: ~z~下次别打台球了。哥们，我好饥渴啊。

english: ~z~I can't right now bro.
zh: ~z~现在来不了，兄弟。

english: ~z~Cool, cause it's good to know people don't give a shit about you, man.
zh: ~z~好，认清一个人的丑恶嘴脸我血赚不亏，哥们。

english: ~z~You boys up to anything? Want to hang out?
zh: ~z~你们伙计俩忙吗？想不想出来玩？

english: ~z~Oye, sorry H, but I got mad shit going on right now.
zh: ~z~不好意思，H，我现在一堆破事忙炸了。

english: ~z~Shit, sorry L, kind of tied up right now. Maybe later.
zh: ~z~操，对不起，L。现在有点忙，晚点再说吧。

english: ~z~Rique, it's Luis, bro. I was thinking I could really use a Bullet. You know of one that might be available?
zh: ~z~恩里克，我是路易斯，兄弟。我现在正好需要辆Bullet。你有没有盯上哪辆能开的？

english: ~z~I guess we'll finish when you're not on your period.
zh: ~z~那就等你经期过了再补上这局吧。

english: ~z~I can't do that right now. Armando got me looking after some stuff for him. I don't want him to get angry again.
zh: ~z~我现在来不了。阿曼多叫我帮他看批货。我不想又惹他生气。

english: ~z~when you stop shoving half of Bolivia up your nose every Saturday night.
zh: ~z~只要你每周六晚不把半个玻利维亚的毒品吸到肚！

english: ~z~That's gonna narrow the search ain't it?
zh: ~z~这不是又把范围缩小了？

english: ~z~I don't think that's such a good idea.
zh: ~z~但这可不是个好主意。

english: ~z~Yeah. Mami, don't be like that. Okay?
zh: ~z~对。老妈，别这样。好吗？

english: ~z~Boss, yo, look. That guy said he might put me in his show. Don't let him forget about me, will you?
zh: ~z~哟，老大，听着。那家伙说他可能让我上他的节目。别让他忘了我，好吗？

english: ~z~Like I said man, everything's a little fuzzy.
zh: ~z~我说了，伙计，我还没缓过来。

english: ~z~That's gonna make it hard for them to find us isn't it?
zh: ~z~这不是更容易让我们被抓？

english: ~z~Fuck these people, fuck your cause, that shit's over.
zh: ~z~干他们全家，干你丫的理由。差不多得了。

english: ~z~Don't tell that guy the party's over, L.
zh: ~z~别告诉那家伙派对结束了，L。

english: ~z~I wish I didn't need to keep coming here, but I'm that kind of degenerate.
zh: ~z~希望我不用一直来这儿，但我就是那种败类。

english: ~z~~c~ Fight the power, dog.
zh: ~z~~c~不畏强权，老哥。

english: ~z~I ain't bought this time, but I know what I want for Christmas.
zh: ~z~这次就不买了，但我想好圣诞节要买什么了。

english: ~z~~x~This the same as a bus tour only we higher up.
zh: ~z~~x~妈的，这不就是天上的观光巴士。

english: ~z~Hey if Tony gave you my number, then it's okay bro.
zh: ~z~嘿，既然托尼给了你我的电话，那就没有问题，兄弟。

english: ~z~Ray, hey man, I hate to disappoint you.
zh: ~z~雷，嘿伙计，我不想让你失望。

english: ~z~Now I do something and it ain't good enough because I ain't hanging out around the neighborhood with them.
zh: ~z~现在我做了什么了，你又嫌弃我没跟他们混在一起。

english: ~z~Yusuf. You staying out of trouble, man?
zh: ~z~尤瑟夫。你没遇上麻烦吧，哥们？

english: ~z~They aren't as bright as you and you have disrespected them. Laughed at them with your rich friends
zh: ~z~他们没你那么有活力。你还对他们不尊重，和阔佬朋友一起嘲笑他们。

english: ~z~and I know it takes a lot to put up with you and keep you on the path.
zh: ~z~我还知道跟你长期相处、让你不误入歧途很难。

english: ~z~You better believe it, bro. Totally guilt free. It's business, business, business with me.
zh: ~z~你一定要相信我，兄弟。完全无罪。我一直在工作、工作、工作。

english: ~z~Listen, I thought you should know that things is cool with Tony now. It looks like we might be okay.
zh: ~z~听着，现在托尼这边没事了，我跟你说一声。应该不会有事了。

english: ~z~Heh heh, yeah. Kibbutz on a motherfucking kibbutz, huh! Yeah but I've taken this shit over.
zh: ~z~没错。基布兹现在在基布兹，哈！但这里已经归我管了。

english: ~z~Anyway, it changes. Give him a break, for me okay?
zh: ~z~总之，经常变的。别逼他太紧，看在我的面子上。

english: ~z~Look, I just wanted to apologize to you. I was an asshole.
zh: ~z~听着，我想跟你道个歉。之前是我不对。

english: ~z~You are though to the M. Kibbutz Holding Company, Tanya's away from her desk.
zh: ~z~感谢联系M. 基布兹控股公司，坦尼娅现在不在。

english: ~z~Yeah but, but it's a commune?
zh: ~z~是啊，不过你这是公社？

english: ~z~And you haven't got any time for your old friends.
zh: ~z~忙到没空见老朋友了是吧。

english: ~z~Don't you "Yo" me. You think I'm one of your little nightclub putas?
zh: ~z~别跟我「哟」。你当我是夜店里的婊子吗？

english: ~z~Bandstand? Huh, Dios Mio. Look, I can't ever win with you. I love you, Mami.
zh: ~z~舞台？我的天哪。行吧，说不过你。我爱你，老妈。

english: ~z~Thanks a lot, bro. You didn't need to do that though.
zh: ~z~多谢了，兄弟。没必要这么客气的。

english: ~z~It's a special machine, but what you have done for me recently is more special.
zh: ~z~这是辆特别的车，但你之前为我做的事，更加特别。

english: ~z~What you doing with that man? Why don't you go to college like a good boy.
zh: ~z~你跟他在一起干嘛？为什么不能做个上大学的好孩子？

english: ~z~Don't you disrespect that man.
zh: ~z~我不许你不尊重他。

english: ~z~Shit, I think the signal's dropping, man. Later, bro.
zh: ~z~妈的，好像信号不太好，伙计。回见，兄弟。

english: ~z~ Don't speak back to me, son.
zh: ~z~别跟我顶嘴，儿子。

english: ~z~Mami, I didn't mean anything like that. I'm stressed at the moment. Tony's putting me through hell.
zh: ~z~老妈，我没有那个意思。我现在压力很大，都是托尼害的。

english: ~z~Oh yeah. You're the Russian who was asking about coke, hookers, and corpses. Yeah, I'm sorry we couldn't accommodate.
zh: ~z~哦对，你就是那个咨询毒品、妓女、杀手的俄国人。恕我们没有这些服务。

english: ~z~Cash ain't going to fix this problem, okay. We got a crazy Russian after us and we in some deep shit with some Cosa Nostra morons.
zh: ~z~靠钱解决不了我的问题，好吧。我们被一个俄国疯子追杀，还跟几个科萨诺斯特拉蠢蛋有矛盾。

english: ~z~We need people, so pack your bags and come out here. That material shit, it don't matter anymore.
zh: ~z~我们很缺人手，背上行李加入我们吧。物质之类的，不必为此烦恼。

english: ~z~I've been out tilling the land and it really put shit in perspective for me, you know?
zh: ~z~最近一直在种地，让我有了不同的想法。

english: ~z~Don't be too proud, Luis. You ever need something, you call Yusuf, okay? See you round, bro.
zh: ~z~别太自信了，路易斯。需要什么了就联系尤瑟夫，好吗？再见了，兄弟。

english: ~z~Treat him with respect, you hear me, son. Look after those who have looked after you.
zh: ~z~对他放尊重点，听见了吗，儿子。不要忘记照顾过你的人的恩情。

english: ~z~Yusuf don't like his main dude unhappy.
zh: ~z~尤瑟夫不想让他的好哥们愁眉苦脸。

english: ~z~Alright. I'll be by sometime. Just don't wait up.
zh: ~z~好的，我有空就来。你别一直等我。

english: ~z~Hey I don't even know what it is yet.
zh: ~z~喂，我都不知道具体内容。

english: ~z~Then maybe you should have asked! Instead you run around this city making a fool of me.
zh: ~z~不知道你不会问吗！结果你当我是白痴，到处乱跑。

english: ~z~Mami, I thought you wanted me to respect him.
zh: ~z~老妈，你不是要我尊重他吗。

english: ~z~Unfortunately, I'm busy being a rich, successful and very popular international superhero,
zh: ~z~很不幸，我忙着当有钱、成功而且备受欢迎的国际大英雄，

english: ~z~Mr. Tony gave me your number, there are some other matters I need to discuss before we get down to the real shit.
zh: ~z~托尼先生给了我你的电话，干正事之前我还有些别的事要找你聊。

english: ~z~Listen, man, I told you. I didn't know shit about who owned them diamonds.
zh: ~z~听着，伙计，我都说了。我压根就不知道钻石是谁的。

english: ~z~Yeah, Tony's kept me on a path alright. I don't know if it's the right one though. I love you, Mami.
zh: ~z~是，托尼没让我误入歧途，但有没有走上正途就不知道了。我爱你，老妈。

english: ~z~Yeah, we were saying good bye, Mori.
zh: ~z~我们聊到告别了，莫里。

english: ~z~Why the city ain't shut us down, I don't know.
zh: ~z~政府怎么还没关了我们的店？搞不懂。

english: ~z~I wouldn't miss this. See you there, T.
zh: ~z~这我不能错过啊。待会儿见，T。

english: ~z~so don't fucking condescend to me.
zh: ~z~别跟我这儿优越了。

english: ~z~Doctors' notes don't cut it with these people.
zh: ~z~医疗诊断书对他们可不管用啊。

english: ~z~Calm shit down, T, and don't take it out on me. I'll be by soon. Take care of yourself.
zh: ~z~冷静点，T，别拿我当出气筒。我会来找你的。你多保重。

english: ~z~I'm sorry. I fucked up. Kind of refreshing for me to be the one getting us in shit for once, don't you think?
zh: ~z~很抱歉，我搞砸了。这次是我把你拖下水，对我来说还挺新鲜的，不是吗？

english: ~z~He's bad news. I hate to be the voice of reason here, but I don't think we need that kind of stress in our lives.
zh: ~z~他让我很不舒服。我不想当理中客，但我们不需要他那样的压力。

english: ~z~Hey boss. I'm just wondering when you think you gonna do a shift at the club?
zh: ~z~嘿，老板。你有空的时候能不能来店里当个班？

english: ~z~And that's why we love them so. How about this, from now on I can get someone else to handle the VIP shit?
zh: ~z~所以我们才喜欢他们。这样吧，现在开始我找别人负责VIP的事情吧？

english: ~z~I wasn't involved T.
zh: ~z~不是我干的，T。

zh: ~z~希望用不到这玩意。

english: ~z~Sorry, man. I lost track of you. Can we do this another time?
zh: ~z~抱歉哥们，我走丢了。能不能改天再约？

english: ~z~Fucking snake better get outta town or there'll be trouble.
zh: ~z~阴险小人，快滚吧，不然有你好果子吃。

english: ~z~but he's obsessed with what they won't sell him.
zh: ~z~但他更中意自己买不到的东西。

english: ~z~I got greedy. I shouldn't have tried to set you up.
zh: ~z~是我贪心，不该搞你们的。

english: ~z~You tell him I don't care. A billion dollars is chump change.
zh: ~z~告诉他我不在乎。十亿美元算个屁啊。

english: ~z~Calm down, will you? I'll see you in a moment.
zh: ~z~别急，好吧？我们一会儿见。

english: ~z~I-I-I told you to chill, man. Shit.
zh: ~z~我、我、我都说了别急啊，妈的。

english: ~z~Yeah, shit, I'm coming, man. Chill the f out.
zh: ~z~对，妈的，我过来了，哥们。你他妈别急。

english: ~z~That don't sound good to me neither, bro. Keep your head down.
zh: ~z~是不太妙，兄弟。避下风头吧。

english: ~z~Having this gun out wouldn't look too friendly.
zh: ~z~把枪掏出来是不是不太友好。

english: ~z~Sometimes, bro, money ain't enough.
zh: ~z~有时候啊，光有钱还不够。

english: ~z~I should put my gun away. That shit might not set the right tone.
zh: ~z~把枪收好吧。举着枪怪怪的。

english: ~z~You said he said he'd be here.
zh: ~z~他不是说会来吗？

english: ~z~When I say bounce, I don't mean bouncing literally, I just mean...
zh: ~z~我说的「弹射」，不是字面上的那个弹射，我是说...

english: ~z~Only time I like getting deep in shit is when I'm rear-ending models, man. This doesn't sound good.
zh: ~z~我只有在操逼的时候才玩得大。听上去不太妙啊。

english: ~z~Please, I'm like a brother to Yusuf. He wouldn't want me dead.
zh: ~z~求你了，尤瑟夫把我当兄弟，他不想让我死。

english: ~z~If these guys is jumpy, they ain't gonna want to see this gun.
zh: ~z~那帮人提心吊胆的，可不想看到枪吧。

english: ~z~Yusuf's in town, baby. And your shit 'bout to be inadequate.
zh: ~z~尤瑟夫来了，宝贝。你们的楼压根不够看的。

english: ~z~What does a billion dollars buy anyway today? It doesn't even buy a million dollars.
zh: ~z~这年头的十亿还有什么用？压根就不值十亿了都。

english: ~z~Please, I don't know anything.
zh: ~z~求求了，我啥都不知道了。

english: ~z~It ain't good, bro. We in some real deep shit.
zh: ~z~不太妙，兄弟。这下我们玩大了。

english: ~z~Please, whatever you do, I'm sorry.
zh: ~z~拜托，不管怎样，很对不起。

english: ~z~What you mean, "what's going on?" Chill, homeboy.
zh: ~z~什么「怎么回事」？别急啊，兄弟。

english: ~z~Don't worry, we'll buy a new one.
zh: ~z~没事，可以再买一辆。

english: ~z~I dunno, man. Ahmed had an accident before I could get the info outta him, so we in the dark.
zh: ~z~不知道，哥们。我还没问出来，艾哈迈德就死了。多的我也不懂了。

english: ~z~I am giving you this special auto shotgun with exploding shells.
zh: ~z~给你一把特别的全自动霰弹枪，能打炸药的。

english: ~z~If this don't come in handy now, it might later. Thanks, bro.
zh: ~z~现在用不上，以后也会用上的。谢了，兄弟。

english: ~z~Poppa, it's complicated. I miss you, Poppa. I do. Yes, I'm close to closing the deal. The biggest tower. You're going to be so proud of me.
zh: ~z~老爸，别纠结了。我想你了，爸。真的。对，生意就快成了。通天巨塔。你会为我骄傲的。

english: ~z~He's acting like a bitch and I can't figure out why.
zh: ~z~他样子不对劲，我也不知道原因。

english: ~z~I cannot believe it. They were brothers to me. I would have brought them anything they wanted.
zh: ~z~真是不敢相信，他们是我的兄弟啊。想要啥我都能满足的。

english: ~z~Excuse me a moment, please. I have to call Ahmed. Make sure it's all cool and safe and that.
zh: ~z~不好意思，我给艾哈迈德打个电话，确保那边没出岔子。

english: ~z~I ain't done a thing, bro!
zh: ~z~我什么都没干，兄弟！

english: ~z~Do you mind going up to the observation deck and checking it out?
zh: ~z~你不介意去观景台看下情况吧？

english: ~z~I'll just hit Ahmed up on my burner, man. Make sure shit is going down.
zh: ~z~我用匿名号码联系下艾哈迈德，确保不会被放鸽子。

english: ~z~What's up, papa? Trouble with your old man?
zh: ~z~怎么了，老兄？跟大爷闹别扭了？

english: ~z~I have a special gift, Luis. An auto shotgun with explosive shells!
zh: ~z~给你一份特别的礼物，路易斯。打炸药的，全自动霰弹枪！

english: ~z~Okay, man, if you say you're cool, you're cool. We'll be there in a moment.
zh: ~z~好吧，哥们，你说没事那就没事吧。我马上到。

english: ~z~Shit. They were brothers to me! You didn't even give them a chance to explain?
zh: ~z~妈的，那都是我的好兄弟啊！你连个解释的机会都不给吗？

english: ~z~I have a deep sadness in me, Luis. Will you join me, please - for an orgy of champagne,
zh: ~z~太让我伤心了，路易斯。求你了，能不能跟我喝个烂醉、

english: ~z~Let's hope I don't need to use 'em.
zh: ~z~希望是用不上。

english: ~z~I ain't falling off this building.
zh: ~z~我可不想掉下去。

english: ~z~Really? Ah, this is terrible. Are you alright?
zh: ~z~真的吗？啊，太可怕了。你没事吧？

english: ~z~Who gives a shit, player? Bring her back to the site.
zh: ~z~有什么差别吗，玩家？开回工地就是了。

english: ~z~Maybe you're right, I don't have the means.
zh: ~z~好像也没错。我现在没钱。

english: ~z~Luckily for us, this stuff is too 'serious' for Yusuf to be invited.
zh: ~z~还好，这个会太「正式」了，尤瑟夫不配参加。

english: ~z~I'm sorry, me bredren.
zh: ~z~对不起啊，兄弟。

english: ~z~You got a sniper rifle. How you missing this shit?
zh: ~z~这可是狙击枪啊，怎么会打不中呢？

english: ~z~What is that chopper? I haven't seen one before. So powerful!
zh: ~z~那是什么飞机？从来没见过，好牛逼啊！

english: ~z~No doubt. I'll see you round, yeah.
zh: ~z~必须的，哥们。再见。

english: ~z~Let me tell you something, man. I know some disadvantaged, needy cats. You don't need shit.
zh: ~z~嘿，哥们，我跟你说，跟我弱小无助的伙计们比，你需要个屁。

english: ~z~Take the stick, big hitter. I can't be seen driving my own chopper.
zh: ~z~你来开吧，大佬。不能被人发现我在飞自己的飞机。

english: ~z~Just don't have an army of LCPD trailing you back when you do. Clear those shitheads off.
zh: ~z~回来的时候别带着一屁股警察，把这帮傻逼干掉。

english: ~z~What's the problem, man? Why ain't we got this already?
zh: ~z~怎么回事，哥们？为啥还没到手？

english: ~z~Don't worry, man. I got these controls again.
zh: ~z~别担心，哥们，我来开飞机。

english: ~z~I'm thinking maybe you should start fetishizing some other piece of hardware, man, and just give up on the NOOSE tank.
zh: ~z~你还是倒腾别的玩意去吧，别惦记NOOSE的坦克了。

english: ~z~Don't mention it.
zh: ~z~不客气。

english: ~z~I hope she's alright.
zh: ~z~希望车子没事。

english: ~z~I didn't hear that cable snap.
zh: ~z~没听到绳子断掉的声音。

english: ~z~I know! A tunnel! Ah, we'll burrow in there and have the motherfucker in no time.
zh: ~z~有了！地道！挖条隧道，马上就能拿下车子。

english: ~z~Shit, man. Didn't get the NOOSE tank and we lost a chopper. I'm going to have to write this one down to experience.
zh: ~z~妈的，坦克车没拿到，直升机也没了。得吸取一下教训了。

english: ~z~Listen, are we going to do this or what? I'm on the fucking clock, man.
zh: ~z~拜托，正事到底还干不干了？我按钟头收费的，大哥。

english: ~z~Luis, I think I can give old papadap the slip. Meet me in Star Junction.
zh: ~z~路易斯，我可以趁老爸不注意开溜。去星汇广场等我。

english: ~z~This is ridiculous. You think that is all I have done?
zh: ~z~别开玩笑了，我就那么不正经吗？

english: ~z~Shit, man, so am I. I wouldn't miss this for the world. Even if Poppa does hold the purse strings, so to speak.
zh: ~z~妈的，我也觉得。绝不能放过这个机会，哪怕可能被老爸掐住钱袋子。

english: ~z~Man, shit, that place is impenetrable. How will we get our tank now?
zh: ~z~天，操了，那地方可进不去啊。这还怎么偷坦克？

english: ~z~Yo, what's wrong with you, man?
zh: ~z~你是不是有病啊，哥们？

english: ~z~They took her in there, man. My baby's all alone. Will you go in there and save her from those animals?
zh: ~z~他们进到警局里了，哥们。我的车就摆在那了。你能不能进去英雄救美？

english: ~z~Chill, baby. Get into it. Feel it. Let's go!
zh: ~z~别急，宝贝。代入进去，感受一下。来吧。

english: ~z~Hey, man. What is it, money? Is it money you want? Here, here. Have it. But come on, let's go get this thing... Come on!
zh: ~z~嘿，哥们，咋了，钱不够？嫌钱不够多吗？来，来，拿去。行了吧，去把它弄来吧...来吧！

english: ~z~We ain't got much time, man.
zh: ~z~没时间了，哥们。

english: ~z~I knew how disgraceful you were, but I didn't realize quite how shameful you were.
zh: ~z~我知道你作风不正，但没想到你居然这么不知廉耻。

english: ~z~You're fucking ridiculous, man.
zh: ~z~真是不可理喻，哥们。

english: ~z~Before you think about stealing one, man, it's just an air crane. You can buy them real easy.
zh: ~z~你别急着动歪脑筋，哥们，那是空中起重机。有钱就能买到。

english: ~z~I tell you, Poppa, magisterial doesn't do justice to it!
zh: ~z~告诉你吧，老爸，「鬼斧神工」都不足以形容！

english: ~z~Yeah, I don't think I can handle any more of that shit, partner.
zh: ~z~这种事你还是别来找我了，搭档。

english: ~z~We can't let them get where they're going, man.
zh: ~z~不能让他们送到地方，哥们。

english: ~z~Shhhh. Go and leave right now! And don't you dare come back without
zh: ~z~嘘！滚，赶紧滚出去！再敢回来你就...

english: ~z~uh- uh- knocking...first.These people are a disgrace, Poppa. But I tell you,
zh: ~z~呃...先...敲门！这帮人真是不要脸，老爸。我跟你说，

english: ~z~You're lucky I like you.
zh: ~z~幸好我不讨厌你。

english: ~z~Don't run out of ammo, now.
zh: ~z~别把子弹打完了。

english: ~z~A coke habit? Maybe some venereal disease? Is that what you call an achievement?
zh: ~z~毒瘾吗？说不定还有性病？这就是你的战果？

english: ~z~But you know, Poppa, I tell you are looking- you're looking- very well, in fact.
zh: ~z~其实吧，老爸，你今天气色...气色不错，真的。

english: ~z~It's just a NOOSE tank, bro.
zh: ~z~不过是一辆NOOSE坦克而已，兄弟。

english: ~z~Back where we started, bro. Sorry.
zh: ~z~得从头再来了，哥们。不好意思。

english: ~z~Don't judge a book by its cover, Father. That's what you taught me.
zh: ~z~不能只看表面啊，爸。这你是教我的。

english: ~z~You need a better zoom on that thing?
zh: ~z~要不要换个更好的镜子？

english: ~z~Ummm. I don't know about that. Maybe.
zh: ~z~呃，我不太清楚，兄弟。应该是吧。

english: ~z~He gonna cut you off?
zh: ~z~不给你钱花吗？

english: ~z~Things do not look good, son.
zh: ~z~看起来就是这样的，儿子。

english: ~z~Dammit. We didn't free her up in time, they're taking her in.
zh: ~z~我操，没及时打下来，他们到地方了。

english: ~z~I got you that tank thing and the chopper - what now, you want the Statue of Happiness for your back yard?
zh: ~z~我给你弄来了坦克和直升机，然后呢？是不是要把幸福女神像放进后院？

english: ~z~We haven't got all day. Unhook the front car.
zh: ~z~我们时间不多了。解开车头。

english: ~z~Aside from how fucking dumb that sounds, how am I supposed to take that thing?
zh: ~z~先不说这想法有多蠢，你告诉我怎么抢地铁？

english: ~z~Got lucky there.
zh: ~z~运气不错。

english: ~z~Can't you just buy yourself a subway car, bro?
zh: ~z~你就不能自己买一辆吗，老兄？

english: ~z~Would you shut the fuck up, man? What's wrong with you?
zh: ~z~你能不能闭嘴啊，伙计？你到底啥毛病？

english: ~z~Don't joke around with that weapon, dog.
zh: ~z~别拿那枪乱打，兄弟。

english: ~z~But he's obsessed with what they won't sell him.
zh: ~z~但他更中意自己买不到的东西。

english: ~z~Yo, I'm Dominican. We ain't terrorists, you dumb fucks.
zh: ~z~哟，我是多米尼加良民。不是恐怖分子，你们这些蠢货。

english: ~z~I don't think I'm going to get this bitch.
zh: ~z~我感觉我拿不到这台车了。

english: ~z~Here goes nothing.
zh: ~z~我来也。

english: ~z~No one likes people fucking with their public transport in this paranoid age.
zh: ~z~在这个多疑的时代，大家都讨厌打公共交通主意的人。

english: ~z~You kidding me? Where were they hiding?
zh: ~z~有没有搞错？从哪冒出来的？

english: ~z~I don't know why I hang out with you, bro.
zh: ~z~都不知道我为什么要跟你混在一起，兄弟。

english: ~z~Don't fucking shoot me, man.
zh: ~z~别他妈打我，伙计。

english: ~z~Leave me alone!
zh: ~z~别管我！

english: ~z~The plan doesn't allow for that, homie. Disappoints me as much as you. Probably more. Inside, I am crying.
zh: ~z~可惜计划不允许啊，哥们儿。我可能比你更失望。在我心里，我已经哭了。

english: ~z~There might even be room for a Maisonette 9 franchise there. How about it?
zh: ~z~说不定还能在那儿开一家9号豪宅的分店。你说怎么样？

english: ~z~Cynics don't build pyramids, man. You got to believe. Tell me you believe, Luis.
zh: ~z~悲观的人造不出金字塔。你得相信它。告诉我你信了，路易斯。

english: ~z~Yusuf, bro, we got problems, man. I couldn't handle that thing for you.
zh: ~z~尤瑟夫，兄弟。出了一点岔子，兄弟。我不能帮你了。

english: ~z~But I thought you was busy building the pyramids?
zh: ~z~你不是忙着造金字塔吗？

english: ~z~Fuck. That was close.
zh: ~z~操，差点没命。

english: ~z~"The impossible dream. Priceless indulgence. Style by Yusuf Amir. A timeless classic. Timeless classic!"
zh: ~z~「无尽的奢华，不可能之梦。尤瑟夫･阿米尔风格。万古千秋的经典。永恒的经典！」

english: ~z~'Cause you fucking love this shit, homie. Ain't nothing like rolling with this Arabic bad boy.
zh: ~z~因为你喜欢这种活，哥们儿。跟着阿拉伯坏小子混可是独一份的。

english: ~z~Yeah, sounds perfect, man. Just what the people want right now. But...
zh: ~z~听起来真不错，兄弟。很符合当代人的需求。但是...

english: ~z~Shit, dude, you got attitude. Ease off with that thing.
zh: ~z~操了，兄弟，给点面子。别乱打了。

english: ~z~You heard me. A genuine Liberty City subway car.
zh: ~z~你没听错。货真价实的自由城地铁。

english: ~z~Why do I struggle to believe that?
zh: ~z~我有点不太相信啊？

english: ~z~Things have a tendency to get outta hand man. Maybe you could give me some more exploding shells for peace of mind.
zh: ~z~不怕一万就怕万一。能不能给我点爆炸子弹，我好安心点。

english: ~z~Hey, bro. Just in case you mind if I hit you for some of them exploding shells? Thanks, man.
zh: ~z~嘿，兄弟。以防万一，你不介意我拿你点爆炸子弹吧？谢了，伙计。

english: ~z~Not going to be easy, dog.
zh: ~z~稍微有点棘手，兄弟。

english: ~z~This place going to be so expensive, people won't even be able to afford it.
zh: ~z~这地方会卖出天价，普通人绝对买不起。

english: I haven't heard from you. did you lose my number? Maybe my phone was unplugged or something. It's been being weird. Listen. Give me a call sometime. Would be great to hang out again.
zh: 你都不联系我，是忘了我的号码吗？也许是你打过来的时候我的手机没电了吧。这样感觉很怪。听好，时不时给我打个电话吧。很希望能和你一起出去玩。

english: Things are real complicated right now. Look after yourself. Luis
zh: 我现在因为一堆麻烦事忙得不可开交。多保重吧。 路易斯

english: Don't think I'm working tonight. Luis
zh: 我今晚不上班。 路易斯

english: Please stop mailing me. Forget we ever met.
zh: 别给我发邮件了。就当我们没见过。

english: What's up? or as you might say 'Yo, wassup!?' Still haven't heard much from you. I left a couple of messages. Maybe you didn't get them.
zh: 你好吗？或者按你说的「哟，咋的了！？」你还是没怎么联系我吧。我给你留了几条留言，好像你没收到。

english: I ain't the one you need to talk to, it's momma! I help her all I can, and she still gets on me. Love to the kids. Luis.
zh: 你跟我说没用啊，跟咱妈说去！我已经尽力帮她了，但她还是那么对我。替我向孩子们问好，路易斯。

english: Huh? I don't know what meds you on, sis. But you better cut the dose. L.
zh: 哈？你是不是吃错药了，妹妹？少嗑点吧。L。

english: ME? I ain't crazy, sis. I don't know what you talking about. Luis
zh: 我？我可没疯，妹妹。我都不知道你在说什么。路易斯

english: Was you involved in that crazy shit I just saw on the news? You take care of yourself, you hear.
zh: 新闻上那件疯狂的事跟你有关吗？你多保重啊，听到没。

english: Hey sis, I figured it would happen some day. Man can't control himself. Send me some pictures of your kids and I'll take down the ones of Dad. Much Love, Luis.
zh: 嗨，妹妹，我早就知道会有这么一天的。他这个人控制不住自己。给我发几张你家孩子的照片吧，我拿来换掉老爸的。爱你，路易斯。

english: it's me, how you doing? I miss you! Listen, I know things been kind of hard and I know I've been absent and hard on you, and I know Ernesto can be a prick (is always a prick!) but can you try and keep an eye on Momma.
zh: 是我啊，过得如何？我可想你了！听着，我知道最近日子不好过，也知道我不在的时候对你有些苛刻，还知道埃内斯托可以多混账(他一直都很混账！)，但你能尽量照顾着点妈妈吗？

english: Heard some news from the midwest. Apparently Dad ran out on his new family too. First it was the army, then us, and now his new set of kids. He's living with a waitress or something. He's a fucking asshole, L. I can't believe you still keep those photos of him up. Anyway, thought you'd want to know. Don't turn out like that, okay? I know you're better than that. Just saying...
zh: 我听到了来自中西部的消息，老爸从他的新家庭逃跑了。先是逃离军队，再是逃离我们，现在又逃离了新的家庭。他貌似跟一个女服务员还是什么的好上了。他真是个混蛋啊，L。你居然还会留着他的照片。这事我就跟你说一声。你可别变成他那样啊，好吗？我知道你是比他好的。只是说说...

zh: 从东非海岸到洪堡河沿岸，海盗已经成为21世纪上班族的主要威胁。日前一伙海盗在布洛克偷了一节地铁车厢，这是过去几个月里最大胆的劫案之一。据目击者称，一名「黑不溜秋」的男子爬上列车车顶，脱开车钩，车厢随后被一架吊挂直升机拉入空中。拉着车厢的直升机在绕到一栋大楼后面后消失，当局因此失去了它的踪迹。

english: He's setting up a task force with a web site and Bleeter page to ensure things happen quickly to get everything back on track in an all out assault on government action. Lawton looked compassionate but strong and promised to continue to improve the country, reduce taxes, punish foreigners and increase government spending in most areas, but sensibly and with one eye on what America is and another on what it could become. He received a standing ovation for the speech. We will stay with this fluff piece our owner made us run.
zh: 他正在筹建一支配有官方网站和Bleeter账号的特别工作组，以确保工作顺利推进，并通过遍地开花的政策让国家的一切重回正轨。劳顿看上去富有同情心，但态度强硬，他承诺将继续改善这个国家，减少税收，惩处外国人，并在大多数领域增加政府支出，但要理智。他一方面着眼于美国的现状，另一方面着眼于它的未来。他的演讲博得全场起立鼓掌。我们将继续关注我们的老板让我们发的这篇通稿。

english: Sitting Duck Quacks
zh: 会叫的狗不咬人

english: Citizens are growing increasingly tired of being told to be scared shitless. "It really wears on me," 34 year old Broker resident Hamil Hajaj said. "I've had a heart attack and three strokes. I can't take it anymore." In light of the recent attacks, many say they'd rather take their chances than deal with the congestion, inconvenience and loss of liberty that comes with a so-called safer community.
zh: 市民们越来越厌倦被灌输的种种恐慌。34岁的布洛克区居民哈米尔･哈贾吉说：「这真的让我很烦。我犯了一次心脏病，还中风过三次。我再也受不了了。」鉴于最近发生的袭击事件，许多人表示，他们宁愿冒险，也不想再搭理所谓的安全起见，它只会带来拥挤、不便和束缚。

english: A man was killed on the subway when an angry mob took exception to his refusal to stop playing air guitar while he listened to his mp3 player. After repeated requests to stop annoying everybody, the man was turned on by a mob and ripped apart. Passersby cheered as both locals and tourists ripped the man into shreds and scattered bloody remains all over the carriage. Witnesses spoke of a happy, festive atmosphere amongst the mob which is thought to have included three nuns, two teachers and a mother of six. Such was the state of the victim that police where unable to identify him and are asking for help.
zh: 一男子在地铁车厢内边听MP3边弹空气吉他，引起其他乘客不满，并因拒绝停止其扰民行为被杀。多次请求该男子停止扰民无果后，该男子被暴民群起而攻，随后分尸。当地居民与外来旅客都参与了分尸，车厢内血肉横飞，其他乘客则拍手称快。谈及此事时，目击者们都以欢快愉悦的口吻陈述，作案者包括三名修女、两名教师以及一位六个孩子的母亲。鉴于被害者已血肉模糊，警方无法确认他的身份，正在向社会大众寻求帮助。

english: The Recession is Not Over
zh: 经济衰退并未结束

english: President's Claims Jar with Facts
zh: 总统的声明不符事实

english: Ashvilli's Private Army Wiped Out
zh: 阿什维利的私人军队全军覆没

english: Despite the President's speech last week that the recession is over, speak to anyone on the street and they will tell you times are tough. Bagels now cost a fortune. Gas is through the roof. And daytime TV is terrible. The conservative president may be trying to save face. But we don't believe it, especially since our newsroom has been cut by 75%. Seriously. I'm the janitor but they make me write the stories.
zh: 上周总统说经济衰退结束了，别信他的。去街上随便找个人问问，哪一个不是说日子难过。现在百吉饼贵到离谱，油价笔直向上，白天的电视节目更是一团糟。这位保守派的总统先生还想留点面子，但我们才不买他的账，我们编辑部的人已经被开掉四分之三了。真的。其实我是他们这儿扫地的，硬被拉过来写稿子了。

english: What is clear is that this is a serious blow for the hockey team, who lost their controversial owner, and are plagued with rival claims over ownership of the franchise as well as documented hostile takeover attempts. The Rampage are now likely to be the subject of a series of court cases as Mr. Ashvilli's complex business affairs are untangled by the state. Hockey fans just wished they had got to watch the shoot out as it sounded a lot more interesting than the sport.
zh: 此次事件对这支球队显然是一次沉痛的打击，他们失去了备受争议的老板，面前的对手则主张拥有球队的经营权，球队同时还受到过几次记录在案的恶意收购。阿希维利先生相关的商业纠纷现已移交州政府处理，之后暴怒队将成为一系列庭审案件的主角。冰球爱好者则为没能看到那场枪战感到遗憾，因为它听上去比比赛有趣多了。

english: While the chronology of these events is still being debated, authorities have used social network updates on the popular bleeter.biz website in order to put them in an approximate order. It is believed that the first blast caused a crane to go down at the Libel site on Columbus Avenue. The second made an out of commission subway train derail on the Algonquin-Bohan line. And a third blast caused a private jet belonging to the LTA to combust at Francis International. Cleanup crews are hard at work on the sites while authorities debate on how to better safeguard against a repeat of these tragedies.
zh: 虽然三起事件的先后顺序仍有争议，但有关部门参考热门社交网站bleeter.biz上的相关动态发布时间，大致确认了事件发生顺序。在哥伦布大道的LibEl工地发生的第一起爆炸造成一台塔吊倒塌。第二起爆炸致使阿尔冈琴-波汉地铁线路上的一列非运营空车脱轨。而第三起在弗朗西斯国际机场发生的爆炸则烧毁了一架属于交管局的私人飞机。善后人员正在爆炸现场进行后续处理，有关部门则在商讨如何避免这种悲剧再次发生。

english: What have a plane, a train, and a crane got in common? They rhyme and they could all kill your children. Unrelated accidents in three corners of Liberty City have shown how close we come to death when we leave our apartments everyday.
zh: 飞机、车皮、起重机，三者有何共同点？它们押韵，也都可以害死你的孩子。近期在自由城的不同地点发生的三起无关事故已经告诉我们，走出家门后，死神离我们究竟有多近。

english: Controversial Rampage owner, Marki Ashvilli has forcefully denied allegations he is about to sell the team, and says he is looking forward to the new season. Mr. Ashvilli, who has faced down a string of accusations, including claims he is not the legal owner of the team along with on going investigations into his links to organized crime, released a statement through a spokesman.
zh: 备受争议的暴怒队老板马尔基･阿什维利坚决地驳回了他将出售球队的指控，并表达了他对新赛季的期待。阿什维利先生此前遭受了一系列指控，例如涉嫌参与有组织犯罪、否认他是球队的合法所有人等。现在他通过一名发言人发表了以下陈述：

english: Simon Epstein loves his job. So much that he gets high on his own supply. The Liberty City Dentist was arrested recently for selling nitrous oxide tanks to local partiers. But some of his dental hygienists are coming forward and saying he liked to suck on the gas while at work, and would often fondle them while doing teeth cleaning. Hygienist Sarah Levin said "He was doing a root canal, and that sucky thing is pulling spit out of the patients mouth, and there's blood and spit everywhere, and the dentist started to caress my thigh. It was very erotic, and I was in to it then. But now I just want money."
zh: 西蒙･爱泼斯坦十分热爱自己的工作，已经热爱到吸自己的货吸嗨了。近日，自由城的这位牙医因向当地的派对参与者出售笑气被捕。然而其诊所的几名洗牙师则称，这位牙医喜欢在工作时吸入笑气，还会在洗牙时占洗牙师便宜。洗牙师萨拉･莱文说：「当时他在给病人做根管治疗，一根管子正在吸出病人的口水，然后血液混杂着口水搞得到处都是，然后医生就开始摸我的大腿了。被摸的感觉真的好色，我也非常享受这个过程。但现在我想要的只有钱。」

english: Debate Rages - Has Vinewood Lost its Balls?
zh: 争论激烈——好麦坞没种了吗？

english: Romantic comedies are all the rage at the box office these days as Vinewood changes course from the macho to the metrosexual. It's been a long time coming. Elisabeth Lanclett, a spokesperson for Liberty City Cinemas said business is booming. "We love the trend of romantic comedies. Men won't bring women to a war or robot movie, but women will drag their men to a romantic comedy. And the men will shove his face full of expensive food from the snack stand just to make it through the film." Experts say it's a phenomenon they don't yet have a theory but isn't it worthy of a major government study as it seems really important?
zh: 随着好麦坞由主打铁血硬汉转向都市美男，最近浪漫喜剧的票房一时疯涨。美男子终于熬成爷了。自由城影协的发言人伊丽莎白･兰开特表示，如今影院生意正旺。「我们很高兴看到浪漫喜剧的增长态势。男性观众不会带女性观众去看战争片和机战片，但女性观众却会拖着伴侣来看浪漫喜剧。被拖来的男观众还会购买影院内的高价食物，撑过整部影片。」专家称目前还没有理论可以解释这种现象，但这个课题似乎很有价值，值得政府设立专项资金进行研究。

english: A fight outside a bar in Broker's East Hook neighborhood ended in death and carnage last night. The One-Eyed Sailor, a neighborhood dive bar for over 50 years, has been overrun with hipsters in recent months following a blog post that described it as, "undiscovered, counter-cultural and uber-raw." Jude Corbin, age 32, had been running up a tab on his parents' credit card with six or seven other identically-dressed, bearded 20-somethings since the early afternoon. The group spent a few hours loudly debating the type of bagel that best defines their identity, while slouching outside every five minutes to nonchalantly smoke clove cigarettes. As they became increasingly drunk, however, tensions with the regular customers began to build. When they started playing 80s music on the juke box and ironically body-popping, their patronizing fauxhemian antics proved too much for one local man, who dragged Corbin outside by his asymmetrical bangs and proceeded to beat him on the sidewalk, shouting, "Go back home you ridiculous hipster scum,". Corbin's friends ran off immediately, leaving the 90-pound, wannabe Beat Poet at the mercy of his 250-pound assailant. Witnesses say that he curled up into a ball, crying like a baby, and died a few seconds later when his skintight corduroys cut off the blood flow to the brain.
zh: 昨晚，布洛克区的东胡克街区发生斗殴，随后演变为一场屠杀。「独眼水手」是该街区的一家平民酒吧，有着超过50年的营业史。此前一篇博客文章将其描述为「未被发现的、非主流的、极其原生态的酒吧」，导致近几个月酒吧里满是「时髦人士」。刚过中午，32岁的裘德･科宾就带着六七位着装统一、满脸胡须的二十出头的年轻人进店，刷着父母的信用卡花天酒地。这群人大声争吵了几个小时，讨论哪种百吉饼最能代表他们的身份，隔五分钟还到酒吧门外抽上一支香烟。然而，科宾一行人的酒劲上来了，酒吧熟客的脾气也上来了。他们用点唱机放起80年代的歌，滑稽地模仿着机械舞的动作。一位老顾客实在难以接受这种傲慢而又充满恶意的嘲弄，扯着科宾不对称的刘海走出酒吧，在人行道上暴揍了他一顿，大声吼道：「给老子滚，回家找你妈去吧，傻逼嬉皮士！」科宾的朋友被吓得落荒而逃，留下这位80斤的节奏诗人任由230斤的袭击者摆布。目击者称科宾缩成一团、痛哭流涕，然后被自己的紧身裤勒到大脑供血不足，当场去世了。

english: Unwashed Hipster Bathed in Blood
zh: 肮脏不堪的嬉皮士浴血而死

english: Pressing the wrong button on his phone may cost him millions of dollars as fans react to the scandalous shots of boy band superstar Bobby Blue in women's lingerie posing and mugging in the mirror. Mr. Blue initially claimed it was a digitally altered photo that had been sent out by a rival boy band. Now he's confessed all and says he dressed up for a funny shoot for their next video. However, industry insiders say they haven't had a plan for a video shoot in months.
zh: 玩手机时一个手滑可能带来上百万元的损失。现在，人气男团成员博比 Blue穿着女性内衣，对着镜子凹造型摆鬼脸的照片让粉丝炸开了锅。Blue先生最初称这是对家伪造并发布的照片。但现在他和盘托出，表示他是为了拍摄下一部MV中的搞笑镜头才会穿成这样。然而，据业内人士透露，该团体在之后数月都没有拍摄MV的计划。

english: A controversial South African business man was killed in a violent incident in the harbor yesterday. Fricke Van Hardenburg, who had only recently been granted a visa to enter the country was relaxing with pals on a motor yacht, when an assailant attacked and killed him and his friends.
zh: 昨日，颇具争议的南非商人弗里基･范･哈登堡在港口的一起暴力事件中遇害。被害者最近刚取得我国的入境签证，案发当日其正在游艇上与朋友们休闲放松，随后他们被杀手袭击，无人生还。

english: A homeless Vietnam veteran, Jerry Kapowitz, has stumbled upon a haul of diamonds valued at over $2 million. They were in a small pouch amongst the trash in Meadows Park. Mr. Kapowitz had been living near the dump and surviving off of things he salvaged from there. "Before this, the best thing I'd found was a TV and that didn't even work," he told reporters. Mr. Kapowitz plans to take his newfound wealth down to Vice City where he will start a gun shop and liquor store, "They're real men down there and they need real guns and liquor in one convenient location." Mr. Kapowitz's ownership of the diamonds was immediately contested by over 100 people. Mayor Ochoa decided that it would be impossible to verify the claims so allowed Mr. Kapowitz to keep all of the proceeds from the diamonds' sale.
zh: 一名流浪的越战老兵，杰里･卡波维茨，捡到了一批价值超过两百万美元的钻石。钻石被装在一个小袋子里，混在草地公园的垃圾堆中。卡波维茨先生一直住在垃圾场附近，靠捡垃圾生存。「此前，我捡到过的最好的东西是一台电视，而且还是坏的，」他告诉记者。卡波维茨先生计划带着自己刚获得的财富去罪城，然后开一家枪店兼酒馆，「那边的人都是真汉子，他们需要一家同时具备真枪和好酒的店。」已有上百人对卡波维茨先生的钻石拥有权提出了异议，称自己是失主。奥乔亚市长则以无法证实失主为由，允许卡波维茨先生保留出售钻石所获得的收入。

english: Mob Boss, Jon Gravelli, alleged head of the Gambetti crime family, died peacefully in his sleep last night. Mr. Gravelli, 85, had been residing at the Schottler Medical Center for the last 3 years. Although some in the DA's office argued that this was a ruse to avoid a court case, Mr. Gravelli never left hospital after being admitted. Mr. Gravelli has been head of the Gambetti crime syndicate since 1978 and under his stewardship, the family had become the most powerful of Liberty City's crime families, rivaling the Pavano family. Although he had been indicted several times, Mr. Gravelli was never convicted of a serious crime. Some believed he had contacts within the government who protected him, and for whom he would get criminal associates to perform hits and other crimes, but these allegations were never substantiated. What happens now to the delicate balance of power amongst criminal gangs within Liberty City is unknown. It is unlikely to be pretty.
zh: 被认为是甘贝蒂犯罪家族头目的黑帮老大，乔恩･格拉韦利，昨晚在睡梦中安然离世。85岁的格拉韦利先生过去三年一直住在舒特勒医疗中心。尽管地检署中有人认为住院是其回避庭审的诡计，但格拉韦利先生在住院后的确从未离开医院。格拉韦利先生自1978年起担任甘贝蒂犯罪家族的头目，在其管理下，该家族成为了自由城最强大的犯罪家族，与帕瓦诺家族分庭抗礼。尽管其已被指控多次，但格拉韦利先生从未被判任何重罪。有人认为政府内存在他的保护伞，为其实施谋杀等各类犯罪提供便利，但这些说法并未得到证实。自由城各大犯罪势力间的脆弱平衡或将发生变化，但很难向好发展。

english: Authorities and pundits are looking for the meanings behind two gangland shootouts that broke out in the city. Several Russian gangsters thought to be involved in a major heroin deal were killed in Hove Beach. Shortly afterwards, a shootout broke out at Francis International Terminal, culminating in the crashing of a private jet belonging to controversial Russian business man Ray Bulgarin.
zh: 有关部门和专家正在研究本市发生的两起黑社会枪战带来的影响。数名涉嫌参与一起海洛因交易案件的俄国黑帮分子在霍夫海滩被杀害。随后不久，弗朗西斯国际机场又发生了激烈枪战，最终导致一架私人飞机坠毁，这架飞机属于备受争议的俄国商人雷･布尔加林。

english: Workers disgruntled
zh: 工人持续不满

english: These are just some of the words that our editors thought would lead you into reading this story. But they are also words that could be used to describe how local recently graduated workers feel about Liberty City companies who are taking advantage of them. Sandra McColland has filed a lawsuit that sets a new standard for workers. After collapsing on the job in what she describes as a work/life balance, McColland is fighting for all Liberty City businesses to allow 2 months paid vacation a year, flexible hours, yoga a flotation/isolation chamber spa on site. Local businesses complain about a generation that wasn't required to work in high school, received an allowance, had college and a condo paid for, and then expect the same from the workforce.
zh: 小编承认自己标题党了，但这也确实是应届求职者对利用他们的自由城企业的感受。桑德拉･麦科兰就势提起诉讼，试图为工人争取更人性化的行业新规。此前她在工作时昏倒，因为那份工作让她无法平衡工作时间和私人时间。在此之后，她便一直致力于为自由城所有企业的员工争取每年2个月的带薪休假、弹性的工作时间、瑜伽活动室、SPA中心等福利。而当地企业则抱怨这一代人高中不需要勤工俭学，拿着助学津贴，大学学费和公寓租金都有补贴，就业后居然还想要这样的待遇。

english: MOCAP PLACEHOLDER ~n~~n~Santo is pissed Luis didn't fall in the 3rd, he threatens to burn Luis mum's house down.~n~Luis says he'll kill him first.
zh: 动作捕捉占位符~n~~n~桑托因为路易斯第三回合没倒下而恼火，威胁要烧掉路易斯妈妈的家。~n~路易斯说他会先杀了桑托。

english: MOCAP PLACEHOLDER ~n~~n~Santo tells player he did a good job. ~n~ Player tells Santos he has his money and to leave his mum alone.
zh: 动作捕捉占位符~n~~n~桑托称赞玩家干得不错。~n~玩家告诉桑托钱已经到手，让他别再骚扰他妈妈。

english: ~r~You are no longer welcome into L.C. Cage Fighters.
zh: ~r~自由城铁笼格斗将你拒之门外了。

english: You drive your child to school and teach them that minorities are all ok (but just can't afford your neighborhood because of conservative racism) and that they should treat everyone with kindness. But what about adults who prey on our children? In a recent report, there are over 8 million registered sex offenders with MyRoom accounts.
zh: 你开车送孩子上学，告诉他们少数族裔也是好人(只是因为保守的种族主义，他们住不起你的小区)，他们应该善待每一个人。但是那些「掠食」我们孩子的成年人呢？最近的一份报告指出，有超过800万的性犯罪者注册了MyRoom账户。

english: How did we get here? The family dentist has become a creep. A drug dealer. A lecher. And despite most of us having dental insurance, each visit costs us a fortune. It came to a head recently with Simon Epstein, the so called Dirty Dentist, a sad case which sheds a light on a profession that needs to be regulated. Our children go to these creeps. Who knows what these guys are doing to my teen daughter while I'm in the waiting room thumbing through some idiotic right wing magazine? In light of the recent report by the National Library Center that the net generation does not read books or newspapers unless they are online, the publishers of the Liberty Tree are planning to cease the newsprint version of the paper by 2010. Readers will still be able to read their news stories online via wireless mobile devices and high-speed internet connections and blog and call each other names and be assholes on message boards. "This really is the future. It's 2.0. It's interactive. Paper books and newsprint will be phased out by the end of the decade. Ebooks and web news are the future. Now if you'll excuse me, I have to go to a webinar," said associate publisher, Louis Fertinatta, on his new blog, which he started because some 22-year-old prick in marketing told him it was essential to the future, man.
zh: 伴随着全新的商业计划，Liberty Tree将进入2.0时代。根据国家图书馆中心近期发表的报告，互联网一代只在网上读书看报，Liberty Tree出版社计划在2010年前停止发行纸质版报纸。读者获取新闻消息的途径还有很多，比如无线移动设备、高速互联网、公开博客、激情对骂、论坛钓鱼。「这就是未来，这就是2.0时代，未来将充满交互。纸质的书籍和报纸会在21世纪的第一个十年后渐渐消失。电子书和在线新闻才是未来。我要去参加在线会议了，恕我失陪。」 副出版人路易斯･费尔蒂纳塔在他的新博客上如是写道，而他开始写博客只是因为市场部的某个22岁混蛋告诉他：「这对未来至关重要。」天哪。

english: More than half a million dollars taken
zh: 超过50万美元被盗

english: A daring raid on a downtown branch of the Bank of Liberty has left one robber dead along with multiple police and civilian casualties. The suspect has been identified as Michael Keane, a convicted felon from Dukes. Four men wearing suits and balaclavas entered the branch and held the customers hostage while blowing the door to the vault with explosives. In the confusion, brave customer Eugene Reaper attempted to stop the robbery and was murdered in cold blood. Three robbers left the bank on foot and fought their way through police before escaping on the subway. Authorities are questioning all known associates of Mr. Keane in an attempt to discover the identities of his accomplices. The Bank of Liberty estimates that in excess of half a million dollars was stolen.
zh: 自由城银行中心支行遭到大胆袭击，劫匪团伙造成包括警察和平民在内的多名人员伤亡。劫匪中有一人死亡，其姓名为迈克尔･基恩，是一名居住在公爵区的重罪犯。四名身着西装的蒙面男子进入银行，挟持银行客户作为人质，同时炸开了金库大门。在混乱中，勇敢的客户尤金･里珀试图阻止抢劫，结果被残忍地杀害。三名劫匪步行离开银行，一路杀入地铁站，逃离了警方追捕。有关部门正在询问所有与基恩先生往来的人，以查明其他劫匪的身份。据自由城银行估算，此次有超过50万美元被盗。

english: Opponents of online gambling say that children as young as three know how to play poker online. Online poker fans say that they enjoy getting drunk and lying to strangers on the Internet, a pastime that is as old as America itself. But just as prohibition worked, this should work as well, say politicians.
zh: 网络赌博的反对者说就连三岁小孩都会上网打牌。网上打牌的拥护者则说他们就喜欢喝醉后跟网友吹逼，而这也是美国的传统休闲项目。但政府官员表示，以前的禁酒令*就是成功案例，他们对这次的法案充满信心。(禁酒令：美国1920至1933年的禁酒时期)

english: An audacious prison escape, like something you might see on a Weazel Network show, occurred ninety seven feet under the surface of the West River earlier. A convoy carrying convicted felon, Aiden O'Malley, was ambushed by two trucks. O'Malley was being taken from a police station in Algonquin back to the Alderney State Correctional Facility. Two men used the trucks to block the convoy from the front and the back in the middle of the Booth Tunnel while they freed O'Malley. O'Malley, 48, who is American born but spent much of his adult life in Ireland, was serving a twenty-year term for his involvement in a string of robberies.
zh: 不久前在西河之下30米的地方，发生了一起惊天劫狱案，就像Weazel电视台的节目演的那样。押运重罪犯艾登･奥马利的囚车车队正在将奥马利由阿尔冈琴警局押送至奥尔德尼州立监狱，途中遭到了两辆卡车截击。车队驶至布斯隧道中段时，两名男子驾驶卡车一前一后拦截了车队，随后劫走了奥马利。现年48岁的奥马利出生于美国，但他的成年生活大部分在爱尔兰度过，他因参加了一系列的抢劫活动被判20年有期徒刑。

english: Today the Liberty Tree witnessed an emotional reunion between an Algonquin couple and their son who was lost for six years in a KRAPEA store. A well-known pedophile at Krapea's Alderney branch alerted staff to a pallid youth whom he had spotted sleeping in the same bunk-bed on his last three visits. The child's mother told reporters, "It's a miracle. We were sure that our son was dead and had even converted his bedroom into a home gym. He appears to be a little institutionalized and cannot understand why we don't have fifteen adjacent kitchens but it's great to have him back."
zh: 今天，Liberty Tree目睹了阿尔冈琴的两夫妇和在宜室走失了六年的儿子的重聚。一位著名恋童癖提醒了宜室的奥尔德尼分店工作人员，称他在最近三次购物中发现一名面色苍白的年轻人睡在同一张双层床上。孩子的母亲告诉记者，「这简直是奇迹，我们都以为他死了，还把他的房间改成了健身房。我儿子似乎有一些缺乏常识，还执着于『为什么我们家没有15个连着的厨房』这种奇怪的问题，不管怎样，能找到他真是太好了。」

english: Elizabeta Torres, a drug dealer from South Bohan, was handed a record prison sentence at the Civic Citadel yesterday. Liberty City Judge, Mitt Burrows, slapped her with a 300 year stretch for thirty counts of cocaine distribution. It is also believed that Torres murdered Bohan community leader, Manny Escuela, and documentary film maker, Jay Hamilton. They have been missing for several weeks but police cannot bring charges until their bodies are discovered. The District Attorney submitted hundreds of hours of surveillance audio in the trial. These tapes provided evidence of her working with international drug rings. The last tape before her arrest, played at her trial yesterday, features a heated conversation between her, a Jamaican man and an Eastern European man. Authorities have been unable to locate either of these individuals.
zh: 伊丽莎贝塔･托雷斯是一名来自南波汉的毒贩，昨日米特･伯罗斯法官在市政厅对其以30项关于贩卖可卡因的指控判处300年有期徒刑，刷新了司法史上的判刑纪录。托雷斯还被怀疑涉嫌谋杀波汉的社区领袖曼尼･埃斯库埃拉和纪录片制作人杰･汉密尔顿，两人均已失踪数个星期。目前警方尚未发现这两人的尸体，无法对其提出谋杀指控。地方检察官在庭审中提交了数百小时的监听录音带，为证明托雷斯涉嫌参与跨国走私毒品提供了证据。昨日庭审中还播放了托雷斯被捕前的最后一卷录音，录音内容是其与一名牙买加男性和一名东欧男性的激烈争吵。目前有关部门仍未找到这两人。

english: What would you do if the hard-earned American dollars in your wallet turned out to be cheap communist knockoffs? Unfortunately it's already happened. N.O.O.S.E operatives have started to find high-quality counterfeit $100 bills in circulation in Liberty City. They are believed to be so-called supernotes - fake currency using identical ink and paper to genuine bills printed overseas. Police believe the current batch originates from Asia. N.O.O.S.E estimates that among $100 bills one in every fifty is counterfeit.
zh: 当你钱包中的血汗钱变成了廉价的共产主义仿制品时，你会怎么做？很不幸，这一幕正在现实中上演。近日，国安办探员已在在自由城流通的美元中发现了高仿$100假币。这种假币在地下社会被称为「超级钞」，是一种国外印刷的假币，印刷时采用的油墨和纸张与真钞完全一致。警方认为目前流通的这批假币来源于亚洲。据国安办估算，目前每五十张百元大钞中就会有一张假币。

english: Liberty City Police have arrested Dr. Yahann Klietzel after raiding his laboratory and finding up to 6 clones of the doctor at various ages. Klietzel is charged with engaging in sexual relations with the clones, which range from 10 to 48 years of age. The 16-year-old Dr. Klietzel clone said, "We all love each other, all of us clones. We are not devious bastard children of the future. We are a family. Who are you to judge?"
zh: LCPD突袭了亚汉･克利策尔博士的实验室，随后对其进行了逮捕。警方还在实验室内发现了六个不同年龄的博士克隆体。克利策尔博士被控与10岁到48岁不同年龄的克隆体发生性关系。克利策尔博士的16岁克隆体说：「我们这些克隆体相亲相爱。我们不是来自未来的邪恶坏蛋。我们是一家人。你凭什么审判我们？」

english: Fears over the safety of air travel were further compounded yesterday when a drunken pilot nearly killed 200 passengers on an Air Sol flight from Vice City to Francis International airport. Suspicions as to the pilot's state of mind had been raised even before take-off when he welcomed passengers "aboard the party bus" and announced that, "in the unlikely event of landing on water, the woman in 15B has two beautiful flotation devices." Over the course of the 2-hour flight, he became audibly more boisterous and incoherent singing, "Who wants to sit on the captain's knee?" and shouting things like "Kamikaze" and "Look no hands" as the plane came into land. "He even asked an air hostess for a sickbag at one point," said one terrified passenger. The 48-year-old father of two was questioned by Francis International authorities before driving home.
zh: 昨日，一架满载200名乘客的Air Sol公司航班从罪城飞达弗朗西斯国际机场，执飞这一航班的机长醉架飞机，引起公众对空运安全的怀疑。起飞前这名机长的精神状态就被质疑不宜进行飞行，他用「欢迎登上派对巴士」问候乘客，还在广播中说「如果遇到了小几率的水上迫降，15B座位的女士就有一对美丽的救生气囊。」在两小时的航程中，透过广播也能感受到机长的兴奋与神志不清，他在广播中高歌「谁想坐在机长的腿上？」降落前仍在大喊「神风特攻」和「爷脱把开飞机」之类的胡话。据一名吓坏了的乘客所说「机长甚至还问空姐要过一个呕吐袋。」这位48岁的机长同时也是两个孩子的父亲，他在接受了机场相关部门的询问后就驾车回家了。

english: Remember, identity theft is ALWAYS your fault, reads Bank of Liberty's new website. Is it not enough that 8-year-olds are hacking into our online accounts and stealing our life savings? Is it not enough that meth addicts are rooting through our trash and piecing back together our shredded documents? Is it not enough that lap dancers can no longer be trusted with our credit cards? Now the banks are turning their backs on us as well? "We're simply going to ignore it from now on," said a spokesperson for Bank of Liberty, "I refuse for my bonus to be cut because some moron posted personal details all over their MyRoom page or wired their kid's college fund to a Nigerian con-artist. We're the ones getting scammed."
zh: 「记住，被身份盗窃永远都是你自己的错。」这句话出现在自由城银行的新网页上。八岁小孩黑进你的网银账户，盗走你的毕生积蓄还不够吗？瘾君子翻遍垃圾桶，拼出你粉碎的重要文件还不够吗？再也不能放心地让脱衣舞娘帮你刷卡结帐还还不够吗？就连银行都要抛弃我们了吗？「从现在起，我们将无视这类问题，」自由城银行的发言人说，「我拒绝自己的奖金因一些愚蠢行为而被削减，比如一堆弱智在MyRoom网公开自己的个人信息，或者把自家孩子的大学基金直接汇给尼日利亚骗子。我们银行才是受害者。」

english: Kerry McIntosh was barely 12 steps out of rehab last night when she was arrested for DUI and possession of a controlled substance, believed to be a small amount of cocaine. Once the police were made aware of Kerry's celebrity status, she signed some autographs and was released with a warning. According to a statement issued by her agent, McIntosh has decided to sue the rehab center in Los Santos, claiming that she is just as messed up as when she arrived four days earlier. Lenny Tinderman, who runs the $60,000-a-night treatment center and is an active alcoholic himself, told reporters, "Miss McIntosh checked out two hours early, against all our advice. If she cannot complete the program, we cannot take responsibility for the repercussions." In a posting on the supermodel's blog, Kerry told fans that she is now on her way to a new rest facility in the Bahamas, "An enema and a game of tennis and I'll be back on track. If I'm going to face my demons, I want to do it with an ocean view."
zh: 昨晚，凯里･麦金托什还没走出戒毒所12步，就因酒驾、毒驾和持有管制物品被警方逮捕。据悉，其持有的管制物品为少量可卡因。得知凯里的名人身份后，警方让她签了几个名，并对其警告了一番，随后释放了她。根据其经纪人发表的声明，麦金托什已决定起诉洛圣都的一家戒毒中心，因为她的状态与4天前进入戒毒中心时一样糟糕。经营这家六万一晚的戒毒中心的莱尼 廷德曼本人也是个酒鬼，他告诉记者：「麦金托什小姐不顾我们的劝阻，提前两小时结帐离开了我们中心。由于她没有完全完成戒毒疗程，我们不会对事后的复吸负责。」在这位超模的一篇博客中，她告诉粉丝说她即将前往巴哈马，去一家当地新开的设施进行疗养，「灌个肠，打局网球，我就能回到正轨了。如果我要面对心魔，我想在能看到海景的地方面对它。」

english: The Air Sol pilot who reportedly downed six gin-and-tonics, five whiskies and a tequila worm before and during a two-hour flight from Vice City to Francis International has apologized for the drunken antics that put the lives of 212 passengers at risk. He told reporters, "I'm sorry if anybody was frightened. We always have a little loosener on the plane but I was trying to impress the new airhostesses and may have got a little carried away when I exposed myself and said 'grab the stick honey.' Normally we leave this kind of thing for the staff lounge after work. I'll never mix my spirits again." The 48-year-old Broker resident has been suspended from flying for two weeks by Air Sol and has told friends that he is enjoying his time off.
zh: 醉酒驾驶的Air Sol飞行员终于对将212名乘客的生命置于危险之中进行道歉。据报道，他在起飞前和自罪城飞往自由城的2小时中喝下了六杯琴汤尼、五杯威士忌和一杯龙舌兰。他对记者说：「吓到了一些乘客我很抱歉。我们一般都会在飞机上喝点小酒，但当时我想在新来的空姐面前表现一下，就有点昏了头，脱掉了自己的衣物对空姐说『抓住棍子，宝贝。』这种事通常是下班后在员工休息室做的。下次我不会再犯迷糊了。」这位来自布洛克的48岁机长已被Air Sol公司勒令停飞两周，他告诉朋友们说他很享受他的假期。

english: Nightlife king, "Gay" Tony Prince spoke out yesterday after he had two clubs closed by the city. He said that the city should not try to turn itself into a version of the Midwest. Mr. Prince, who has run clubs in the city for 25 years, been to rehab 5 times, and also incarcerated for tax evasion, commented, "I don't have a traditional family. I don't care about family values. That's why l live and work in Liberty City. If I wanted to go to bed at 8pm and worry about noise and hate people who weren't identical to me, I would go and live in Ohio. Nothing against Ohio. I went there once. I just used it as an example. Liberty City is supposed to be threatening and dangerous and challenging. Right now, it's about as challenging as a dog show." The LCPD spokesman we interviewed noted, "Mr. Prince's clubs were violating 8 city ordinances, and were undoubtedly places where drugs were being consumed. He is lucky he is not back in jail."
zh: 夜生活之王「基佬」托尼･普林斯经营的两家夜店被当局勒令停业。昨天他对此事进行了表态，称自由城不应成为中西部的翻版。普林斯先生在自由城经营夜店已有25年，被判5次强制戒毒，还曾因逃税而被监禁。他评论说：「我没有传统的家庭，我不在乎家庭观念，所以我才在自由城生活、工作。如果才八点我就想睡了，一边还担心噪音、讨厌那些跟我不同的人，我就会选择搬到俄亥俄住。我不是要抹黑俄亥俄，那里我去过一次，我只是拿它举个例子。自由城应该具有威胁、富于危险、充满挑战。现在，自由城的挑战水平大概跟狗狗秀差不多。」我们采访的LCPD发言人指出：「普林斯先生的夜店违反了8项城市条例，而且我们确定他的夜店是吸毒场所。没把他抓回监狱已经是他走运了。」

english: These are lies. Our workforce is strictly volunteer now and besides, what would you rather do? Starve or earn 10 cents an hour? 401k and gym membership isn't going to put food on their floor. Children require less sleep and women are better at multi-tasking. It's simply good business sense. We spend billions every year on advertising and celebrity endorsements and that has to come from somewhere." The battle over morality vs. overpriced sports fashion continues to rage. Many of Eris's sponsored athletes came out in support of the company, saying they were each getting paid $10 million to wear the logo and the human rights scandal is overblown.
zh: 但这些抨击都是谎言。我们的工人一直都是自愿工作，如果让你选，你会选择饿死还是10美分的时薪？企业年金和健身房使用权可没法让他们填饱肚子。童工需要的睡眠时间更短，女性更擅长一心多用。这是很正常的商业考量。我们每年都会在广告宣传和名人代言上投入数十亿资金，这笔钱总得有个来由。这场关于道德和价格虚高的运动产品的争论仍在持续，而且愈演愈烈。许多Eris赞助的运动员为Eris公司发声，表示他们都拿到了一千万的代言费，所谓的人权丑闻是夸大其辞。

english: Arch conservative and political gay basher, Bryce Dawkins, was yesterday hiding in rehab after he was discovered to have a double life. As well as a wife and children, Mr. Dawkins also had a boyfriend whom he kept in an apartment that the city financed. Photographs have emerged of Mr. Dawkins kissing Bernie Crane, his guest. Mr. Dawkins released a statement that read, "I am 100% heterosexual. Things look bad, but the evidence is just circumstantial. I do however have a substance abuse problem, which I am dealing with and I also have been addicted to bad behaviors, including visiting lap dancing clubs. I love women. Look at my wife. She's satisfied. Please leave my family alone. We need privacy. I (will) continue to stand up for what I believe in, even if I am just a man and a work in progress. I'm not gay and I never have been. Quite the opposite. I just have a soft spot for sad people who need looking after.

Although he had been indicted several times, Mr. Gravelli was never convicted of a serious crime. Some believed he had contacts within the government who protected him, and for whom he would get criminal associates to perform hits and other crimes, but these allegations were never substantiated. While they have only so far been found in Amsterdam and Belfast, authorities believe that the notes are being manufactured with the backing of a national government. Speculation is rampant that this is the work of a terrorist state or a communist power. To this reporter, however, a campaign this cowardly and vindictive points to only one possible perpetrator - France.

Previously, US authorities had only found these bills in Europe and Asia. Suddenly, they are appearing in huge quantities on home soil. These counterfeits are too sophisticated to be manufactured on a homemade press in this country.

A new range of adult protective underwear called Flypers has been selling out in airports across the country. We used to have the most envied airline industry in the world. Now we sit in our filth for five hours. Like foreigners.
zh: 现在航班上的一切都要收费。细菌遍布的枕头？十块。一杯热水？五块。满是脚趾甲和干呕吐物的舱内杂志？四块。快过期的小零食？六块。最令人气愤的是，得花三块才能到棺材大小的卫生间里上一次厕所。一种名为「飞人」的成人纸尿裤正在全国各大机场热销。我们曾经有过世界上最成功的航空业。现在却只能在脏兮兮的机舱里熬过5小时，就像外国人一样。

english: Remember the good old days of air travel? Getting served endless miniature bottles of cheap vodka by statuesque blondes in low-cut tops and short skirts? Flying used to be considered the height of luxury. Now you have to print off your own ticket, check in your own bags and submit yourself to humiliating security checks before being herded like cattle onto a filthy plane to sit for 2 hours on the runway because an undertrained stoner in air traffic control hit ESC by mistake.
zh: 还记得航空旅行的辉煌曾经吗？低胸短裙的金发美女不断为你续上廉价伏特加？坐飞机曾被认为是一种奢侈的体验。现在你得自己打印机票，自己托运行李，还被迫接受耻辱的安检，然后才能像牲口一样被赶上肮脏的飞机，再在机舱里坐上两个小时等待起飞，仅仅因为一个训练不足的瘾君子在空管室手滑按下了ESC键。

english: Brokerage firms were rocked yesterday by the news that some of the people who work there are not corrupt, greedy rule breakers. After a wide spread investigation into insider trading and corporate greed, the FIB only arrested 20 brokers at three brokerage firms in northern Alderney yesterday, which represented only 35 per cent of the work force. Human resource professionals at all the firms were humiliated to discover they had employed as up to 65 per cent of their work force people who are not morally destitute and greedy as can be. One CEO commented to us "How are we supposed to make our growth targets and raise our share price if we are not taking undue risks with other people's money, driven on by the desperate greed of our brokers? I'm appalled at what is happening in this town." Federal investigators promised to search out more corruption on the exchange and make sure those found guilty are properly punished with book deals and talk show appearances.
zh: 各大证券公司被昨天的一则消息震惊，因为公司内竟然有不腐败、不贪婪、遵守规矩的经理人。在一场针对内幕交易和企业贪婪的大规模调查后，FIB仅逮捕了3家北奥尔德尼券商的20名经理人，只占该行业从业者的35%。各大券商的人力资源部门纷纷以此为耻，因为他们雇佣的人中竟有65%的人拥有道德，不够贪婪。一名CEO告诉本报：「如果不拿别人的钱冒险，不雇贪婪至极的经理人，我们怎么实现营业额增长目标，怎么抬高公司股价？这里发生的事情令我震惊。」联邦探员保证会在证券交易所中查出更多腐败，并会让违法者得到应有的惩罚，让他们出书或是亮相脱口秀。

Tragically, his life took a turn for the worse. After positive drug tests, the loss of his weight supplement sponsorship deal, and alleged involvement in a male escort business he hit rock bottom.

english: A Los Santos man, who was prescribed medical marijuana for his glaucoma, has filed a lawsuit against his doctor and Cluckin Bell after ballooning from 180 to 350 pounds in less than six months. Phil Rosenburg, who can now back-roll a perfect blunt with just one hand, claims that he was not adequately informed of the side effects of his new medication. Rosenburg's attorney told Weazel News that his client now regularly devours a stuffed Pollo Toto Frito, a jar of mayonnaise, three pizzas and a plate of chocolate brownies covered in ranch sauce. He's lost his wallet seventeen times in the last month, developed an obsession with iconic bands of the 1970s and has started expressing increasingly left-wing political views. This is a landmark case and, if Rosenburg is awarded damages, predatory law firms are gearing up to get a class action suit against God, who created weed in the first place.
zh: 洛圣都一男子在服用了医生为治疗他的青光眼所开的医用大麻后，在不到六个月时间内体重从160斤激增到了320斤。在经历了这一切后，他对他的医生和铛铛钟正式提起诉讼。这位名叫菲尔･罗森堡的男子现在只用一只手就可以轻松地卷好完美的大麻烟。他声称医生在开药时并未向其阐明新药方的副作用。罗森堡的律师跟Weazel新闻透露说，他的这位患者现在经常狼吞虎咽地吃掉填酱的意式烤面包卷、一整罐蛋黄酱、三个披萨还有一碟子淋满了田园沙拉酱的巧克力布朗尼。仅仅是在过去的1个月里，这位患者就丢了17次钱包，在迷上了上世纪70年代的偶像乐队的同时，他的政治立场也越发左倾。这一诉讼在法律史上具有里程碑的意义。若是罗森堡起诉成功得到损失费，虎视眈眈的众多律师事务所会向上帝提起集体诉讼，因为大麻是由上帝创造出来的。

english: Just as workers were getting their work-life balance back, corporations are crushing resistance, forcing employees to stay at their constraining cubicles, not surf the internet for seventy five percent of the day, and show up on time. Another casualty this week as Sandra McColland collapsed while at work. Many therapists and holistic specialists believe an open attendance policy, lack of management hierarchy, and daily breaks to catch up on literature about celebrities creates a happy and fruitful workplace.
zh: 一如工人们想夺回他们工作与生活的平衡，企业也在进行反抗。他们逼迫职工呆在工位上，让他们一天有75%的时间不能网上冲浪，还要求他们每天准时出勤。本周还有一个噩耗，桑德拉･麦科兰在工作时昏倒。许多治疗师和调养专家认为，快乐而又高效的工作环境需要满足以下条件：包容的出勤考核，缺失的管理体系，用于阅读名人八卦的每日休息时间。

english: Are you incontinent, diabetic or menstruating? Make sure you arrive at the airport with a big bag of quarters for your next flight (although be aware that you'll probably exceed your weight allowance). In a last-ditch attempt to sustain their record levels of profit, Air Sol has announced that pay toilets have been installed on all its aircraft. Passengers will now be charged $2 for a number one and $3 for a number two. Where will this lunacy end? $20 for a life jacket? And, yes, before all the CEOs start whining from the top of their ivory towers, we know what's at the root of all this nickel-and-diming: Oil.

english: Sweatshops. That's what the ragged, broken American college student finds when they hit the workforce. Fresh out of college, a place of learning, they want time to balance life by taking long hikes, getting colon cleansing, writing in a journal! How do we expect people to be part of a democracy when they are bogged down by oppressive work 8-9 hours a day? We feel sad for Sandra McColland, she's standing up for herself and fighting corporate America. Good for you. You go girl. These conservatives will take every ounce of your being. Sue them till they get a clue that work is about more than working.
zh: 广大落魄的美国大学生加入劳动大军时所遇到的是血汗工厂。刚从大学这片知识天地毕业的他们，需要时间远足、洗肠、写日记，借此平来衡生活！如果人们被每天八九个小时的强制劳动绑架，他们还怎么参与到民主社会当中？桑德拉･麦科兰为自己发声，并与美国企业界进行抗争，我们为她的遭遇感到难过。你真行，加油姑娘。这些保守派会榨干你的每分每毫。起诉他们，让他们认清劳动不仅仅是干活。
